tei:div.tei:p: hā:bye ni gu/ 1 bca 'ab 3777ne bya 8330lung0606ba 'ang 505 5 3 3 17 bci kho migaXng khukhu po khor
rte /༷༷/nye 9 0ci(sta 5)cing ri kṣe ༷ hwa ci'i/ji sna 'i nyu nga cho ga — sde sta/ te 4//7rtse la dī hūṃ hūṃ 249 sa ci sta/ 〉 (4sa nu / sa rdo stordo 〈pe
snyeshi// / / / rno// / / /
— kyi ga /sde / / snyo / choX nga // / yo go

dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib la dug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i snye dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par dul brtan mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes ma ske ske'agog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin glu legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu kho//spung ge'i bod rig pa dpe lhan khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi ga khog tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nor te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las dar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshos bas phyog ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba pa'i tshes 7la/3

ba//sgrig gsal bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogasasgrig khang nasaspyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang / de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags (kan 6) rtogana' ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) 'a) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum sto pod rtags la khong2) (ja3) 'a4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags6) storgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags 6)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogasachosatshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags kho)ste bstod tshogasadangos grub rgya mtsho sogasachos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (pa) (mi (tshanaste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bachedasarin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza/ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chosatshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma khi)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshamasakyi nad brgya 'jomasapa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma (ga)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma (geste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lalja mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du lalji'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/()

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ rmad la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser ka khug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshos bas phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog cesabyar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ ratna'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi bande zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'khrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' lo snal bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor /lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khrag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar /3debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sdo khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhis mchode rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser ra khrog nang brten dpe rnying 'tshos bas phyogs ga khang nas/0

dkar chagasku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang gi glegs bam dang po/ (1)myos ldan zhes pa sa mo yos lo'i byed grub bzang ldan skar nag dgongs bstun gyi le'u tho bal ga dar du bzos pa'i lo bshad dag byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun sogs/ (1)chu mo lug lo'i skar nag dgongs bstun gyi le'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo bshad lkog gyur gzugs brnyan gsal ba'i rdzing bu sogs/ (10)shing mo bya lo'i skar nag dgongs bstun gyi le'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo bshad 'chi med bdag po'i lag nyal sogs/ (20)me mo phag lo'i skar nag dgongs bstun gyi le'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo bshad kun tu dga' ba'i dbyangs sogs/ (29)bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos hor sog la nye bar mkho ba'i khrims yig gsar rtsom mdzad rtsis kyi 'go rgyangs mchod brjod rnam par rgyal ba'i rdza rnga sogs/ (54)gong nas bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal por tham ka 'ja' sa gnang ba'i dus jo bo shākya mu nir tham phud phul pa'i kha yig gnam gyi she mong dpal 'bar sogs/ (70)chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi 'du khang la rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing gi ldebs bris byas skabs zhal byang tshigs su bcad pa ngo mtshar dpag bsam snye ma rbe1gas/ (74)1

dga' ldan pho brang gi gzims chung rab gsal gyi ldebs bris la jo bo chen po'i lam yig bris pa'i rten ga sdu'i mtshan byang phan bde'i srog 'tsho sogs/ (123)phyag mdzod sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyi tham ka gsar du brkos pa'i tham phud 'phags pa lo ke shwa rar phul ba'i kha yig legs tshogs lhun grub sogs/ (129)dwags po lcang ra ba sa skyong mgon po tshe brtan gyis thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba par du brkos pa'i par byang nges legs sgo 'byed sogs/ 5143)lcags phyi'i lo mchod yon thun mong gi tham ka dmar po gsar du bskrun pa'i tham phud 'dod khams dbang phyug mar phul ba'i kha yig 'dzam gling 'dod 'jo'i mngal khur sogs/ (156)rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i 'du khang gsang sngags pho brang gi sbug mgon khang zhi khro rnam rol gyi kha byang sgo'i shing bzang la bkod pa zhing khams rgya mtsho sogs/ (175)phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i grwa tshang bkra shis khang gsar gyi bkra shis ka bzhi'i rten mchod kyi deb kyi mchod brjod 'dod don kun 'grub sogs/ (182)pho brang chen po po ta la'i li ma lha khang gi deb ther gsar bsgrigs kyi mchod brjod nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'byed sogs/ (193)mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong gi tham phud lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du phul ba'i kha yig 'tshams sprin gsar pa'i lang tsho sogs/ (209)sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa'i gleng gzhi'i zhal byed don dam dbyings nas shar ba'i nyi 'od sogs/ (220)bkra shis lhun po'i dngul gdung gsar pa'i deb kyi mchod brjod rin cen gan mdzod sogs/ (230)2

g.yas ru gtsang gi ban sngags bon gsum gyi sder mang 'gyed dang mnga' 'bangs la 'bru 'gyed star chags su gtong ba'i deb kyi 'go brjod legs byas ga dma'i chu rgyun sogs/ 4238)chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi dri gtsang khang gi mchod rdzas kyi deb ther 'go brjod srid zhi'i dpal 'byor 'khyil ba'i gser gzheng sogs/ (266)pho brang chen po po ta la'i go mdzod rdo rje gling gi g.yul chas rnams kyi deb ther le tshan gyi 'go brjod sdeb sbyor rgyun chags dang po gtum po'i char 'bebs sogs/ 4275)sa bya yar klung gi sa'i cha ri bo chos gling gi gtsug lag khang gtsang khang mgon khang bcas pa'i mchod rdzas kyi deb ther 'go brjod du bkod pa ba le'i kha nas babs pa'i nor bu dga' 'khyil sogs/ 4293)byams gling em phyi sangs rgyas 'byung gnas kyi gra thang du gnas brtan bcu drug gi gos sku phul ba'i deb kyi 'go brjod snyan grags dpal 'bar sogs/ (326)

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnar༅༅/ /sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang gi glegs bam dang po bzhugs/ /myos ldan zhes pa sa mo yos lo'i byed grub bzang ldan skar nag dgongs bstun gyi le'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo bshad dag byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun sogs/༄7/ /na ma shrī ma spro tha mānā mutta ma nā byu/ phun tshogs ji snyed dkyil 'khor 'khor lo kun gyi mchog gyur dpal ldan thog ma'i mgon/ /mgon po gang de'i lam kun kun nas lus pa med par ston pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /rgyud don tshul bzhin rgyas mdzad mdzad pas yongs gang zla bzang la sogs 'jam dpal grags/ /grags snyan srid pa gsum khyab khyab bdag bla ma'i tshogs kyis dge legs 'bras bu stsol/ /rgyal ba kun yum yid bzhin 'khor lo ma/ /ma lus dbang du sdud mdzad rig byed lha/ /lha mchog ngag gi dbang phyug tshangs sras zhabs/ /zhabs pad dus kun rgyun du spyi bos bsten/ /dpal stug bstan pa 'chi med skyed tshal du/ /mkhas mang rkang 'thung 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /blo bzang ha ri tsas stong po la/ /grags pa'i dri bsung 'phro der gus pas 'dud/ /dri med 'od kyi sna tshogs(2na chin chen 'phreng / /phyi nang gzhan gsum dar gyi srad bu la/ /legs drangs skal ldan na chung — 1 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)mgrin rgyan du/ /'god mkhas dus 'khor zhabs pa chos kyi grags/ /sna mang mkhas dang grub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /lung rtogs yid bzhin nor bzang dbang gi rgyal/ /mngon par rab bkod yon tan phung po'i khur/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di yis theg pa mtshar/ /lhun grub gtsug lag rgya mtsho chen po las/ /legs 'ongs skar rtsis rta ljang 'od rnon gyis/ /phyogs 'di'i log rtog mun tshogs 'joms mdzad pa/ /khu dbon brgyud par bcas pa rtag tu rgyal/ /'di na mdzub mo ngal byed gzhung mang tshogs/ /ma lus spangs nas mkhas pa'i gsung gi phul/ /pad dkar zhal gyi lung bzang dgongs don bzhin/ /'brul med ri mos gtan la deng 'dir 'bebs/ /'phags pa'i yul du pra ma tir brjod pa/ /de yi skad bsgyur bde mchog bstod 'grel las/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir myos ldan zhes su 'bod/ /'dren mchog bu ram shing pa lcags sprel lor/ /legs par bltams nas bug gter mda' (2ba thag 'das/ /pho brang chen po byang phyogs ka lwa par/ /rigs ldan seng ge mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir/ /zhabs sen mngon par 'khod nas nyi ma'i lor/ /(rgya gar)grub rtsis lo gza' bde 'byung gtsug rgyan gyi/ /mkha' glang legs 'khrigs char 'bab sman bcud ldan/ /chu klung lteng ka nags tshal me tog rgyas/ /'jig rten lhas skyong khyad par rje rigs bde/ /stong dang drug brgya nyi shu'i yul gru na/ khyu skar lha mo sa khams gdu bu yis/ /lo yi bdag byed gos bu ston pa la/ /snag gi gnyen mchog rigs kyi gcen po dang / /phyi skyes tshogs rnams longs spyod rab rgyas shing / /lusacan kun bde chos spyod skyong rnams la/ /nad kyi gnod pas cung zad nye bar 'tshe/ /nub phyogs mgron skar 'bras bu phal cher bzang / khāe rol)byed pa'i lo gza' drang srong gsal ldan gyis/ /yul khams bde zhing lo tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /rgyal 'bangs dga' ston la rol khrims kyis 'tsho//mkhas rnams yon tan ldan zhing tshangs byung bde/ /rgyal sar lha min bla ma legs gnas shing / /blon po chu shel dbang po'i lo 'bras la/ /'jig rten bde zhing 'bru nor longs spyod rgyas/ /khyad par bud med rkang bzhi phyugs rnams bde/ /(rgya nag)dbang phyogs rgyal por sa mo yos brjod pa/ /'byung ba —2

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhongs dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (mnagasum ldan kha ral zla ba'i klungs//dgu gling dbus su lde thung btsun mo gnas//gtsug lag de nyid gsang ba'i tshig las ni//blon gyis rgyal la rtsod cing so zar btson//gnag rnams 'bring zhing 'bru yi tsho gos spyi snyoms//yams3na khod chom rkun dar sogs 'bras ga yang //dkar po'i phyogasakyis nag phyogs bcil ba'i dge/de ltar gtsug lag gdong bzhi'i mgo skyes las//bdag blo skal ldan shing rtas legs drangs pa'i//skar nag rtsis kyi dza hu'i bu mo yis//blo gsal 'jug pa bcu pa'i dga' ston rgyas/'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis sa yos dgung geg rde'u zhe bdun ma'i sgo nas myul ba'i khra ma'i chos spyod sbor thang rnam bkra/dpag yas mkhyen pa'i lha lam yangs pa la//brtse chen rta bdun bdag po'i 'od stong gis//blo gros padma'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad pa//smra ba'i seng ge 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud//rgya nag rtsis kyi gzhung lugs ma lus pa//rgyas mdzad rgya bod mkhas grub tsho gos spyi dang //khyad par phyogs 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed mkhan//dpal mgon 'phrin las bdag blo'i pad mtsho skyongs//sa bos sto zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga'i wo shar gling nas zla ba dus mes gzung bsto pa'i mus lho gling 'dir wor ba'i sgo yig ma 'ongs ma' sum ston pa'i me long /ro rkyang pad dkar sa mos gnyen gyi khams/twa tī seng ge ma bu'i dkyil 'khor du//bcoms nas mchogo tu 'gyur med bde wo la//rol mdzad dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog khyud rgyal spel mdzad zla ba bzang po nas//phyag na 'khor lo'i bar du rim byon pa//chos rgyal rigs ldan mig brtse'i grangs tshogis dang //'phags yul puṇḍa3ba chi ga'i tshal rpā rnams//bsdus rgyud 'od zer 'phreng bas rgyas mdzad pa//dus zhabs 'od dkar can sogasapaṇḍita//gdong bzhi'i mgo skyes dang mtshungs yul dbus nas//dza sna'i bu mo lta bu'i rgyud rgyal rnams//pad dkar mig 'dra'i mtha' 'khob bod yul 'dir//zhabs bsil rjes 'gro'i zab lam rgyas bya'i phyir//rgyal rigs skal ldan shing rtar 'gran bzod pa//skad gnyis smra ba lo chen gshong ston zhabs//rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gser gyi 'khor lo yis//dbang sgyur chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa//khyad par phyogs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)'dir 'khrul pa'i dri ma'i tshogs/ /rab spangs dus 'khor zhabs pa chos kyi grags/ /lam mchog yid bawo nor bu'i bang mdzod la/ /bzang po'i mdzad pas dbang sgyur chos kyi rje/ /lhun grub gas lag 'chi med dga' tshal du/ /skar rtsis gzhung lugs rkang 'thung phreng ba'i tshogs/ /mkhyen rab rgya mtshos ches cher rgyas mdzad pa/ khu dbon rjes 'brang brgyud par bcas pa la/ /deng nas bzung ste kha sbyor bdun ldan gyi/ /go 'phang ma thob bar du 'dud par spro/'phags pa'i yul du pra ma ti zhes brjod/ /phyogs 'dir myos ldan lor grags dbang thang dang / /bas pa'i skad dod sa mo yos kyi lor/ /'dren mchog kun mtho bu ram shing pa'i zhabs/ /drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u'i lor/ /legs par bltams nas2599(4na sta skos stong lnga brgya dang / /go dgu 'das shing pho brang shambha lar/ /rigs ldan seng ge mi 'jigs khrir 'khod nas/ /nyi ma 12'das pa 'khrul med rtsis kyi lor/ shar phyogs rgyal khab ston zla ra bar grags/ /mkha' me'i zhag gi grangs ldan me pho sprel/ /lugs 'dir dbyar ra ston gyis nya ba yi/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa la/ /gnyis skyes rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas par/ /sna tshogs gtsug phud dag gis sgrib pa'i tshul/ /byed grub dgongs pa gcig bsdus deng 'dir spro/nyin gyi chu tshod so gnyis rdzogs 'tshams nas zla ba la sgra gcan 'jug /chu tshod gcig rdzogs nas lhag drug gi ring gling 'di nas mthong / shar gling du me lha'i phyogs nas 'dzin/ nub byang nasagatong / gza' lhag pa dang skar ma skrubs kyi steng du bzung bas 'bru mang / 'bras bu dang 'o ma 'phel/ char che/ lo phyugs legs/ de ltar 'od dkar can gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /mi mthun dus mes sgrib tshul 'char yun sogs/ /byed grub man ngag mkhas pa'i dgongs don ltar/ /rta bdun bdag po 'khrig khyim babs pa yi/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa la/ /dbus 'gyur 'bras spungs chos kyi sdo' por/ /bkod pa'i dge des dpal ldan dus 'khor lo'i/ /lugs bzang dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas gyur cig /(4bskogs pho 'brug lo'i skar nag dgongs bstun gyi le'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo bshad drang 4

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (mnasrong dga' ba'i shā/tsā kṣa sde su khyu tsā ma hā ba santa ni lhas sgo sgyu tswa'i rta shu ā gra/na ṭa kyu kā nā gi lum brgya kaky-i/byu cu ni tta sdi buddhaXrmis na///phul byung mi 'gyur bde chen lang tsho'i dpyid//rten dang brten pa'i mdzes sdug zur mig gi/zlos gar rnam par spro ba'i byed po mchog/dang po'i sangs rgyas ri dwags mig can rgyal/shel dkar lhun po'i mdangs ldan sgra dbyangs lha//lha sogs srid gsum gtsug 'gying dbang gi rgyal//rgyal kun ma lus skyed byed legs sbyin ma//ma ltar brtser dgongs mchogo thun dngos grub stsol//sngo bsangs ma der ldan khong rtsi'i rgyal mtshan can//'dab stong zum zhes smra ba nges rdzun te//lag rtse'i grangs ldan mi dbang mkhyen 'od kyis//'gog med rgyud don pad tshal bzhad 'di gang //brgya phrag bgrod dka' lam gyi na bkra'i grong //snying stobs gzings las rgyal khab nor gling du//legs son phyi nang gzhan gsum yid bzhi dbang //nges don dgos 'dod stsol mdzad lo paṇa tshogs//rgya chen rgyud sde'i chos kyiXlha ga'i//grags pa'i sgra dbyangs rab bsgrags dus 'khor zhabs//shes rab byed pos legs sbyar rin chen mchog/thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtser 'god lo tsā ba//bde chen zla ba'i ma mar rtag rol yang //ches phra rig pa'i yid bzhin nor bzang mthus//legs bshad 'dod rgu rgya mtsho'i gos can bar/khyab mdzad mkhas grub gdengs can 'dren par 'dud//rnam dpyod lhun grub stobs kyi 'brul 'khor las//gtsug lag rgya mtsho blo gros lto bar 'jug/dpal ldan thog ma'i mgon gyi 'phrin las rnams//spel mdzad mkhas dbang brgyud par bcas pa rgyal//gang de'i rig byed gzhung gi chu gter las//drang srong gsang tshig bum bzang bdud rtsi'i bcud/khyim zhag 'khor lo'i rin cen yol go'i nang //mngon par 'geng la bdag yid spro dga' brtas//dbus 'gyur 'amang du bī ra zhes brjod pa//gang de skad bsgyur bde mchog bstod 'grel las//gangs can ljongs 'dir dpa' bo zhes su 'bod//stobs bcu mnga' 5bsgo kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras//lcags sprel lor bltams mkha' mkha' dus mig 'das//pho brang chen po byang phyogs ka lā

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)par/ /rigs ldan seng ge 'jigs bral 'phrog byed khrir/ /zhabs zung mngon par 'khod nas 'dod 13pa'i lor/ /(mar)grub rtsis log za' sngo bsangs lus can gyis/ /'chi med lam du sprin 'khrig gru char 'bab/ /rtsi shing lo rtag rab rgyas 'jig rten dar/ /mkhas pa'i skyes bu chos ldan grags pa thob/ /rta bdun dbang po lug gi skyed tshal nang / /mngon slebs dmar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i nyin/ /drang srong 'chi med bla ma rang 'gros kyis/ /dal bus rgyu zhing spyod pa'i mi lhung phreng / /stong dang drug brgya nyi shu'i yul gru nas/ /'bab ldan khams las legs grub chu stod kyis/ /lo yi bdag byed 'bras bu ston pa la/ /mkha' las rlud gi 'bras 'byung lo tog rgyas/ /yul gru la lar tsha ba'i 'jigasapa yis/ /kun gsal mdzes ma nam mkha'i glang po'i gos/ /mngon par bral bas lo tog mi smin cing / /bde dang yib rtsod nyer 'tshe 'dres mar 'ong / /khāe rol)byed pa'i lo gza' skyed byed bdun pa yis/ gru char legs 'bab 'bru dang rtsi shing rgyas/ /rta glang 'phel zhing 'jig rten lha yis skyong //mi phyugs nad bral khyad par bram ze bde/ /rgyal po chu shel dbang po la gnas shing / /blon po drang srong blo ldan lo gos la/ /rlung gi zhin skang rta'i bcud kyis gser ldan ma/ /kun khyab sman bcud nyal 'gro rkang 'thung rgyas/ /khyu mchog la sogs bzhone rnams 'o ma 'phel/ /mi rje byams pas 'bangasaskyong rje rigs bde/ /tshangs byung rig byed spro zhing gzhen nu rnams/ /rtsed 'jo la rol blo ldan rig pa rgyas/ /(dbyangs lang)g.yul las rnam par rgyal zhes mgrin sngon gyi/ /gsang tshig 'khrul med 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ /yul dbus 'bod grogs 'bab ldan lho'i phyogs su/ /bgrang bya ma rdzogasabar dang rgyal zla ba'i/ /phyi ma'i phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po nas/ /rje 'bangs rnams la 'thab rtsod nad rims sogs/ /duḥkhas gtses la dge tshogs bsod nams kyis/ /thub ces tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gzhung las gsungs/ /(rgya nag)dbang phyogs rgyal por lcags pho 'brug brjod pa/ /'byung ba gsum ldan se shig mig dmar klungs/ /dgu gling dbus su g.yang gi me long gnas/ /gtsug lag de nyid gsang ba'i tshig la ni/ /gro dang dkar mo bzang zhing so zar 'bring / /char che nam stod than —6

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)zhing nam smad zhed/ /yul 'pho bkren grang la sogs 'bras ngan yang / /dbang thang mis dbang dkar phyogs stobs kyis dge /de ltar rgyud rgyal dgongs don byed grub rtsis/ /gtsug na zla ba'i gsang tshig dbyangs 'char gzhung / /rgya nag mkhasapa'i gtsug lag dgongs mthun par/ /bkod 'disaphun tshogs dga' ston dpal la rol/ /(6bskogasamo sbrul lo'i skar nag dgongasabs gyi le'u tho lag bdar du bzosapa'i lo ༅da rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mar/shrayākulasgrushrī/shatamadhya/ /maṇḍalatsakrosdinatsanāshā/ /pāpuṇanākṣatradumakalpa/ /shuyarbawalwargyupu'irusirnyi/ /dpal ldan phun tshogs rigs brgya'i nor 'dzin dbus/ khyu skar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i skyed tshal du/ /rab rgyas thog ma'i mgon po dpag bsam ljon/ /dngosagrub 'brasabu'i dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /rgyud rgyal padma'i tshal kun ma lus rgyas mdzad chos rgyal rigs ldan nyin byed dbang / /snying stobs brtson pasargyud 'grel dbus 'gyur 'chang du spel mkhas paṇa chen rnam pa gnyis/ /'phags yul rin cen gling nas lugs bzang nor bu len (7nangadzad lo chen ded dpon mchog /tshul 'dir bka' drin che ba'i rgyal blon mkhas grub tshogs kun zhabs zung spyi bor bsten/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal ster legasabyin ma/ /ma lus ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can lha/ /lha mchog srid gsum zil gnon dbang gi rgyal/ /rgyal yum rnam gsum dus kun phyag gi yul/ /grangasamed mkhas pa'i skyed tshal rab yangs par/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i yongs 'du sa brtol dbang / /rnam gsum mkhasapa'i mdzad mchog dri bsung gis/ /grags pa 'jig rten 'di na mngon par rgyas/ /dpal ldan chos kyi 'chi med rdza rnga'i grags pas kun khyab dus 'khor zhabs pa mig stong can/ khres rab rin chen shing rtasalnga rig gling bzhir dbang bsgyur lo chen 'khor losasgyur rgyal che/ /lung rtogasayid bzhin nor bzang mchog gi mkhasagrub rgya mtsho'i gosacan dbusan 'gran zla bral/ /lhun grub gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i mthar son dpal mgon 'phrin lasagragasapa'i ba dan rgyal gyur cig /gang zhig snga ma'i 'khrul pa kho na'i gzhung / /rmongs zhen dbang gis 'dzin pa'i blun po mang / / 7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)'khrul med grwa mda' phug pa'i lugs bzang gi/nyin byed spro bo shes ldan 'dab brgya 'dzum//'phagasapa'i yul du bṛ ṣa zhes su brjod//gang de'i skad bsgyur bde mchog stod 'grel las//srid pa'i ljongs 'dir khyu mchog ming du grags/rsām 'dren mi yi seng ge nyi ma'i 7bsko nyen//lcags sprel lor bltams gzugs mkha' dus mig 'das//pho brang chen po byang phyogs ka lā par//rigs ldan seng ge mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir//zhabs pad mngon par 'bod nas ma nu'i lor//(rgya gar)grub rtsis lo gza' drang srong phur bu yis/khru char legs 'bab 'jig rten lha yis skyong //mi phyugasand bral 'bru dang rtsi shing rgyas/rta glang 'phel zhing khyad par bram ze bde//nyin mor byed pa lug gi dga' tshal nang //rab slebs dkar phyogs ri bo'i tshes kyi nyin//lha yi bla ma rang 'gros stobasashugs kyis//dal bur rgyu zhing spyod pa'i rgyu skar 'phreng //stong dang drug brgya nyi shu'i yul gru nas//rgyu skar lha mo lag mig grangs 'dzin pas//lo yi bdag byed 'bras bu ston pa la/rtsi shing lo tog phun sum rab tshogs shing //me tog 'bras bu smin pa'i sa yi char//nad kyi 'jig pas cud zad gtses 'gyur zhing //gzhan dag yul kun phal cher bde skyid dang //dge ba'i dpal la spyod ces mgi par grags//9rol)byed pa'i lo gza' sngo bas pas lus can gyis//kun gsal mdzes mar sprin 'khrig char rṣa 'bab//'jig rten dar zhing rtsi shing lo tog rgyas//mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams phul byung grags pa thob//rgyal sar skyed byed 'dun pa la gnas pas//char 'bab 'dzin ma lo rtag gis mdzes shing //sa bdag mngon par mtho sogs 'bras 8na ) bzang yang //rgyal kha blon bsgyur bcu gnyis bdag po yis//char chung lo tog 'bru tsho gis mi 'phel zhing //nyi zla 'od bral chu rgyun tsha bas gdung //dka' thub can phyug mi phyugs nad kyis 'tshe//yul dbus dmag 'khrug la sogs 'byung bar 'gyur//(dbyangs lang)'jig rten mes po'i gtsug lag dbyangs 'char zhes//ma 'ongasamangon sum ston pa'i gsang tshig las//dbus 'gyur 'chang dang dbang po ka ling ka/a sa biṇḍa lho nub ko shan ta//yul gru chen po 'ga' ru rgyal phran la//nad rims mu ge 'thab rtsod la sogs pas/

sku gsung thug rten gsar tsongs dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas kha bzang gi dkar sha/ (mna'ajigs shing khyad par sa ga zla ba tso//hor yul 'jig cing de nas bde bar gyur//sgron zla nasabazung gangs can ba ru ṇa'i//yul du nad yams mu ge 'thab rtsod sogs//nyer 'tshe mang yang dkar phyogs bsod nams kyis//dga' bde'i dpal la spyod snyam yid la drang //(rgya nag)rgya nag rgyal khab lcags mo sprul brjod pa//'byung ba gsum ldan kha ral spen pa'i klungs//'khrul med skar mgo'i lugs la dgu gling dbus//brgyad dkar lha brgyad me long gnas pa'i lor//'bras dang so ba sran legs khre nongs shing //sna tshogs skad rigs mang dang gdang sad 'ong //lho nub nub byang dmag dang 'khrug pa dar//dbyar zla ra ba nas bzung ston mtha'i bar//nad kyis 'jigs shing 'bru yi tshogs rnams dkon//dbang thang mi min dbang sogs 'bras yang //phun tshogs rnam dkar dge ba'i byed po yis//nag phyogs ma lus 8ba'i joms pas rab tu dge/'khrugs sde bus ma shes phyogs re'i gzhung tsam la//zhen pa'i tshul spangs byed grub dbyangs 'char gzhung //rgya nag rtsis sogs dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu//bsdebs 'dis mkhas rnams dga' bde'i dpal la spyod//chu lug smon lam thog khal kha yer ti ni hong tha'i ris jo bo rin po cher dngul gyi maṇḍal phul pa'i kha yig sku gsum rgyal mtshan rtser mdzes/:gi lā lo warā ra snomaṇḍal lha tsā/da sti shornyo da ni tswa gu snyen bi ni/shā sa rnar smi da dhyā sa ha su pradzā su dma su khyuhitā utpa lha po khri tsā//dbyig ldan mdzes rgyan rin cen maṇḍal mchog/rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras drung phulaba'i dges//dpal stug bstan pa nyin byed 'od stong gis//skye rgu'i phan bde'i ༄ la rgyas pa dang /9nasgo ya yum siddhi rā/kho shrī bi sitā tsā tatta yaḥ/kho bha grwa gha na3s tsitta wa tra//dzñādzñākā mdzayantum rgya sto//phun sum tshogs pa tshe ring gnam gyi brgyud//dri med las san gang de'i rnam par dkar//dge tsho gos rgya mtshor grub pa'i yid bzhin nor//sku gsum rgyal mtshan rtse mor rgyal gyur cig/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()chu mo lug lo'i skar nag dgongs bstun gyi le'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo bshad lkog gyur gzugs bas gsal ba'i rdzing bu sogs/akta ra shā ni ni hi bstanā ma lha〉〈pe na a lidma yoḥrna//shri ye95khyad ya su rādzñā yiḥde rtsa nā shā resam bla lo kus/9bas 'gyur stong gzugs kun gsal lus phra ma//bde chen 'ja' ris kyis 'khrud zung 'jug sku nor//dge legs 'dod rgu stsol ba'i dbang gi rgyal//thog ma'i mgon pos dus kun shis par mdzod/phun tsho gos dge mtshan 'od stong 'bar ba'i snang bas rab mdzes ka lā pa yi grong khyer dbus//rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la yang skyengs pa ster byed rin chen brtsegs pa'i pho brang gi/gdong lngas bteg pa'i 'jigs bral khri steng zhabs zung 'dab stong mngon par bkra ba'i dri bsung gis//skal bzang ra yig gnyis pa'i dga' ston ci yang stsol mdzad chos rgyal rigs ldan tshogs rnams rgyal//'chi med 'dod 'jo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dpal//0na ) dpal mo'i snyems pa 'phrog pa ngag gi dbang //dbang phyug brgyad la mnga' sgyur rig byed ma//ma lus mchogo thun dngos grub stsal du gsol//grangs med rgyud sde'i dza ཿ'i zhal sgo las//rgyud 'grel chu klung 'bebasamakhas paṇa chen zung //gangs khrod phyi nang gzhan gsum kunda'i tshal//'dzum byed skad gnyis smra ba bsil zer can//rgya chen chos kyi dbyug gus grags pa'i rnga//sgra brgya phyogs bcur sgrogs mkhas dus zhabs pa/shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs rab yangs blo//rin cen mchog gis gzhal dka'i lo tsā ba//stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis nor bzang 'od gzi'i mdangs//rab yangs rgya mtsho'i gos can kun du 'bar//lhun grub rtsis gzhung rgya mtsho'i mthar son pas//'jigs med mkhas pa'i dbang po gra phug pa//tshul 'dir 'brul pa bral ba'i shing rta che//dpal mgon 'phrin las brgyud par bcas pa

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnargyal/ /phra mor dpyod pa'i rig lam tshul 'di la/ /rags rtsis mu cor smra ba'i glegs bam 'ga'/ /mthong tshe pad dkar zhal lung dgongs don bzhin/ /ri mor byed la dwangs pa'i spro ba 'phel/ /'phags yul 'dzin ma'i thig ler surya zhes/ /brjod pa skad bsgyur bde mchog bstod 'grel las/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir nyi ma zhes su 'bod/ /'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge'i zhabs/ /drag po ces pa lcags pho spre'u'i lor/ /dbus 'gyur stobs kyi 'khor re rgyal gyi/ /(10bsras su bltamasanas yon tan 2603mkha' dus dang / /lag pa 'das pa 'khrul med rtsis kyi lugs/ /grangs med grong khyer 'phreng mdzes shambha lar/ /chos srid bla na mtho ba'i 'jigs med khrir/ /rigs ldan seng ge zhabs zung rab 'khod nas/ /mtshams dang 'od dkar can du slebs pa'i lor/ /(rgya gar)grub rtsisalo gza' 'od zer bdun pa yis/ /rgyal po rtsod cing dus min rlung chen gyis/ /sa bzhin lha lam nyi zla'i 'od mdangs dman/ /char dkon 'bras bu mi smin mu ges 'jigs/ /mi phyugs nyams shing khyad par dpyod ldan 'tshe/ /mi bsrun rkan po gdol pa'i rigs rnams bde/ /rta ljang lug khyim 'phos pa bug mche'i nyin/ /dbyangs bdag myur 'gros spyod pa'i rgyu skar 'phreng / /stong dang 1620drug brgya nyi shu'i yul gru na/ /lo skar byang phyogs skyong ba nam gru'i 'bras/ /lo tsho gos legs shing khyad par sran ma smin/ /la lar mi smin rgyal po khrims kyang bsrung / /ṇa rol)byed pa'i lo gza' bde 'byung gtsug rgyan gyis/ /bar snang mdzes ma'i lto bar ma he sbul/ /rwa dbyibs lta bu'i sprin 'khrig char rgyun 'bebs/ /rtsi shing me tog lo 'bras g.yur za ldem/ /bzhen rnams 'o 'phel mi bdag yul 'khor skyong / /gzhen nu na chung sna tsho gos rgyan spud cing / /glu gar rol mo dus kyi rtsed 'jo yis/ /dga' ston la rol khyad par rje rigs bde/ /rgyal po zla bus rtsi shing rig pa 'phel/ /(11na tshe khru legasargyal 'bangs bde sogs 'bras bzang yang / /rgyal kha blon sgyur drang srong tshangs skyes kyis/ /yul 'khor mi phyugs 'tshe zhing 'bru tshogs dkon/ /bud med bus 'chi chu klung skem pa sogs/ /drang srong nyi bu'i 'bras bu cung zhig ngan/ /(dbyangs ra)legs ldan gtsug na zla ba'i gsang tshig las/ /— 1/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dbus 'gyur a sa biṇḍa gangs can ljongs//ko sho nta yi rje 'bangs grong khyer la//'thab rtsod dmag nad nyes pas rab tu gtses//hor zla bzhi pa nas bzung yul dbus bde//sag zla nas rta chen zla ba'i bar/khar nas nub bar phyogs dang mtshams lnga yi//g.yas bskor zla zung bcad de nye bar 'tshe//dbo zla nas bzung ka ling ka dang ni//hor dang ge sar yul gru 'jig pa sogs//'bras bu pha yang rnam dkar gzi 'od kyis//mi mas mun pa 'joms phyir mchog tu shis//(rgyan ga)rtse ṇa'i rgyal khab chu mo lug brjod pa//'byung ba bzhi ldan kha ral zla ba'i klungs//'khrul med skor mgo'i lugs la dgu gling dbus//drug dkar steng na yab lha dar dkar 'phyar//'bru rigs sa dang so ba khre rnams legs//bra sran rlon zhing char che gdong sad 'ong //rje blon 'byug cing mi phyugs nad kyis 'tshe//dbang thang mi min dbang sogs gos ngan yang //phul byung rnam dkar byed po'i dri gsung gis//nag phyogs tsha gdung 'joms pas rab tu dge/byed grub mgrin 11bsngon gtsug lag dbyangs 'char gzhung //dbang phyogs yul gru'i spor thang brgyad cu skor//ma 'ongs mngon sum ston pa rig pa'i 'phrul//gcig tu bsdebs 'dis blo gsal 'dod pa 'jo//rgyal ba 'a bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel du gyur pa'i mdo rgyud kyi blta bcos/phyi nang a mong pa'i tha snyad rig pa'i gtsog lag sogs glegs bam stong phrag tu nye ba'i dkar chag gsar du bsgrigs pa'i mchod brjod ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba//(notta ma su ni dhi ma hanaḥ.a:me gu rgya bhan bte dzuḥpra lha mo smos khriman lte he bus kā lika kuru5she//ye shes mchog gi chu gter chen po las//mi zad yon to 'od zer 'bar ba'i gzis//skye rgu'i snying gi mun sel gnyen gcig pu//zas gtsang sras kyis dus kun shis par mdzod//12na skom 'dren gsung rab mtha' yas lce yi mdzod//dbyangs bdun rgyud khugs mdo sngags za ma tog/'dzin mkhas rgya bod lo paṇa mkhas grub rnams//gzur gnas shes ldan kun gyi phyag bya'i gnas//gangs khrod rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dri bzhen gyis//rnam par 'geng ba'i chos rgyal mes dbon gsum//thub bstan lang tsho gsar ba'i dzi ba gas//yangs pa'i nor 'dzin legs mdzes zhi ba 'tsho//rgyal ba

sku gsung thugs rten gsar sa gos dang rin po stu mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnakun gyi mkhyen pa'i pha mthas kyang //gzhal dka' bka' drin zla med padma 'byung //lha chos bdun ldan bsil sbyin ga bur thigs//skal bzang snying la reg pa'i a ti sha//rgya chen blo gros tshang ching 'khrigs pa'i dbus//skal bzang dga' skyed yongs 'du sa brtol dbang //grags snyan 'khri shing phon po'i me rtag tshogs//srid gsum rna bar 'god mkhas rtag tu rgyal//sde snod rgyud sde'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gzhung //mkhas rnams 'asdug pa'i thun mong rig gnas lnga//ngo mtshar gtam gyis bskyed pa'i chos 'byung sogs//rmad byung glegs bam bzhugs tho 'di ltar ro//chos srid rigasa'abyor sogs kyis mchog dman bar pa'i yul du gyur pa rnams la 'phrin yig bsring ba'i kha byang sogs che chung rnam par dbye ba 'a brjed byang mdzad med nor bu' dpya/12bgu khyen ko ya lhag gad pi:byukaraḥbidhi sum ya//so do ru wa yi7tsa tsanda tsitta pā dan ra5thubha gir thun maḥ/rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang mdzod ga dma'i rgyun//sna tshogs brda sprod gzhung gi byed po yis//gangs can zla snying rkang par legs stsol ba'i/sgra sgyur thon mi skal ldan shing tor 'dud//gang de nas bzung rgya bod gsar rnying brdas//log smra tshar gcod blo gsal dga' ston rnams//spel mdzad chos skyong bzang po'i bar byon pa'i//lo chen rjes 'jug bcas pa rtag tu rgyal//mchog dman bar pa'i lus can nor gling nas//wen yig rdzing las don gyi rin rpā phreng //len phyir tshig gi sbyor ba'i ded dpon che//'gyur med dran gso'i khang bzang 'di na spro//13na skong pho sbrel lo' skar nag dgongs bstun gyi li'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo bshad glang chen shugs 'gro'i gom stabs/siddhi3bye shā nus ka la dharmā mā yadha na shul snyir kā lika /ākār su liṅgā shu co grwa bar tsa yub na hākālatsakra/mtha' dag brtan g.yo'i chos kyi sgyu ma'i nor//stong pa'i gzugs su grub pa na tshod gnas//ngo mtshar mchog gi lang tsho'i g.yon mig mas//'byud pas bde ba'i 'byung gnas dus 'khor lo//rtsod dus rdzogs ldan 'gugs byed bya ma rtar//stobs kyi 'khor lo'i shing rta mkhar 'phags pa//sa spyod chos rgyal bdun dang rigs ldan tshogs//dbang phyug yon tan brgyad kyis bla na mtho//mdzes

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)sdug bzhin (13ba)ras zla ltar rab dkar dkar 'jam yid 'ong 'chi ba'i srog 'phrog legs byin ma/ /ma drug mtshon ltar rnon po'i mkhyen rab rab yangs blo yis khrung khrung rmongs 'joms tshangs pa'i sras/ /sras bcas rgyal yum dngos kun ma lus lus pa med par rang gir legs mdzad dbang gi rgyal/ /rgyal bar gyur cig shis brjod dbyangs snyan snyan tshig sgrogs na lhag pa'i lha kye rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /phyi rol rig smra'i dbyar skyes gzhone nu'i 'bras/ /mkhyen brtse'i char gyis smin phyir 'jig rten dbang / /gtsug na zla ba'i zlos gar chu khur las/ /thal ba'i snying por gyur pa'i 'brug sgra dngar//snying stobs dri yi shing rta'i shugs kyis bgrod dka'i zla 'phel las brgal te/ /'phags yul nor bu'i gter gyi gling nas legs bshad rin cen drangs pa'i zong / /bsil ldan mang thos dpya yis 'phongs la rna ba'i bcud du ma smad dpyid/ /dpyod ldan ded dpon skad gnyis smra rnams gzur gnas yongs kyis phyag bya'i gnas/ /mchog gi dang po'i rin cen khang bzang dbus/ /'jigs bral smra ba'i gnyis 'thung steng 'gying ba/ /chos kun cig car gzigs pa'i mig stong can/ /log smra'i sbyin skyes las rgyal grags pa 'bar/ shes rab me long ngos su gnas lnga'i gzugs/ shar ba'i rin cen lta bu'i 'jig rten mig /'dod rgyal brda yis mkhas dang grub pa'i mtshan/ /'chang min don gyi kun mkhyen nor bu bzang / /dregs ldan sa 'dzin spo las lhun po ltar/ /(14na)zla bralagrub pa'i khur gyis rgya mtsho che/ /ma bzod rngul ba'i dal 'gro'i sgra 'byin par/ /byed pos dbyig gi blo gros klubs sam snyam/ /e ma dpal stug gsung gi bcud/ /thog ma'i mgon po'i brgyud kyi don//'khrul med ston pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /sgo 'phar 'byed mkhas grwa phug pa/ /kye ma tshul 'dir blo rmongs kyang / /snyems pas smra ba'i mu cor kyi/ /lugasang na rjes su blun po 'ga'/ /'brang yang shesaldan su zhig 'jug /de phyir blang dang dor bya la/ /nges brnyed mkhas pa'i bka' drin mthus/ / zhal lung dpyid kyi do shal las/ /ri mo'i u dum wā ra 'dzum/ /chu gter ske rags mdzes rgyan yul dbus su/ /legs sbyar skad du ka ra so rli gar/ /'bod pa bsgyur tshig bde mchog stod 'grel na/ /— /4

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas kha bzang gi dkar sha / (ma)su la'i ljongs su nyi sgrol byed ces grags/ /bu ram shing pa drag po lcags sprel lo/ /sa spyod mtho ris rgyal po zas gtsang gis/ /sras su 'khrungs nas rgya mtsho 2604mkha' 'tshams dang / /'khrig pa 'das pa tshad ldan mkhas pa'i lugs/ /phul byung rigs kyis ma rga par mtho ldan pas/ /gsang chen nā da'i seng ge'i nga ro'i dbyangs/ /cha bsags skye rgu'i sgra 'dzin legs brgyan pa/ /bzang po'i bskal pa dar babs ri gzugs lor/ /(rgya gar)grub mtha'i lo gza' gnyis skyes rgyal po yis/ /(14bsko lam bzhin snod brang 'gro bhra ma ra/ /tsandan ma he'i snang bas chu 'dzin las/ /char 'bab nags klung me tog lo 'bras rgyas/ /mi bdag sa skyong bzhen rnams 'o mar 'phel/ /yid 'ong rgyan gos kyis spras na chung dang / /skyes pa'i tsho gos rnams dga' ston rtsed 'jor rol/ /lo 'jug sad 'byung rje yi rigs rnams bde/ /rnam par rgyal ba lug gi lding khang du/ /bcu gnyis bdag pos rtse ba'i thog ma'i dus/ /blo ldan 'byung 'gros spyod pa'i sgrol byed 'phreng / /nam mkha' mig dus gzugasakyi yul gru na/ /lo skar shing 'phel khams 'dzin bra nye'i 'bras/ /mkha' gos las 'ongs sprin gyi me tog gis/ /sa gzhi rab bas ljon shing lo tog rgyas/ /nor 'dzin skyong ba'i stobs ldan dbang po rgyal/ /khāe rol)byed pa'i lo gza' drang srong sa skyes kyis/ /dus min shugs drag bser bu las drangasapa'i / tsha reg 'jigs pas rkang 'thung tsho gis kun nyams/ /skye dgu'i bdag po phan tshun zhabrug cing rtsod/ /phol mig tsha ba'i rims dang dbul 'phongs kyis/ /grong khyer kun 'tshe mi bsrun chom rkun bde/ /rgyal bo nyi shu blon po bkra shis kyis/ /rlung ldang nyi zla sa gzhi mkha' 'od dman/ /dal 'gro kha 'bri nad 'khrug mu ge yis/ /yul khams nyams shing rig pa'i dpa' bo 'tshe/ /'ching byed ma 'ga' bus 'chi mi rje rtsod/ /'jab bu'i lkog nor yongs 'phel gdol (15na)pa dar/ /(dbyang lor)skog gyur chos kun rjen par ston byed pa'i/ khyu mchog rgyal mtshan gsang ba'i man ngag las/ /ka ling ka dang bod yul ko shanta ra/ /dmag nad duḥkhas mnar zhing bye brag tu/ /bsil ldan lte ba 'phrul snang gtsug lag gi /gnod sbyin dbang ldan me lha'i rje 'bangs la/ /mi 'dod g.yul 'khrug nad kyi 'jigs— /5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)pas gtses/ /smin drug zla ba'i stod tshun lho nub dang / /de nas nub phyogs 'tshe zhing rgyal zla'i bar//shar phyogs yul du mi mthun gnod pa mang / /snron zla nas brtsams yul dbus bde ba las/ /phyir gyur khyad par mchu khra'i zla zung 'dzer/ /lho phyogs 'dod dus rdzogs pa'i nub byang sogs/ /dug can bgrod pas stid las phyar brgal ba'i/ /yul gru kun tu bde skyid pad dkar tshal/ /stobs ldan bsod nams 'gros kyi snang bas rgyas/ /(rgya nag)'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khab na gya shing du/ /brjod pa phyogs 'dir shing pho spre'u zhes/ /'byung ba gsum ldan kha ral mig dmar klungs/ /dgu gling dbus su pra ha gser slog gyon/ /lha lam sked med mchu ngos so 'phreng gi /sprin dkar lang long che las rab babs brlan/ /'dod ldan zhing pa'i snying la dga' skyed can/ /nye reg 'bru tshogs rnams rgyas so zar btson/ /nam smad char gyi stobs 'phel ju tshe rgyas/ /god rimasang na pa'i yan lag cung dar yang / /chu shel zhun ma'i mdangs la rab 'gong ba/ /legs(15ba)byas rtsal gyi stobasa'adi gang gis 'phrog grub mtha'i glang chen byed pa'i gser sbyang rgyan/ /g.yul rgyal mtshon cha'i 'khor lo snar bkod par/ /ca ṇa'i spor thang spyo chusang ra blud 'di/ khres ldan dga' ba skyed pa'i yul du mtshar/ /shing sbrel hor zla bdun pa'i gnam gang gi nyi dros la nyi ma sgra g.yo gyis 'dzin pa'i yi ge lha srin rdo ring mdzes byed 'phyug med zab gsang rtogs pa'i zlos gar/shanta bha wa ma hāXrti su ra dza la dha prabha sa ha su tsa(liXshrī ma〈sna dan su rla:hwa yudzdza sku lo ka su khe/ srid dang zhi ba na kra'i grong khyer las/ /grags chen dbyangs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba can/ /dpal ldan zas gtsang sras po rta ljang dbang / khyod kyis 'jig rten chu skyes bde bar mdzod/ (16na)theg mchog snying po gsang chen nā da'i sgras/ /rigs rnams khyab bdag dbang por lhun grub pa/ /rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug dus 'khor lo'i/ /zhabs sen skal bzang 'gro 'di'i spyi bo'i rgyan/ /sum rtsen 'dzin mar 'phos 'dra'i grong khyer gyi/ /'khor yug rin chen brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas/ /sa spyod chos rgyal — 16

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)rigs kyi dbang phyug ldan/ /rtsa gnyis dam pa'i gsung mchog rna bar 'jebs/ /blo gros rab bzang dri bral nyal 'gro'i stor/ /rgyal ba'i chos tshul chu shel dbang po dag /'gog med shar ba mi 'dzad grags pa'i gzugs/ khong ba'i snod 'di mes pos sprul lam ci/ /tshul 'di'i ring lugs smra ba'i dbang phyug dus 'khor zhabs pa chos kyi grags/ /gnas lnga rig pa ma lus kun mkhyen lo chen shes rab rin cen dpal/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen dbyings rol mkhas grub nor bu bzang po'i zhabs/ /gtsug lag rtsis rig smra la zla bral lhun grub rgya mtshor rab tu 'dud/ /gangs ri'i ljongasa'adir skar nag rtsis gzhud la/ /mkhyen pa'i dpal mnga' dpyod ldan yongs kyi mgon/ /'phrin las do zlar bral ba'i shing rta che/ /gra phug lugs bzang srid 'dir rgyas gyur cig /dbus 'gyur 'chang du legs sbyar lha'i skad du/ /ka ra so: gar brjod gangs can 'dir/ /nyi sgrol byed 'bod dbang phyogs rgyal khab tu/ /gya shing 'byung ba bzhi ldan shing sprel grags/ /zas gtsang sras po drag po lcags sprel la/ /bltams nas rgya mtsho mkha' dus 2600mig 'das shing / /rigs ldan seng ge (16ba'i jigs bral gdong lnga'i khrir/ /zhabs zung 'khod nas ri bo gzugs 12kyi lor/ /chu shel dbang po gro bzhin lus phra ma'i/ /lang tsho'i dga' ston la spyod dmar cha yi/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo au yig 'char ba'i tshe/ /chu tshod bdun 'das srang gi dus sbyor la/ /gshin rje'i phyogs nas sgra gcan bzhin ras kyis/ /rta bdun rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor cha brgyad sgrib/ /dbyu gu lnga dang chu srang spyi shu dag /rdzogs 'tshams lho yi phyogs nas gsal 'gyur zhing / /lcags sreg lta bu'i kha dog mdangs dang ldan//res gza' 'chi med bla ma las skar gre /me rlung khams kya 'bras bus rtsi shing dang / khang khyim g.yo zhing gza' skar mkha' 'od dman/ /me yis bsreg dang dmag 'khrug 'tshe bas nyams/ /rims dang yams sogs nad kyis kun du mnar/ /sad ser mu ge'i gnod pas rnam nyen yang / /bsod nams dge ba'i tshogs kyis cis mi 'joms/ /legs byas myu gu spel ba la/ /thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi sgo 'phar can/ /'od rnon seng ge mo bu yis/ /spyod pa'i dbyar rnga rna bar mdzes/ /— 17

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos jo bo shākya mu ni la gser sbyangs dbu rgyan 'bul ba gnang ba'i ngo bo bcos bslad med pa la lhan thab kyi tshul du o rod kho shod kyi da las kun ci rgyal mos gser zho nyis brgya nyi shu dang rin po che sna tsho gis kyi phras spra te dpangasatshad mtho bar byas nas phul ba'i kha yig phan bde'i 'dod 'jo/ cha shas gzugs can/phun tshogs dpung pa skyes kyi rigs mchog (17na7khar/ /dpal ldan stobs bcu'i 'od zer stong 'char ba/ /srid dang zhi bar grags pa'i bcu drug cha/ /rab 'bar zas gtsang sras des dus kun skyongs/ /cha shas gcig pa'i gzugs can rgyal ba'i snang brnyan mi yi srid bzung gzugs/ /blo ldan 'gro la 'chang ba'i zlos gar gyis/ /bzang po'i skal pa can kun chos kyi rnga'i/ /grags snyan dbyangs su spyod pa'i byed po yis/ /dge bcu'i yon tan mtho ris gnam skas las/ /legs babs kun nas 'khyil ba 'dzin ma'i tog shwakya'i skyes mchogo snang brnyan sgeg mo'i thod/ /gser sbyangs rgyan gyi brtse dzi ba ka /slar yang sa spyod dbang mo kun ci yis/ /nyi shus lhag pa'i nyis brgya'i grangs kyi zho'i/ /rin cen dañtsa na yis rab brgyan te/ /mdzes byed bkod pa'i khyad par gyis bskrun nas/ /legasaphul dge des rnam 'dren lung rtogs bstan/ /rab rgyas tshul 'di dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgos/ /ngal ba bsten kun gnas skabs mthar thug gi /phan dang bde ba'i 'dod 'jo rgyas gyur cig /ra mo che'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu ༅ rnying pa'i steng du gser zho drug brgya bdun cu/ g.yu mu tig sogs rin po che'i phra rgyan gyis spras te yo rod kho shod kyi da las kun ci rgyal mos phul ba'i kha yig legs byas chu rlabs gyen 'phyur bzhugs so/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba mtha' dag gi /bla na mtho ba nyi ma'i gnyen/ /klu yi grangs kyi zla 'phreng can/ /thun mong snang ngor shar ba'i sku/ /phun (17ba)tshogs āṣṭa dhwa tu'i rgyu/ /'chi med bzo po'i sor rtse las/ /rab bsgrubs lha bcas skye rgu yi/ /legs byas rgya mtsho'i nyid gi mchog /rgyal po'i yum gyur khro gnyer can/ /bsams bzhin ni pā la yi rje'i/ /sras mor srid bzung khri btsun gyis/ /spyan drangasasku yi cod pan du/ /deng gi dus 'dir byang phyogs kyi/ /nor 'dzin skyong ba kun ci yis/ /brgya phrag drug dang bdun cu'i grangs/ /zho yi 'khor lo'i sa le sbram/ /musti ka dang g.yu la sogs/ /rin chen — /8—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)phra tshogs kyis mdzes pa//rnyog bral yid kyis phul ba las//bsod nams dbyar mtsho'i rlabasazhabrug pa//srid pa'i rtse mor 'phyur pa'i sgras//lugs gnyis 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin can//bde legs rnam bkra'i gzhog rlabs kyis//mi zad dga' ba'i gar byed shog/dpal ldan 'bras sbungs su nged rang gi ma'i ched du dmig te dngul las grub pa'i 'o shāka gi sku'i 'dra cog gsar bzhengasal yo rod kho shod kyi da las kun ci rgyal mos gser zho stong phrag las grub pa'i dbu a la rin po che sna gas kyi wos spras te phul phe kha yig srid snyo 'dod pa lo ༅nor ga sku gsum mi zad shel gyi khang bzang yangs pa'i nang //bsod nams ye shes beeḍū rya yi them skas las//bde bar byon pa'i bu ram shing pa mig stong can/khyod kyi snang brnyan skye rgu yongs kyi bsod nams zhing //de phyir gser ldan sto ba'i khyon la bde 1ni legasakyis//mnga' sgyur sa spyod rigs ldan dbang mo kun ci yi//mi dman lhag bsam zla snang lta bur rab dkar bas//stong phrag zho yi gser sbyangs las grub mu kuṭa ra//sna tsho gis ra ta'i 'a sbyos mdzesasngon med dbyig 'dzin rgyan//mngon par spud pa'i dge tshogs rgya mtsho dngas pa las//chos dang srid kyi yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal//thogs med 'grub pa'i 'dod rgu'i char chen snyil gyur cigazhang bya rtseg chos rje rgyal༅ phren las pas jo bo po cug sgo rkaje phul༅ kha yig gto ge'i gsal snang ba/myu kho pos ma lta:kā me tsa gror smi:ya hisaḥbram rdiḥs blo dzñā557rmā shu sho/bha 6bhā waḥspos lhakyarwa rje/sku gsum 'khor lo rdzogs pa'i 'od zer gang //rmongs pa'i dgra tsho gos thams cad rab 'joms pa'i//chos kun mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug zas gtsang sras//grangs med dge ba'i dngos po rgyas par mdzod//18ba ) pa ryanta ji ka rluḥko kha su waṇi di pa tsa datta su tu/dzñā na b.raḥpu nub rmig la kwa lu:laḥshrī/mtha' sbyar ba'i shis brjod klas snang gsal snod bzang sa le sbram//rgyal ba rnams kyi 'phrin las pas phul pa'i//legs byas stobs kyis ye shes mchog thob cing //dus rnams kun tu shis pa'i dpal gyur cig/ 9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()shing mo bya lo'i skar nag dgongs bstun gyi le'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo bshad 'chi med bdag po'i lag nyal sogs/9na ) bri/sha kun batpa ra su:thos rmāḥsirnyi beeḍū rnyas ri7har tisma//sa5dru dzñā na ti sha tu ma skṛ tasuspo pu nu tsa//josgo ru tsi re bar sa kha su rṣa hā/shing mo bya lo'i ṛ tho las bzhi kun 'grub beeḍūrya'i chu rgyun bzhugs//phul byung ye shes chu gter las//bsod nams 'chi med byed po yis//thub bstan lha lam la mdzes pa//mkhas mchog bcu gnyis bdag po rgyal//mtha' yas stong pa chen po'i gar mkhan ma//mi 'gyur bde ba'i sgyu rtsal drug cu'i mdangs//gnyis med gnyis su 'char ba sgyu ma mkhan//dpal ldan thog ma'i mgon des shis pa stongs//ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin ka lā par//chos srid 'byor ba'i 'dod rgu char snyil ba//mig ldan rtse'i grangs ldan sa dbang snyan pa'i rnga//phyogs bral yongs kyi rna ba'i rgyan du 'jebs//tshe yi mchog ster yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dpal//dpal ldan phyogs 9bsgos rnam rgyal rig byed ma//ma lus mkhyen brtse'i gter gyur dbyangs can lha//lha mchog gsol 'debs dus kun skyongs shig kye//'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i 'od dkar can//phyi rol ston pa'i yid kyi mtsho nang du//thabs mkhas phral gyis shar las yang dag pa'i//lam du bkri mdzad dpal mgrin dge legs stsol//phyi nang gzhan gsum ri skyes las grub pa'i//rgyud rgyal shing rta wo po'i kha lo ba//paṇa wo gnyis dang rwa 'phro lo tsā ba/nangs dpang mkhas dbang tshogs rnams phyag gi yul//gang zhig gting mtha' bral ba'i blo gros kyi//sngon med bzang po'i rnam dpyod med byung 'dis//rgyal kun mkhyen spro 'i phung po'i dper bstan zhes//grags pa blo ldan yongs kyi gtam du sgrogs/shes bya'i nyal 'gro hub kyis 'thung mkhas chos kyi grags pa dzaḥ//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)gnas lnga rig pa'i mkha' la thogs med shes rab rin chen 'od dkar can/ /mchog gi dang po'i go 'phang mngon gyur dus 'khor zhabs pa nor bu bzang / /'jigs bral smra ba'i dbang phyug dam pa lhun grub rgya mtsho spyi bor bsten/ /gtsug lag bee ḍūr gsar 'khyil me long la/ /phra zhib rig pa'i gzugasabarnyan stong 'char ba/ /byed po dpal mgon 'phrin las brgyud par bcas/ /kun gyi ral pa'i bla na mdzes gyur cig /gra phug lugs bzang zla ba'i ma ma las/ /snying por yongs dril zil dngar li'u (20na)tho/ /blo gsal gtsug na zla ba'i mgrin mdzes ched/ /za hor bande tshul 'di smra la spro/ /grags can rnam 'dren stong gi ye shes mchog /brnyes phyir 'jigs med gdan gyis legs spa ba'i/ /'phags yul brda sprod skad du bhū pā lar/ /'bod pa bsgyur tshig bde mchog stod 'grel na/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir sa skyong zhes su grags/ /zas gtsang sras po drag po lcags sprel lor/ /bltams nasa'abyung ba nam mkha' dus 26sa dang ni/ /lag pa 'das pa 'khrul bral rtsis kyi lugs/ /gsang chen dbyar skyes rnga sgras ka lwa pa'i/ /skal bzang 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin yongs kyi rnar/ /spud mdzad rigasaldan seng ge chos kyi khrir/ /zhabs pad mngon par bkod nas klu 18gzugs18lor/ /(rgya gar)grub rtsis 2lo gza' bsil sbyin mkhan po yis/ /lha yi lam ngos ma he sbrang bu sprul/ /tsandan rwa dbyibs lta bu'i mkha' gos las/ /legs 'ongs char gyis 'dzin ma'i khyon brlan pas/ /ljon shing lo 'bras tshogs rnams g.yur za zhing / /bzhon rnams 'o 'phel mgron kun glu gar rtse/ /stobs ldan dbang pos byams pas sa chen skyong / /rje rigs tshogis kun dga' bde'i dpal la spyod/ /nyin mor byed pa lug gi khyim nang du/ /dgyes rgur rtse ba'i thog ma'i dus kyi nyin/ /lha yi bla ma 'byung 'grosakyis spyod pa'i/ /rgyu skar 'phreng ba mkha' 'khrig 1020mi bdag gi /yul grur sa khams lha mo snar rima'i (20bgyi cas/ /ljon shing gser lcags sor mo'i 'du byed kyis/ /sgyur ba'i bzo bo rnamasadang ba glang la/ /mi mthun bro nad kyis gtses rgyal po rtsod/ /gro nas la sogs lo yi tsho gos spyi dang //dkar ser me tog skye ba'i 'bras rnams 'phel/ /9 rol)byed pa'i lo gza' sngo bsang lus can —21 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)gyis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin skyong rnams stobs 'phel zhing / /lo tog rtsi shing rab rgyas 'bangasakun spro/ khyad par blo ldan bde zhing rig pa 'phel/ /rgyal po bkra 3shis 'bras bu tsha than gyis/ /lo tog kun 'joms 'jab bu'i lkog nor mang / /tshad khris phol nad 'byung zhing 'phongs pa dar/ /rgyal bo 'thab cing rtsod sogs ches ga yang / /rgyal kha blon sgyur lha min bla ma yis/ /bu ram shing dang lo legs tsho'i nor 'phel/ /sbum ma bder btsa' rje 'bangs dga' ston rgyas/ /nad rigs ches dkon khyad par bud med bde/ /(dbyangs lang)khengs ldan mi bsrun gdug pa'i rgol ba kun/ /'jomasabyed g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes/ /'jig rten byed po dbang phyug gsang ba'i tshig /lkog gyur ston pa 'i 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ /gangs can lte ba 'phrul snang dbus bzhag pa'i/ /dbang phyogs me dang srin po rlung lha yi/ /yul grong rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor bcas pa la/ /dmag 'grug nad kyi nye bar 'tshe 'gyur snyo / /snron zla oṃ du dbus dang khrums zla nag /lho phyogos tha skar zla nas lto nub dang / /mgo (21na)rgyal zla bar nub kyi phyogs kun du/ /stobs ldan nang rtsod rje la 'bangs sdo zhing / /nad rims g.yul 'khrug yul 'pho skya mug sogs/ /drang srong gdug pa'i nusamathus 'byung bshad kyang / /legs byas 'bum phrag zhus ma 'dzag byed pa/ /med byung dge ba'i tsho gis kyis cis mi bzlog /(spos dza sgor myang rtsis la char 'bras rlung sad dang / /phrug gu 'brug nyung grang ngad than zhabrug che/ /skya 'pham rtsi bcud snyoms shing la la dag /bzhad bcas yin pas char pa che zhes smra/ /(yig)rgya nag gong ma'i khab tu yi yi'ur/ /brjod pa bsil ba'i ljongs 'dir shing mo bya/ /'byung ba bzhi ldan kha ral phur bu'i klungs/ /dgu gling dbus su klu yi me long gnas/ /gtsug lag gsang tshig skya rgyal yul khams bde/ /bra sran rlon cing khre rgyal ju tshe 'bring / /gro nasadaman zhing chom rkun khrel shor rims/ /mang dar na tshod yar son rje dpon dang / /rta dang bong bu'i tsho gis la cung zad 'tshe/ /khyad par dbyar zla ra bar 'khor 'bangs 'gas/ /gong ma'i rgyal por rgol sogs ngan pa'i 'bras/ /'ga' zhig mchis kyang rnam dkar stobs kyis 'joms/ /byed grub —22

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)dgongs mthun shel gyi ba gam dbus//rgya nag spor thang rin cen khrir 'dzegs nas//g.yul lasarnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon che//bsgrengs mkhas lha dbang gnyis pa deng 'dir shar//don ldan ming gi mdzes pa'i rab 'byams smra spu blo bzang chos ba ) grags kyis chos 'khor gling gra tshang gi mchod rdzasade btu bkod pa'i shi brjod cha gtsang tshul las mdzes pa'i bang mdzod kha 'byed//su sti pradzā saḥnyi ma'i gnyen gyi brgyud 'khrungs mi 'jigs bzhi/grub pa'i kun mkhyen bla med gan mdzod can//skyabs mchog chos dang dge 'dun bcas pa yis//dus rnams kun du dge ba'i dngos po stsol//rgya bod thub bstan mdzes byed lo paṇa tshogs//bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po a ti sha//dus gsum rgyal kun spyi gzugs btsong kha pa//skal bzang 'gro ba'i rgyan du rtag bzhugs shig/rgyal ba'i gsang ba kun gyi mdzod 'dzin pa//bka' sdod gnod sbyin chen po ngal bsos po//rnam mang thos pa'i sras dang blon por yos//mkho rgu'i 'dod pa'i bang mdzod sa du phob//chos tshulu rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i gting zab dbus//rig lam nor bu'i thod 'chang gdengasacan dbang //brgal brtag gser gyi 'khor lo 'dzin byed pa//mkhas mang grangs ldan 'du ba'i nor gling gi/snying pos dben pa zang zing nor gyi tshogs//mchog gsum mchod pa'i rdzas su bsgyur ba na//rang gzhan don kun 'grub pa'i dpal ster zhes//gser 'gyur rtsi la gdung ba lhod por byed//sngon byon cha gtsang lung dang rig pa'i gter//spyod pas sgos min sku gsung thugs rten dang /khrims ldan bos sde'i nyer dpyad bdog pa'i tshogs//rnam thos ne'u le'i mgrin nas 'byung ba bzhin//sa skyong shing byar 'bod pa snron zla yi//22na ngo mar phyogs bzang po dang po'i tshes kyi nyin//zla ba gro bzhin 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor la//bkod legs yi ge'i phreng ba 'di ltar spel/me pho khyi lo'i skar nag dgong bstun gyi le'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo bshad sum rtsen dga' byed/dza taḥbha ra shos da nodza la dhi tsas su zhi ya da ya kurwa skor smi pu kha kunda//tshogs gnyis chu gter las 'khrungs pa'i//zas gtsang sras po bsil sbyin mkhan//mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od zer gyis//phan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)bde'i kunda rgyas par mdzod/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa dbang po'i gzhu/ /mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan bkra ba ngo mtshar can/ /sngon med thos 'dzin rgyan gyi dpyid gyur pa/ /dpal ldan dang po'i sangasargyas gtsug gi rgyan/ /snyan snyan ngag gi dbang phyug tshangs pa'i sras/ /mang mang (22bsrid zhi kun sdud rig byed lha/ /yang yang tshe dpal ster mkhas legs sbyin ma/ /lhang lhang gsol ba 'debs na rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /phyi rol ring lugasang na pa lcags kyi khams/ /phyag na padma'i gang 'tshams zlos gar rtsis/ /yang dag lam gyi gser du sgyur mkhas pa/ /dpal ldan gtsug na zla bas dge legs stsol/ /ngo mtshar rgyal khab lus phra'i bzhin ras ngos/ /rtsa gsum chos rgyal rig ldan 'dren byed dkyus/ /nges gsang lang tsho can gyi brtan pa kun/ /'phrog pa'i grags snyan dpyod ldan sgra 'dzin rgyan/ /'phags yul rin cen gling nas phyi nang gzhan gsum nor bu'i bang mdzod rnams/ /gangasacan ljongs 'dir 'dren la zla bral rwa 'bro shong lo ded dpon che/ /g.yul las rnam rgyal yan lag brgyad ldan chu klung skyug mkhas glo bo pa/ /rmongs pa'i gnyen por dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i drang srong che de phyag gi yul/ /phul byung blo gros snyan pa'i glu/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i mgrin pa las/ /blangasatshe grags pa mchog dman gyi/ /skye rgu'i rna ba'i gsos su 'jebs/ /chos kun gzigs pa'i gragasasnyan can/ /bod yul paṇa chen stag tshang pa/ /mkhas grub 'byung gnas nor bu bzang / /rnam gsum bla ma gtsug na mdzes/ /phyogs 'dir rnam dpyod lhun grub sgra/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs khyab cing //dpal ldan thog ma'i mgon po yi/ /'phrin las spel mkhas gra phug pa/ /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i (23na po phreng 'dzin pa/ /mkhas mchog smon 'gro lo tsā sogs/ /gtsug lag tshul 'di ston mdzad pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin tsho gos rnams rgyal gyur cig /ma dag rnyog pa'i rdzing bur zla ba'i gzugs/ /'char 'dod byis pa'i blo yi rang mtshang ltar/ /pad dkar zhal lung dang bral 'khrul med rtsis/ /smra 'dod nam mkha'i pa blor lag pas snyeg /'di na blang dang dor bya'i zlos gar kun/ /'char byed gsar byung le tho'i ā dar sha /mang thos mkhas pa'i drin las rnyed pa de/ /dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis —24

sku gsung thugs rten gsar stongs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)bsus te brjod par spro//rnam 'dren stong gis me shes mchog brnyes pa//dbus 'gyur 'phagasapa'i yul du akṣa yar//brjod pa skad bsgyur bde mchog stod 'grel na//mi zad pa zhes kha ba'i ljongs 'dir 'bod//stobs bcu mnga' ba stong gi tog gyur pa'i//bu ram shing pa drag po lcagasasprel lor//zas gtsang sras su bltams nas dus mkha' 2606'tshams//bgrod pa 'das pa mkhas dbang bzhed pa'i srol//sde bzhis mngon par mtho ba rgyal po'i khab//dpal ldan shambha la yi pho brang cher//rigs ldan seng ge chos srid khrir 'khod nas27//bug gzugs zla ba'i phreng bar slebs pa'i lor//(yir)grub pa'i lo gza' drang srong dmag dpon gyis//me sogs tsha ba'i stobasargyas lo tog nyams/yul 'gar char che phal cher than pas gdung //mkhris tshad phal 23bstod 'phel zhing 'phongs pa mang //rgyal po phan tshun g.yul 'khrug 'thab rtsod che//'jab bu'i lkog nor can rnams mang zhing bde//lug khyim dga' ba'i tshal du rta ljang can//dgyes dgur spyod pa'i thog ma'i tshes kyi wo//drang srong blo ldan 'byung 'grod kyis spyod pa'i//stong dang drug brgya nyi shu'i yul gru na/1620khyu skar lha mo chu khams lag gi 'bras/khru char ches dkon lhung lhung sgra 'byin pa'i//nyal 'gro'i tshogs rnams skems shing skya yang 'pham//sa 'dzin ngos su gnas pa' srog chags dang //sgo nga las skyes 'gro la nyer 'tshe mang //stobs ldan rgyal rnams rtsod cing zhabrug pa dar//khāe rol)byed pa'i lo gza' sag zla ba yi//dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes kyi bar//lha yi bla mas gru char dus su 'beb//'bru dang rtsi shing rab rgyas rta gling 'phel//mi phyugs nad bral sa bdag mnga' thang rgyas//'jig rten lhas skyong chos ldan grags pa 'thob//mchod sbyin 'phel zhing blo ldan rig pa rno/khyad par gtsug lag 'dzin pa'i bram ze bde//'dod pa'i tshes phan 'od zer bdun pa yis//dus min rlung wo g.yo bas nor 'dzin dang //lha lam mdangs ga nyi zla'i bkrag 'od dman//char dkon lo tog nyams shing mu shes 'jig/bud med bus 'chi rig byed mkhan la 'tshe//rkun po rgyal zhing gdol pa'i tsho gos rnams bde//rgyal po sngo bsangs lus can blon po ni//bsil sbyin mkha

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)na po'i 'bras bu ma he sprul//tsas lta bu'i sprin 'khrig char chu 'bab//rtsi shing lo tog legs smin 'o mar 'phel//24nas bdag byams pas 'bangs skyong dga' ston dar//sbrum ma bder btsa' khyad par rje rigs bde//(dbyangs lang dmi mthun dgra sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba//gtsug lag ma 'ongs mngon sum ston pa las//lha ldan sprul pa'i khang bzang dbus bzhag pa'i/shar phyogasaganod sbyin srin po dbang ldan gyi//yul grur 4ba rtsod skya mug nad rims kyis//'tshe yang bka' sgrogs mdos zor dkar nag lho'i//rim gro'i ga bur gsar pa'i thigs pa yis//duḥkha'i tsha gdung mtha' dag cis mi 'joms//(4 sheg ra myangs pa lta bu ni pā la'i//rtsis las char dkon 'bru nyung rtsa sang na//grang ngar che zhing rlung dang than pa chung //phrug gu mang skye skya 'pham 'khrug pa dkon//khyad par kun 'jug yin pas char pa ni/zhan tu chung ba bal yul mkhas pa'i lugs//(gyon ga)shar phyogs rgyal po'i khab tu bing zu'i zhes//brjod pa phyogs 'dir me pho khyi yi lo//'byung ba bzhi ldan khong nor spen pa'i klungs//dgu gling dbus su gnyen gyi me long gnas//gtsug lag de nyid gsang tshig ju tshe 'bring //snga than che zhing skya 'pham 'bru tshogs dkon//gos dang so ba nyams shing gro sran tho//dmag kun rgod cing god rims nad yams 'ong //dbyar smad char che gshong wo phal cher nyes//mi 'bru ches snyi khon can mang ba sogs//'bras bu ngan yang dge ba'i nyin byed kyis//legs byas 24ba ) padma dkar po'i tshal kun rgyas//byed grub sa srungs dbang po'i steng 'gying zhing //lkog gyur blta ba'i dbyangs ra mig stong can//rgya nag spor thang rtse brgya 'dzin pa yi//ṛ tho 'chi med bdag po deng 'dir shar//gangs ga ma thig le sto khas 'a po pho brang pho ta phe rang byon 'phags pa lo ke shā ra'i gtsug lag khang gi rten mchod kyi deb ther rin cen bang mdzod/tswa te shāka na ṇa bha mahwa bā dha sheyas tā /dzā snya steng sbyor sku po dbyangs/go tam tsas stod ya ka3kā la shubhakuru shu pā lha thaḥ/phul byung mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od zer gyis//skye rgu'i legs byas chu gter chen po'i tshogs//rgyas mdzad bu ram shing pa bsil sbyin /khan//dus kun dge ba'i shis pas skyong bar

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khog dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)mdzod/ /(25na)med byung snying stobs chen po'i dri bzhen gsar pa yis/ /gdul dka'i 'gro 'di'i tsha gdung ma lus rab 'phrog pa/ /'jig rten kun la phan pa'i dbang phyug dam pa mchog /gang dang dbyer med gzugs sku'i rnam rol de la 'dud/ /rgyal kun gsang gsum mi zad yon tan ma la ya yi dga' tshal nas/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar snga na med pa'i dri bsung can/ /gangs ldan phan bde'i dga' ston spel slad cir yang spro ba mi yi rje/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srong btsan sgam po'i med byung thugs rjes ring du skyongs/ /blo chen gser mngal can dang gtsug na zla ba 'chi med gtso bo la sogs kyis/ /mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' cha tsam rtogs min skal bzang 'gro la 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu gang / /mi yi
