srid bzung zol la nyer brten btsong kha pa zhes grags pa'i dbyangasasnyan po/ /srid gsum rtse mor ches cher bsgrengs pas dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor nge la 'dud/ /ring nas bsod nams bye ba'i gser 'khor thogs med shugs kyis sde bzhi'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /drangs te rang gir longs su spyod pa'i chos srid dga' ston ma smad 'byor pa dang ldan pa/ /thub bstan ma lus 'dzin la blo gros rab brtan sa yi dbang phyug gnam bskos rgyal po yi/ /pho brang mnga' 'bangs chab srid mtshan jus dkar phyogs chu shel dbang po lta bur 'phel gyur cig /dge bcu'i yon tan 'phyur bur spungs pa yi/ /nor 'dzin bu mo'i mngal khur rab lci ba//(25ba) 'gyur med lte ba gru 'dzin pho brang zhes/ /yangs pa'i 'dzam gling spo las ma wa zhe par 'phags/ /phyag na padma'i rang byung sku brnyan sogs/ /bde legs rgya mtsho spel ba'i zhing mchog gis/ /legs byas rnam smin dkar por ches 'dzag pas/ /'og min gnas de 'di las gzhan du ci/ /mtha' bzhi'i nor gyi dpya khral 'dod rgu'i tshogs/ /rtsol med lhun gyis grub par 'du ba yi/ /'byor ba'i 'dod rgu char du rab bsnyil bas/ /rnam thos bu yi mdzod kyis 'gran du med/ /rgya hor stod smad nyi 'og rgyal po'i tshogs/khengs pa'i ngal ba btang ste phu dud du/ /sor mo'i 'dab ma snying khar sbyor byed na/ /'jig rten mesapo'i dbang gi 'gran zlar byas/ /gya gyu'i sems ldan rgol ba ngan pa'i snying / /'dar dang 'chi ba'i —27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)'jigs pa lhan cig tu/ /ster bas lang ga'i bdag po'i pho brang de/ /bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir 'ongs ba bzhin/ /e ma srid gsum kun las rab rgyal zhing / /sdebazhi ma lus gcig tu spungs pa yi/ /rtsod dus gnam gyis bskos pa 'khor lo sgyur/ /rdzogs ldan mgron du 'gugs pa'i pho brang 'dir/ /'jig rten kun la rmad byung brtse ba can/ /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad kyi dpal mnga' ba/ /rang byon lo ke shwa ra'i gtsug lag khang / /rten mchod deb ther rin cen bang mdzod spro/ /zhes snyan pa'i tshig gis sdun bsus te/ sgron ma'i bskal ba bzang po 'di la grags can (26na)gyi rnam 'dren stong byon pa rnams kyi nang nas snying stobs phul du byung bas pad dkar lta bur bstod pa'i dbyangs kyi rgyal mo zad mi shes pa'i yul dam pa rang cag rnams kyi 'dren pa zas gtsang gi sras po 'di nyid kyi bstan pa rin po che rgyal ba nyid kyis lung bstan pa ltar/ /dbus 'gyur 'phags pa'i yul gyi byang phyogs gangs kyi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir dar ba'i byed po mchog 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po'i zlos gar bod rgyal po'i gzugs su shar ba rim par byon pa rnams kyi bka' drin yin la/ de'i nang nas mi rje srong btsan sgam pos rgya bal nas rgyal ba dngos dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs bod 'bangs kyi bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing du spyan drangs pas mtshon te bris 'bur dang rang byung gi rten ngo mtshar bas gser ldan gyi khyon kun rab tu bkang zhing / khyad par smin mtshams nas sprul pa'i dge slong ā ka ra ma ti shi las gdan drangs pa'i rang byon lo ke shwa ra zhes pa bod kyi skad la 'jig rten dbang phyug tu grags pa 'di nyid chos skyong ba'i mi bdag srong btsan sgam po'i mchod pa'i zhing gi gtso bor bzhugs shing / bar skabs su rgya dmag byung dus skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar lo mang bar bzhugs pa rim gyis ra mo cher phebs/slar tshal pa si tu smon lam rdo rjes ri bo gru 'dzin 'dir bzhugs su gsol ba nas bzung / gnam bskos kyi rgyal po phag mo gru pa'i sde srid ma nyams bar du (26ba)phyi 'khyar med par bod 'bangs yongs kyi legs lam rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar 'byed pa la bzhugs na'ang / /bod rten gcig mtha' la —28

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)'khyar na mtha' dbus 'jig pa'i lung bstan dus la babs te bar skabs su skye bo ci rigs kyi byed pas yul gru du mar phebs pa las/ mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang ba dang bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po mchod yon nyi zla zung gi bsod nams chen po'i dpung dang btsan po'i las kyi shugs drag pos bod gling dgu'i sa thams cad rang byon du lhun gyis grub pa dang chabs gcig par sa dbang da las kun ci rgyal mo'i phun sum tshogs pa'i bsam sbyor bzang pos 'phags pa'i snang brnyan mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i sku 'dra rin po che 'di nyid yar gdan drangs pa dang / pho brang chen po gsar bzhengs dus mtshungs su rtsol bral gyi rten 'brel rang shugs kyis 'grig pa nas rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa'i rten gsum kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i bye brag gi tshogs byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi deb ther gsar du bkod pa la/tham shu'i ri mo mi gsal ba me khyi gsar du brkos pa'i tham phud srid gsum bdag mor phul ba'i kha yig bsam don thogasamed myur tshib/ rgyal ba'i yum gcig dbyangs can lha/ /drag mo'i skur bstan dmag zor mar/ /dar dkar zla rgyas tham ris kyis/ /ri dwags gzugs can phul ba'i mthus/ /chos srid legs tshogasa'adod pa'i don/ /sngar bcol 'phrin las grub pa ltar/ /(27nad 'chol las kun bsams pa bzhin/ /thogs med myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /me mo phag lo'i skar nag dgongs bstun gyi le'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo bshad kun tu dga' ba'i dbyangs sogs/ su ka rwa tu ma ṇi nas blo ྅ku la dza ge khu tsa/ na ma ādzñā shākya mun ye gro yatsā su khri ya tsa/ med byung mdzad bzang nor bu yis/ /ris bral lus can thams cad la/ /phan dang bde ba stsol mdzad pa/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen la 'dud/ /stong gzugs lang tsho 'i rgyas pa gzugs sku'i mkha'/ /bde chen sna —29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)tsho gos lha mo'i dbang gzhuga'akhyud//snang bas cir yang ston pa'i 'khor lo'i mgon//dpal ldan thog ma'i sangs rgyas phyag gi yul//srid gsum dbang 27bsdud dbang gi lha mo mchog/mchog gi ngag stsol ngag dbang lhag pa'i lha//lha mchog dngos grub dngos su tshe ster dpal//dpal mo'i snyems 'phrog snyems ldan legs phyin rgyal//lkog gyur chos kyi snang brnyan ma lus pa//dri bral rnam dpyod me long ngos 'char ba'i//byed po gtsug na zla ba'i grags snyan rnga//blo gsal yongs kyi rna ba'i rgyan du mdzes//legs pa'i cha bsags grong khyer shambha lar//gsang chen theg mchog bdud rtsi'i za ma tog/skal bzang kun la ster ba mi ye rje//chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyis dge legasastsol//gang gi ring lugs gser gyi shing rta che//bod yul ra bar 'dren pa'i skad gnyis pa//rwa 'phro shong dpang phul byung mdzad bzang la//ba smos tshe snyim pa'i padma da gdod zum//rang sde chos srid pad dkar tshal rgyas shing //gzhan phyogs kumu da ma lus zum byed pa//g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i nyin byed dbang //'dren byed rta ljang glo bo lo tsā ba//rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab phung po dang //gang gi blo gros tshad ma'i srang gzhal tshe/khyu yang rtogs dka' bzang po'i mdzad pa can//grags pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal snying po rgyal//sgrib med gnas lnga kun rig chos kyi grags/shes bya thams cad gzigs pa stag tshang ba//mchog gi go 'phang mngon gyur nor bu bzang //rnam gsum bla ma'i mdzad pas yid rab 'phrog/rab yangs 28na dzin gyis grub pa'i mkhyen pa yis//rtsisagazhung rgya mtsho'i pha rol mthar son cing //dpal ldan rgyud sde smra ba kun gyi mgon//'phrin lasamatshungs pa med pa'i gra phug pa//mtha' klas shes bya rig gnas rgya mtsho che//rnam dpyod srad bur brgyus pa'i 'phreng 'dzin pa//grags pa don mthun smon 'gro lo tsā sogs//tshul 'di'i legs bshad stsol rnams rgyal gyur cig/mngon rjes tshad mas gzhal dka' srid pa 'dir//legs nyes 'byung 'gyur dngos su ston pa yi//'khrul mer drang srong gsang tshig le'u tho//bshad tshe kun mkhyen ye shes gnyis par byas//'jigs med rdo rje'i gaXn gyis rab spa ba'i//dbus 'gyur legs sbyar

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang si po tsho chad jo go bzang gi dkar ga/ 'diskad du ā dzi tar//smra ba skad bsgyur bde mchog bstod 'grel na//thams cad 'dul zhes su la'i ljongs 'dir brjod//snying stobs mchogo la bad dkar ltar bsngags yul//bu ram shing pa drag po lcags sprel lor//sgyu 'phrul lha mor bltams nas ri mkha' ro//lag pa 2607'das pa 'khrul med rtsis kyi lugs//ka lā pa zhes pho brang chen po'i khrir//chos srid 'byor pas skyong ba mi yi lha//rigs ldan seng ge zhabs zung legs 'khod nas//nam mkha' mig 20gi grangs su sleb pa'i lor/(ar)grub pa'i lo gza' lha yi bla ma'i 'bras/khru char dus 'bab 'bru dang rtsi shing rgyas//rta glang rab 'phel mi phyugs nad 28bting bral/'jig rten lhas skyong chos ldan grags pa 'thob saspyod rgyal po'i mnga' thang mngon par mtho//blo ldan kun 'phel khyad par bram ze bde//nam mkha'i nor bu lug gi khyim nang du//thog mar spyod pa'i ma nu'i tshes kyi 4zhi//drang srong phur bu 'byog por bgrod pa yis//nam mkha' mig 620dus gzugs kyi grong khyer na/khyu skar lha mo me khamasargyal 7gyi 'bras//char sgoms rtsi shing lo 'phel rgyal po rnams//4ba rtsod zhi zhing mnga' 'bangasarab tu bde//sngags bon dar bas legs pa'i dngos grub 'thob//༷ rol)byed pa'i lo gza' smin drug zla ba yi//klu gzugs8pos tshun 'od zer brdun pa'i 'bras//dus min rlung ldang sa gzhi kun gsal gyi/kha dog mdangs 'phrog nyi zla'i gzi byin dman//char dang 'bru dkon skya mug 'jigs pa 'byung //rig byed mkhan nyams na chung bu yis 'chi/gdol pa bde zhing rkun po'i tshogasarnams rgyal//bug gzugs9tshes man bcu gnyis bdag po yis//tshad nad dar zhing dmag dang 'brug pa 'byung //char dkon srog chags gdug pas 'gro la 'tshe//rkang bzhi'i phyugs rigs nad kyis rnam par 'tshe//rgyal po mi bsrun dmangs rigs rnams ni bde//rgyal po zla gzhen blon po blo ldan gyis//sbrul dang tsas ma he sbrang bu ra'i//dbyibs༅ sprin gyis char 'bab 'bru shing rgyas//bzhen rnams 'o 'phel skye bo rtsed 'jor rol//rgyal po mnga' 'bangs bcas 29nasgo dga' ston spyod/khyad par rje rigs bram ze'i tsho gos rnams bde/(dbyangs ra)/g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)zhes grags pa//ma 'ongs mngon sum gsal ston gtsug lag las//ra sa 'phrul snang pho brang dbus bzhag pa'i//dbang po byang shar rlung lha'i phyogs rnams su//rgyal po phan tshun rtsod cing 'khrug pa dar//nad rims mu ge sogs kyis nyer 'tshe yang //dkar phyogs rim 'gro'i ga bur thigs pa yis//mi bde'i tsha gdung kun las grol bar nges//(bal sa gar myang rtsis la char chung 'bras bu nyung //rto so ga zhing rab grang rlung than chung //phrug gu mang skye skya 'pham 'byug pa dkon/khyad par rdzing bur 'jug pa'i yul gru 'gar//char che phal cher kun la chung ba ni//ni pā la yi mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes yin//(rgya nag)'jam dbyangs rgyal po'i khab tu ting 'a zhes//brjod pa phyogs 'dir me mo phag gi lo//'byung ba gsum ldan kha ral zla ba'i klungs//dgu gling dbus su bdud kyi me long gnas//gtsug lag de nyid gsang ba'i tshig las ni/zhub nas dmag gis rgol zhing 'thab rtsod dar//char dang than pa snyoms shing gnag rnams legs//lo tog so zar bzang zhing khre rnamasanongs//nad sna ches mang nang du 'khrug pa 'ong //dbang thang mi min dbang sogs sang na yang //rgyal ba'i bka' sgrogs mdos zor dkar nag ltos//29ba tha mthun nyes pa'i tshogs kun sel bar nges//skar rtsis dpyid kyi mngal las legs 'ongs pa'i//dbyangs 'char chos kun ston pa'i glog stong 'byug/rgya nag spor thang gru char legs babs pas//ri tho dbyar skyes dga' ston 'di na 'phel/sa pho bya phe lor skar nag dgongs bstun gyi li'u tho lag bdar du bzos pa'i lo shad chos srid gye brgya wod pa'i dga' ston/(dza khi sdeb sbyor 'phags ma)dza lha sne rdza lha kye phu ru shrīmā lha kya mu neḥpradzñā 6bha bye:he pra ya〉tsa su khyahi taḥ/dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi//dbang phyug dpal ldan zas gtsang gis//bgrang yas skye rgu'i tsho gos rnams la//phan dang bde ba stsol zhig kye/ 30na gsum gsang ba rab 'byams bye ba'i sgo//stong gzugs lhan skyes bde chen ye shes mdangs//gnyis med gnyis su 'char ba sgyu ma mkhan//zung 'jug dus kyi 'khor lo thob bya'i gtso//brtan g.yo'i dngos kun dbang sdud rig byed ma//ma smad tshe 'phel

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs//zhabs pad bsten pas blo ster dbyangs can lha//lha mchog rnam gsum snying gi pad mtshor rol//rang srid snang ba 'bum sde'i mchod sbyin mkhan//mi bsrun mun tshogs pha mthar skrod pa'i dpyid//dbyangs 'char rta bdun dbang po'i byed po mchog/gtsug na zla bas 'jig rten 'di skyongs shig/gsang wo nā dar grub pa rdo rje'i glu//'gag med chas pa'i dbyangs su len mkhas pa//legs tshogos cha bsags 'jigs med seng ge'i khrir//'gying mdzad chos rgyal rigs ldan phyag sgo yul//ming tshig rtags su grub pa'i glegs bu'i khams//phyi nang gzhan gsum beeḍūr 'khyil ba'i ngos//bsil ldan skye bo'i blo gros bzhi 'char ba//byed po rwa 'byo shong dpang 'jig rten mig/legs lam rgya mtsho'i dri bsung ches mang ra zhing //phung byed las sbyor dug sbrul gyisa'abyud pa'i//g.yul rgyal ma la ya yi ljon pa la//longs su spyod 'di slo bo lo tswa'i drin//blo chen gom pa gcig gis dus gsum gyi//rgyal kun mdzad bzang sa chen 'gong nus pa'i//med byung gragasapa 'di kos pad dkar mig/30ba hā da dang dbye ba gnas kyi khyad par tsam//chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan grags pa'i zhabs//thams cad mkhyen pa stag tshang lotsā ba//rgyal ba kun dngos mkhas grub nor bu bzang /rsām gsum bstan la kun mkhyen gnyis par nges//mkhyen dpyod lhun grub gdugs dkar srid pa'i rtser//'khor bas rtsis gzhud rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' rtogs//gtsug lag tshul 'dir zla bral grwa phug pa//dpal mgon 'phrin las smra ba'i nyi ma rgyal//rig gnas rgya mtsho'i phreng ba 'dzin mkhas pa//bod yul paṇa byu smon 'gro lo tsā sogs/kho bo'i blo gros sa mos rgyas byed pa'i//yongs 'dzin 'od dkar can rnams phyag gi yul//lkog gyur chos kyi snang tshul za 'og thags//ma 'dres gzugs su gsal ba'i ri mo can//skar nag rtsis kyi rgyu dra'i gar mkhan mas/khres bya thams cad mngon sum nyid du gsal//byings dang rnam 'gyur rkyen gyi rang bzhin las//legasagrub lha yi skad du sarba dha ka/brjod pa bde mchog stod kyi 'grel pa na//kun 'dzin zhes pa gangasacan ljongs 'dir smra//rgyal ba zas gtsang sras po lcags sprel lor//'chi med bu mo'i khengs 'phrog

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)sgyu 'phrul ma'i//sras su bltams nas klu mkhar dus dang 2608mig/'das pa padma dkar po'i zhal lung lugs//chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor rin chen sogs//'phyur bur spungs pa'i 'jigs med gdong lnga'i khrir//rigs ldan mi yi seng ge legs byon ma//zla ba lag pa'i grangs21su slebs pa'i 31na〉(ra//(rgya gar)grub pa'i lo gza' lha min 6bla ma yis//rgyal po 'bangs bcasabade zhing dga' ston 'phel//'gron po lam bde tshong pas rin cen rnyed//bu ram shing dang lo rtag rnam par rgyas//yul rnams nad med kun kyang dga' bar spyod//khyad par bud med rkang bzhi phyugasarigs bde//nyin byed lug khyim sleb pa'i tshes kyi nyin//lha yi bla5mas 'khyog 'gros kyisaXsnrod pa'i//stong 16dang drug 2brgya nyi shu'i yul gru na/khyu skar lha mo me khams rta chung 10'bras//char rnams dus 'bab lo rta go rtsi shing 'phel/ /sems can kun bde khyad par mdza' grogs rnams/ /phan tshun yid gcugs dga' ba'i rtsed 'jor rol//skya rgyal skye bo'i don rnams tshegs med 'grub//9ra rol)byed pa'i lo gza' the skar zla ba yi//tshes gnyis tshun la rta 1bdun dbang po'i 'bras//tshad nad dar zhing dmag dang 'khrug pa 'byung //char dkon srog chags gdug pas 'gro la gnod//rkang bzhi'i phyugs rigs nad kyis rnam par 'tshe//rtse mo'i tshes phan chu shel 2dbang po yis//sprul dang tsas sbrang bu ma he dang //rwa dbyibs lta bu'i sprin 'khrig char chu che//rtsi shing me tog lo gos rnam par rgyas//bzhon rnams 'o 'phel skye bo glu gar rtse//yangs pa'i nor 'dzin chos ldan rgyal po yis//legs par skyongs zhing khyad par rje rigs bde//rgyal po blo ldan char 'bab lo rtag smin//rta glang 'phel zheng chos ldan grags pa thob//sa spyod mnga' thang dar 3ba tha ngo yon tan mkhan//nad med khyad par bram ze'i tsho gos bde yang //rgyal kha blon sgyur nyi mas1tsha gdung nad//mang zhing nyi zla'i 'od dang sman stobs 'an//'bru rnams mi smin yul dbus dmag gis 'khrug/dka' thub ldan phug dmangs rigs tshogos rnams bde//(dbya pas la 'a)g.yul rgyal gtsug lag 'khor lo'i man ngag las//chos ldan rgyal po'i pho brang po ta la//dbus su bsdug pa'i dbang phyogs byang shar me//yul dbus

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po tsho mgo rdzasakha 4nga gi dkar sa/ (ma)chu lhar bcasapa'i phyogasarnamasasu//rgyal po phan tshun 'thab cing rtsod pa dang //mu ge skya 'pham nad rims sogs mang yang //rnam dkar 'jigasamed rdo rje'i thog mda' yis//mi mthun nyes ba'i rtsa ba 'byin par nges/(bgo88 pā la yi ka ra myang rtsisal//char che 'brasanyung rtsa so ngan zhing grang //rlung than chung zhing phru gru mang du skye//skya 'pham zhabrug pa chung zhing khyad par du//yang dag 'jug pa'i yul kun char 'bab pa//bal yulamathil dugatan la phab pa'i rtsis/(mag)khar phyogasargyal po'i mdun sar wu tsi zhes//'bod pa phyogasa'adir sapho byi ba'i lo//'byung ba lnga ldan bdun khur mig dmar rlung //dgu gling dbusasu lde thung btsun mo gnas//gtsug lag gsang bar smra ba'i tshig lani//blon gyis rgyal la rgol zhing nad sna mang //'brasadang sobar btson zhing than zhing legs//gnag 'bring dbang thang mi dbang mchog tu dge/skar nag rtsisagazhung yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//rnam dpyod le'u 32nasku'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod pas//mi mthun phyogasalasarnam rgyal 'dod pa'i don//lhun grub bkra shigayar ngo'i zla ba bzhin/phyag mdzod soskyong bsod nam rab brtan gyi snying stobasayon pa'i dpung pasakhur bayo grong gsar pa padma rab brtan gyisabakod pa byasanasorab byung ༅ khig pa'i shing mo bya'i lo nag zla'i nang du ca barṣa na la 'dzin zhesapa pho byi ma lor legasopar grub pa'i pho brang go po po ta la'i 'on to yongasasu brjod pa 'jigasamed seng ge'i rgyud pa'i sgra dbyangs/ngo mtshar snang ba 'bum sde'i 'khor lo marga dpe'i ri mor yongs su grub ba sngon med 'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs lhun po mtshamasasprin bla gosagasar pasamadzes//'gag pa med pa tshangasapa'i gsung kun ta'i ra yi snyan 'gyur rgyud du nyer bkug gzhom med nā da'i sgra dbyangasanyamasadang 'gyur ba stong gi daphyid//zab gsal gnyisamed chu mtshor mtha' klas shesabya'i snang brnyan rab 'char rmad byung brtse chen rlung gisabaskul bas 'gro la gzigs pa yol med rlabasa'aphreng can//e ma bzang po'i bskal pa'i rnam 'dren tshogs kyi dbusan ma smad snying stobs cho ga yongs rdzogasasrid gsum bla ma shākya seng ge rgyal gyur cig/mi bsrun dusadagra'i mun tshogs ma lus pha mthar skrod pa sngon med

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)bcu gnyis bdag po'i dkyil 'khor can/ /'gyur med rtag brtan rdo rje'i dngos po lhun gyis grub pa'i grangs med 'od rnon phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis/ /nam yang 'chi ba med pa'i rang bzhin bla na mngon mtho bdud rtsir 'khyil ba med byung sbrang rtsi'i bas/ /(32brkol bzang bung ba'i tshogs la mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar 'byed mdzad tshe dpag med pas 'gro 'di skyongs/ /phul byung mdzes sdug lang tsho dar la babs pa'i 'khyog po lta ba'i 'dren byed kyis/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dngos kun skad cig nyid la thogs pa med par dbang sdud pa'i/ /'jam mnyen utpal nyag phran dag gis khams gsum 'bigs pa'i sgyu dra'i gar mkhan ma/ /bcom ldan rigs byed lha mo khyod kyis dngos grub ma lus dus 'dir char du snyil/ /phyag na padma'i gsang ba gsum gyi ma la ya yi nags klung nas/ /byams brtse'i rlung gis nye bar drangs pa chos rgyal mes dpon dri bsung ches/ /rtsod pa'i tsha gdung ma lus rab 'joms rdzogs ldan phan bde rgyas mdzad pa/ /'phags mchog chos ldan rgyal por srid pa bzung rnams bka' drin bla na med/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi mkhyen pas lan brgyar rab gzhal yang / /pha mtha'i tshad bzung rtogs par nus min blo gros mthu grub pa'i/ /mdzad bzang nor bu'i yu bas legs bteg grags snyan gdugs dkar can/ /srid rtser 'khor lo'i 'jam dbyangs bla ma btsong kha pa la 'dud/ zhal dkar rdul mang brtsegs pa'i rjes 'gro can/ /gangs kyi ri bosayongs su bres pa'i nang / /dge bcu'i lo 'dab phang phung cher g.yo ba/ /dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i dpag bsam ljon pa mdzes/ /gang de'i dbus gyur skyid shod nor 'dzin gzhin/ khyu skar sa la bkram 'dra'i grong khyer mchog /lha mi'i 'byor pa ma lus 'du ba'i sa/ /sum rtsen yul gru'i khengs pa rab 'phrog par/ /zas (33na gtsang sras kyi phul byung thugs rje mchog /rin cen zhun mar lhan cig 'khyil ba'i sku/ /ngo mtshar snang bas rgya mtsho'i byed po yis/ /phan bde'i mgron kun ring nas 'gugs pa bzhin/ /bgrang yas rgyal ba'i rang snang ye shes tshogos/ /gzhal med ba gam dam par legs grub pa/ /lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang bzang zhes/ /mkha' la dbang po'i gzhu bzhin —36

sku gsung thugs rten gsar stong dang rin po 7 mgo rdzas la bzang gi dkar sha/ (mnarnam par bkra/khrong btsan ye khro ma'i 'khrul 'khor gyis//tshar du dngar ba'i bkod pa 'di bstan tshe//pad dkar gzhen nu khong nas dga' ba'i nyams//yang yang phyogs der bltas nasa'adzum pa bzhin//mtha' bzhi'i rgyal po'i khengs pa sbyin skyes grong //sna tsho gos sprul pa'i mda' yisanyer bcom pas/phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang phyug mchog/thob pa'i sngon med mgrin sngon srong btsan rje//bde stong zung 'jug klong du ro gcig kyang //gnyis med gnyis su 'a zar ba'i khri btsun gyis//legs bskrun 'dzin ma'i rgyan gcig pho brang che//dmar po ri zhesapo ta la gnyis ba//ya rabs gong ma'i spyod pa dbyar gyi rnga//snyan brjid dal bur sgrogs pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis//lugasaganyis mdongs mtha' rab dga'i gar sgyur can//chen po du mas bar du rab bzung zhing /khyad par rtsod pa'i dus 'dir gnam bskos lha//sde srid phag mo gru pa'i lung las kyis//byang phyogs rdzong chen skyong ba'i rje dpon du//nyer bskos sne'u pa sogs 'gas bzung mthar//phra zhib rtogs dka' shes bya'i gzugs brnyan kun//33bsgo khyen pa'i me long ngos su gsal 'char ba//rgyal ba kun 'dus padma ka ra yi//zhal lung bdud rtsi'i snying po za ma tog/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i kha rlang chesamangar ba//dri bsung zad mi shes par tsol ba'i ro//lung bstan ji bzhin dus su nyer babs pas//sa la rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang che//mdzes sdug lha dbang khang bzang rjes 'gro zhing //rngam brjid lang ga'i grong gi spun slar byas//'dod rgu'i longs spyod 'phel bas lcang lo can//bde skyid dga' ston spel phyir gru 'dzin dngos//mi bsrun glags lta'i mun stug mthar sgrod par//sra brtan lcags ris khor yug kun bskor ba//sdebazhi'i legs tshogos 'byung ba'i sgo 'phar gyis//lcog rnams rgyal chen bzhi yi mkhar la 'gran//'dzam gling yongs kyis nyer gas skye bo'i 'grul//ho med rgyu ba'i rin cen them skas tshogos//lhun po lta bur mtho ba brag ri'i ngos//byed pos pir gyis bris pa lta bur mdzes/khrel dkar brtsegs steng pad rag kha bas brgyan//sgo 'gram dbang sngon byu ru'i ka bas bceg/gdung sogs sna tshogs rin chen las grub pa'i//pho brang 'di ko rnam rgyal khang bzang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)bzhin/ /'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs las grub rgyal mtshan gyis/ /'od 'bar 'jig rten ma lus gsal byas pas/ /rta bdun bdag po skyengs te thun mtshams ma'i/ /stegs las mchonges te byang gling mkha' la bros/ /'tshams sprin 'og pags klubs 'dra'i ba gam dbus/ /rang (34na)byon 'jig rten dbang phyug la sogs pa/ /'phags yul rgya dang bod kyi sku brnyan sogs/ /byin rlabs lang long g.yo ba chu 'dzin bzhin/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'dzad mi shes pa'i gter/ /rigs bral yongs 'dzin bla ma rin cen 'phreng / /mthong thos dran reg phan dang bder sbyor ba/ /'og min sdug po 'akod pa'i dpe zlar byas/ /brtse ldan snying rje chen po'i 'dzum rlabs kyis/ /lus can thar pa'i grong du bsu mkhasapa/ /rang byon 'phags ma chag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /rten dang brten pa ye shes snang ba'i zhing / /'dren mchog phyag sor las 'ongs me rtag rtsis/ /'phags yul sa 'dzin byin brlabs su wa rnar/ /legs bsgyur lo paṇa chos rgyal gyis bskrun pa'i/ /li rags sku bas du ma tshar du dngar/ /ca ṇa'i shes ldan sor rtse'i 'dab ma las/ /sku brnyan ra yig gnyis pa'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /ngo mtshar sbrang rtsi'i ro bcud ster byed pa/ /dbang phyogs rgyal po'i gan mdzod las 'ongs dpal/ /rtse mor beeḍūr ser po'i khu ba yis/ /lan brgyar byugs pa rgya phibs nor bu'i tog /kun gsal 'gram par snyeg pa'i 'dab 'phreng las/ /dril bu'i sgra dbyangs dri za'i rgyud bzhin 'brol/ /phyogs kun yid 'ong ba gam sna tsho gis kyis/ /rnam par mdzes pa sa 'dzin lhun po'i rtser/ /nye dbang tsho gis kyi bkod legasakhang bzang gi /ri mo tshar du dngar ba byas pa 'dra/ /bde chen snang ba stong chen rab yangs(34ba)mkhar/ /zhi dang khro bo'i rol gar dbyar skyes sprin/ /dngos grub char du bsnyil ba gsang sngags kyi/ /dga' ba'i tshal 'di skyon mkha' 'gro'i gling / /dgra sde'i snying khrag dron mos cher spyos shing / /dbugs bral bam chen steng du gar rtse ba/ /chos srung dregs pa'i tsho gos kyis yongs gang phyir/ /bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod gnyis pa 'dra/ /srid zhi'i dga' ston kun gzigs khams gsum las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i bde ba che ldan sa/ /'jig rten yongs kyi yang rtser rab son pa/ /'chi med tshal gyi —38

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)spun zla grangs med mdzes//gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal khab chen po gang //sa gzhi chos bzhin skyong ba mi yi bdag/bsod nams rab tu brtan pa'i snying stobs dang //dpal 'byor brtson 'grusabyed po'i mas yis bskrun//ngo mtshar bkod pa'i khyad par gsal byed mkhan/snang srid gzugs su spel la blo gros kyi//rnam dpyod rab yangs blo ldan phur bu'i sbun//grong gsar padma rab brtan zhesasu grags//bzo rig sgyu rtsal tshul la goms pa'i mngal//phra zhib rigs pa'i drod kyis nyer bskyangasapas//med byung khang brtsegs gser sgong sbrum byed po//gangs can ra bar gnas pa'i tshangs pa bzhin//rin cen rgyan sogs mas kyis rab mdzes shing //ya rabs spyod tshul sgrigs kyis nye bar spa//rigs rus yo rnyan tsho gos kyis ma mtho ba/khungs ldan skye bo'i 'du 'khod pha mtha' yas//sde bzhi dgyes dgur dud pa'i dga' 35na ston la//dus kun longs su rnam par spyod pa yi//'chi med dbang po'i mdun sar mtshudas pa'i tshoms//pha mtha' gser ldan dga' ma'i sto bar 'bu//gang 'di'i zhal ba'i smin legs bzhin ras ngos//ri mo'i 'dren byed rnam par bkra ba dag/nyamasa'agyur sna tshogs g.yo ba'i gar mkhan mas//kun yid brtan pa 'phrog pa'i lcags kyu 'di//rgyal dang rgyal sras kun gyis cher bsngags pa//gnas lnga rig pa'i chu skyes phreng ba las//rjes 'dzin bzo rig utpal phon po mchog/blo gsar gzhen nu'i rna ba'i rgyan du 'jibs//'gro mang legasabyas spel dang smin byed kyi//bskyed rim zab lam dmigs pa gsal 'debs mchogo/sku gzugasasnang ba grangs med spro byed pa//dngos grub rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas 'di med byung //mtshan bzang smi wa ra'i 'dab ma'i kha//sgrib gnyis ri dwags gos can so skye'i zlas//'byed nus min yang gsung rab mdzes ma yi//'gram chang la brten 'thus pa chos nyid de//de phyir dkar nag rgya dang bod yul 'dir//gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i mig yangs pa//du mas mdo rgyud las 'ongs cha tshad dang /mthun pa'i bris 'bur cho ga grangs med bstar/'on kyang snyigs dus rang bzo'i chu rdzo kyiX//rdzun lung gto gyi mas mor nyer 'khrid de//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā9)cha tshad bral ba'i mun par mal 'cha' ba/ /blun po 'ga' yis ring lugs 'di nyams(35ba)byas/ /de lta na yang nyin byed dbang bo dag shar tshe mun pa'i ga rum gzhom pa ltar/ /sman thang lugs bzang gaṅgā'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bzo rig dri ma kun bkrus drungs par byas/ /kun la ches sman gtsug lag tshul 'di'i bla/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos blo gros bzang po'i dpal/ /yon to rgya mtsho pir thog ma lus pa'i/ /gtsug na dkon cog ji bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /legs bris yul nas bi shwa skadze dag /bir thogs dbang por 'i rdo ba gar mkhan gyis/ /bsil ldan gangs can ljongs 'dir 'ongs pa la/ /sman thang pa zhes snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /de'i srol mkha' la rjes gong rgyu skar gyi/ /'phreng dbus grangs med rnam 'gyur 'od dkar can/ /spro mkhas chos dbyings rgya mtsho la sogs pa/ /sor mo'i 'phrul gyi rnam dpyod yangs pa rnams/ khyud rgyal kha sbyor sdom 'byung la sogs pa/ /mdo rgyud tshad ldan mkhas pa'i bstan bcos las/ /snying rje dad dang dul zhing dbang po gsal/ /sbyangs 'drisayon tan bshad rnams ma lus tshang / /de phyir mdzes brjid sgeg dpa' mi sdug sogs/ /rang rang nyams kyis mngon sum ji bzhin ston/ /srid pa'i zlos gar ri mo'i lam 'phos pas/ /'jig rten mes po'i khengs pa phyogs kyis dogs/ /'gro la rjes chags thugs rje'i 'khri shing tshogs/ /rmad byung skyes rabs lo 'bras g.yur za ba'i/ /phan bde'i sgrib bsil cho ga legs bstar ba/ /(36nasgo smad yongs 'du'i phreng ba tshar du dngar/ /chos rgyal mdzad bzang grags snyan rsā pir gyis/ /dang ba'i yid mkhar rin cen rtsig ngos la/ /yongs bris rlung gi rgyal mtshan lang tsho'i dpyid/ /smin pa'i tshul 'dis 'jig rten khams kun ston/ /yun ring lhags kyis mi sgrub skad cig la/ /bskal chen du mar bskrun pa rgyal sras kyi/ /rtogs brjod spel tshe sprul pa'i bzo bo 'ga'/ /mchis zhes skabs gsum pa rnams gtam du gleng / /mes pos gdong bzhin sprul nas phyogs kun du/ /bltas kyang pho brang gang 'di'i dpe zla'i 'os/ /ma rnyed ngal bas zag bcas bde ba'i ro'i/ /mi zad gnyid la bskal pa'i bar du g.yur/ /lho phyogs dal bur bskyod pa bser bu'i tshogs/ /'dren byed gzigs —4(lha

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdza kha bzang ga dkar sha/ (ma)mo'i dga' ston la 'ongs par//tsandan dri bsung 'phyogs la rab bteg nas//'gro ba'i tsha gdung bcil ba'i rgyal brten//'dzad med 'dod rgu'i gter gyi tshong 'dus su//mkho rgu'i bdog pa spel phyir mtha' bzhi yi//grangs med skye dgu 'du rnams pho brang che'i//yid 'ong bkod par lta la 'ongasasam snyam//gnam sngon 'dzin mar 'khyil 'dra'i nyal 'gro'i klung //ro bral gtam kun bskyungs te dal med par/khul ring lam du zhugs nas gang 'di yi//snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog la brel ba bzhin//mkha' dbyings lus phra gcer bur rgyu skar gyi//do shal phreng bas spud de lta 36ba tha la/khung zad skyengs pas thun mas gsar pa yi//smad g.yogs lhab lhub g.yo bar byas pa 'dra//grangs med dag pa'i zhing gi rten brten pa//rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i ba gam la phyogs pas/khrims ldan 'dus sde'i gling du nyer brdzus nas//dgon gzung gi rnam par bstan nam snyam//bkra shis dge mtshan g.yasasu rab 'khyil ba'i//bsod nams snyan grags srid rtser sgrog pa'i dung //zhing rdul bye ba phrag brgya'i bkod pa rnams//tshar du dngar bar rab bskrun dge tshogs kyis//nyi ma'i brgyud zha spungs skye rgu rnams kyi lha//lha mi'i dbang phyug rgyal ba zas gtsang sras//sras bcas lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa kun//kun nas dkar phyogs zla snang ltar 'phel zhing //zhing khams rgya mtshor rgyal kun snying rje'i bdag/bdag nyid chen po'i 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang //dbang phyug brgyad ldan srong btsan dge bcu'i khrims//khrims gnyis gser gyi gnya' shing lci gyur cig/'dren pa mchog gyur mchog gsum dam pa dngos//blo gros rab yangs rab 'byams chos kun gzigs//bzang po'i snyan grags snyan 'gyur drug skyes glu//thams cad kun gzigs kun mkhyen btsong kha pa//'jam dbyangs bla ma ma smad rnam dpyod kyis//legs par rab bshad bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan//srid mtha'i bar du du mar rab 'phel zhing //g.yo med sa 'dzin 'dzin ma ltar 37na tha rtan shog/khang bzang 'du byed byed po rjes 'brang bcas//mtha' dag gnas skabs skabs gsum dbang po ltar//bde skyid dpal dang dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi//go 'phaX ma lus lus pa med thob shog/kun gsal rab

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)yangs sgo 'phar las 'ongs gnam gyis bskos pa'i sa'i tshangs pa/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i khrims gnyis gser gyi 'khor lo thogs med 'gro ba yis/ /gling bzhi'i dpal la 'dod nas dbang sgyur phan bde'i rdzogs ldan ma lus pa/ /phul du byung ba'i dga' ston mchog gis dus rnams kun tu khyab gyur cig /pho brang chen po ta la'i tsho mes chen logs bri kyi kha byang deb ther du bkod pa kun gsal nyi ma/oṃ su sti si ji/ ye shes mchogo gi dbang po'i gzhu ris can/ /ri mo yongs smin sprul pa'i chosargyal gar/ /sgyur mdzad srong btsan thugs rje'i bdud rtsi yis/ /gangs can 'chi med dga' ston rgyasapar mdzod/ /de yang grags can gyi bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong byon pa'i snying stobs kyi dbang phyug rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po'i bstan pa rin po che byang phyogs gangs ris bskor ba'i yul 'dir 'phel rgyas su mdzad pa'i byed po mchog /rje btsun lag na padma mi'i srid pa'i zlos gar can chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i pho brang dmar po ri zhes dpal ri bo gru 'dzin dngos dang khyad par med pa 'di nyid/ bar skabs su hor rgyal po'i (37bsnying la brten nas tshal pa khri dpon dang sde srid phag mo gru pa'i rdzong dpon dang sde srid phag mo gru pa'i rdzong dpon sne'u rdzong pa zhes kun mkhyen bla ma btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tu gyur pa de sogs che gnyan du mas nye bar bzung ba'i rdzong sna tshogs shig yod pa rnams kyang glog gi bu mo'i gar mkhan ltar 'dus byas kyi cho ga rjes su bstar te dus re zhig gi bar mchod khang tsam ma gtogs ri gtsang du gnas pa las ha cang mi ring ba'i tshe/ /gter ston chen po chos rgyal dri med lhun po'i lung bstan las/ /spyir yang mtha' dmag lan bdun tha ma la badzra pā ṇi'i sprul pa'i rgyal po gcig /bod khams dar cig bde la sbyor ba 'byung : zhes dang / /rigs 'dzin chen po ratna gling pa'i bstan pa spyi'i lung du/ blo gros stobs ldan thugs rje'i 'od zer can sna tsho gis thabs kyis 'khor lo'i kha lo sgyur chos kyi rgyal po dpung dang bcas pa 'byung : 'bri yi rwa co phag gi mjug ma can: gung gi tshang 'cha' sa yi zas za zhing : mig bzhis gyen 'thur dag la lta bar byed/ /lte gnyis bden rdzun gnyis kyi shan 'byed pa dbus—42

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)gtsang thams cad sku yi mnga' 'og 'du: rdo tshil mas stobs brtan pa'i bdag po 'byung : zhesapa'i dus rtags kyi rgyu mtshan 'bri gung pa'i bstan srid 'bri'i gzugs su bkod pa'i rwa co tsam dang /phag mo gru pa'i bstan srid phag gi gzugs su bkod pa'i mjug ma tsam lus pa'i dus su/ mal gro gung dkar sogs kyi shing cha drangs te skyid pa'i tshang (38na yo 'a ba/ /sa chen po'i nor gyi dpya khral sogs za ba ste sdud par byed ces sogs lung bstan gyi 'phreng bas bsngags pa dus la babs te/lcags mo sbrul gyi nang du srid gsum thams cad 'dar bar nus pa'i dpung gi tsho gis chen po dang chabs cig par bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po nyid ngo bo dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin las g.yo ba med bzhin du rnam pa gtum drag rngam pa'i cha byad kyis rigs ldan drag po'i 'khor lo can gyi ngang tshul la 'gran bzhin pa dang bcas te/ bod yul gyi lte bar phyags phebs pa tsam gyis sngon chad dregs ldan du mas ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal te 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal thabs chen po 'bad pa med par lhun gyis grub pas/ lha sdo mi sde rang nyams kyi ngang tshul la chog mi shes par phan lan log par sgrub pa'i dug sprul sbyong khyer gyi snang tshul mtha' dag mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar mthun pa'i rkyen 'ba' zhig tu song ste/ stod mnga' ris khyung rdzong dkar po nas bzung /lho rgya gar gyi grong khyer rtsa mchog tshun/ shar kong po dang / smad dar rtse mdo tshun gyi rgyal khams mtha' dag bka' khrims gcig gi 'og tu mngon par bsdus te rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston la spyod pa'i dus sngar gyi lung bstan gyi 'phro nyid las/ lha sa dmar ri dpal gyi chu bo ri has po ri sogs dbus ri de gsum la pho brang byas na dbus g.yor mtha' gsum sdud de lta'i bstan (38ba)pa mi lo drug cu 'byung : rjes kyi bstan mjug dang bcas bdun cu phu sems can yongs la bde skyid nges par 'byung : zhes pa ltar shing mo bya'i lo la pho brang chen po'i 'di nyid gsar du skrun pa'i bkra shis kyi dge mtshan rgya chen po'i dus su/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'phags mchog lo ke shwa ra'i sku'i snang brnyan mthong na mi mthun pa med pa 'di nyid kyang sa spyod dbang mo da las kun ci rgyal mos 'bul bar btang —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)ba sogs ma bsgrigs par ngang gis 'grig pa'i rten 'brel lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang chen po 'di nyid kyi tsho mos chen 'dir/ rgya mtshan 'brel chags shing mchog dman kun gyi mig la bdud rtsi sbyin pa'i slad du chos rgyal mes dbon gyi rnam par thar pa'i zhing bkod ri mo'i 'phreng bar spel ba la ha cang snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs tshe tshul de la mkhas par grags pa rnams kyang mgo bo 'gal me ltar 'khor na skye bo phal cher gyis rtogs pa'i skal pa phra la/ snyan tshig dang mi ldan pa'i tshigs bcad kyi sbyor ba blun po'i nang zong ston pa kho nar gda' bas 'dir tshig lhug gi sgo nas bri bar bya ste/ de yang rgyas par ni chos 'byung khungs ma rnams su gsal bas spros ma dgos shing / snying por dril na/ stod mnga' ris g.ya' dang gangs ris bskor ba/ bar dbus gtsang brag dang spang ljongs kyis brgyan pa/smad mdo khams rtsi shing nags tshal gyis gang ba'i yul thams cad glang po/ ri dwags/ sgres brag srin sogs dud (39na'i gros bzung bas gnas ngan len pa'i rgyu kho na spel ba'i mthus 'og tu dmyal ba'i za ma tog yod par 'gro ba de thams cad lhung ba skyob pa'i slad du/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong gis lha sa'i thad kyi nam mkha' la phebs pa'i thugs rjes dmyal ba mtha' dag lha'i dga' tshal ltar gyur/ de yang bod kyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad par blang dor shes dgos par dgongs te/ /thugs rje chen po dang sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin las 'phel ba'i mis bod chen po'i rgyal khams gang / bod spyi la dbang bsgyur ba'i ched du 'phags yul gyi rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i sras g.yu'i smin ma sogs mi las 'das pa'i khyad par can zhig 'phags pa'i thugs rjes sprul te btsas pa rnam rtog gi dbang gis sprugs pa lha ri gyang mtho'i rtse la byon nas gzigs pa na/ yul yar klungs skyid par dgongs te lha skas las babs nas btsan thang sgo bzhir byon pa na bon po sogs mi bcu gnyis kyis mthong bas lha las chad par rig nas rjer 'tshal lo zhes gnya' bar btag pas gnya' khri btsan por grags shing / pho brang yum bu gla sgang brtsigs/ rgyal rabs brgyad pa gri gum btsan pos smar khams kyi yul nas khrab blangs te blon po lo —44

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnangam dang 'thabs pas blon pos rgyal po'i dpral bar mda' bsnun te bkrongs/ sras rnams glang 'phur shes la zhen te gong por (39ba)bros/ yar lha sham po'i bu ru las skyes kyis blon po bsad nas sras bya khri rgyal sar bskos/ gri gum gis ral gri klad la bskor bar brten rmu thag chad de spur byung ba zangs kya ga'ur bcug nas chur bskyur ba klu srin gyis snyed pas blon pos bang so brtsigs/chu drangs te zhing rmos/ dngul zangs lcags gsum btan no/ /rgyal rabs nyer brgyad pa lha tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus pho brang yum bu gla sgang du pang skong phyag rgya pa/ gser gyi mchod rten/ yi ge drug pa/ tsanta ma ṇi'i skos phor rnams babs te gsang ba gnyen por ming btags/ bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ rgyal rabs so gnyis pa gnam ri srong btsan gyis rgya yul nas rtsis dang sman pa bos te srol btod/ pho brang khri brtsegs 'bum gdugs bzhengs/ 'brong bsad pa'i shas tsha rnyed/ de'i sras chosargyal srong btsan sgam po dpal kun tu bzang pos bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling nas bteg ste ge re'i 'phrang du phebs pa na/ tshur ri'i brag la yi ge drug rang byon dang /pha ri'i brag la spyan ras gzigs/ rta mgrin/ sgrol ma rnams kyi rang byon la 'ja' phan tshun du 'brel/ pho ta lar phebs te bzhugs pa'i tshe snyan grags kyis mtha'i rgyal po mtha' dag gis bkur/blon po thon mi rgya gar du brdzangs te bram ze li byin dang paṇḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge la brda' sprod pa sogs rig pa mang du bslabs/ slar bod du byon nas rgyal blon gnyis kyis nyang bran pha bong (40na)khar mtshams mdzad nas bod yig gtan la phab/ lhas lung bstan pa ltar smin mtshams nas sprul pa'i dge slong ā ka ra ma ti shrī las tsandan sbrul gyi snying po las bcu gcig zhal rang byon dang / tsandan ha ri'i sdong po las wa ti/ dbu khang / 'ja' ma li/ lo ke shwa ra rnams byon pa'i bcu gcig zhal dang lo ke shwa ra gnyis/ g.yin yang gnas chen brgyad kyi sa dang de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig/'od srungs/ shākya thub gsum gyi ring bsrel/ chu bo ni rañdza'i bye ma dang rtswa'i chun po/ po ta la'i tsandan gor sha'i dum bu rnams spyan drangs te smin mtshams su thim/ thun mong ma yin pa'i snang ngor —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)rgyal po'i spyan g.yas las 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po sprul te bal yul nas jo mo khri btsun dang rten skal dang nor skal la jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje/ byams pa chos 'khor/ nor bu ratna : wa/ stag sha : wa/ beeḍū rya'i lhung bzed sogs dang bcas te bod du blangs/ thun mong ba'i snang ngor rin po che beeḍū rya'i khrab kyi rten bal po'i rgyal por bskur ba la brten nas blon po rta pa lnga brgyas gdan drangs/bal mo bzas dmar po ri'i sa phyogs su lcags ri'i phreng ba gsum skor yod pa mkhar dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa dgu dmar po ri'i rtse'i mkhar the ba'i stong phrag gcig yod pa rngam brjid dang ldan pa brtsigs/ yang thun mong ma yin pa'i snang ngor rgyal po'i spyan g.yon nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po sprul te/ rgya mo bza'/ jo bo shākya mu ba sogs rten gyi (40bshor skal rnams gdan drangs shing /thun mong ba'i snang ngor rin po che beeḍū rya'i rmog rgya rje la rten du bskur te mgar gyis gtsos pa'i blon bo rta pa lnga brgya btang ba/ g.yu phub tsam mig gcig dkyil dang mig gcig mtha' la yod pa nang gi mig rnams kyang phub kyi spa rim ltar yod pa zhig la dar yug tshud pa dang / bya ma brgya bu brgya/ shing zlum po'i rtsa rtse/ nyin gcig la mi res lug sha bubs re zos zin pa/ pags pa mnyes zin pa/ chang ban re btungs zin pa/ ma bzi ba/ rang gi gnas tshang du mtshan mo ma nor bar sleb pa sogasa'agrub par dka' ba'i rig pa mang po 'gran du bcug pas rgyal te rgya mo bza' thob/ dar zab bsregs pa'i thal ba/ tsandan bsregs pa'i sol mdungs/ lug gi mtsher khrag /nas brngos te sa bon du 'debs pa sogs g.yo sgyu du mas rgya nag po'i rgyal khams chams la phab ste thabs mkhas kyis bod du 'ongs/ /de nas kong jos sa dpyad bzang ngan dang sa dgra 'chos lugs sogs rtsis khog nas gtan la phab ste bal mo bza'i g.yog mo la 'phrin bskur kyang sgra ji bzhin par ma 'khyol bas/ mtsho bsub tu ma 'dod cing slar rgyal po dang lhan cig tu mtsho 'gram du byon nas sor gdub bskur te dmod bor pas/ mtsho 'od kyi drwa bas khebs shing / bal po'i bzo bos rdo 'phangs pa rnams dbus su rdo'i mchod rten ltar gyur pa la shing gi rtse de stad de mtsho legs par zubs kyang bcos thabs rnams —46

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khosadang rin po tsho marna rdzasakha bzang gi dkar ga / (ma)mi 'byung bar rten rtsig pa'i rmang bting ba rnamasalha 'dresabashig pas/ nyang (41na)bran pha bong khar mkhar dgu thog brtsegasanasachosargyal yab yum gsum sgrub pa mdzad pas rigs gsum mgon po zhal gzigs shing rdor thim pasarang byon gsal bar byon/ de nasasprul pa bkye ste mi 'gyur ba'i gzer gyi gtsug lag khang bcu gnyisabartsegs/ sngar sprul pa'i dge slong gis spyan drangs pa'i byin rlabs rten brdar ba'i phye ma rnams la bzo rgyu dang bcu gcig zhal rang byon nang bzhugs su 'bul ba'i sta gon mdzad pa la bzo bos bzheng ma dgosapar rang byon du byon zhing / nang bzhugs kyi sku 'dra slar 'od zer gyisadrangasate thugs skar bzhugs/ zhal las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis bdud sde'i dpung tshogasathamasacad btul/ zla tshal gyi brag la snang ba mtha' yasakha sar pa ṇi/ rta mgrin gsum rang byon du byon/ de nasargyal posasprul pa dang bcas te ra sa'aphrul snang dang ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang rten brten par bcas ba bskrun zhing thugasarje chen po gtso 'khor rnams pho brang gi mthongs khung man gshegs te gtsang khar byang mar sprul pa'i rdzu'aphrul gyisaphebasarab tu gnas pa mdzad/ ru yong bza' dang / zhang zhung bza' dang mon bza' khri lcam rnamasakhab tu bzhesapar snga ma gnyisakyi rten skal du brag lha dang thim bu lkog gi lha khang bzhengs/ phyi ma dang sras gung ri gung btsan gnyisakyis yer pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ ma rungasapa'i skye bo rnamasagadul ba'i slad du khrimasal sbyar ba'i sprul pa bkye ba dang / rgyu mtshan de la brten nasali yul (41ba)gyi dge tshul gnyisalog lta skyesapa de bsal nas skad cig gis rang yul du sleb pa/ khra 'brug tu bande hrul po zhig gisamachod rten sor rtses blangs pa'i lan du dbu thod phud nas a mi de wa bstan pa sogs rdzu 'phrul du ma mdzad cing / chosagater/ nor gter/ drag sngagasakyi gter mang du sba ba dang zhal chems lung bstan gsungs te thun mong ma yin pa'i snang ngor yab yum gsum thugs rje chen po'i thugs gar thim/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis gtsug lag khang gi nang rnams khyab pas 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad byung / thun mong ba'i snang ngor rimasand kyisaphan yul zal mo'i sgang du sku gshegs/—47—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)dus der rgya'i dmag gis lha sar slebs kyang rme brtsegs kyi sku las sprul pa'i dmag gis phyir bzlog /lan du mgar gyis bod dmag 'bum tsho khrid nas rgya rnams bcom/ slar rgya dmag 'ongs kyang jo bo lho sgo me long can du bzhugs pas sur ma thub/ mi bskyod rdo rje snga dro gcig gi sar khyer/ dmar po ri'i pho brang bal bzas bskrun pa me la bsregs/ rgyal rabs so drug pa 'dus srong gi blon po bdun gyis glang po che'i phrug gu theg pa/ g.yag grus po che theg pa/ mda' ste'u kha mas bya khra'i sked pa gcod pa/ mig rgyang gsum la mda' rgyang gis sleb pa/ sha ba'i rlid bu bye mas bkang ba klad la bskor ba/ 'byong 'thur la rgyugs pa gyen la 'then pa/ rta g.yang la mchong pa gyen la 'then nus ste (42na)rtsal dpag par dka' ba bdun ston nus pa byung / sras mes ag tsho mos kyis theg pa chen po'i glegs bam lnga bzhengs shing / bzhugs khang du brag dmar mgrin bzang / brag dmar ke sagasang mkhar brag /mchims phu sna ral/ ma sa gong gi lha khang dang lnga bzhengs/ de'i sras choge rgyal khri srong lde btsan rgya mo bza' phyi ma la zhakhrungs/ sna nam bzas phrogs pas bod kyi sa dpyad mang po nyams su bcug /slar rgyal bu rang gis ma ngos bzung bsas dpyad rnams gsos/ sang shi rgya nag tu bzangs pas ju zhag mkhan pos bod nas mi 'di 'dra ba 'ong zhes lung bstan pa ltar byon/ rgya rjes gser gyi glegs bam sogs bya dga' chen po byin/ yar lam hwa shang mngon shes can dang phrad nas bod kyi bde dog dris pa rnams zhib par bshad/ bod du slebs dus chos khrims bshig 'dug pa'i glegs bam rnams rdza gseb tu sbas/ dus der blon po 'ga' zhig gis chos khrims bshig pa'i rkyen gyis shi ba sogs mi shes pa kha yar byung bas mo rtsis lung bstan ltar shākya mu ni sa 'og tu sbas pa bton nas skyid grong du bskyal/ gsal snang gi bu mo shi ba la/ kha nang du rtags mtshan rgyab nas bu mo bur skye bar sang shis gsar du khrid 'ongs pa'i ha shang gis lung bstan/ hwa shang rang yul du phyir slog /sang shis dzo gseb nas glegs bam rnams blangs te btsan po la bstan pas btsan (42ba)po yid ches nas sang shi rgya gar du brdzangs te mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho mang yul du spyan drangs/ slar sang shis —48

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs te mkhan po'i gsung rnams bskyar/ rgyal blon bka' bgros te thabs mkhasakyis ma 'ad dur du bcug /mkhan po gdan drangs te chos gsungs na'ang lha srin rnams ma dga' bas pho brang dmar po rir thog 'bebs pa/ yar klungs 'phang thang gi pho brang chus khyer ba sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung bas re zhig mkhan bo bal por slog /mkhan po'i lung bstan ltar slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas gdan 'dren kyi pho nya btang / lam du rdzu 'phrul ston pa dang lha srin 'dul ba sogs mdzad de rim gyis phebs nas rgyal po dang mjal/ slar mkhan po gdan drangs te mkhan slob chos gsum bka' bgros nas bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang rten brten par bcas pa bzhengs shing rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ thams cad yod smra'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs pas kha stong bar mdzad de mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du sad mi mi bdun gyis rab tu byung / lo paṇa rnams kyis sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde 'og ma rnams bsgyur cing gtan la phab/ slar yang / paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra gdan drangs te/ theg pa'i yang rtse du ma rgyal blon la gsungs/ bee ro rma gnyag sogs kyis mdo rgyu sems gsum gyi rgyud sde rnams bsgyur cing 'chad nyan gyi gtan la phab/mchims phur slob dpon chen pos rje 'bangs rnams la sgrub pa bka' brgyad dang (43na lda rje phur pa'i dbang bskur zhing rje 'bangs nyer lngas rdzu hrūl du ma bstan/ lha lung dpal rdor gyi dus der grub pa ma thob kyang phyis yer par grub pa thob/ hā shang ma hā yā na dang / kā ma la shī la gnyis rtsod pas hā shang pham ste rang yul du log /rgyal po'i sras che ba mu ne btsan pos bod 'bangs rnamasaltogs phyug lan gsum snyoms shing / chung ba mu tig btsan pos rgyal sde skar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i sras mnga' bdag khri lde srong btsan gyis gsung rab rnams skad gsar gcad kyis gtan la phab/ rgya bod dbon zhang 'khrugs pa las bod 'bangs kyis rgya'i grong khyer du ma bcom zhing rnam par rgyal/ slar hwa shang dang lo paṇa rnams kyis dbon zhang mthun par mdzad/ 'u shang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba'i ngo mtshar can bod 'bangs yongs —49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)kyi phan bde'i rtsa bar bskrun pa'i bkra shis kyi dge mtshan phyogs kun tu khyab bo/ /rnam dpyod chu 'dzin gsar pa tshogs pa las/ yi ta ngu'i gtam gyi dbyar rnga sgrogs pa na/ shes ldan gtsug phud can gyi dga' ba'i gar/ /mkhas mang tsho gis pa'i mdun sar sgyur la brel/ /lha rigs nor 'a na stong ba'i dbang po sa skyong rgya ri bsam 'a rtogs ma rtsa 'grel gyi rnam gad blo bzang gongs ma logs med gdong lnga'i dang pho sgra dbyangs par du bskos pa'i par byang yong sbyin mi da gter mdzod/su sti pra dzā ༷ ཿ dge legs dbyar (43ba ji sa lus phra'i mngal gyi khur/ /rnam par lci ba mtshan dpe yongs 'du'i ljon/ /skal bzang 'gro blor sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /ston mkhas rgyal ba'i tog gyur nyi ma'i gnyen/ /gang gi gsung rab gser sbyangs shing rta che/ /rnam dpyod gcig gisa'adren pa rgyad kyi rigs/ /bsil ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag btsong kha pa/ /thams cad mkhyen de'i legs par bshad pa las/ /brgya phrag dka' spyad khyogs la ma blangs kyang / /mi phyed mdza' bsabacings pa dbyangs can lha/ /mgrin par rtsed 'jo'i gar gyis stid pa yi / /tshig nyung don rgyasabastan bcos che 'di bskrun/ /mtha' klas bsod nams dpung pa'i rta ljang gis/ /nor 'dzin rab yangs mkha' la nyer drangs pa'i/ /sa spyod lnga rigs gsar pa nyin byed dbang / /lugs gnyis 'od stong phyogs brgyar spro mkhas pa/ /'chi med bdag po'i rigs can brgyud kyis btsun/ /gnam bskos mthu yis grub pa stobs kyi btsan/ /legs byas dpung gis tshangs pa mi'i gzugs can/ /yangasapa'i sa chen chos bzhin skyong ba'i rje/ /ngag gi dpal grub dbang phyug brgyad mnga' ba/ /kun dga'i rang bzhin 'dzum pa'i blo ldan gyi/ /chos srid mngon par rgyas shing ches brtan pa/ /lha sras zla ba bzhun ma'i bsil zer gyis/ /'dzad pa med pa mchod sbyin brgya phrag sgo/ /longs su spyod la mi zad gtong ba'i dpyid/ /sngon med par gyi kunda'i dga' ston gyis/ /blo gsal sgeg (44na tā 'a rna ba ci yang mdzes/ /'jam dbyangs mi yi srid bzung sa sto ṭa'i/ /sdeb legs yi ge'i phreng bar spel byed pa//tsā ri dar rgyas blo bzang mchog gyur zung / /sngon med mig gi dga' ston zlos gar mkhan/ /tshul —50

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4kho dang rin po che'i mgo rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag / (mna'adir rgyu sbyor lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /dngosadang brgyud pa'i sgo nasa'abad byed rnams/ /nad gdon glo bur nyer 'tshe'i g.yul ngo las/ /rab rgyal mthun rkyen lhun gyisagrub par shog /tshe rabasakun tu mi pham dbang po yi/ /'dun sar skyesanasatheg chen chosatshul la/ /longasasu spyad de stobs bcu'i go 'phang mchog /mngon du byas nas kun mkhyen thob gyur cig /mtho bas 'odagasal lha rigs saskyong rgya ri bsamaja pa mdzod kyi rnam bshad chosamadzo rin cen 'dren pa'i shing rta par du brkosapa'i par byang tshog gnyisanor bu'i bang mdzod/swasti bradzā bhyaḥ tshogasaganyisaman shel gsar pa'i rtsig ngosal/ /mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan bye ba 'char byed pa/ /nyi ma'i brgyud zhabrungasakun mkhyen zasagatsang sras/ /gang gi chosamangon sdosnod gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /rmad byung blo gros hub gcig gis 'thung ba'i/ /gnas lnga rig pa dbyig gnyen dzahū'i/ /gzhung lugs 'dzin mkhas 'jam dbyangs mi'i srid pa/ /yongs bzung dkon cog chosa'aphel gsung rgyun rnams/ /tshangs dbang sras mo dgyesapa'i 'dzum bag gis/ /nam yang ba'ad pa'i rtse dga' mi gtong ba/ /blun rmongs kun 'joms 'jigs med rdo rje'i sdes/ /legs bshad dri za'i rgyud mang 'brol ba 'di/ /(44bangatho btsun 'od gsal lha yi gdung lasabyon/ /lugs gnyisarnam par 'byed pa'i mkhyen spyan yangs/ /sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar ma lus yongasaphye ba/ /ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan dpal bzang pos / /blo bzang rgyal bstan lus phra'i rna lung du/ /mi zad chosasbyin par gyi nor bu'i dpya/ /rnam par legasabargyan mtshungs med snying stobasakyis/ /yangasapa'i sa chen 'di yang 'degs sam snyam/ /sgyur ma'i rol gar gzigasamor mtshar ba la/ yid kyi mdud pa 'grol byed sor mo'i 'phrul/ /sgyur ba'i mkhan po rtsa ri dar rgyasadang / /dme dar po'i rnam dpyod dag las so/ /gang zhig tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i skye bo kun/ /tshogs gnyis nor bu dbang gi rgyal po ches/'dod don re ba bskong ba'i char chen po/ /'dzad med kun tu snyil ba'i bkra shis shog /—5/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)'od gsal lha rigs skyong rgya ri bas rgyal rabs deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyang par du bskos pa'i par byang rdzogs ldan rtse dga' bongs ba lhad/su sti pradzā ༷ ཿ ngo mtshar gtam gyi sbyor ba'i 'od zer gyis/ shes ldan thos 'dzin bad dkar 'dab ma brgya/ /rgyas byed deb ther sngon med rta bdun can/ /rdzogs ldan mgron du 'i 'gugs pa glegs bam 'di/ /mtho ris lding khang gsar pa'i them skas las/ /bsod nams stobs kyis 'ongs pa mi yi rje/ /gnam sa'i dbang phyug dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i lha/ /sa skyong ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan gyis/ /(45na'i dzad med rgya mtshor 'gran pa'i chos sbyin par/ /gtong ba'i phyag gis ris med 'gro ba la/ /spel bar rab brtson go cha cher bgos tshe/ /thams cad sgrol yang khengs pa btang ste 'dar/ /tshul 'dir ngal brgya'i dka' thub drag po yis/ /rtsa ri dar rgyas ka dze dar po zung / /sor rtse'i zlos gar bsgyur tshe dbang po'i gzhu/ /'gran slar byed snyam mkha' la bros pa bzhin/ /lhag bsam zla ltar dkar ba'i dbyu gu yi/ /phyogs 'dir phan pa bsgrubs pa'i rdza rnga che/ /bsnun rnams don gnyis snyan pa'i grags snyan sgra/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du 'bar gyur cig /rtsod ldan mun pa'i smag rum kun 'joms pa/ /rdzogs ldan rtse dga' rgod pa'i lugs gnyis khrims/ /sngon byon chos rgyal dam pa'i rnam thar kun/ /deng 'dir 'bad pa med par lhun grub shog /dag pa don dam 'gyur ba med pa'i khams/ /gcig las du mar 'char ba mchu zla'i gar/ khrud zhi'i snang brnyan bkra ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas mi pham mgon/ gser mngal sor mo'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar/ /med byung gzugs sku'i dpyid du legs grub dpal/ /mthong thos dran dang reg pas lus can kun/ /rnam grol mchog gi sal 'god 'di mtshar/ /rgyal kun gsang ba rab mas bkod pa'i zhing / /mtha' klas rdul gyi gangs ldan mkha' mnyam 'gro'i/ khams dang dbang por nyer 'tsham mdzad bzang las/ /(45bcu 'phrul mchod pa'i dus kyi dga' ston tshe/ /rlabs chen bsod nams utpal dkar po'i tshal/ /rtse dga' khong nas rab rgod 'dzum rlabs can/ /byed por skal bzang nyer —52

sku gsung thug rten gsar sgo sngos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)'tsho'i zla shel sku//'dren pa'i sngon med shing rta 'khor lo gang //khams gsum cig car yongasa'adegs stobs ldan la/kha lo skyes bu gcig bye nus pa'i//thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi tshul la sgyu ma mkhan//skyed byed med byung tshar du dngar ba 'di//rnam dpyod dpal gyi be'u'i ri mo gang //snying gar yongs su 'khyil ba'i shes rab kyi//mtha' klas rgya mtsho che las nyer bskrun tshe//sa 'dir khyab 'jug gnyis pa g.yin yod min//myur mgyogs bgrod pa'i rtsal ldan 'khor lo zhig/gangasaldan ra ba dkar por gnas so zhes//ma bzod rta ljang can de chu lha ma'i//thun mtshams gos dmar phag tu gzims pa bzhin//gling bzhin mnga' sgyur sa dbang rgyal po la//nyer 'os rtsibs stong 'khor lor 'gran gzod pa//rtsod pa'i dus 'dir mchis zhes ngo mtshar gtam//skabs gsum bdag po'i mdun sar lha rnams gleng //'khor ba'i pha mtha' 'tshol la rings pa'i 'gros//rnam bzhi'i mchod sbyin gtong ba'i 'dzad med sgo//brgya phrag phye bas gto bde'i yid bzhi nor//legs byas rgyal mtshan rtse mor mngon par brjid//dri med dge tsho gos rgyud mang snyan po'i sgras//srid na kho nga rgud pa'i gru gzings dag/46na gtong dang snying rje zung 'jug chu ga kho slong //dag pa don dam dbyings su ro gcig shog/sgo gsum rab 'bad rta bdun gyis drangs pa//legasa'i byas nya ma 'bum gyi snang ba'i gzis//gto bde'i padma dkar po'i tshal wo po//nam yang bzhad pa'i rtse dga' gtong min shog/'di snang 'khrul pa'i rang bawo ā thar//grangs med sdebazhi'i snang bas rab 'char ba//gcig tu gzigs mor mtshar ba'i dga' ston gang //skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun la 'gran gyur cig/bdag sogs mkha' mnyam ris bral skye rgu'i tshogs//dge ba'i rin chen them skas la 'dzegs nas//mi pham chos kyi 'dun sa'i dga' tshal du//bgrod de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen gyur cig/ces cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus byams mgon gyi sku bas 'gro ba kun gyi snang byed du 'dren pa'i shing rta 'khor lo ca ṇa'i rgyal khams kyi 'phrul la 'gran par bzod pa zhig lugs gnyis la lta ba'i rnam dpyod can bod sog gi lo tsā ba mer gan dka' bcu shes rab rgya mtshos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bkod pas grub par byas tshe de nyid kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal lo//bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos hor sog la nye bar mkho ba'i khrims yig gsar rtsom mdzad rtsis kyi 'go rgyangs mchod brjod rnam par rgya bha brtags mi du bhañtsa sa rbe64ra lha tā ma ṇi tsinta bā re/gra tra bras rmuku ṭa5di nā thaḥsarba lha zhi chis mu dradakhyi/srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs thams cad kyi//dbang phyug phan bde'i yid bzhin nor bu mchog/khyab bdag rigs kyi cod paṇa dang po'i mgon//dus rnams kun du bkra shis rgya mtsho stsol//ring mo nyid nas lan brgyar yongs goms tshogs gnyis bser bu'i dri bzhen rgyud kyis nye bar drangs las rab 'ongs pa//mtshan dpe'i rang snang sprul sku'i zlos gar ma la ya yi dri bsung dngar ba dal busabaskyod las tsol ba yis//bgrangs yas skye rgu'i dug gsum tsha gdung mtha' dag rab bcil zag med bde chen bsil ba'i reg bya sbyin mkhas pa//bla med sku gsum tsandan ljon pa'i bdag nyid gcig pu stobs bcu mnga' ba shākya seng 47na ) ge rgyal gyur cig/rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i zlos gar 'jam dbyangs mi yi srid pa yongs bzung ngag gi lha/shes bya kun la rnam dpyod blo gros gom pa gcig gis mkhas btsun bzang po'i gdong lngas bteg pa'i khrir 'dzegs nas//'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs 'khor los dam pa'i chos kyis gling bzhi yongs la mnga' sgyur ba//dus gsum rnam 'dren rgyu skar 'phreng dbus mngone par mtho ba nam mkha'i nor bu btsong kha pa la gus pas 'dud//lus can rnams la rjes su rab chags gting mtha' yongs bral snying rje chen po'i chu gter las 'ongs pa//'jig /na dbang phyug phyag na pad dkar mdzad bzang cha

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang na po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar sha/ (mnashas ma lus yongs su gang ba'i bsil zer can//med byung thugs rje'i 'od kyis mtha' 'khob mun ba rab 'joms bsod nams ches dkar snang ba legs stsole ba//rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yol ba med pa'i 'phrin las dbang phyug zhabs zung rkang drug snying dbus ze 'brur bzhugs//tshe yi dngos po mtha' dag 'gyur med rtag pa'i rang bzhin g.yung drung du//lhun grub mgon po phyag na 'chi bas rab dben bdud rtsi'i bum bzang can//grangs med skal bar gzhom zhig dang bral dngos grub 'brasabu'i dpal ster ba//tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa yongs 'du'i ljon shing gtsug na mdzes//brtan dang g.yo ba'i chos kyi 47bskonas lugs snang brnyan sna tshogs ri mo'i gzugs//mkhyen pa'i me long dri bral gsar par 'gog med rjen par 'char ba can//'dzum ldan zhal gyis ring nas legasabasus lugs gnyis gtsug lag bye ba'i mgron//'gugs mkhas 'jam mgon zur phud lnga pa mgrin pa'i rgyan du rtag bzhugs shig/mdzes sdug lang tsho rnam par rab rgyas zur mig dag dang lhan cig tu/khyud las yongs 'phos utpal dmar po'i 'dab ldan shugs kyis srid pa gsum//rab 'gugs rje btsun rigs byed dbang mos srid zhi'i dge legs ma lus pa//thogs pa med par dbang du bsdus la snying gi ze 'brur gar mdzod cig/bsod nams dpyid kyi mngal las legasa'ongs rdzogs ldan dbyar gyi dus ston la//longs su spyod mdzad mang pos bkur sogs 'khor lor sgyur ba'i rkang 'thung 'phreng //bod yul dge bcu'i dpal la rab 'god mes dpon gsum sogasalha yi rje//'phags chen dam pa bsams ba'i na rgyal por srid bzung rnams ni phyag gi yul//mesapo tshangs pa'i lung gis rgya hor bod sogs 'dzin ma'i gzhir//legs byas she mong dpung shugasadrag pos rang gir dbang bsdus pas//laṅka'i bdag po 'dar bar byed pa'i dpa' mdzangs rtul phod can//se chen gan sogs nyi 'og rgyal phran yongs kyi gtsug na mdzes//bsod nams nyin byed stong 48na gi gzi brdzid kyis//rtsod pa'i mun pa mthar bskrad rdzogs ldan dpal//snang ba gsar pas khyad par sa'i tshangs pa//bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i gtam 'di nyon//zhesapa snyan pa'i

rgyal dbang lnga gang ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā9)tshig gis sngun bsus te rang cag mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus ba la phan pa dang bde ba 'byung ba'i sgo dam pa ni dge ba bcu spyod pa dang mi dge ba bcu spongs ba'i blang dor gyi gnas la tshul bzhin du spyod pa gtso bor mchis shing / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'gro ba rnams dge ba bcu mtha' dag la spyod pa'i tshe rdzogs ldan gyi bskal ba zhes bya ba tshe lo brgyad khri thub cing longs spyod dpal 'byor yang de dang mtshudas pa'i legs byas kyi dngos po zad mi shes pa byung ba'i rgyu mtshan des na rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul la 'gyur med kyi nges pa brtan pos yid drangs te/ yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhi chen por 'khod pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag bde ba nas bde bar longs spyod pa'i ched du khrims su bca' ba'i dran tho mchog dman kun gyi yid kyi me long gtsang ma'i ngos su 'char ba ni/ spyir rdzogs ldan gyi bskal pa la mang pos bkur ba sogs 'khor rte ba'i rgyal po rim par byon pa nas bzung / rtsod ldan gyi dus su yang 'phags yul rgya hor bod sogs yul gru mang por chos ldan gyi rgyal po grangs med pa byung ba ni lo rgyus so sor gsal bas 'dir smos ma dgos/ 'dir rang re'i byung tshul 'od gsal lha las chad pa dang / chos skyong rgyal po'i brgyud pa (44)rim par byung ba'i deb ther gtam rgyud su gleng ba ma mas kyang / /byang phyogs ho me gyi yul gru'i ya gyal o rod tsho pa bzhin grags pa'i nang tshan hor shod ces pa 'bangs khri phrag du mar mnga' sgyur ba'i rje bo'i rigs su btsas ma thag pa nasamatshan mkhan rnams kyis 'di ni thar pa bla na med pa'i 'byor ba la spyod pa'am/ yang na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba nyid do zhes slu med kyi 'bras bu 'byung ba'i lung bstan gyi 'phreng bas bsngags/ snang srid kyi bdud tshogs ma lus pa la gyis gnon pa'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi zab gter mtha' klas pa'i lung bstan ta'i ra'i rgyud las nye bar 'ongs par gsang ba'i bdag po mi'i zlos gar can du bstan cing / nam yang mi phyed mdza' bas yid gcugs pa'i rnam dkar gyi las la bag chags bzang pos na tshod phra mo'i dus nas dge sdig gi blang dor gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam sogs 'bad pa med par yid la shar/ /don de nyams su bstar bar snying stobs kyi —56

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnago cha btsan po ma smad par gyon pas mtho ris kyis rtse mo nas 'char ba'i sngon med pa'i nyi ma ni khyod nyid do zhes 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur te stong spyi phud kyi 'khor losasgyur ba'i rgyal por gnam gyis bskos/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po'i rang shugs kyis khar kha o rod kyi gzhung 'khrugs pa'i srin po mi yul du rgyu ba'i spyod tshul lta bur lus srog la ma bltas par khar kha'i khrod du tsham tshom med par phyin nas(49na skog bsam gyis kha tas gzhung 'dums par bgyis te/ da lta'i bar du rdzogs ldan gyi padma rgod pa'i bzhin ras lta bur bde 'jags kyi dar dkar yug ni srid rtse'i bar du brkyangs/ ngang tshul de la khar kha'i rgyal po blon 'bangs rnams kyang rjes su yi rang ste tā'i gu hri zhes chen po'i ming dang snyan pa'i gtam gyis dril bsgrags/ kun mkhyen bla ma btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gces par bzung ba'i blo stobs kyis dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi snying la zhugs pas phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal thabs mtha' dag 'bad pa med par lhun gyis grub/ me mo glang gi lo la dpung tsho gis bye ba phrag brgya bshams te me tog mda' can dang tshangs par mtshudas par spyod pa'i chog thu dpon g.yog gting sel gtsang bar tshar bcad/ shar phyogs dbang po'i mthar thug pa'i rgyal khams mtha' dag chab 'og tu bcug /nor 'dzin bu mo yang 'dod pa 'jo ba'i mngal khur gyisadud/ rim gyis dbus gtsang nor 'dzin gyi ljongs su son te bod yul gyi lte ba lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i jo bo shākya mu ni'i spyan sngar ta la'i bla ma badzra dha ras bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i ming gi lung las gnang ste mngon par mtho sayos nang du yan lag rnam bzhi'i dmag gi dpung tshogs mdo khams kyi phyogs su bshams te stobs 'byor gyi (49ba jigs pas myos pa'i be re dpon po mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag chab 'og tu bcug /rje bo ngan pa gnas nas dbyung mdo khams sgang gsum mtha' dag dbang du bsdus kyang rang nyid gcig pu mngon par mtho ba'i bde ba nye bar spangs te chog shes pa ngo tsha khrel yod dang ldan pa'i —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)ngang tshul gyis phyogs de'i grub mtha' ris med kyi bla dpon gnas nas dbyung ba mtha' dag rang gnas su bskyal/ lcags mo sbrul la gnam sa 'gul ba tsam gyi dpung tshogs nyang smad bsam grub rtse'i mdun du phab/ dbus gtsang khri bskor bcu gsum mtha' dag rang zhabs su bcug /phan lan log par sgrub pa'i kur srid rnams kyis byed spyod dug sbrul sgong khyer dang mtshungs pa la yal bar mi 'dor ba'i dgra gdugs tsha ba nas shar phyogs kong po'i yul gru mtha' dag dpung shed kyis bcad/sngar dpal ldan sa skya pa dang yar klungs rgyal po gnyis kyi mnga' 'og tu ma 'dus pa'i stod mnga' ris khyung rdzong dkar po nas bzung lho rgya gar gyi grong khyer rtsa mchog tshun/ smad khams kong mdo smad bar gyi yangs pa'i sa thams cad dbang du bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi che bas 'jig rten na nad med cing tshe yang ring du lhag pa'i mtshan ma bzang po thob/ rdzogs ldan gnyis pa'i dga' ston la mdzad pa med bar longs spyod pa'i dus 'dir bod kyi khrims yig sngon byung ba rnams las gsar du bzo bcosam dgos shing / rang re o rod kyi sdo 'dir sngon chad khungs ldan gyi khrims yig zhig ma mchis pasagasar du (50na sku/na pa la/ /chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa 'jam la dam/ /rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing ldid non che/ /rang khrims theg pa khur blangs yon tan ldan zhes pa gsum zung 'brel du tshang dgos shing / de yang khrims med gtso bor byas na 'bod pa su la rgyag zer ba ltar bcu dpon tsam zhig yin yang spyi snyoms shing nye ring chung ba/ bsam pa che zhing bran 'khor mtha' dag bde bar skyong ba zhig dgos/ g.yog sa nas kyang gong sar dad chen tshud pa'i dpon gdung rabs dang g.yog mi rabs 'ded pa'i dpe ltar gser gzheng mar khus khengs pa lta bu'i snying thog tu snying khel ba/dpon gyis bskos pa'i sne mo las 'dzin rnams kyang dpon po la mngon shes med pa gzhin bzhag ste kha mdzes shing gting rang 'dod kho na lhur len pa ma yin pa'i mi chos sgor 'jug pa la rang bande gtsang ma zer ba ltar rang gis khrims thug pa'i dkon cog mi khrel ba zhig dgos pas/ mdor na dgra 'dul ba drag po dpung gi sbyor ba bshams tshul/ gnyen skyong ba zhi ba thabs mkhas kyis spyod —58

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho 4nga rdzas kha sang gi dkar sha/ (ma)tshul/ga pa rengs su mi 'jug cing bzang po gzengs su bstod pa sogs nye khungs med par sal drang po'i thig 'debs pa'i khrims yig/nyi zla mkha' la 'char ba ltar nye ring med cing gser gyi gnya' shing lta bur rtsi ba'i zhal che'i lag len gyi rim ba bri ba la/byang phyogs hor sog gi gzhung bde bar byed pa'i yig dan gyi don mi 'gyur ba'i dpang po mchog gsum 50bskom par gsol ba byams brtse'i zhags pa/rnam 'dren kun gyi yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs//mtshams sprin bla gos gsar pa'i zlos gar can//khams gsum 'gro kun bla ma btsong kha pa//dus gsum rgyal ba'i gtso des dge legs stsol//'chi med dpal ster bcom ldan tshe dpag med//khams gsum dbang du sdus pa rigs byed ma//srid zhi'i 'dod pa 'jo ba bye la//lha mchog rnams kyis dngos grub char ltar phob//bstan dang bstan 'dzin sbyin pa'i bdag por bcas//legs par mgon skyabs mdzad pa srung ma'i gtso//'jam dbyangs gshin rje gshed po chos kyi rgyal//dmar zlum spyan gyis legs nyesagasal bar gzigs//phung krol khon dang rtsod ba zhi ba'i phyir//mnyes gshin mdza' bar dam bca'i yig dan ltar//tshul bzhin 'grub cing sgrub rnams srung skyob dang //log par 'khu ba'i tshogs rnamasatshar chod cig/gnod sbyin 'dzin mar 'khod pa'i skye rgu rnams//ngal gsor byed pa gto mdun rin chen stegs//bde skyid dga' ston dpal la longs spyod pa'i//bden tshig 'grub par mdzod cig mchog gsum lha//phun tsho gis legs byas bye ba'i 'od stong gis//bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i snang ba rab gsal ba//bde legs rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar phyogs kun tu//rnam par 'byed pa'i dpal des khyab gyur cig/med byung thub bstan dar ba kha ba'i ljongs//dge bcu'i yon tan kun tshang skyid shod mthil//sde51nasgo zhis mgo mtho bod yul rdo rje gdan//'bum phrag grong khyer ldan pa yul gyi ljongs//skar tsho gos sa la 'phos 'dra'i grong khyer mchog/gnam la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gdugasaltar phub//sa gzhi pad 'dab brgyad pa'i tshul gyis brten//phyogs mtshams bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis mdzes shing //grangs med dge mtshan tshogasaXs bskor ba'i dbus//spyan ras gzigs dbang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)gangs can ljongs kyi rjer//bsams bzhin srid bzung srong btsun sgam po yi//thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar las legs grub pa//lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang bzang 'dir//sngon tshe 'phags pa'i yul du shākya'i tog/zas gtsang sras kyis mu stegs rab btul ba'i//ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan rnams//gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal du skrun mdzad pa//blo gros mchoge gis skal ba bzang po sa/sgyur mkhas 'jam mgon bla ma btsong kha pas//cho 'phrul mchod pa'i mdzad chen rab spel dus//lus can rnams kyi bsod nams zhing mchog tu//sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par ma ma mis par/zhal gyis bzhes pa shākya mu ni sogs//rgyal dang de sras snang bas grangs med cing //rgya chen mang thos lung gi yon to dang //mngon rtogs bslab pa gsum gyis rgyud phyug pa//phyogs ba chu'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyis//dri med smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar ba//phun sum 51batsho gis pa'i dus chen 'di nyid la//lusang ga yid kyis bsags pa'i dge ba'i tshogs//cung zad bgyis kyang grangs med bsod nams kyi//dngos po zad pa med phyir 'bad par rigs//zhes pa 'di yang smon lam chen mo'i dam bca'i skabs ma ṇi bskul rgyu'i 'go rgyangs zhig dgos zhes byams gling pa ma ni ba dkon cog blo gros kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o//rna4ra sa shar leg gad gling pa rnam rgya sgrub mchod mas sa khang /snang gsoga' zlog ༅sa zla ba ngo re dang /dus rmis che sa sogasalamakho shā wo dpyad grwa sgo rang du rtsi sbrad7de0kyi sgong brjod yod med 'dod tso sa rpā/su sti sirnyi/ngo ma' mas dpe'i cha shas ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'od zer gyis//brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung po'i kuṇḍa'i tshal rab rgyas pa las//grangs med phan bde'i 'dab stong 'dzum pa'i ze 'bru g.yur du za ba yi//lus can rkang drug dga' ston 'phel mdzad shākya seng ge rgyal gyur cig/byu ru'i lhun po 'bum phrag nyi 'od kyis//mngon par klubs la gar dgu'i nyamasaldan pa//sngon med sa 'dzin dbang po tsho gos kyi bdag/gang gis 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor char du phob//rnam kun mchog ldan bde chen 4 nyid ༷༷//thos bsam bshad sgrub bstan pa spel ba'i

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas kha slong gi dkar sha/ (ma)phyir//gnod sbyin dbang po'i skur sprul rnam thos sras//dpal ldan rgyal po chen pos shis par mdzod//sna tsho gos brjod pa nam mkha'i glang po las//52na jim yang 'dzad pa med pa tshig gi char//rab dkar shog bu'i nor 'dzin sto ba na//yi ge'i rkang 'thung 'phreng ba 'khrig pa bzhin/spyi bka' dang zur bka'i dbang rjes gnang gi mas dang //phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi phur sgrub/gshin rje'i zor/mdos phang mnan sreg go kyi dgo byed gal che ga mchod dpon blo yong mas stobs la rtsis sbrad pa'i de po kyi ma rdzo brjod 'dzad med nam mkha' ga kho mdzod/su sti pra dzā saḥrnam kun mchog ldan mi 'gyur bde chen bla na med pa'i zil dngar la//brten nas bdud bzhi'i 'chi ba'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal thob pa//mtha' yas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tsho gos skabs gsum pa yi bdag nyid can//kha sbyor bdun ldan rje btsun bla ma gser mngal can de phyag gi yul//rab dmar lcags kyus srid zhi'i legs tsho gis kun/khog car 'gugs nus khro chags sgeg mo'i gzugs//dran pa tsam gyis 'dod rgya'i dpal stsol ba//bcom ldan rigs byed lha mos dus kun skyongs//gzi brjed nyi ma'i snang ba mi 'gog cing //phun tshogs dpal 'byor char rgyun rtag 'bab pa'i//sngon med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar brgya//'byed mkhas rnam thos sras des shis par mdzod//'jam dpal khro bo'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar las//snang srid dregs pa'i sdod pon skur ston pa//gnod sbyin bshan pa beg rtse lcam dral gyis//'gal rkyen bsol la dngos grub char ltar phob//52ba / rab dkar shog bu'i rin cen yangs pa'i snod//rmugs 'dzin longs spyod 'khyil ba yi ge'i 'phreng //tshig gi srad bur brgyud dang lhan cig tu//ri mo gsum pa'i rgyud mangs sgra dbyangs 'brol/rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i rten gsum sngags mas snyan dar rol mo 'phan gdug bla bre bol ba go khrab dkar sder dpyad tsho gos gur sogs spyi rdzas deb 'khod kyi mchod brjod rmugs 'dzin bang mdzod 'byed pa'i lde mig/su sti pra dzā ༷ ཿsrid dang zhi ba'i dge legaXkun gyi gter//'dod pa'i re ba yongs skong dbang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)gi rgyal//rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam srung ma yis//phun tsho gis bkra shis dpal gyis skyong gyur cig/rgyal kun mi 'gyur bde stong zung 'jug gar/khro chags bcu drug lang tshor legs shar bas//brtan g.yo'i chos kun dbang du sdud byed pa//bcom ldan rigs byed lha mos dge legs stsol//nyin byed 'bum gyis stid pa gser bzhun ri//gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa'i 'jo sgeg can//'dod rgu'i longs spyod byu du snyil mdzad pa//gnod sbyin dbang po rnam thos sras des skyongs//rab tu rngams pa mi bzad srin po'i zhal//log 'dren dgra la gdangs pa'i khro gtum can//srog bdag bshan pa beg rtse lcam sring der//sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor dang bcas pas srungs//rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje theg pa la//brten nas phan bde'i legs lam bye ba'i sgo//bshad dang sgrub pa'i tshul gyis rab 'byed pa//53na 'ag sngags 'chang ba'i khrims ldan 'dus sde'i gling //gang gi rten gsum mchod dang dam tshig rdzas//nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad la sogs pa//dkar 'jam shing gi ma ma'i yol go'i nang //mi zad yi ge'i nor bu g.yas su 'khyil/oṃ swa :dzo:zung 'jug mi zad gsang ba 'khor lo'i mdzod //mtshan dpe'i snang ba dar la 'bab pa'i dpyid//dpal ldan sku bzhi'i 'byor par dbang bsgyur ba//lhun grub 'jam mgon bla ma phyag gi yul//blo bzang grags snyan bstan pa ma snyika/rnam dpyod rgyan du sbud pa'i ngo mtshar gyi//dus gsum rgyal rnams gzigs mor g.yeng ba la//me rtag phal cher 'dzum zhing dgod pa 'dra//skyes rabs yongs 'du'i phreng mdzes dga' tshal na//mkhas btsun bzang po'i yal 'dab g.yur za zhing //sku gsum ro brgya'i 'bras bu legs smin pa//sngon med ljon shing dbang po khyod min su//mgon khyod zag med dga' bzhi yongs rdzogs pas//mkha' sbyor bdun ldan gnas 'dir mngon gyur phyir//'di las ga' na du dag pa rab stims kyis//zhing khams 'tshol bar byed rnams byis pa'i blo//nyer bzhi'i yul gyi ya rgyal lha mo mkhar//mkhas grub bye ba'i bsti gnas dam pa 'dir/khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin de'i sku'i snang brnyan//skal bzang yongs kyi dad pa'i gsos su 'jebs//

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnamathong thos dran reg tsam gyi byed po yis/ thar (53ba)pa'i sa bon yongs su 'jog byed na/ /tshulabazhin phu dud bsgrubs rnams tshe gcig la/ /mi gnas myang 'das thob las gzhan du ci/ /dad pa'i myu gu rab bstar cho ga yis/ /don gnyis 'bras bur longs su spyod byed pa/ /dkar chag gzhan gsosamagrin pa'i dbyangs snyan po/ /bsod nams dpyid kyi mthu las deng 'dir len/ /de la 'dir dusagasum rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi bdag nyid 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub de nyid nges pa'i don du rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor dbye ba med pa las thun mong ba'i gdul bya rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i slad du ji ltar mkha' la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig shar yang rdzing bu brgya phrag du mar snang brnyan tha dad pa so sor 'char ba ltar 'phags pa'i yul du slob dpon chen po shākya bshes gnyen dang / kha ba'i ljongs 'dir chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa sogs mkhas pa dang grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur pa mtha' klas pa'i rnam rol bstan te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dang / 'gro ba'i phan bde'i rtsa lag dam par gyur cing / khyad par sku tshe 'di nyid la mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum gyi sgo nas kun mkhyen bla ma btsong kha pa chen po'i dri ma med pa'i ring lugs yang dag par spel ba'i mdzad pa ni rnam par thar pa las shes par bya zhing /dgung lo nga dgu pa sa mo lug gi lo la yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya rgyal de wi ko ṭi ming (54na skoyin pho brang ma ru zhes chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sogs dam pa du mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i pha bong kha'i gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs nas sgrub pa'i sde btsugs te bstan pa dang sems can gyi phan bde rgyas pa'i smon lam la nan tan gtso bor gnang ba yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan sngon chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos phan bde'i rtsa lag ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang gegs med du 'grub pa'i thabs su gnas 'dir sgrub pa mdzad pas rigs gsum mgon po zhal gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs pas ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin 'bad med du 'grub pa nas bzung rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa glang 'di yan la bod kyi bde skyid rgyas mi rgyas gnas 'di'i dar rgyas kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byung 'dug pas de dag gi rgyu —63

rgyaladabang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)mtshan thugasal nye bar mnagasapa dang/ khyad par de'i skabs sa rta'i sde gzar la brten lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du khrag mtsho 'khyil zhing se 'bras la bkag po phog pa sogs dus nyam thag pa la 'gro ba'i 'dren par rlom pa rnams ni rang gi bde ba don du gnyer ba las sems can gzhan sdug bsngal gyisamanar bar ba spu g.yo 'gul tsam yang 'byung ba'i gnas min la/ rje bla ma 'di nyid ni bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don kho na thugs la 'chang ba yin pas de skabs chos sde du ma'i mkhan thog tu phebs dgos par gsol ba 'debs pa sogs phyogs bral 'phrin las kyi sgo 'phar dus gshig tu bye bar gyur kyang bod 'bangs kyi (54bangade thabs sgrub pa la gcig tu gzhol ba'i med byung lhag bsam mchog gi shing rta bdun gyis rje btsun nyin mor byed pa dben gnas padma dkar po'i tshal 'dir nye bar drangs so/ /de ltar sku che'i smad la dben gnas chen po 'di nyid du yun ring por bzhugs te bstan 'gro'i sman yon rlabs po che bskrun nas rtag par 'dzin pa rnams dam pa'i chos la bskul ba'i slad du chos sku bde ba chen po'i klong zad mi shis pa'i dbyings su gzugs sku'i bkod pa nye bar bsdus nas bgrang bya bcu gsum du slebs pa'i tshe skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la thugasarje chen po'i 'jug pa dus las mi g.yel ba'i rten 'byung du gnas 'dir dam pa 'di nyid kyi zhal skyin zhig bzhugasan legs tshogs che bar bsams te 'gal ba zhes pa sa mo glang gi lo'i khrums stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po phun tshogs sbyor ba'i gza' tshes dge ba nas bzung nyer bzhi'i rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'i 'grub sbyor la legs par sgrub pa'i sku 'dra rin po che 'di nyid bla na med pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od mngon par 'bar ba'i byed por nang bzhugs kyi rim pa ni/bstan pa spyi'i byin rlabs rten la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung gnyis/sangasargyasaglang po'i gdung / rgya bza'i phyag bzo'i sangasargyasabatags sku'i ris ma/ byang chub kyi shing / rang sangs rgyas kyi gdung rdo'i khams su byin gyis brlabs pa/ dgra bcom pa 'char (55na)ga'i snam sbyar/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho'i na bza'/ bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi rusargyan/ paṇa chen nā ro —64—

skugasung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po tsho mar rdzasakha bzang gi dkar sa/ (ma)pa'i snyan rgyan/grub chen nag po spyod ba'i rusargyan/chosargyal srong brga sgam po'i zhabasaphyags/de'i dusakyi sprul pa'i stag gi pagasapa/bka' gdamasarin po che'i byin rlabs rten gyi skor la dpal ldan a ti sha'i snam sbyar de'i gdung nag de'i dbu paṇa de'i phyag gi tsha par la par btab pa gnyis/dge ba'i bshesaganyen sgom pa ba'i sku rags/dge ba'i bshesaganyen po to ba'i sku chos/dge ba'i bshesaganyen sha bo sgang ba'i gdung rus/mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i byin rlabs rten gyi skor la/rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i dbu lo/de'i na bza'/de'i phyag tsha gcig/rgyal tshab thamasacad mkhyen pa'i dbu skra/paṇa chen byamasapa gling ba'i na bza'/thamasacad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub gyi sku chos/rtogasaldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i gdung rus/semasadapa' chen po kun bzang ba'i dbu lo//chos rje smon lam dpal ba'i shangasaphyis/chosarje mdung rtse ba'i dbu lo/'dar ston blo bzang gragasapa'i gdung rus/mkhasagrub nor bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/thamasacad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/de'i sku rags/gling smad lha dbang dpal 'byor gyi gdung rus/paṇa chen bsod namasagragasapa'i dbu lo/thamasacad mkhyen pa bsod namasargya mtsho'i dbu lo/de'i dbu klad/de'i pur ras/de'i sku srung 55bgi tshal/chosarje rje btsun pa'i dbu lo/grub chen na kha pa'i dbu lo/shar pa sgom sde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/thamasacad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa nyid kyi dbu lo/gsang chab/gdung rus/phyag sen/zhabasasen/rje nyid kyisabasgrubasapa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/rje de nyid kyisadakyil 'khor go po'i bdag 'jug mang du bzhesapa'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangasadang bcasapa/sku ber bubs/nged rang gi skra/gosakyi dum bu/dpal ldan saskya pa'i byin masarten gyi skor
