la/rnal 'byor dbang phyug beerba pa'i rusargyan/'khon rog shes rab tshul khrimasakyi phyag 'phreng /rje btsun brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po'i na bza'/rje btsun rtse mo'i gar gos/rje btsun gragasapa'i kha ṭaṃ gyi 'phan lce/rje btsun sapaṇa gyi dbu zhwa/'phagasapa rin po 6

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)che'i na bza' dang rdo rgyus bang khebs/ theg chen rin po che'i pur ras dang pur sol/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi sku chos/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po'i pur tsha/ mtshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku rags/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun ril bu/ rin po che bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun ril bu/ sa skya'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i byin rlabs rten gyi skor la/ gter ston byang chub gling pa dpal rgyal mtshan gyis gter (56nags bton pa'i slob dpon rin po che'i thugs dam sdig par la par du btab pa gcig /bee ro tsa na'i phyag dpe'i cha shas/ bsam yas bar khang gi rgya dpe/ mnga' bdag nyang gi gter ma'i bde 'dus shog ser/ byang gter shog ser/ chosadabang rin po che'i sku sha/ des bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman/ g.yar po g.yung ston rdo rje dpal gyi ring bsrel/ gter ston ratna gling pa'i gdung rus/ gter ston kun skyong gling pa'i zhabasang ra/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i sle bem/ mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che'i snam sbyar/ rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje'i dbu lo/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis bsam yas khams gsum du bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman/ byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po'i dbu skra/ de nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'gro don las sbyor lnga pa'i ril bu/ yol mo sprul pa'i sku bstan 'dzin nor bu'i dbu sgra de nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i 'gro don lasasbyor lnga pa'i ril bu/ zur gyi rigs 'dzin chen po ngag dbang bkra shis kun dgas snga 'gyur gyi dam rdzas kho na phyogs gcig tu bsdus te tshes bcu'i nyin ril bur bsgril ba grangs med du 'phel ba'i ngo mtshar can/ dwags shangs sogs grub mtha' rigs med sna tshogs kyi byin rlabs rten gyi skor la/mkha' 'gro ma ni gu'i gdung / mkhas grub khyung po'i dbu thod/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi snam sbyar/ mar pa'i ber seng (56ba)gi mjing bsnol/ thugs dam padma ra ga par la btab pa gcig /dpal sga lo'i gdung 'dam/ sgam po zla 'od gzhen nu'i zhabs phyags/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i dbu skra/—66

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)skyon pa rin cen dpal gyi sgom thag /paṇa chen shākya grwa'i snam sbyar/ bal po mahā bo dhi'i dbu lo/dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i gdung / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i na bza'/ rgyal sras dngul chu chos rdzong pa'i na bza'/ mkhas pa ye bzang rtse pa gzhon nu dpal ba'i dbu skra/ don gyi paṇḍita chen po zha lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po'i dbu skra/ sa sna rdo sna la/ bal po shing kun/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor/ bal po stag mo lus byin/ bal yul yang le shod/ gangs ti rtse rnams kyi rdo/ mtsho ma pham gyi bye ma sna lnga/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug sogs bod kyi gnas chen rnams kyi sa sna rdo sna/tsa ri'i mtsho sna 'dus pa'i zan gyi dum bu/ bde bar gshegs pa sman gyi bla'i zhal thang gcig /byamasapa sman bla 'od dpag med gsum gyi sku/ sātstsha gcig /mkhas grub klong chen rab 'byams pa'i dgongs gter bla ma yang tig gi glegs bam/ byang chub lam rim chen mo/ bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho gcig /gtso bor chos sku'i ring bsrel rgyud sde bzhi dang mdo nas gsungs pa'i gzungs sngagasashin tu mang ba/ de yang sgril tshul 'khrul pa med pa gsang sngags sbrul 'khyil ba'i dbyibs can du bgyis pa la nang du dri bzang dang phyi rol du dar zab la sogs(57na)pa'i na bzas klubs pa/ skyesamached byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzungs sngags dus 'khor bde dgyes sogs rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa'i phyag len 'khrul pa med par bstar/ dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i sgrub pa'i bsti gnas yin pas don med 'jig rten gyi rnam g.yeng zar zir mang po dang tshe 'di don du gnyer ba'i skye bo mang po'i 'du tsho gos la dgos pa mi 'dug kyang / chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa dang gtan gyi bde ba don du gnyer ba'i spong ba bsam gtan pa'i grwa 'phel bar byed pa'i thabs su khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i man ngag khyad par can 'phags yul gyi paṇḍi ta chen po rdo rje gdan pa dang bod yul gyi rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa rje btsun brtse ba chen po'i zhabs la sogs pa rnams kyi snyan rgyud thun mong ma yin pa/ klu pa'i gser chos kyi man ngag la brten nas dge 'dun dang longs spyod dbang du 'du ba'i 'khor lo phyag len 'phyug pa med pa dang / 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi rgyud nas gsungs—67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo pho mo go ma ldog pa'i phyag len rab gnas sgrub pa ga thul med sogs mdor na gzungs 'bul tshul phra zhib mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par 'bad pa chen pos bsgrubs shing /bgegs skrod pa dang ye shes pa 'jug pa sogs byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od phung por byas pa yin no/ /de ltar mchog gsum thugs rje chen po'i gzugs/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i rnam par legs shar bas/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gnyen (57ba)gcig 'khon ston rje'i/ /snang brnyan 'di ko bsod nams zong gis bskrun/ /'phags mchog dam pa'i man shel khams las grub/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dkyil 'bor cha kun rdzogs/ /per rtsod rtsom pa'i 'od stong rab spro ba'i/ /bshes gawo wo byed chu lha'i stor gzims kyang / /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i bsil zer gyis/ /phan bde'i ku mud 'dzum gyi bsu mkhas pa/ /dam pa'i sku brnyan zla ba gsar pa 'di/ /legs byas rlud gi shing rtas ring nasadrangs/ /dge 'dis kha bas bskor ba bod yul 'dir/ /'dren mchog thub pa'i bstan pa yongs 'du'i ljon/ /lung rtogs 'dab stong rgyas pa'i grib bsil la/ /'gro kun bde skyid ngal gsor spyod gyur cig /khyad par 'jig rten dbang phyug srong btsan gyi/ /ngo mtshar grub pa'i bsti gnas lha mo mkhar/ /khrims ldan 'dus pas yongs gang thos pa'i don/ /bsam dang sgom pas nyams su len par shog /'khor ba'i shul lam 'khrul ba'i 'phrang ring por/ /dkar nag las kyi dbang gis bgrod pa'i tshe/ /bde ba'i lam du nyer 'khrid sa mkhan can/ /yongs 'dzin mchog gi mgon dang mi 'bral shog/khyad par 'khor lo'i mgon po he ru ka /ngur smig gar mdzad dpal 'byor lhun grub kyis/ /deng nas zung 'jug go 'phang ma thob bar/ /rjes su bzungs te don gnyis lhun grub shog /de ltar bod yul swā la'i ljongs chen po 'di nyid kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag dam par gyur (58na)pa pha bong kha byang chub shing gi nags khrod rje bla ma dam pa'i sgrub pa'i bsti gnas su/ sku 'dra rin po che yid bzhin nor bu bzhedasapa'i dkar chag gi rim pa 'di ni bla ma'i bka' 'bangs za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/rnam rgyal zhes pa chu mo sprul gyis lo 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal pos nyi ma nub phyogs kyi chos srid stan pa tshog tu gyur pa'i —68

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas go bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)lung las gser gyi byang bu la rgya bod hor gsum gyi yi ge bris pa'i wo' sa dang cas gnang shā du dpal ldan lha mor tham phud phul ba phan bde'i dga' ston/saḥdzin badzra sa ra su:tribha bā pā ti re ma gli/dha'i khrig smos khri yab rā de wa shu ma dhe pa ri ā nirti/rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje dbyangs can ma//srid gsum bdag mo dpal ldan re ma ti//phan dang bde ba'i mchog stsol lhag pa'i lha//'dod pa'i khams kun yongs la dbang sgyur mar//54skor phyogasargya mtsho'i mthar khyab skye rgu la//stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i lung las kyis//mtshams sprin mdangs kyi dpal 'dzin tham ga'i phud//'bul gyis dus kun bkra shis dge legs stsole//bshul du nad gdon nyer 'tshe dang bral nas//'dab bzang dbang po ji bzhi thogs med du//kha ba'i ljongs su son nas dam chos kyi//dga' ston rgyun ho med par spyod gyur cig/wom dbyang gong masaganang ba'i tham spu'i phud chu sbrul sgar 'a dbus su ba kho na 'or dus su'i sder slebs thog dar gan nang so bod la snga mgyog su brdzang skabs jo bo shākya mu zher phul ba'i kha yig srid pa'i rtse mor 'khor ba'i gdugs dkar/shu stod kā kā la ya su brakuṇḍa lo kaṇḍa na ni tsa sgo la//bas nta ya sto mrita kaṇi mā ni khyab/he rnyas spos khyunab/59na ) dus kun dge ba'i chu klung rab gyi 'as bar//ba po shis dbyangs kyi rgyal po ma si pa'i rnga// 7sgra 'dzin bdud rtsir byed pa'i ༅ dga'i dpyid//stsol cig lus dkar dbang po nyi ma'i garsā/ā shu zer tsakā ya pha lha tsaḥpā ya pra lha'i dza su ra pā ka a nutta ras stog yas sgra dzag tsā bha dra/ge ta bha tigodza yan ma:ma pā mchu//tshar du dngar ba'i thabs shes sa bon las//bla med sku bzhi'i gos bu smin pa'i bcud//'gro rnams longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang can//rgyal ba'i tog gyur shākya seng ger 'dud//59bapar ma ti:khu su go mya ho po la su da ya tsa kirti chub na/ /:du stokho3bos spyo ga bratig gan bi mu khyu//blo gros mchoge gyur mkhas btsun bzang po yi//med byung grags snyan lang tsho legs dar bas//zur phud lnga pa de dang tha dad sgo//rnam par 'byed paX blo gros gsal ba bzhin/phul byung mkhyen brtse

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)nus pa'i dri bsung gis//srid zhi'i tsha gdung sel ba'i cho ga mkhan//rgyal sras nyan rang slob mar bcas pa yi//sngon med tsas ljon pas 'gro 'di skyongs//gnam gyi mthongs nas 'jig rten mes po yis//stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i mchog byin pas//gser ldan ma 'di gang gis rjes 'brang ba//sa gzhi'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma ches//nub phyogs nor 'dzin yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyi//bstan 60na tā gro'i bdag por de'i chi kying gang sogs//chen por bkur ba'i lung dang las ka'i rtags//tham ka padma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin phud//phun tsho gos skal bzang rnam par rgyal ba zhes//nyal 'gro'i gos gyon 'byung ba gsum ldan lo//chu sto phob sngon ma'i yar gyi ngon/rgyal phur 'phrod kyi dge ba'i dus bzang por//mngon par rab bkra gan gos ā darshar//rgya hor bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs bas rnams//thun 'tshams gsar pa'i mdog 'dzin yongs shar 'di//sdebazhi'i sgo 'phar legs phye'i sgar nas phul//rgyal kun thugs rje'i yu bas nyer bteg pa//phun tsho gis phan dang bde ba'i gdugs dkar po//srid pa'i rtse mor yongs 'khor grib bsil la//'gro rnams nyer 'tsho'i skal bzang thob gyur cig/gong nas bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal por tham ka 'ja' sa gnang ba'i dus jo bo shākya mu nir tham phud phul pa'i kha yig gnam gyi she mong dpal 'bar sogs/swasti pradzā byeḥsrid zhi'i dge legs gtsug tor mthon po'i rtser//zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo rnam bkra ba//'gro ba'i bla ma zas gtsang sras po yis//ngo mtshar bkra shis glu yi rgyud mangs 'khro pa//bsod nams rang bzhin dar ba'i 'od stong gis//bstan 'gro'i snang ba kun nas rab rgyas dpyid//sa dbang bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i ming /0/ngo mtshar snyan grags gdugs dkar srid rtser

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)'khor ba yis/ /40bskong der tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gis/ /stobs kyis 'khor rte ba'i rgyal po'i sar/ /dbang gyur 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po zhes/ /sal spyod pa'i mi yi tshangs pa des/ /chen po'i go sar bkur byed lung las kyi/ /lag rtags mtshams sprin mdog can tham ga'i phud/ /'dzam gling rgyan gcig shākya mu zhe'i sku/ /lus can bsod nams zhing gi rgya mtsho cher/ /legasaphul dge tsho gos ma la yi dris/ /rgud pa'i tsha gdung ma lus kun bcom nas/ /bla med phan bde bsil ba'i reg bya la/ /legs spyod 'dod don re ba skong gyur cig /ye shes mchogo gi bee ḍūr mthing kha'i rgyun/ /med byung mtshan dpe'i lang tshor rab 'khyil sku/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa'i nad kun 'joms mdzad lha/ /rgyal ba sman gyi bla mas rtag tu skyongs/ /rgya chen gsorig gzhung lugs gaṅgā'i chu/ /blo gros hub kyis 'thung ba drang srong che/ /rigs 'dus sman rgyal gu ṇa rdo rje 'chang / /g.yu thog mgon de snying gi bad mtshor rol/ /'chi gso'i bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'gro kun gyi/ /snying la sbran mdzad phyogs ris bral ba'i nor/ /snang rigs rjes sbyangs lus can yongs kyi gnyen/ /tshe yi rig byed 'dzin rnams rgyal gyur cig /ngo mtshar mthong bas yid 'phrog lta na sdug /sman gyi nags klungs sdug po'i khor yug can/ /lhag bcas drang srong 'du ba'i grong khyer che/ /sprul pa'i gnas de 'og min zhing gi dpyid/ /gang der rgyal dbang sman blas bka' stsal pa/ /41na)bdud rtsi'i snying po yan lag brgyad pa zhes/ /rtsa bshad man ngag phyi rgyud bzhin 'dus pa'i/ /tshig nyung don rgyas legs bshad 'di med byung / /e ma lho phyogs tsande na dga' tshal nas/ /bser bus rab bskul dngar ba'i dri bsung can/ /tshad pas ches mnar 'gro rnams gdung sel la/ /sngon med zla shel zhun ma'i skrun zla gzhan/ /dbyangs can 'phang 'gro'i sgra ltar rna ba la/ /bdud rtsir longs su spyod pa kun dga'i dpyid/ /dpyod ldan yid kyi gdung sel mdza' na mo/ /a ho gso rig gtsug lag ngo mtshar med/ /blo gros mgrin pa gzengs su mtho ba'i dung / /smra mkhas ri mo g.yas su rab 'khyil ba/ /mi zad dbyangs su 'tsher ba snyan pa'i glu/ /blangs tshe mkhas rnams dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsu//—71—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo rsāng rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)zhes gso ba rig pa'i che brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni gso rig 'dzin pa tshe brtan rdo rjesabaskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bya rgyal po bkra shis so//ma dbyangs gong ma'i bye sdu/ /sdu rdo ༷༵ ༵ sdu // ༷zlo/ // ༷'a tsho mar rdzas su dmigs te snam sbyar mngags ba khyad go'i phul phe a tha sra sti sirnyi ra stu/thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i chu gter las//bla med sku bzhi'i 'od kyis 'gro kun la//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen gzigs 'bras smin pa'i//gtan bde stsol mdzad thub dbang nyin mor byed//gang de'i pahrūl 61bgyi jigs med seng ge'i sgras//bdud dang mu stegasari dwags srog 'phrog pa//mnyan yod mchod pa'i cho 'phrul dus chen gyi//e ma 'phags yul skal ba bzang por byas//ngo mtshar snang ba'i gzugs bas ā darshar//'phos pa ji bzhin sman ljongasagangs can 'dir//lha ldan zhing du 'jam mgon btsong kha pas//rgyal kun mchod pa'i srol btod 'di ༅ byung //dus der kun tu bzang po'i ma rdzo sprin nas//'dod yon sna lnga'i gru char wob pa las//'jam mnyen reg bya'i dpal gyur rung mthun gyi//dge sbyong mchog la 'os pa'i gos bzang 'di//za hor brje'i lhag bsam gyis bskul bas//'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i gdung 'dzin pa//nor ldan skyong ba'i khe shing chin dbang gis//mkhyen dpyod rab yangs dad pas legs par bsgrubs//dge des bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i 'od//nyi zla ji srid gnas par rab gsal zhing //sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe dpal bsod nams dang //mnga' thang rdzogs ldan dpal la 'gran par shog/phul byung thugs rje'i rdo rje rtse brgya pas//srid zhi'i rgud pa'i ri bo kun bcom nas//phun tshogs bkra shis 'chi med dga' ston tshogs//stsol kye dkon cog rin cen lha'i dbang po//dus kun rnam par dge ba bkra shis kyi//snyan pa'i 'gyur khugs g.yas su legs 'khyil dung //dam pa'i chos kyi dbyangs su rab sgrogs sgras//lus can yongs kyi rna ba'i rgyan gyur cig/62na skong rta dpal ldan 'bras ngas kyi 'du khang 'a mor dpag bsam 'khri /bye gi zhing bkod bzheng pa'i bar mtshams la bla ma dang sgo srung gi

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdza khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)chos skyong bri pa'i mas byang srid sto gan mdzod/tsinta rā dzā pha da stoḥtsa ā kontabhawa the ya su khyu hi ta/kirti rnarnyo darsha bī bha lha gram rnyetsa posaryata smis srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs kun gyi mdzod//phan bde'i dpal ster yid bzhi dbang gi rgyal//zas gtsang sras kyi grags pa gdugs dkar can//srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du 'khor der 'dud//62bam rya mā lwaka a lha da nā dzineḥg bya koṭa ra bā tsā tsā pa sdu/te dza tha lha surya sa pu rtsa sho zhe rje lha pi lhanaskoX PROBPROBPROB/rgyal dbang rtogs brjod ma ra yi 'phreng //snyan dngags bye ba'i dbyangs su len mkhas pa//nor 'dzin skyong ba dge dbang yab sras kyi//bsod nams nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid 'bar63nadzes bya lhas mi sa bcad ma bā sa stobasgo rtsi lha dzaḥdīpe〉shā sa nā bā ti ko)lhan〉bha lha mupal nā/rgyal ba ༅ gyi gsang gsum rdo rje gar//mas dpe'i lang tsho dar la babs pa'i dpyid//'dzam gling bstan pa'i bdag po btsong kha pa'i//'jam dpal mi yi srid pa can de rgyal//63barsā༅lha to༅spon8bha ri kya tsa/pā no padma na mo dza gya:ā nā the tsan ṭa gi/ngo ma' bsod namasaye shes kyi//tsho gos gnyis rgya mtsho lasangs pa//phyag na padma'i zlos gar cher//'gro ba kun gyi mgon der 'dud/64nabrarmi shwarnya lha kha bha wa shā gas nā the shrī//sen wa gi〉tshwa sug sde:rdzis ku lha pa te://gnam sa'i dbang phyug tshangs pa yis//srid dang zhi ba'i dpal mgon du//rigs kyi bdag por dbang bskur ba//ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/64ba.a tā ṣi rgyas khyu pa rbe ka lnga sgyu gi pra lus shrī ma dma shā kwa li pa sa karmā la myushā sorakṣa//mig sman dang mtshungs sa 'dzin la/ /bskal pa'i me dpung rab 'bar ba/ /dpal ldan dus kyi dgra — po'i/ /las kyi gshin rjes bstan pa srungs/65na

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()semar sa rgyu tsā ma hā bikṣa ru sumaX.a cho/stotta karya tsadharmā rāḥnirmā ma hāswā dha karma tsa/ /sde brgyad kun gyi dbang phyug che//grangs med rnam 'gyur sgyu 'phrul gyis//'phrin las thams cad sgrub mdzad pa//sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen por bstod//65bachos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi 'du khang la rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing gi ldebs bris byas skabs zhal byang tshigs su bcad pa ngo mtshar dpag bsam snye ma sogs/shantibha lha shu:ni dhi:so / shrī datta te tsinda ji rā dzā/zhe cad ni ra kirti shukla bha bā ge khus tsakranamya srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs kun gyi mdzod//phan bde'i dpal ster yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//zas gtsang sras kyi grags snyan gdugs dkar can//srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du 'khor der 'dud//rgyal dbang rtogs brjod manta ra yi phreng //snyan ngag bye ba'i dbyangs su len mkhas pa//nor 'dzin skyong ba dge dbang yab sras kyi//bsod nams nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid 'bar/()/ngo mtshar bkod pa'i grong khyer 'od sgo na dzin du//nyi ma'i gnyen de sa bdag rab gsal zhes//nor 'dzin bdag por gyur tshe gnyis 'thung dbang //gangs ri'i dum bu ho 'dra sgo drung lhags//gang de 'dul bar bga' bsgos pa//ji bzhin byed pos las rung du//dul bar byas la mi'i bdag pos//zhon nasatsā chi ngogs su byon//'dod pas myos pa'i glang wo de//rang dbang dang bral rab brgyugs pa//phra rgyas zhags pas nyer bcings pa'i//'gro 'di'i rang mtshang ston pa bzhin//ljon pa'i yal gar 'chang pas rgyal po'i srog/'tsho ba'i bdud rtsi bsod nams kyis bskrun pa//rgyal khab chen por log nas glang rdzi la//mi bzad tshig gi mtshon cha nyer phab tshe//tsha bsreg reg bya rnam par 'bar ba'i lcags//rdzi bos glang po'i zas su byin pa na//di 'dod bzhin du za ba'i sta gon gyis//lus dang

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho 4sko rdzas kha slong gi dkar ga / (ma)sems gnyis 'dul tshul so sor mthong / /ma rig sngon chags 'khor ba'i 'gro rnams kyi/ /sna tshogasathabs mkhas byed pos thul min sems/ /'dul byed mthong thos dran pas rnam grol ba/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya'i mtshan gyi dbyangs 'di snyan/ /tshul des rab gsal dang por byang chub tu/ /thugs bskyed mkha' la legs bris tshogs lhags nas/ /myur du bla med zhi bde bdud rtsi'i ror/ /longs su spyod pa'i dbugs dbyung phan bde'i dpyid/(2)/a sti zhes yangs pa'i grong khyer du/ /nor 'dzin dga' 66bsgos 'dud pa dpal gyi sde/ /ma smad sdebazhi'i 'byor ba rnga bo che/ /grags pa'i dbyu gus snyan pa srid rtser sgrogs/ /dus der rig byed ston pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /rang gi slob mar rgyal po dpal gyi sde'i/ /btsun mo 'chi med lusaphra'i rjes 'gro de/ /gtsug lag bstan ba'i yon du phul zhes smras/ /slob mas rgyal po'i drung song mchis brang de/ /slong ltar re ba yongs bskang grags pa'i sgra/ /mtho ris gnas su khyab pas brgya byin gyis/ /lus smad bral ba'i nyam thag bram zer sprul/ /ldab ldib tshig gis kwa ye mi'i bdag po/ khyed kyi lus phyed sbyin tshe bdag gi srog /'tsho zhes lha rnams smra na rang bde kun/ /gtong ba'i snying stobasaldan pa khyod nyid dgongs/ /gsol tshe blon 'bangs rnams kyis nyer bkag kyang / /ri gzar chu bo gyen du ldog min ltar/ /sbyin pa'i dam bca' brtan pa'i rgyal po des/ /rang gi khog smad gsog lesabacad de byin/ /brgya byin ngo mtshar legs bris bdud rtsi yis/ /nor 'dzin skyong ba'i lus ni sngar bzhin gsos/ /gtsug lag smra bas btsun mo slar phul zhing / /'dzam gling bdag por 'chi med dbang pos bskur/(3)/legs byas mngon sum mthong ba rang byung gi /nor bus gtsug gi rgyan du rab gsal lha/ yā ke ra zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du/ /sa la nyer spyod bdag por lhun gyis grub/ /chu skyesa'adab brgya'i sbubs nas btsas pa'i 67na po/sa/ /sbyin bsregs lhag ma'i 'o mas rab bsos pa/ /smin legs lta na sdug pa'i mdzes ma zhig /lha ku'i drang srong zhig gis btsun mor phul/ /dus der sbyin sreg cho ga'i me dbus nas/ /lha dbang srin por yongs sprul slong ba por/ /bza' dang btung ba'i —75

rgyaladabang lnga pa ༅dang blo 4nga rgya4'a gsung ldom/ ()ro mchog cher bstabasakyang //ma 'dod rang gi lusakyi sha khrag byin//rgyal po srog dang bral la mngon phyogasatshe//brgya byin rang gzugasabastan nasabadud rtsi yis//bsosapasabatsun mo blon 'bangasabacasapa rnams//dga' ba bsam gtan dang po'i lha bzhin gyur//sbyin pa'i snyan grags kyisabakug slong ba'i tshogs//glang chen btsun mo srasadang bdog pa yis//re ba bskang tshe ku ru'i rgyal po des//lag ldan dbang po slong ba'i pho nyar mngags//glang po g.yin la byin zin pas//gang de'i 'dod pa'i re ba dag/ma 'grub brnag pasagayul bshamasakyang //gtsug na nor bu khro ba bral//mkha' la byon pa'i rang sangasargyas//bzhi yisachosabastan de rnamasadang /lhan cig rgyal po gangasacan ngos//gshegasanasazhi ba'i bdud rtsi thob//slong ba'i sanasami bdag sras//blon posabaslangasate dmag tshogasabacom//nad dang mu gesapha rol yul//mnar ba sdig 'bras smin pa bzhin//pad can cho ngesami yi bdag/bosatshe gdugasadang bral mthong nas//dga' skyo 67bangagran rjes smin legasamar//log spyod rngon pa sgrag te bros//ku ru'i yul gyi rgud pa'i tshogs//sel phyir gtsug gi nor bu mchog/slong bar snying rje'i gzhan dbang gis//byin kyang rma med sngar bzhin bsos//yab yumalhan cigagadan 'dzomazhing //slar yang rang giphobrang cher//chosasrid 'byor ba'i bde ba la//longasasu spyod pa 'di ko mtsho/(4)/'gro rnamasadapag med tshe lor bde ba la//longasasu spyod pa'i rgyal po gsosbyong 'phags//rig sngagasakyisabatab bum chu btung ba'i mthus//spyi bo lasardol 'byungasapa'i nga la nu//skye ba gzhan du sangasargyasarnam gzigasal//dad pa cung zad sri zhur bgyis pa'i 'bras//bsod namasagaser gyi 'khor losasakun la//dbang sgyur nor 'dzin skyong ba ljongasargyu tshe//'phur ba'i nusabral gnyisaskyesalnga brgya zhig/bsamathar 'gro ba gzigasanasargyu drisapas/kho cosanagasa'adi'i drang srong bsam gtan la//gnod par dmod mosa'adab gshog bral gsol ba//thos pas kye ma cung zad mibazod kyang //bsamagato par rlomamarupasagayo tha snyam//rang grimatsho rigasadag las76

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i spang rdzas khang rsāng gi dkar sha/ (ma)phyir bskrad pas//gling bzhi las 'das gser ri'i ngogs su song //rin cen char dang ma rmos lo tog sogs//phun tsho gos 'dod rgur 'bangs kun longs spyod pa'i//yun ring phan bde'i mgron du nga la nu//bsod 6ni gims dpung gis ring nas bsus pa bzhin//nam zhig lha gnas blta phyir nam mkha' la//yan lag rnam bzhi'i dpung bcas nyer bgrod tshe//ma rungs drang srong spyi bor rta glang sbangs//lhungs bas dmod po bgrod pa'i nus pa btul//de'i lan rgyal po'i bden tshig rnon po'i mtshon//bsod nams rtsibs stong g.yas su 'khor ba des//drang srong ral pa nags klungs lta bu'i tshogs//mi bzad mya ngam thang gi spun slar byas//chos bzang mdun sar 'chi med bdag po dang //phun tsho gos bzang po'i skal ba mnyam byas kyang //ngan sems yi wang dang po'i rgyud gcig gis//phun tsho gos stobs ldan gru gzings skad cig bzhig/8)grong khyer bzang po'i brag zhes par//zla 'od mtshan can sa bdag ni//slong ba'i re ba kun skong bar//snga na med pa'i dpag bsam shing //dus der drang srong drag po'i mig/mi bsrun bsam dang sbyor ba yis//sa skyong dbu ni slong ba'i ched//grong khyer chen po'i nang du zhugs//yul de'i lha mos rgyal po la//lus can nyer 'tsho khyod nyid de//gang gi mgo bo slong ba 'di/kho mos dgag ces gsol ba na//lan du bdag gis grangs med lus//blangs pa chu shing snying po ste//da ni 'gro ba'i re ba rnams//bskang na 'dod pa'i don 'grub gsungs//zla dang sa 'dzin blon gnyis kyis//rin chen mgo mang kyis bslus kyang //bram zes ma 'dod mdun na 'don//64po jig rten ga rol ltad mor song //snying stobs ldan des si po che'i//brogazhu bgrolatshe gser ldan ma//ma bzod 'dar bas grong khyer gyi/khod pan thams cad dus gcig lhung //nagasakyi lhas kyang ma bzlog par//tsam pa ka yi ljon shing drung //spos ngad ldan gyi bram ze la//dang ba'i sems kyis mgo bo byin//dge ba'i rin chen them skas la//'dzegs nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ltar/ /skyes pa'i rnam smin rab dkar des/ /rgyu las 'bras 'byung slu med mtshar/ /(6)'dren pa mchog gyur zas gtsang sras//dbus 'gyur 'chang du gshegs pa'i bshul//chom rkun rnams la nor

rgya stsod bang lnga pyong ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)byin nas//tshong pa lan drug bskyabs par mdzad//ma byin len la brtson rnams kyis//bcom ldan nyi ma'i gnyen 'khor bcas//bsod nams mgron du mchod byas nas//nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims blangs//chom po tshangs spyod la gnas mthus//'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing gyur par//der 'dus kun rtog 'char sgo yis//sngon gyi byung tshul dris pa'i lan//wa ra ṇa si zhes bya bar//ded dpon shin tu dga' ba yis//rgya mtsho che las nor blangs nas//'gro ba'i dbul phongs sel bar brtson//skabs ga lam du chom rkun dang //phrad par lan drug tshim byas kyang //da dung nor la brkam chags pa//mthong bas mya ngan khang bur zhugs//de'i tshe lha yi rmi lam lung //bstan pa'i ma gha zhes bya ba//69na ) grogs su khrid nas bstoganyis lor//ro hi ta rka'i gling du bgrod//ring min grogs po tshe yi dus//byas kyang snying stobs ma nyams par//ma gha'i lus kyi bya ba kun//nyer bsgrubs rim gyis phyin pa na//bgrod rka'i ri mthong yid 'byung tshe//mi min dag gis thabs tshul bstan//ring song gser gyi khang brtsegs shig/mthong ba'i ngang nas gnyid la yur//skabs der lha yi lung ji bzhin//rin chen khang mang 'das pa'i mthar//bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po blangs//de'i mthus skad cig rang yul slebs//rgyal mtshanas rtse mor yid bzhin nor//mchod cing gsol ba btab pa las//'gro ba'i dgos 'dod ma lus pa//char du snyil ba de med byung /(7)ser skya'i n+ya gro dha yi tshal chen por//zas gtsang sogs la rgyal bas chos bstan tshe//ming chen chung ma zla 'od ces bya ba//nged cag chos nyan skal pa dman zhes zhus//de tshe rang gi khyim gyi bdag bo yis//kun mkhyen ma 'dris 'gro ba'i gnyen yin pas/shwakya'i mchis brang rnams la chos gsung pa'i//go skabs 'byung zhes gtam gyis dbu gsang ltar//thub dbang chos kyi bdud rtsi wā phyogs tshe//ming rṣa chung ma ha cang rgyan bzang bar//brgyags pa'i rnam 'gyur spongs zhes kun dga' bos//gsungs tshe de bzhin khyim du bskur zin rjes//la la thub dbang gsung la mi sems par//rang gi 69brgyan dang lang tsho rtse dregs pa yis/khengs pa gzhom phyir //ga mo ro hi ta//slar yang khyim du rgyan gos len

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ 6)par btang //'bangs mos chos nyan skal pa ma thob pas//sems khong chud dang sangs rgyas la dad pa//'gran pa'i ngang nas ba yi ra rnon pos//sto ba phug ste lnga pa'i pha mthar song //'on kyang smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyor mthus//siṅgā la yul rgyal po'i rigs btsas tshe//mu nyi /yi char pa cher babs pas//ming yang mu tig 'khri shing zhes su grags//ring min dbus 'gyur 'chang gi tshong pa 'ga'i//ngag las sangs rgyas zhes bya'i mtshan thos tshe//sngon gyi bag chags sad par rgyal ba la//ches cher khyad 'phags na yig phul ba'i lan//rang gi sku gzugs skyabs 'gro'i bslab byar bcas/legs stsal mthong ba'i mod la 'bri shing can/khyun du zhugs pa' gos bu mngon thob nas//mu tig gis mtsho ni mchod pa'i sprin phung spros//(8)rgyal po'i khab tu khyim bdag dpal spas zhes//rnam thos bu la 'gran pa'i 'byor ba can//mu stegs ga pa'i gtam gyis yid drangs te//kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras la gshe ba'i blos//me dang dug gi sbyor ba sna tsho gos pa'i//ma rungs las kyi sta gon nyer byas nas//gcam bus bdag gi khyim du gdugs tsho de la//'byon par gsol ba ji bzhin zhal gyis bzhes//ma la kho bo'i mi bsrun bsam pa dang //ga sbyor 'di tsam rig par ma 70na gyur na//thams cad mkhyen ces brjod pa ba 'ad gad kyi//gnas snyam dga' zhing rang gi khyim du log/lam du dge bsnyen zhig gis sangs rgyas la/khyu mtshan 'di ltar gshegs par mi rigs zhes//gsol ba'i lan du tshul des mi gnod ces//sngon gyi byung ba'i rgyu mas rgyas par stsal//me dong steng du zhabasagayas bzhag ma thag/sgra dang bcas pa'i 'dab brgya 'dzum steng na//thub dbang bzhugs pa mngon sum mthong ma thag/dpal sbas gnong zhing 'gyod pas mchi ma lhung //chags dang sdang ba mi mnga' rgyal ba yis//mi dge'i bshes kyis bslad pa'i khyim bdag de//mthong thos dran dang reg pas rjesabazung nas//phan dang bde ba'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzad/(9)/rgyal po'i khab kyi rab bzang gis//chung ma mngal dang ldan pa la//bu tsha ji ltar btsa' zhes pa'i/khyu mtshan bcom ldan 'das la gsol//lan du 'di la khye'u zhig/btsa' zhing longs spyo/ ༷na sum tshogs//mthar ni nga yi bstan pa la//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)rab byung byang chub 'thob ces gsungs/ /rgyu mtshan mu stegs kyis thos nas/ /'di la skyes pa'i bu des khyod/ /nyams tshul gtam gyis dbye na bcos pas/ khyim bdag khros nas ma mis brang bsad/ /de tshe mu stegs dga' bzhin du/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'phya zhing smod/ /sangs rgyas gzugs can snying bor bcas/ /bsil tshal (70ba)dur khrod gang der gshegs/ /ma yi lto ba rdol ba las me 'bar khrod nas byis ba zhig /byung bas me skyes zhes btags shing / /gzugs can snying pos ring zhig bsos//yul gzhan tshong gi bya ba la/ bu yi 'ad po song ba dag /rang yul ldog tshe gnas tshul la/ /'khu bsabarlang po'i tshig smras pas/ /ma bzod pha yis rang khyim du/ /blangs tshe 'byor pa rmugs 'dzin gyis/ /rjes su 'gro ba klu dbang gis/ /gtsug rgyan nor bu thob pa bzhin/ /phun tsho gis gos bzang bkrus pa dag /ma skyes dgra yi mgor 'i lhungs pa/ /rkyen gyis mi bzad rtsod pa na/ /chags med 'byor ba mtha' dag gto/ /'khor ba me dong ltar shes nas/ /nyi ma'i garsā drung rab byung wo / /bden pa mthong ba'i ngo mtshar gtam/ e ma blo ldan sgra 'dzin rgyan/(10)/thabs shes lang tsho dar ba'i mngal yangasapar/ /phun tshogs rgyu rkyen sa bon smin pa'i 'bras/ /skye rga na dang 'chi ba'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /mtha' med 'khor ba ston pa'i slob dpon bzhin/ /srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las lam bcu'i/ /mi bzad sdig pa'i chang gis rab myos pas/ /'jigs rung ga 'gro'i g.yang sar goms pa dag /'byor ba mthong tshe lus kyi ba spu ldang / /sdig dang mi dge'i bshes kyis dben pa yi/ /yid 'ong lo ma'i spyil chung nyams dga' bar/ /bsam gtan sgom sogs dge la spyod pa rnams/ /mngon par mtho dang ngesapa'i lam (71na7 sbyor/(11)/n+ya gro dha yi kun dga' ra ba na/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar mdzes dga' 'ongs pa la/ /rab tu byung zhes gsungs kyang ma 'dod nas/ khyim du dga' mar rtse la ring zhing song //skabs shig bcom ldan 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas/ /mchod rjes dga' bor lhung bzed bskur ba yi/ /zol gyis khrid tshe chung mas bzung ba na/ /myur du ldog ces sangs rgyas zhabs phyir 'brangs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu tshil bkod pa yis/ /dga' bo rab byung gzugs su bsgyur na yang / /ma —80

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang si po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar man / (mnadul sems de 'dod pa'i shing rta la/ /zhen nas mdzes ma'i phyogs su lan brgyar brgyugs/ /yid kyi zhags pas bcings pa'i mdza' na mo/ /thag ring yul gyi bskal bsam ho sum du/ /ma gyur rdo labris pa'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /sems kyi ngal gso'i rten du yang yang lta/ /tshul de sangs rgyas snyan du gsol ba na/ /bag med rgud pa kun gyi gzhin gsungs shing / /gtsug lag khang gi phyag bdar byed pa sogs/ /sna tsho gos thabs kyis drangs kyang ldog mi gyur/ /mi sdug spra mo lha yi lus phra dang / /'jigasarung dmyal ba'i gnas sogs rim bstan mthar/ /snying nas 'khor ba'i tshul la yid phyung ste/ /tshangasaspyod dpal gyi dngos po bla med blangs/(12)/ming wo 'bangs mo phreng can ma/ /sangs rgyas la dad bsod nams kyis/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal btsun mo sa gyur las 'phags skyes (71ba)po zhesabatsas/ shwakya rnams kyi 'bangs mo'i bu/ /zhes smras pa la 'khon bzung nas/ /rang nyid sa yi bdas po sa /gyur tshe dmag gi dpung tshogs bshams/ /rgyal ba thugs rje ldan pa des/ shwakya dang nye'i shing skam 'og /bzhugs nas gnyen la rjes brtse ba'i/ /gsung gis re zhig 'khrug pa bzlog /bcom ldan 'das kyis shākya'i tshogs/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi legs stsal pas/ khyun du zhugs nas dgra bcom par//'bras bu thob pa grangs las 'das/ /skabs shig rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /sngar gyi sha 'khon dran gyur nas/ /dmag gi dpung tsho gos cher bshams kyang / /mong gal rdzu 'phrul mthu yis bsrungs/ /de nas shākya kun bgros te/ /'tshe ba spong pa'i khrims bcas kyang / sham bha ka yis 'phags skyes po'i//dmag rnams bcom pas yul gzhan bskrad/ /slar yang mi bsrun 'bangs mo'i bus/ shwakya bdun khri bdun stong bsad/ /bu mo lnga brgya'i lag bcad pas/ khrag 'khyil lag pa'i rdzing du grags/ /bud med de rnams bcom ldan 'das/ /yid la byas pas lha lus thob/ /'phags skyes po nyid phyir log tshe//cung zad rkyen gyis rang sras bkum/ /de nas rgyal bas lung bstan la/ /'jigs nas zhag bdun chur zhugs kyang / /nang par rgyan gyi me shel las/ /'bar ba'i zhugs kyis thams cad tshig /(13)gzugs can snying po'i mnga' 'bangs (72na)su/ /gnod sbyin 'phrog mas nyer 'tshe bar/ /yul de'i 81 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()skye bo ma lus pas//bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su gsol//rgyal bas 'phrog ma'i gnas byon nas//de yi bub ṇi ga bsnams pa na//ma yis phyogs kun btsal byas kyang //ma rnyed ston pa'i drung du 'ongs//khyod la lnga brgya'i grangs ldan pa//yod bzhin 'di ltar sdug bsngal na//gzhan gyi bu la 'tshe ba dag/mi rigs gsungs nas bslab la bkod//lhung bzed 'og tu sbas pa yi//dga' byed ces bya mi bsrun rigs//phyir bto sngon gyi byung ba dag/gsungs nas dga' zhing rang gnas song //dngos gzha du 'dul spu lung bsto tshes bas la med kyang ldeb bris la mdzang blun gyi lug ltar bris 'dug pa de dang bas nas bkod pa yin//rgyal po'i khab tu zas gtsang sras bzhugs tshe//rang blo rang la lkog gyur gnag lhas gas//phrag dog mun pa stug pos rgyal ba dang //'gran tshig sa chen skyong ba dag la mol//ris med kun la brtse ba sangs rgyas kyis//log pa'i lam du nyer 'khyams skye bo rnams//rjes su gzung phyir rdzu snyul 'gran pa'i skabs//phye nas rgyal bas chos 'phrul khang pa brtsigs//tshems shing btsugs pas 'phral du lo gos rgyas//sngon med ri la 'gro mang longs su spyod//sa bsil chu rdzing padma g.yur du za//rdzing gi yur ba brgyad kyis choge sgra ston//zhal sgo'i 'od kyis stong gsum gsal bar mdzad//'khor rnams phan tshun bsam pa shes pa dang /'khor 72༷ pa'i rnam pa dag tu bstan//gsang bdag srin po lnga yis mu stegs bcom//tshangs pa'i 'jig rten srid rtse'i bar khyab pa'i//sku lasa'od zer sna tsho gis phyogs bcur 'phro//mi snang 'od kyi gong bur 'khyil ba'i sku//gser gyi 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro ba can//lte ba'i pad 'dab gyes la sangs rgyas stong //me rtag gtor ba rin chen shing rtar song //ro brgya'i zas kyis snod ge glo khengs pa dang //dmyal ba bstan sogs cho 'phrul bco lngar gsungs/(15)/tso dbang sum cu rtsa gsum du//lha rnams la ni chos ston tshe//rnam bzhi'i 'khor gyis mo gal bu//btang nas 'dzam bu'i gling gshegs gsol//brgya byin bee ḍūr gser dngul gyi//them snas btsugs shing lha dang mi'i/ /mar pa dang cas bcom ldan 'das/ shang /shu yi 'gram du byon//de tshe dge slong ༄ la//phyag bya'i skabs/ ma rnyed pas//'khor los sgyur rgyal gzhigs sprul

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4kho dang rin po tsho marna rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sa/ (mnabar//'gromang 'byulaba'i drwa bar tshud/khrolade dge slong 'char /yis//rig gnasa'adi ni saspyod min//dgoslong utpa layin zhes//the tshomadrwa ba rnamapar bcad//rgyalab rang giganasabazhugasatshe//dge slong rnamasakyisagasol ba las//'char /dang ni utpa la'i//sngon byung gtam ni legasapar gsungs/(16)/gyad rnamasa'adu ba'i kusha'i grong khyer du//thub dbang bsod namasamagron du 73naganyer ba'i slad//saphyogasabyi dor chag chag legasabatab cing //ljon shing me tog sogasakyis brgyan par byas//lam gyi sgo bkagasapha bong chen po zhig/stobasaldan 'bad pasabasal bar ma nusapa//sangasargyasaphyag gisatshangasapa'i 'jig rten bar//mi rtag cesapa'i sgra dang bcas te 'phangs//slar yang phyag tu babasapa zhal sgo yi//rlung gisardul phran lta bur gtor byasashing //de dag gcig gyur steng bzhugasachosabastan nas//gyad kun rgyun zhugasasogs kyi lam la bkod/(17)/klu rnams kyisagatsugs gdengasaka'i zam pa yis//bcom ldan 'khor bcas gaṅgā lasabasgral nas//ljon pa'i tshal du bzhugs tshe der 'khod la//phul byung rin cen mgo sdong ltad mor mdzad//'khor gyisargyu marga zhusapasasngon gyi dus//mang posabakur ba'i rgyal po'i mchod yul du//bi shwa ka rmisabaskrun pa'i rin po che'i//mchod sdong ngo mtshar phun sum tshogasa'adi bsgrubs//skye bo phal cher lta bar g.yengasapa yi//so nam tshong dang khe spogasanyamasapa'i mthus//rgyal po'i dpya khral chad pasayid 'khrugasanas//rin cen mchod rten gaṅgā'i chu labaskyur/ /ma 'ongs 'khor los sgyur ba dung gi dus/ /'di nyid dum bur phral ba'i rkyen gyisani//byamasapa mchog gi sprul skur sangasargyasaste//'gro ba kun gyi 'an par 'gyur zhes gsungs/(8)/thub dbang mgon med 73bzasasbyin gyi//kun dga' ra bar bzhugs pa'i tshe//'phags pa 'od srungs gshegs pa dag/mdze mo zhig gis mthong ba yis//sngon yang bsod nams ma bsags pas//gnas skabs 'di 'drar gyur snyam ste//bsod snyams phul bas mdzub mo rnams//lhan cig lhung bzed nang du drul//de nyid tshe 'phosalha yul du//skyesapa'i phun tshogasasnyan gragasani//sabadag gsal rgyalagyisathosapas//nyin zhag mang por sbyin gtong byas//8

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)de nas rgyal pos sangs rgyas la/ /byang chub thob pa'i lung bstan zhus/ /dbul po'i mar me chung na yang / /sa skyong snang gsal yun las ring / /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsal rgyal la/ /byang chub rnyed dka' bdag cag gis/ /skye ba mang por sbyin pa'i tshogs/ /btang yang mya ngan 'das ma thob/ /rgyal po me long bzhin gyur tshe/ /bram ze dbyug pa can zhes pas/ /ba lang bor zhing rta srog bral/ /ste'u chur lhungs thags mkhan bkums/ /chang tshong bu bsad nyes pa'i tshogs/ khrims kyis so sor mgu bar byas/ /de lta na'ang byang chub ni/ shes rab mthu yis thob par gsungs/79)/sngon dus rnam 'dren rgyal po'i khab/ /bzhugs tshe nyan thos shā ri'i bus/ /dgra bcom mngon gyur shes rab la/ /ngo mtshar 'khor gyis dris pa'i lan/ /ming po bram ze rang rgyal gyis/ /chos gos 'tshem pa'i las byas tshe/ /sring mos kha ba kyi rtse mo ltar/ /(74na)rab sna'i shes rab thob gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam legs btab 'bras/ /dus 'dir smin pa shā ri'i bu/ /sngon tshe rgyal po skyes pa'i dus/ /pha yis rab byung las ldog pa/ /ring min glang po che zhen nas/ khyu ba'i lam du dbul po zhig /mthong tshe mthun pa'i rkyen byin te//rab tu byung ba dag la sbyar/ /nam zhig rgan po rang sangs rgyas/ /thob nas rnam 'dren drung 'ongs te/ /rdzu hrūl bstan pas rang rig la/ /ma rangs chos gegs 'di 'dra snyam/ /dman pa'i rigs lasarab byung bar/ /smon lam btab pa shā ri'i bu/ /yin zhes rgyal bas 'khor rnams la/ /gsungs pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba snyan/(20)/sngon tshe sangs rgyas 'od srungs mchod rten la/ /gser sbyangs bye ba re ba'i rin po che/ /legs phul 'bras bu smin pa'i gro bzhin skyes/ /gser gyi mdog can phun tsho gos rna rgyan can/ tshong la nor gling bgrod tshe nyal ba'i shul/ /grogs rnams ring song rang nyid gcig bur lus/ /btung ba 'tshol bar phyin pas lcags khang nang / /bkres shing 'phongs pa'i yi dwags lan gnyis mthong / /rim gyis bgrod tshe rin cen khang bzang du/ /mas mo bde zhing wo mo sdug bsngal dang / /de las nyin mtshan go ldog mthong rnams la/ /'jigs dang ya mtshan kun rtog ci yang shar/ /rgyu ma' dris pas tshe sngon srog gcod dang / /'dod log (4bsgos dang wo spangs de'i cig shos//—84

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i ma rdzo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / 'dilongs su spyad pa'i rnam smin 'di ltar gyur/ /zer ba thos nas rim bzhin bgrod pa na/ /yid 'ong lha mo gnas pa'i khri rkang la/ /mi sdug 'jigs su drang ba'i yi dwags bzhi/ /zas skom rnag khrag sogs su gyur mthong nas/ khyu mtshan dris pas lha mo des smras pa/ /bdag sngon bram zer gyur pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /'phags pa kā tyā ya nar bsod snyoms phul/ /chung ma bu dang mna' ma bran rnams kyis/ /ngan smrasabyas pa'i 'bras bu 'dir smin zer/ /des mtsho ni sngar mthong kun gyi khyim nang du/ /gser sogs rin cen bum pa'i gter yod pas/ /thon la 'phags pa kā tyā ya mchod ces/ /'phrin bskur cung zad nyal bas rang yul slebs/ /pha ma gro bzhin skyes bral mya ngan gyis/ /long ba dag kyang mig thob bde la spyod/ /phra zhib las 'bras ma sum mthong ba de/ /sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa'i byed po bzhin/ /(21)sa bdag rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /blon po dum bu ces pa gnyis/ /gzhan gyis phra ma bcug pa las/ /blon pos yangs pa can du phyin/ /de nyid 'das shul bu gzhen pas/ /tsho gis kyi gtso bo byasapa na/ /rgan pa cung zad ma rangs par/ /gzugs can snying po'i drung du bgrod/ /rgyal po btsun mo dang bral ba'i/ /mya ngan byed pa de mthong nas/ /rang gi nu bo'i bu mo la/ /yon tan du ma'i bsngags pa brjod/ /de nyid lus(75na)phra brkur btang tshe/ /tsi la thob nas phyir bros par/ /yangs pa can bas rjes bsnyegs kyang / /gnod par ma nus gnas su 'khor/ /de tshe mtshan mkhan la bstan pas//tse la zhes pa'i bud med 'di/ /btsun mor bskur tshe btsas pa'i bu/ /nar son dus na pha gsod smras/ /yangs can li tsa byi chen po'i/ /sdum ra'i a mra'i sdong po las/ /btsas pa'i bu mo mtshan ldan gyi/ /snyan pa gzugs can snying pos thos/ /yangs pa can gyi khang bzang na/ /rgyal po so so'i gzugasadris par/ /gzugs can snying po'i snang brnyan la/ /smin legs yid kyi gdung ba 'phel/ /de tshe rgyal pos gsang thabs su/ /phyin nas zhag bdun 'dus pa las/ khye'u btsas shing yid ches slad/ /sor gdub bskur nas btang zhes grags/ /de'i rgyu sngon tshe a smra skyong / /rgyal po'i khab kyi skyed mos tshal//srung ba'i bud med lus thob dus/ /rang sangs rgyas gcig nyer mchod de/ /bdag cag mi gtsang —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pemangal gyi dris//gos min g.yon mig mar gyur nas//sa skyong btsun mor dbang bskur ba'i//smon lam btab pa'i 'bras grub mtshar/(22)/mnyan yod khyim bdag sbyin pa yi/khye'u sbyin la ches dga' bas//mgon med zas sbyin zhes bya'i ming //snyan pa'i grags pa srid na 'bar//gang des khyim bdag nor rṣa la//bu mo slong bar bram ze mngags//de nyid tshe yi dus byas par//mchog zung po bab nyis kyis rjes su bzung //slar yang mgon med zas sbyin gyis//bu mo slong du phyin pa na//sangs rgyas dge 'dun zhes pa'i mtshan//thos pas yid kyi spu long g.yos//bsil ba'i tshal bgrod sangs rgyas la//bzhugs gnas gtsug lag khang brtsigs zhes//gsol bas nyan thos shā ri'i bu//de yi las byed grogs su bskos//rgyal po rgyal byed kyis bzung pa'i//tshal de rin cen su wa rṇa//sa dang mnyam pa'i rin byin nas//thig gdab chu yis bran par byas//de tshe mu stegs mig dmar gyis//sa hā ka ra'i ljon pa dang //bad rdzing sto 'gro ro langs sogs//sna tsho gos rdo 'phrul bstan pa rnams//'dul ba'i snying por shā ri'i bus/ /rlung chen glang po nam mkha' lding //phur bu rnams kyis bcom pa na//mig dmar 'jigs te skyabs su song //bsil ba'i tshal nas zas gtsang sras//gtsug lag khang bzang der bzhugs te/khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi//sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' rnamasagasungs/(23)/rgyal bas byang chub mchog brnyes tshe//yab kyis rang sras lta 'dod nas//pho nya lan grangs mang mngags kyang //rab tu byung nas phyir ma ldog/de nas 'char ka btang ba yang //rab byung ring zhig lon nas log/da de zhag bdun bcom ldan 'das//'byon zhes rgyal po'i snyan du gsol//n+ya gro dha yigatsug lag khang //bcom ldan 'das kyi gnas su bzhengs//7na8 bzhin gshegasab 'khor bcas rnams//rdzu phrul mthu yis mkha' la byon//sangs rgyas thugs rjes lha rnams kyang //skad cig lhags te chos nyan pas//zas gtsang la sogs shākya'i tshogs//brgyags shing khengs pa'i nga rgyal bcom/shwakya'i rigs rnams dam cho mel//bkod pas lhas byin ma gags pa/khyun zhugs dgra bcom bar dag gi/gos bu blo dang ༷tsham pa thob//bzang ldan rgyal sar dbang bskur

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / 6)bar/ /lhas byin ma rungs phrag dog pas/ /nor bu khrag gis sbags byas pa/ /'dab chags khra yisamakha' la khyer/(24)/sngon tshe kun tu rgyal ba'i sras/ /thams cad sgrol zhes bya ba ni/ /sbyin gtong byed par ches dga' bas/ /rgyal blon rnams kyis ga' na du snags/ /lam du slong ba'i bram ze la/ /glang po che dang sras gnyis byin/ /brgya byin bram zer sprul nas su/ /btsun mo bslangs pas nye bar btang / /de tshe gzugs bstan ngo mtshar ba'i/ /gtam gyis bsngags pa tshes cher brjod/ /bram zesaming sring gnyis btsongs pa/ /rgyal pos ngo shes nor gyis bslus/ /lha dbang mthu yis thams cad sgrol/ /slar yang spyan drangs rgyal sar bskur/ /mnga' 'bangs thams cad bde ba la/ /bkod pa'i dga' ston bla na med/(25)/'og min gnas su bla med bdud rtsi'i ro/ /rnyed kyang grangs med 'gro ba bsgral ba'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul lha mo'i (76bzhims zhugs sku bltams pa/ /don kun grub pa'i rgyal po 'di ngo mtshar/ /grangs med rig pa'i gnas dang sgyu rtsal la/ khengs ldan gzhan gyis 'gran pa'i zla dang bral/ /yid 'ong bas mo mdun na 'don dang bcas/ /rtsod dus lor rte ba'i rgyal srid bzung / /sgo bzhin rgas 'khogs na 'chi'i ngang tshul dang / /rab tu byung gzigs ra bar yid phyung tshe/ /mtshan mkhan rnams kyis zhag bdun tshun chad du/ /byang chub rnyed dam 'khor je zhes smras//rgyal po dga' dang 'jigs pa 'gran bzhin du/ /grong khyer sgo rnams srung ba'i dpa' bo dang / /nang du spro ba sring ba'i lus phra sogs/ /sna tshogs thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis bkod pa mdzad/ /bud med gnyid myos rnam 'gyur ga pas kyang / /bskul zhing 'dun pa lnga rtsen gyis bslangs te/ /chibs kyi sug bzhi lhas bteg tshangs pa dang / /brgya byin la sogs legs bris 'khor tsho gis bcas/ /de tshe byang chub sems dpa' rdzu phrul gyis/ /mkha' la thogs pa med par gshegs pa'i tshe/ /ming chen gyis mthong khang thog nas sbran kyang / /lha yi nus mthus gzhan gyis thos ma gyur/ /rta dang rgyan rnamasa'adun par phyir bskur cing / /rang byung sgo nas bsnyen par rab rdzogs te/ /srid pa 'khor ba'i 'jug ldog 'gro rnams la/ /ston phyir phyag dar khrod pa'i gos kyis mdzes/(26)/rgyal bas rdo rje gdan gyi —87—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ༅ dbang blo rlung rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)spor//rtomachoge stan la bzhugs 77na shos su//byang tso mgo du mdzad ba lko pa//nag po bdud sdes ma bzod par//blo brid mdzes ma btang ba dang //rgan mo'i lus su byin gyis brlabs//mi sdug gzugs kyis 'phangs pa'i mtshon//me rtag char pa dag tu bsgyur//dkar phyogs lha yi dpung tshogs kyis//bdud rnams lcags ri'i pha mthar bskrad//mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas tshe//tshangs pas chos 'khor bskor bar gsol//thog mar tshong dpon ga gon dang //bzang pos bstabs pa'i bsod snyoms snod//lhung bzed rgyal chen bzhis phul ba//bdag gir mdzad nas rjes su bzung //(27)rdzon tshe sangs rgyas n+ya gro dha'i//kun dga' ra bar bzhugs pa' tshe/shwakya rnams kyis rgyal po'i rabs//ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu mtshan zhus//rang gis rang rigs gsung ba la//mu stegs lko ba spang ba'i slad//mo gal bu yis sngon gyi mtha'/shes par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus//'byung bzhi la brten snod chags par//lha las nyer babs bcud kyi mi//mtha' klas 'phel ba'i rje bo mā/nyer bskos mang pos bkur zhes grags//tshigs lnga'i rjes su nga la nu//rim bzhin stong phrag tsam gyi mjug/kri kri de nas bu ram shing //'phags skyes po la sras lnga byung //phu bo bzhi po gnas g.yin du//bskrad pas ser skya'i yul bzung zhing //ming sring lhan cig 'dus 'phel bas/shwakya zhes pa'i ming du chags//77bsgo skyongs nyi khri lnga stong rje/mang rta bcu pa de 'das nas//ring zhig lon tshe seng ge 'gram//de sras zas gtsang mched bzhir grags//bcom ldan gcung dga' zas gtsang sras//skar rgyal bzang ldan zas dkar sras//ma 'gags ming chen bre zas sras//kun dga' lhas byin bdud rtsi'i sras//bcom ldan khab tu bzhugs pa'i brgyud//grags 'dzin ma la sgra gcan 'dzin//gzungs sogs sngo zhe byung tshul rnams//smras pas shākya'i tshogs rab mgu/(28)/khyim bdag gru 'dzin zhes bya'i bu/ā skar gro bzhin la btsas par//gser srang bye ba nyi shu yis//dga' ston byasapa'i ming can de//'du thabar thub pas mo gal bu//ched du mngags pas yid phrogs te/kha zas ro brgya'i dpal ldan pa//bas ldan 'das kyi drung / ༷la/khyu des gzugs can snying po yang /khyim du

sku gsung thug rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (ma)blta bar lhags pa na//bzlog phyir bye ba nyi shu pas//mu tig do shal khyer nas 'ongs//lam du rgyal po dang phrad nas//lhan cig ston pa'i drung 'dengs tshe//gro bzhin rkang 'og gos bting pa//rgyal po'i che ba'i phyir ldog kyang //slar yang rgyu ba'i sa phyogs kun//lha yi gos kyis rnam g.yogs pa//skye ba gzhan du bsags pa yi//bsod nams phung po dngos su rgyu//bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bstan pas/khun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob//tshul la ngo mtshar 'khor rnams kyis/khyu mtshan nye bar gsol ba'i lan//bram ze 7ni zla ba zhes bya ba'i//dbul por gyur tshe rang gos kyis//sa g.yog sangs rgyas rnam gzigs la//bsod snyoms phul ba'i sngon byung gsungs/(29)/lhas byin ma rungs sems ldan pas//ma skyes dgra yi blo brid de//pha dang go snya bkums byas nas//de'i tshab byed pa'i gros ga bshams/khrin mthong byis pa'i blo ro des//myos chu i pa'i glang po che//bto bas༅ dga' bo ma gtogos//'khor gzhan skrag nas phyogs su byer//ston pa'i phyag sor lnga po las//seng ge sprul nas glang po btul/khyogs kun tshe yis 'khor ba na//slar yang ston pa'i drung du gas//spyi bor phyag bzhag byin brlabs pas//tshe 'phos lha yi gnas su skyes//lhas byin khang pa'i yang thog nas//mthong bas mya ༅ khang bur zhugs//'khor gyi dge slong tsho gis rnams kyis//ngo mtshar lo rgyus zhusapa na//rgyal ba'i gsung gi tshangs dbyangs kyi//sngon byung da ltar bzhin du bstan/(30)/wa ra ṇa si'i 'argyal po ni//tshangs byin zhes bya grags pa dkar//de sras ka shi mdzes pa dang //dus kyi sa zhesamached gnyis byung //phu bo yab kyi rgyal sa sa/bsko bar brtsams kyang ma bzhed nas/khyim spangasanags su dku' thub spyad//bzod par smra ba zhes su 'bod//chung ba dus kyi sar grags pa//rang rigs srid skyong gyur pa'i dus//dga' mgur rtse phyir ljongs rgyu'i slad//nam zhig nags 78bsu song ba'i tshe//de yi bas mo'i tshogs rnams kyis//drang srong bzod smrar gus nid pas//rang gi gcen du ma shes par//dka' thub can de'i yan lag bcad//ring min yul de'i snod bcud la//sna tshogs mi dge'i 'bras smin pa//drang srong la gaX'i rgyur rig nas//slar yang bzod par gsol

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 79)ba na/ khung zad tsam yang khro med ces/ /bden pa'i tshig gis lus rnams kun/ /nyams pa med par bsos pa yi/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi 'phreng ba mtshar/(31)/ri dwags dbang po gser gyi logs zhesapa/ /bya rog zhig dang grogs por gyur ba'i tshe/ /gzhan gyis chom rkun bcings nas chur 'phangs pa'i cho nge thos pas 'don par brtsams pa na/ /'di ni mi bsrun phan lan gnod 'jal bas/ /btang snyomasarigs zhes bya rog gis zer yang / /snying rjes ma bzod rwa rtse thag pa la/ /brgyus nas skam btane bcingasapa rnam par bkrol/ /nga yis khyod la phan btags drin lan du/ kho bo'i gnas tshul kun la gsong smrasakyang / /drin lan log par 'jal ba'i skye bo yi/ /rang bzhin 'di la su yis bcos su yod/ /dusader rgyal po'i btsun mo zla 'od kyi/ /ngo mtshar ri dwags rmi lam du shar bas/ /sa bdag la gsol rngon pa'i tsho gos rnams kyis/ /'bad pas btsal kyang ma rnyed re ba bskyungs/ /de tshe sngon gyi chom rkun bsam pa la/ /gser logs ri dwags bstan na bya dga' che/ /'byung snyam lha (79na sko/byeg bdag la rgyus mchos zhes/ /rgyal po'i dpung dang bcas pa phyogs der khrid/ /ri dwags tshogos rnams bskyab phyir rang gi bde/ /bto nas gser logs rgyal po'i drung 'ongs pa/ /mi bsrun rkun pos rgyang ring nas mthong ste/ /rgyal por bstan pas lag chad sal lhung / /gser logs pho brang spyan drangs khri la bzhag /rgyal po btsun mo blon por bcas pa la/ /dam chos bstan pas bden pa mthong bar gsungs//ri dwags sangs rgyas chom rkun lhas byin no/(32)/grong khyer pa ṭa li pi yi/ /mi bdag rigs sras dge byed dang / /mi dge byed ces bya ba gnyis/ /snang dang mun pa lta bur byung / /mched gnyis btsun mor bsod nams sde'i/ /bu mo ster bar khas blangs shing / /pho bo sbyin pa la dga' bas/ /rgya mtshor nor bu len par chas/ /yul du ldog tshe gru zhig kyang / /mched gnyis skam sar bde bar thon/ /gshen po gnyid la song ba na/ /nu bos mig gnyis bcar nas song / /phu bos ba glang dzi zhig gi /bran byasade yi mchis brang gis/ /log g.yem spyod pa bzlog byed kyang / /g.yo sgyur rdzi bo 'phrul nas bskrad/ /rim bzhin rgyal po bsod nams sde'i/ /pho brang bzhi mdor sleb pa na/ /rgyas sras shi ba'i gtam gyi —90

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i ma rdzo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / 6)sgras/ /bu mo slong ba'i sa bdag 'dus/ 'dam par lus phra nyid btang tshe/ /gnyen zla gang la mi sems par/ /dge byed mthong bas yid chags te/ /long ba dag (79bsgo gus par byas/ /g.yo med drang zhes bud med des/ /bden tshig brjod pas mig g.yas bsos/ /long bas dge byed nga yin zhes/ /bden pa brjod bas mig g.yon byung / /slar yang mi bdag bsod nams sde'i/ /rgyal sar bzhugs nas chos srid bskyangs/ /mched gnyis de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /lhas byin dag tu thub pas gsungs/(33)/ka ling ka rgyal mya ngan med/ /de sras lo ma rab lo ma/ /rjes su lo ma khyad par gyi/ /lo ma zhes pa'i sras bzhi byung / /nam zhig rgyal pos bu rnams bskrad/ /brgyags chad rang gi chung ma dag /bsad nas za bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ khyad par lo ma snying rje skyes/ /gzhan rnams ma ldog rang nyid kyi/ /chung ma khrid nas yul gzhan byin/ /bud med bkres shig phongs pa na/ /rang gi sha dang khrag gis bskyangs/ /rkang lag chad pa'i skyes bu zhig /chu klung chen pos khyer ba na/ /thabs kyis brtane nas bsos pa yi/ /chung ma dag dang mdza' bar gyur/ /bud med g.yo sgyu'i rang bzhin can/ /rgyal po spong bar 'dod pa'i thabs/ /mgo bo ras kyis dkris byas te/ /na ba'i tshul gyi rdzul brten/ zhan tu gzar ba'i brag logs la/ /phan pa'i sman de yod do ces/ /rgyal bus len par phyin pa na/ /thag pa glod de g.yang la lhungs/ /'on kyang srog dang ma bral bar/ /pu dzir can gyi grong du phyin/ srusamed rgyal po gcig dang phrad/ /rgyal srid gtad nas 'bangs rnams(80na tha skyangs/ /skyes bu yan lag nyams pa dang / /bud med bcas pa phyogs der 'ongs/ /rgyal pos sngar gyi tshul gsungs pas/ /skye bo rnams kyis yul gzhan bskrad/ /khyad par lo ma zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal bu sangs rgyas nyid dang ni//ma rungs g.yo can bud med de/ /lhas byin yin pa'i sngon byung gsungs/(34)/bcom ldan rgyal byed tshal bzhugs tshe/ /ri rab lhun po'i ngogs gnas pa'i/ /dge slong 'ga' zhig lus rid pa/ /sangasargyas spyan sngar mchis pa na/ /lus rnams nyams pa'i rgyu zhus par/ /dga' bo nye dga' zhes pa'i klu/ /lhun por lan gsum dkris pa yi/ /dug gi rlangs pas der gyur gsungs/ /rgyal bas mo gal gyi bu//—91—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)klu gnyis 'dul ba'i don du btang / /dal bus bslang yang gti mug gis/ /gnyid la g.yur ba ma sad pas/ /de yi gnyen por gdengs can che'i/ /gzugs su bsgyur nas ri rab la/ /'byud de sto 'gro dam btsir bas/ /gnyid sad skrag nas phyi la bros/ /de tshe nyan thos gzugs bstan te/ khyed gnyis 'jigs shing skrag gyur na/ /sangs rgyas dag la skyabs gsol rigs/ /smras nas ston pa'i drung du khrid/ /rgyal bas klu la bslab khrims phab/ /rgyal po kri gri'i blon po sa gyur tshe sa spyod rab byung nas/ /rgyal srid mdun na 'don la gtad/ /srid skyong dge sdig spel ma sa /spyad cing sangasargyas 'od srungs la/ /gnas (80bdang yo byad nyer bstabs 'bras/ /lhun po thob pa'i sngon byung gsungs/(35)/klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' gnyis/ /khyim bdag gzugs sprul sangs rgyas la/ /mchod cing dam pa'i chos nyan tshe/ /sa bdag gsal rgyal gnas der 'ongs/ /rgyal por gus pa ma byas zhes/ /chad pa gcod pa'i cho ga la/ /phyogs tshe klu yis nam mkha' nas/ /rdo dang mtshon gyi char pa phab/ /bcom ldan thugs rje'i rang bzhi gyis/ /mo'u gal gyi bu bto ste/ /rdo mdzo char gyi 'jigs pa kun/ /chu skyes 'dab ma'i tsho gos su gyur/ /phyogs der me yi 'jigs pa che/ /byung ba sangs rgyas thugs rjes zhi/ /sa bdag mtshan mo grong khyer du/ /me ni mi gtong khrims kyang bcas/rgyal pos legs byin bu bsad pas/ /pha yis nor rnams sbyin par btang / /sbyin pa chung ngu gtong bar yang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bsngags brjod mdzad/ /las 'bras glegs bam blta ba'i phyir//mtshan mo mar me spar ba na/ /rgyal pos khrims las 'gal lo zhes/ khyim bdag legs byin btson du bcug /go ra'i nang du tshangs pa dang / /brgya byin la sogs 'ongs pa yi/ /'od kyis khyim rnams gang mthong nas/ /'jigs te khyim bdag bsdun nas brta zhe/ /de yis rgyal por bsnyen bkur ba/ /sangasargyas ma chad pa'i rjes byas par/ /mi bdag ma rengs khros gyur nas/ /legs byin sgrod pa'i cho ga brtsams/ /tshul la lha rnams (81nasgo dga' bar/ 91ga chags du mas gsal rgyal lus/ /gtsesapar de'i rgyu rgyal ba la/ /zhus pas ji bzhin gsal bar gsungs/ /btsun mor blon 'bangs tshogs —92

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)rnams kyis/khyim bdag khro ba zhi bar byas//legs byin srid pa'i phun tshogs la//nges par byung nas bstan la zhugs/(36)/khyim bdag nor bzang zhes bya ba//'char byed rgyal po'i gam 'ongs pa//skad kyi gdangs las blo gros dang //gser yod bshes nas blon por bskos//gzhan gyi phra ma gcug pa na//brtag pa'i phyir du nag po'i las//gyis zhes bsgo ba ma bsgrubs pas//mi rje khros nas khyim bdag dbyung //de yis sbyin pa cher btang tshe//skom pa'i drang srong mang po yis//ljon shing zhig la chu bslangs pas//rin cen rgyan ldan lag bas byin//rkang 'thung gzhan las zas bslangs bas//skad kyi gdangs las 'di'i nye logs//zas ni sna tsho gis yod smras par//ngo mtshar rgyu mas dris pa na//nged gnyis lha yin skye ba sngon//mgon med zas byin sbyin gtong tshe//mdzub mos sbyin khang bstan pa dang //g.yos byed 'bangs mor gyur tso gad//tshi de nor bzang rnar garsā mthus//cho bdag zas phyin bltar 'ongs pas//sangs rgyas mthong nas dam chos tī//bstan la sri zhu byed dam bcas//dge slong skul byed zhal ta bar//bskos nas81ba tshe/spyog lag khang bzang brtsigs//de yi phyag bdar byed pa por//'bangs mo mgu byed ces pa bskos//gang des bcom ldan 'das kyi ni//chos gos rdol mthong gos rgyus gyi//tshal pa phul nas bla gos dang /kha dog mthun par byin gyis brlabs//de bzhin gshegs dang khyim bdag gnyis//mi bdag 'char byed rnam bzhi yis//wa ra ṇa sir dge 'dun la//bsnyen bkur cher bstabs byung ba gsungs/(37)/ded dpon 'byor ba zhesa'abya ba//'byor len la sogs bu ldan yang //nam zhig nad kyis btab pa'i tshe//bu dang chung ma kun gyis bor//de tshe 'bangs mo 'phreng ldan mas//rim gro byas pas nad las grol//drin bsams khyim thabs byas pa la//gang po zhes bya'i bu zhig btsas//ded dpon 'chi bar nye ba na//'byor len dag la bslab bya byas//spun rnams so sor gyes pa'i dus//pho bo gsum gyis dkor nor bgos//re zhig bar du 'bangs mo'i bu//dbul bar gyur tshe 'byor lan gyis//slar yang pha yi tshig dran nas//gang po dang ni lhan cig gnas//phal pa'i shing ༷ rin tsam gyis//tsan dan phung po nyos pa na//phu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)bos rgya mtshor lan mang por//bgrod pa'i rnyed par skyengs pa byin//gang pos nam zhig rgya mtsho la//bgrod tshe sangs rgyas ma thos pas//rnam 'dren spyan sngar phyin nas su//tshur shog sgo nas rab tu byung //nags kyi ljongs su 82na thas ma gtan la//gnas tshe nyag phran brdeg rtsom pa'i//rngon pa'i tsho gos rnams rjes bzung ste//dul ba'i dpal la rnam par bkod//ma rungs klu btul tshong pa rnams//rlung gis 'chi ba'i 'jigs bskyabs shing //tsan dan gyis tshim shing de las//rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i khang bzang bskrun//de nas sangs rgyas('phrul gyis//gshegs nas go snya nag po sogs//rjes bzung phyag 'tshal mchod rten mdzad//mo gal ma yang thar lam bkod//slar yang rgyal byed tshal gshegs nas//gang pos sngon tshe rab byung la//gshe bas rigs dman dge 'dun tshogs//mchod gos dgra bcom thob par gsungs/(38)/rab tu byung ba rdzas la mngon wo rnams//log pa'i lam las ldog phyir rgyal ba yis//zla gsum bar du dge slong de dag dang //mjal ba'i go skabs ma phye nga/ben par bzhugs//de tshe nye ba'i sde zhes dgon pa pa//mjal bar btang bas gzhan dag 'dod zhen tshogs//spangs nas rnam 'dren drung du lhags pa na//chos bstan rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob//'di yi sngon byung 'khor gyis gsol ba na//nyi ma'i gnyen nyid tshangs byin rgyal po yi//sras su btsas tshe blon po lnga brgya pa//de yi grangs snyed bu yang dus gcig byung //rgyal sras tshe sngon srid skyong la brten pa'i//dmyal bar skyes pa dran nas rab 'byung bar//gsol yang yab kyis gnang bar 82bsgo gyur pas//re zhig lkugs pa'i tshul gyis rdzul brten//rgyal pos bden par bzung tshe sman pa yis//'di la skyon med bcos ma yin smras pas//gshed ma bskos nas gsod la mngon phyogs te//lan grangs mang zhig bsdigs pas gtam 'ga' smras//'on kyang tshangs byin drung du lkugs pa dang //zha ba kho na'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa na//yab kyis khyod rang 'dod pa'i skabs dbye zhes//smras tshe sngar gyi rgyu mtshan ma lus gsol//rgyal bu blon po lnga brgya'i bur bcas pa//dben par rab tu byung tshe 'khor rnams kyis//gsog ༷jog byas la ma rangs rang nyid ni//gcig pur

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnaganas par ri dwags rnams kyang 'dud/ /'khor rnams rang gi bya bar khrel gyur te/ /bdog pa'i rdzasarnams chu klungs cher dor nas/ /rgyal bu'i drung du lhags te chos nyan cing / /mya ga 'das pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer/(39)/tso dbang bzod par smra zhes pa'i/ /drang srong ོ por rab gyur tshe/ /rgyal po rtsod ldan btsun mor bcas/ /tshang tshing nags khrod rgyu ba na/ /btsun mo drang srong la gus par//rgyal pos de yi yan lag bcad/ khrang srong gzhan rnams khros gyur nas/ /dmod mo bor bar brtsamasapa na/ /bzod smras khro ba med pa yis/ /bden pa brjod pas yan lag bsos/ /rtsod ldan nag po'i gos smin nas/ /chu sbur rnag khrag gdungs tshor myong / /zug rngu'i ngang nas tshe 'phos te/ /mi (83na)bzad dmyal ba'i gnas su lhungs/ /bzod par smra de sangs rgyas dang / /rgyal po lhas byin yin par gsungs/(40)/rnam 'dren yangs pa can bzhugs tshe/ /nya pa lnga brgya'i dol nang du/ /mgo brnyan bco brgyad yod pa yi/ khren tu 'jigs pa'i nya zhig thon/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis der byon te/ /ser skya ngag gi nyes pa dag /dran nam mi dge'i bshes kyi ma/ /da lta gang na yod gsungs par/ /mi yi skad du nyes byas dran/ /ma yang dmyal bar yod ces zhus/ /thub dbang gsung gi tshangs dbyangs kyis/ /dam pa'i chos sgra rna bar bsgrags/ /der 'khod ma lus the tshom zhing / /kun dga' bo yis rgyu zhusapas/ /padma ltar rgyas zhal gyi sgo/ /'dzum par mdzad nas 'di skad du/ /sngon tshe sangs rgyas 'od srungs dus/ /sa skyong kri kri'i rgyal khab tu/ /bram ze smra ba'i seng ge yi/ /rtsod pa ser skyas bzlog par byas/ /ser skya 'chi khar rang gi bu/ khred bu ser skyas gzhan dag la/ /rtsod 'os 'od srungs nyan thosadang / /ma rtsod bkur sti gyis smras kyang / /nam zhig ma yi dbang gyur nas/ /dge slong rnams la chosalog bstan/ /mgo brnyan 'di ltar 'dra zhes pa'i/ /ngan smras 'bras bu smin par gsungs/ /nya de tshe 'phos lha ru skyes/ /sangs rgyas mchode cing chos nyan pas/ khyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob/ /lasa'abras ston pa'i me long gsal/(41)/sgra sgrogs rgyal po u ṭa (83bsgo na yis/ /gzugs can snying por rin cen go cha bsrings/ /dngos po gzhan gyis skyes lan ma 'os par/ /rgyal ba'i sku yi snang 95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bas bris nas bskur/khu tra ya nas ring por 'ongs te bsus//mthong nas bcom ldan 'das la dad pa thob//dge slong rdzongs zhes gzugs can snying por springs//kā tyā ya na dge slong ri ma bzangs//phyogs de'i 'gro rnams chos kyi lam bkod cing /khyad par khyim bdag zung zhig dgra bcom thob//de gnyis 'das pa'i shul du mchod rten bzhengs//rgyal po'i bas mo rab byung lha gnas skyes//lhar skyes btsun mor bskul nas sa spyod des//rigs sras gtsug phud can la srid gto nas//chos blon gnyis bskos rang nyid sangs rgyas drung //rab tu byung zhing dgra bcom 'brasabu thob//bu yis chos blon gnas dbyung sdig blon la//brten pa phas thos ldog phyir 'ongs pa na//sdig pa'i blon pos dbyen bcos gshed ma mngags//las kyi dbang gis rgyal po lam du bkum//pha dang dgra bcom bsad pa'i 'gyod sems kyis//sdig spyod blon po gzhan du bskrad pa na//ma yis mya ngan bsang phyir khyod kyi pha//gang zag gzhan du smra ba'i slu 'drid byas/khyim bdag dgra bcom thob pa'i mchod rten nang //sdig pa'i blon pos byi la bsos byas nas//dgra bcom ming btags de yi skye ba zhes//rgyal por bstan pas chos kyi dad pa log/kā tyā ya nas chos kyi blon po la//84na tshog bdun rlung dang me tog gos dngul gser//char 'bab de rjes sa char babs pa'i 'og/rgyal po 'khor bcas non pas bros shig gsungs//blon po'i bu yis kwa tyā ya na de'i//chos gos la 'jusa'atshe ba med par bgrod//sras med rgyal po gzhan gyi bu byas pas//tshe 'dir phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu smin/(42)/sngon tshe khyim bdag brtan pa'i bu//mkhas pa zhes byas mchode pa dang //sbyin gtong bsod namasatsho gos bsags nas//sangs rgyas spyan sngar 'ongs pa'i lam//dbul po lnga brgyas nor bslangs pa//tshim nus dngos po ma khyer bas//yid gnyis the tshom gyur pa na//lhag ma can gyi klu yis byin//sangs rgyas gsung bzhi mchod sbyin gyis//mchog dman 'gro rnams tshim byas tshe//dbul por yongs bto dngos po rnams//sol ba'i phung po ༷ por song //sbyin gos dman snyam khyim bdag

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khog dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)gis/ /dngos po brtan nas dbul po rnams/ /sbyin pa'i bsod nams gsog tu bcug khyu des sol ba nor bur gyur/ /rin cen gsal rgyal la phul rnams/ /sol bar song ba nam mkha' nas/ /byung ba'i sgra ltar khyim bdag gis/ /sol bar longs spyad nor bur gyur/ /mkhas pa sha ri'i bu yi drung / /rab byung ched du bshul zhugs che/ /chu dang smyug ma ljon pa'i shing / /rtsol bas las su rung mthong nas//mkhan (84ba)po sems med de ltar na/ /sems ldan las su cis mi rung / /gsol nas mnyam par gzhag pa yis/ /dgra bcom go 'phang mngon du byas/ /sngon tshe sangs rgyas 'od srungs dus/ khyim bdag 'di ni dbul gyur kyang / /mchod sbyin byed par yid brnags pas/ /brgya byin mthu yis nor rnyed nas/ /sangs rgyas mchode cing tshe rabs su/ /nor dang ldan nas dbul po rnams/ /re ba skong ba'i smon lam gyi/ /'bras bur rgyal bas bka' stsal to/(43)/rgyal po gser mdog ces bya ba'i/ /yul du mu ge byung ba na/ /rang gi bang mdzod ma lus pa/ /mnga' 'bangs rnams la sbyin par btang / /bdag nyid 'tsho ba'i zas nyud ngu / /yod pa rang sangs rgyas la phul/ /des kyang bsngags pa cher brjod pas/ /bsod nams gzugs can ltar gyur te/ /'bru dang rin cen gos dar sogs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod char du babs/ /legs byas 'bras bu nam du yang / /bslu ba med pa'i gtam 'di mtshar/(44)/khyim bdag lha rje zhes bya'i bu/ /lag gnyis gser las byas pa byung / /de las nyin bzhin dngul srang 'bum/ /babs nas 'phongs rnams dbul ba sel/ /nam zhig de ni thub dbang gi /spyan sngar rab byung dge slong rnams/ /ngo mtshar rgyu mtshan zhus pa na/ /tshems dkar ze 'bru ngoms zhal nas/ /sngon dus sangs rgyas 'od srungs gdung / /sbyangs pa'i rin wo mchod sdong ni/ /kri kris bsgrubs(85nas gser lag 'di/ /bzo bo kunda la ru gyur/ /mchod rten de la gser sbyangs kyi/ /gzungasabarnyan mdzes pa gnyis phul te/ /rnam dag smon lam btab pa yis/ /'bras bur gsungs pa e ma mtshar/(45)/lhas byin ngan pa'i grogs bsten pas/ /ma skyes dgra yis rang gi pha/ /btson du bcug tshe bcom ldan 'das/ /bug pa'i sgo ru 'chag par mdzad/ /gzugs can snying po nyam chung des/ /skad —97

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gdangs zhan pas sdug bsngal las//skyob par gsol mthus sangs rgyas sku'i//'od kyis mun bsal bde bar byas//tshul de thos pas ma skyes dgras//gzugs can snying po'i rkang pa bcad//smre sngags bton pas rgyal ba yis//las 'bras chags bral dam chos bstan//myur du rgyal po tshe 'phosanas//khyu mchog ces bya rnam thos bur//skyes nas drin lan bsang pa'i ched//zas gtsang sras la mchod pa byas//ma skyes dgra la 'gyod bsal mdo//gsungs shing gzugs can snying po yang //sngon tshe rang sangs rgyas kyi rkang //bcad pa'i gos bur bka' stsal to/(46)/lhas byin sen mor dug bskus nas//sangs rgyas zhabs la 'byug snyam pa//glo bur bskal ba'i me nang du//cho nge dang bcasalhungs par gyur//de las 'phros pa'i gleng gzhi'i lan//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa//grong khyer dge ba'i 85ba bo byangs zhes par//sa bdag yid bzang bu gnyis las//byas shes slong ba'i re ba skong //byas mi shes ni sdig la spyod//rgyal po blo gros dbyangs kyis ni//bu mo ster ba'i dusakyang btos//re zhig sras gnyis rgya mtshor bgrod//nor bu lon nas tshur log tshe/khru gzings zhig pa'i shing dum la//brten nas mched gnyis skam sar 'thon/zhu bos gcen gyi mig bcar nas//nor bu khyer te gzhan du bros//byas shes blo gros dbyangs kyi yul//bgrod nas ba glang skyong ba'i tshe/rgyal po'i bu mos ngo shes te//de dang lhan cig khyim thabs byas//nam zhig 'tsho ba sbyor hphu sa tshe//kho bor mi sems zhes smras pas//de yi lan du mdza' na mos//bdag ni khyod nyid kho na la//gusazhes bden tshig brjod pa yis//rgyal bu'i mig g.yas bsos par gyur//rgyal bus gcung la khro med zhes//bden pa brjod pas mig g.yon bsos//blo gros dbyangs kyi rgyal srid la//rgyal bu byasashes kyis dbang bsgyur//nu bo byas mi shes pa de//'bu yang gus pa ltar 'ongs pa//mthong chos dngosasu myong gyur nas//dmyal ba'i me dong nang du lhungs/(47)/rgya mtshor gnas pa'i klu dag gis//mi yi gzugs sprul sangs rgyas drung //chos nyan pa dang lhan cig tu//sa bdag gsal rgyal 'khor bcaX'adus//klu yis rgyal por ma 'dud pas/khros

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)nas dpung gis lam bkag tshe/ /gdengs can tsho gos rnams(86na7khar bgrod nas/ /sna tshogasamatshon cha'i char pa phab/ /rgyal bas mo gal bu btang ste/ /mtshon rnams zas dang btung bar gyur/ /mi bdag ngo mtshar sangs rgyas la/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i gus pa thob/ /dge slong rnams kyis mi bdag 'dis/ /swā la'i ljon pa btsugs pa rnams/ /bu ram shing gi sdong bu sa gyur pa'i 'byor tsho gos rgyu dris pas/ /gsal rgyal sngon dus bur shing par/ gyur tshe rang sangs rgyas shig la/ /bur chu sogasakyis rgyu byas pa'i/ /mchod tsho gos 'bras bu bla med gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas sa dbang gis/ /nyer mchod de la nga rgyal bas/ /dge 'dis bdag cag 'khor ba las/ /grol bar 'gyur ram zhes gsol bas/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang slob lam du/ /sbyin sogs tsam gyis zhi ba'i lam/ /rnyed min rmongs chen srid pa'i rgyu/ /nyon mongs spangs tshe grol bar gsungs/(48)/klu yi rgyal po rgya mtsho'i bu/ /don kun grub pa tshe 'phos nas/ /mi yi rgyal po don 'grub tu/ gyur tshe rgas dang dbul po mthong / /tshul des yid 'byung gzhan phan ched/ /rgya mtshor nor bu len par chas/ /rin cen gling nasatshong pa rnams/ /'dod pa'i nor bskur phyir la slog /rgyal bus pus mo phrag pa tsam/ zhub pa'i chu bo brgal ba'i mthar/ /gnod sbyin 'bod sgrogs yul bgrod tshe/ khrin pos khur nas klu yul bskyal/ /de na ngu mo'i sgra thos pas/ /(86bcu yin dris par nged cag gi /rgyal po don kun grub pa shi/ /zer bas skye ba sngon ma dran/ /pha yis ngo shes dga' bas lkod/ /nor bu byin nas tshur 'ongs tshe/ /lam du rgya mtshor gnas pa'i lhas/ /thabs kyis bslus nas nor bu phyogs/ /lha yi dbang pos grogs byasanas/ /rgya mtsho'i sum gnyis phyir pho bas/ /'jigs nas phyir gtad rang yul 'khor/ /nor busa'agro kun bde la bkod/(49)/khyim bdag legs pa rab gsal la/ khye'u btsas dang dus mnyam du//gser gyi glang po zhig byung bas/ /bu'i ming glang po can zhes btags/ /de tshe rgyal po gsal rgyal la//bu mo chos gos ldan pa btsas/ /de gnyis phan tshun yid chags kyang/ /rje 'bangs khyad kyis so ma nyi gyur/ /nam zhig gzhen nus glang po yi/ /mche ba gnyis po rgyal por phul/ /ji ltar 'dod pa gsong —99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 79)pe ra smyos/ /ster zhes smras tshe bu mo bslangs/ /blon po rnams kyis dmangs phal par/ /rgyal po'i bu mo ster mi rigs/ /'on kyang ci 'dod ster ba yi/ /dam bca' mi nyams thabs tshul gleng / /yid kyis 'gyu bar gser glang de/ /mche ba phyung tshe shi snyam nas/ /bu mo bsu bar gser glang la/ /zhen zhes rgyal blon rnams kyis smras/ khyim bdag dga' mgu yi rang ste/ /gser glang zhen nas kha ba tu 'ongs//rgyal po'i bu mo thob nas ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyin/ /sngon tshe khyo shug (87na 'di nyid kyis/ stonang glang sangs rgyas rnam gzigs la/ /phul ba'i gos bu dge bar smin/ /zhes pa'i ya mtshan gtam gyis bsngags/(50)/bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la/ /nyan thos shā ri'i bu bzhugs tshe/ /bcoms ldan 'das kyi mo galabu/ /'bod par btang bas shā ri'i bus/ /rang gi bla gos sne gcig ni/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri labatags/ /sne gcig mo gal bur gtad nas/ /'then du bcug pas ri bo 'gul/ /ri rab la yang de bzhin ste/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs khri la/ /chos gos btags nas nyer then pas/ /cung zad tsam yang 'gul ma nus/ /mchog zung sangs rgyas drung sleb tshe/ /klu yang ri 'gul 'jig ste lhag zhus wa ra nā si sa /dung dang bris pa'i bram ze byung / /bris pas nyi ma shar ba na/ /dung gi mgo 'gasadamod pa bor/ /de yi nyi ma mi 'a'ang bar/ /dmod pa bor bas mun par gyur/ /'gro rnams mun sel gsol btab tshe/ /dmod pa bsrung slad bris pa yis/ /'jim par dung gi mgo bo bcos/ /nyi ma shar tshe mgo de gas/ /bris pa da lta shā ri'i bu/ /dung ni mo gal bu ru bstan/ /dge slong rnams kyi sangasargyas la/ /las bcu'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa'i lan/ /sangs rgyas mug dhar nyer 'khrungs tshe/ khu bo gsad pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /dmyal ba yun ring myong ba'i mthar/ /las kyi lhag mar mthe bong (87ba)gnad//ded dpon don byin gyur pa na/ /rgya mtshor bgrod tshe chom rkun bsad/ /dmyal ba mang brgyud da lta'ang / /rkang par seng ldeng tshal pa zug /bram ze'i khye'ur gyur ba'i tshe/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi bsod snyom pho/ /skye ba mang por dbul gyur nas/ /'dir yang lhung bzed stong par byung / /bha ra dha dzar gyur — 100

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)pa'i dus/ /phu bo dgra bcom tshangs spyod las/ /nyams zhes skur btab dmyal bar skyes/ /'dir yang bram ze'i bu mos skur/ /padma'i rtsa lag gyur pa na/ /bzang mo bsad cing rang rgyal la/ /nyen kha g.yogs pas dmyal bar skyes/ /'dir yang mu stegs bu mos smad/ /bram ze ma tha rar gyur dus/ /nas rul zan gyis dge sbyong rnams/ /mchod par 'os zhes smras pa yis/ /'dir yang nas rul za bar gyur/ /bram ze u tta rar gyur tshe/ /byang chub thob la dka' spyad dgod/ /smras nas sangs rgyasamachod ldog pas/ /lo drug dka' ba spyod dgos byung / /sman pa kha ba'i bzhin gyur dus/ khyim bdag nor ldan sman log gis/ khyu ma bcad pas dmyal ba myong / /'dir yang zhabrul ba'i nad kyis btab//nya pa'i bu ru skyes pa'i tshe/ /nya sha bcad pas ngu sgra la/ /dga' bar bya pas dmyal bar skyes/ /'dir yang mgo bo na bar gyur/ /ljon pa'i gyad du skyes pa na/ /gyad pa gzhan dag srog dang phral/ khyu desadamyal ba nyams myong nas/ /'dir yang rlung gis byang khog gzer/61)/ (88na81na tshe sangs rgyas dka' thub nags gshegs tshe/ /zhal 'dzum mdzad pa'i rgyu rkyen brgya byin gyis/ /zhus lan utpal ldan gyi grong khyer du/ kho bo bud med gser ldan zhes byar gyur/ /de tshe bkres pa'i gdung ba drag po yis/ /ches cher nyam thag bud med rang gi bu/ /za bar mngon du phyogs par mthong ba ni/ /snying rjesam bzod nu ma bcad nas byin/ /lha dbang ngo mtshar bden mthus bud med lus/ /skyes par gyur nasas de'i rgyal po thob/ /de nas tshe 'phos yul der tshong dpon bu/ /snying stobs mchoge gyur de tshe lusabyar byin/ /de nyid lus 'phos yul de'i bram ze'i bu/ /bden pa'i brtul zhugs bya bar skyes pa'i tshe//stag mo bkres pa mthong nas rang lus la/ /tsham tshom med par rma phyung sa la 'gyel/ /stag mos rang sha za bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs snyam yid dga' bas/ /sems med nor 'dzin ma de ngo mtshar nas/ /sa gzhi g.yo ba'i rdzus la ci yang bstan/(52)/rgyal ba 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu/ /brgya byin gyis ni zhus pa na/ /mā gu da ga'i grong khyer du/ /bsod nams mi dman rgyal por gyur/ /gzhan 'byor phun tshogs mi bzod pa'i / /sa skyong tshangs byin —10/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()phrag dog gis//g.yul gyi dpung tsho gis cher bshams pa//rtsod ldan rang mtshang ngom pa bzhin//mi bdag 'khor bar yid phyung nas//rgyal srid spangs te nags su song //'on kyang blon pos rgyal po 88bdag/yod pa'i rdzur brten 'khrug pa byas//tshangs byin rgyal pos bram ze yi//gnyen rnamasabatson du bzung ba de//bslu ba'i ched du nor 'tshol slad//bsod nams mi dman drung du lhags//bdag gi nye du 'jigs pa las//bskyab phyir dngos po nyer bslangs tshe/ju mtshan bshad pas bram ze brgyal//gnyis skyes re ba bskang ba'i phyir//bdag gi mgo bo nyer chod la//tshangs byin la phul ces bsgo bar//ha cang bzod par ches dka' zhes//bram zes bya bar ma nus pas//des na bdag nyid tshangs byin drung //khrid la dgra bo bzung zhes spros//de yis khyod kyi don 'grub gsungs//bram zes de ltar byas pa na//ma rungs pa yi tshangs byin kyang //ngo mtshar skyes nas 'khon zhi ste//bsod nams mi dman rgyal srid du//bskos nas bkur dang bsngags pa byas/(3)/sngon tshe wa ra ṇa si sa/thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das//mi bdag legs bshad 'tshol du gyur//de nyid dbul phongasa'agro ba'i gnyen/khyad par legs bshad don gnyer bas//nam zhig blon po blo bzang gis//nags su rngon pa mkhas pa dag/yod ces rgyal po'i snyan du gsol//mu tig 'phreng ba khyer nas kyang //gang de'i drung du yi par phyin//do shal slar yang phrogs dogs pa'i//ma rungs bsam pa 'chad por skyes//chos nyan srog dang bral ba'i ched//tshigs bcad thos rjes ri'i rtse nas//mchong ba'i dam bca' yon blangs pa bzhin//de don bsgrub par zhal gyis mches//legs par bshad par thosapa'i rjes//lus la ma chags mchonges pa na//gnod sbyin rnam rgyal gyis bzung ste//rgyal khab chen po nyid du bskyal//nam zhig rngon pas phreng ba de//'tshong bar 'ongs pas mi rnams kyis//rkun por dogs nas btson du bzung //mi bdag gis thos btson nas brtan/(4)/rgyal bas gnod sbyin 'phrog byed ni//btul nas zhal 'dzum mdzad pa'i dus//lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis//de yi rgyu dang rkyen dris par//sngon tshe dbang chen sde'i sras ///sems can sman du bcom ldan nyid/gyur tshe

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (ma)thos dang reg tsam gyis//'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus bsal//de nyid tshe 'phos nags kyis mtha'i//rdzing 'gram sku gdung tshas bcas bzhag/de la reg dang dri phog pa//tsam gyis 'gro ba'i nad kun bsal//rang gi sngon gyi byung ba'i tshul//ma bsgribs gsal bar dran pas kyang //bde ba'i dpal la spyod 'gyur ba//ngo mtshar gtam snyan dbyangs su 'tsher/(55)/sangs rgyas thams cad ster zhes pa'i//rgyal por gyur tshe phug ron zhig/'jigs shing skrag nas mdun du byung //de rjes rngon pa zhig kyang lhags//kye ma bdag cag 'tsho ba'i zas//'dab chags 'di ni yin zhes zer//phug ron bslu phyir rang gi sha/bcad nas ster ba'i sbyor ba brtsams//5ba ) byed por gser gyi rngon pa dag/sbyin no smras pas dngos po la//sred pa'i bram ze ser skya zhes//'ongs nas sha rnams rim gyis bcad//phug ron ljid dang ma mnyam pas//rgyal po'i lus nyid srang du bcug/lha yis me rtag char pa phab//rngon pa ngo mtshar rgyu mtshan dris//sangs rgyas thob phyir dka' spyad ces//bden tshig brjod mthus lusakyang gsos//de ltar rgyal ba'i sras po yi//rlabs chen spyod pa 'di ngo mtshar/86)/sa bdag tshangasabyin zhes bya bas//sangs rgyas 'khor bcas mchode pa na//grong khyer de yi skye bo rnams//ston pa'i spyan sngar nye bar 'dus//ba lang skyong zhes bya ba'i klu'i//dug gis mi nor 'bru tsho gos rnams//nyams shing brlag pa'i sdug bsngal las//thugs rje can gyis skyob par zhus//rgyal bas chu yi 'gram du bzhugs//ma bzod klu yis rdo char phab//de kun me tog char par gyur//gdengs can bcosanas bslab la bkod//mi bsrun gdug can gnod sbyin yang //zhi ba'i sems la rab tu sbyar//zhal 'dzum mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni//lha yi dbang pos zhus pa na//gnas 'dir sangs rgyas mang posakyang //byon nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad gsungs//sku bal gyi ni ring bsrel la//brten nas rngon pasamachod rten bzhengs/97)/ba glang skyong gis klu btul ba'i//gnas der mig stong ldan pa yis//gsol ba btab nas mchode pa'i rten//mang 90na ju bskrun nas bsod nams spel//tshong pa legasapar rab sad dang /khyim bdag bā lo kyar gragasaX//7sba ra dang ma li ga'i//gnod sbyin rnams la

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)dam chos bstan/ khyim bdag gru 'dzin mi li spros/ /grong khyer pā ṭa la zhes par/ /rgyal ba spyan drangasachos nyan cing / /skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten byas/88)/sangs rgyas bsod nams stobs zhes pa'i/ /rgyal por gyur nas lam zhugs tshe/ /nad pa mthong bas snying rje skyes/ /zas sman btab cing bran g.yog bskos/ /nam zhig nad can blta ba'i phyir/ /glang po zhen nas song ba na/ /lha dbang long ba'i gzugasasprul nas/ /mig slong mtshon rgyas phyung nas byin/ /long bar mig chung ya gcig kyang / /ster bar brtsams tshe brgya byin gyis/ /gzugs bstan khyod ni snying stobs can/ /e ma ngo mtshar zhes bsngagasabarjod/99)/sa skyong mya ngan med kyi sras/ /ku lwa la zhes bya ba ni/ /mig gi mdzes chos khyad par can/ /kun gyi yid du 'ong bar gyur/ /mngon shes drug dang ldan pa yi/ /gnas brtan grags pa zhesabya bas/ /rig nas khyod ni rab tu byung / /gzhan du mig ni nyams zhes brjod/ /yab kyi btsun mo skar rgyal de/ /sras la brtse bar mngon phyogs kyang / /'os pa min zhes phyir ldog pas/ /g.yo can bud med khros par gyur/ /rdo 'jog rgyal bo gzhom pa'i phyir/ /ku las dmag dpung bcas te bgrod/ /(90bsgo sod nams chen pos 'bad
