med tu/ /pha rol gyis btud rgyal sar bskos/ /nam zhig rgyal po mya ngan med/ /lto ba zhakhru ba'i nad kyis gzir/ /gzhan gyis ma phan skar rgyal gyis/ /de 'dra'i nad pa'i lto ba phral/ /nang du srin bu ma rungs pa/ /dug sman gzhan gyis ma gsod gang / /lha min khrag gis 'chi mthong nas/ /sgog pa'i sman gyis sa spyod bsos/ /bya dgar zhag bdun rgyal srid bslangs//'phyon mas rgyal po'i bkar brdzus nas/ /rang gi sras kyi mig phyungs zhes/ /rdo 'jog rgyal por springs yig btang / /sa yi bdag pos nyer bklags pas/ /don de smra bar ma nus tshe/ /ku wā la yisargyu mtshan dris/ /bshad pas yab kyi bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ /long ba pi wang brdung bzhin du/ kha zas slong phyir yul mang song / /nam zhig pha yi drung du slebs/ /rgyal po yud cig dran med brgyal/ /bsos nas nan dris rgyu mtshan bsnyad/ /btsun mo gsod par brtsams pa na/ /khro dang 'khon 'dzin med ces pa'i/ /bden pa'i tshig gis mig gnyis bsos/ /ku lha la 'di skye ba sngon/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs 104

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang ran po che'i mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (mnamig phyung nas//slar yang ind+ra ni la las//spyan gnyis bsgrubs pas 'bras bzang thob/(60)/rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi klu yi khang pa zhig/bye tshan char gyis nyen pas gdengs can bu//gzhen nu nor bzang sangs rgyas drung lhags te//skyabs su song zhing bslab pa'i gzhi yang mnos//rang gi khyim 91na ) du spyan drangs rin po che'i//gtsug lag khang brtsegs bsnyen bkur phun tsho gos byas//dus kun dge ba'i bsod nams dpag med tshogs//'thob ces shākya'i tog gis dbugs dbyung ngo //(61)bram ze nor med bkra shis kyis//de bzhin gshegs pa byon mthong nas//chung ma zas kyi sbyor ba'i tshogs//byed du bcug ste rgyal ba mchod//smon lam btab gos myu gu'i tshogs//'bad pa med par gser du gyur//phun tshogs 'byor ldan bram ze des//bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas pa mchod//chos nyan rgyun zhugs sa bu thob//rab tu byung zhing lhag ma'i lam//nyams su blangs pasadagra bcom gyur//bsod nams 'bras bzang tshe der smin/(62)khyim bdag legs par rab sad kyi//n+ya gro dha yi shing drung phyin//bu yi dngos grub ster na mchod//mi byin sdong po gcod ces smras//shing de'i lha yis brgya byin drung //phyi nas bu yi dngos grub zhus//lha bu blo bzang 'pho gzigs nas/khyim der nying 'tshams sbyor zhes bsgos//'chi med bus kyang rab byung bar//gegs med gyur na byed ces gsol/mang gi lha des khyim bdag la//bu btsa' rab tu byung zhes smras//ring por ma thogasagaser mdog can//rin cen gdugs kyis spyi gtsug la//brgyan pa'i bu zhig khyim bdag gi/chung ma la ni btsas par gyur//ljon pa'i lha yi tshig dran te//pha yi sgo la mel 91bas bskos//cher skyes shing rta la smo nas//skyed mos tshal du rgyu bar song //de tshe bde gshegs slob mar bcas//mthong bas sa la myur babs te//zhabs rdul gtsug tu blangs pa na//rab tu byung zhes lung yang bstan//bam dang bud med ra ro'i gawo//mthong bas 'bor bar skyo ba skyes//brgya byin nus pasasgo srung kyis//ma tshor thag ring gnas su bgrod//chu klung chen po'i 'gram slebs che//bsnyen sring med par rab 'jug pa'i//sangs rgyas thugs rjeXphyag brkyangs nas//tshur shog gsungs te rab tu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)byung / /pha yis grags sbyin 'tshol 'ongs pa/ /rnam 'dren mthu yis bu ma mthong / /thub dbang khyim du spyan drangs nas/ /mchod pas dgra bcom 'bras bu thob/(63)/bram ze n+ya gro dha'i rtag gis/ /chung mar ring min khye'u zhig /pi bla la yi shing 'og btsas/ khreng las 'bad med gos kyang byung / /nar son khyim thabs long zhig ces/ /pha yis bskul tshe ma 'dod kyang / /gser sbyangs las bzos bu mo'i gzugs/ bstan nas 'di 'dra dgos zhes smras/ /bram zes rang gi grogs po la/ /gser gyi bu mo bskur nas brdzangs/ /bzang mo zhes pa'i ngo mtshar can/ /mthong nas khyim du log ste smras/ /de tshe bu yi slong mo ba'i/ /mas gyon bu mo brtag par phyin/ /bu mo tshangs par spyod shes nas/ /pha yi 'dod bzhin khas blangs so/ /de tshe bu dang bu mo gnyis/ /tshangasaspyod brtul zhugs(92na thags zung nas/ /gnyid log mel tshe re mos su/ /spyod lam mi mthun so sor gnas/ /lus phras lag pa phyir brkyangs nas/ /gnyid la song tshe dug sprul zhig /byung ba'i 'jigs pa bskyab ba'i phyir/ /de yi lag pa gos kyis bkab/ /bu mos dam bca' brjed smras tshe/ /pi skyal skyes rgyu mtshan gleng / /til mar las byung sdig pa sogs/ /mthong bas 'khor bar yid ni skyo//gnyis ka thub pa'i spyan sngar lhags/ /sangs rgyas 'od chos srungs ma da rten drung / /rab tu byung ba'i dngos po bsgrubs/ /myur du dgra bcom go 'phang thob/(64)/nor bzang rgyal khyab dang nye ba'i/ /dbang wo sde yi rgyal po yod/ /gang de'i yul du char dkon pas/ /grong khyer phal cher nyams par gyur/ /nor bzang yul du klu gnas pas/ /'gugs par rigs zhes gros mthun nas/ /tshul de bsgrub par nus pa yi/ /rig sngags 'chang zhig gnas der btang / klu yis shes nas rngon pa la/ /grogs bcol dus der sngags mkhan gyis/ /sbyin sreg byasapas mtsho khol tshe/ /rngon pas mda' 'phangs sngags pa bsad/ /klu yis drin lan bsang pa'i ched/ /rngon pa rang gi yul du bos/ /nor bu don zhags des mthong nas/ /nan gyis slangs ltar byin nasasong / /sdig can de'i bus sgra snyan thos/ /drang srong la dris rgyu mtshan bshad/ khrus kyi rdzing bu'i sar 106

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (mnaphyin nas//zhags pa 'phangs te 92ba thad 'phrog bzung //ring min rgyal bu nor bzang gis//rngon par 'dod pa'i nor byin nas//lha mo yid 'phrog khab tu bzhes//bag ma'i dga' ston rgya cher byas//nam zhig rgyal po dmag la chas//gtsug rgyan nor bu ma la bcol//bu mo'i srog la babs na gtod//zhes sogs bslab bya mang du mdzad/khrag gi rdzing bur khrus byas shing //mi'am ci yi tshil bu la//sbyin sreg byas na rgyal po yi//ngan ltas bzlog ces ser skyas smras//rgyal pos btsun mo gsod brtsams tshe//ma yis gtsug rgyan nor bu gtad//sgeg mo mkha' la skad cig mar//mi'am ci yi yul du song //sor gdub 'phrin dang bcas ba ni//lam gyi drang srong dag la bzhag/pha rol g.yul las rnam rgyal te//nor bzang slar yang rang yul slebs/khyu mtshan shes nas 'tshol bar phyin//drang srong gis ni sor gdub gtad//'phrin rnams ma lus rdzogs par bshad//mi'am ci yi yul du bgrod//yid 'phrog dang phrad nam mkha' la//'phur nas rang gi yul du slebs//zas gtsang gragasa'adzin la sdang ba'i//sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' rnams gsal/(65)/rgyal po ka shu zhes bya ba/srusamed 'byor ba che ldan byung //nam zhig bu tshab 'tshol ba la//blon po rnams dang gros byas pas//pha ni drang srong ri dwags kyi//ma las btsas pa'i khye'u ni//gser gyi mdog can rwa gcig pa//de ni 'gugs 93na / par rigs zhes mthun//sa dbang sras mo pad ldan de//drang srong gzhen nu'i yid 'phrog ོ//tshang tshing ljongs su nyer bto nas//rtse 'jo'i rnam 'gyur sna tsho gos byas//rwa gcig ba yis bu mo bur//'khrul gtam smras pas glags rnyed de//zas byin ngo tsha nyer btang ba'i//'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs byas//bdag gnas ring min ga bur tshal//yod ces lag 'byud shing rta'i steng /khrid tshe 'dren rta ri dwags su//bsams nas rkang pa mi reg smras//rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i shing rta'i mthus//skad cig yul slebs yab rgyal por/khyu mtshan bsnyad tshe drang srong gi/dmod pa la 'jigs re zhig btang //gzhen nu bu mor yid chags par//pha yis ldog pa'i tshig smra ba//rlung gis rab sbar nags kyi me//chu yi thigs pas//da pa bzhin//gaṅgā'i 'gram du skyed tshal la//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)zhabrul ba'i rdzing bzos 'jo sgeg mas/ /slar yang rwa gcig der khrid de/ /chu rgyun la brten pho brang 'ongs/ /gzhon nu blo gzhan mi phyogs pa'i/ khreg za 'bar ba'i cho ga dang / /sgo gsum bde ster dga' ston ni/ /sum rtsen sal 'phos pa bzhin/ /skabs shig rwa gcig chung mar bcas/ /nags su 'ongs tshe bu yi mas/ /pad ldan ma ni su zhes lan/ /sbyin sreg las thob zol tshig smras/ /rim gyisachung mar shes gyur te/ /pha mas bag ma'i cho ga bsgrubs/ /slar yang kā shi'i pho brang gi /rgyal sar (93ba bo bang bskur mnga' 'bangs bskyangs/(6)/rgyal po bden pa dga' zhes par/ /btsun mo gnyis yod chen ma la/ /bu btsas ring zhig lon pa na/ /sa bdag 'jig rten pha rol song / /de tshe chung mar bu zhig btsas/ /mtshan ngan yin zhes grags pa yis/ /de nyid gsod pa'i gshed ma bskos//chos bzang ma yis nya grong sbas/ /de nas na tshod lon pa na/ /gzhon nu snyan ngag mkhan du grags/ /slar yang shes nas gsod par brtsams/ /ma yi gtsug rgyan nor bu byin/ /de yi nus pas chus ma khyer/ /gdengs can yul du sleb pa na/ /mngag gzhug rnams kyis klu la bsdigs/ /'jigs te khrusamakhan gnas su bskyal/ /rim gyis dzomakhan khang par bros/ /de la gshed mas bskor ba na/ /ro yi tshul gyis gzhan du bskyal/ /slar yang ded pas g.yang la mchongs/ /gtsug gi nor bu shing la 'thogs/ /pho nyas de shes rgyal por phul/ khye'u gnod sbyin 'a rgyas bzung nas/ /nags su slebs tshesasu da sa sa/ /gsod par brtsams la thub pas bskyabs/ /de yas rgyal bur sgyu ma bslabs/ /rang gi yul 'ongs gar mangs sprul/ /sgyu ma bkye nas pho brang phyin/ /mgo la rdo bsnun phu bo bsad/ /rgyalapo'i srid la dbang bsgyur cing / /tshe 'phos dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes/ /zhes pa'i sngon byung rgyal bsagasungs/(67)/dge 'dun kyi srungs sa shā ri'i bu'i/ /rjes su gongs nas rab tu (94na bang / /nam zhig mkhan po la zhuganas/ /tshong pa rnams dang lhan cig bgrod/ /chu gter dbus su rdzingasazhig par/ /sngon du phyogs tshe chu'i nang nas/ /lung bstan byung ltar dge 'dun srungs/ /the tshom med par chu la mchongs/ /klu yi yul du phyin nas ni/ /gdengs can rnams la dam chos bstan/ /slar yang /08—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)klu yis steng du bskyal/ /rim phyin gnyid g.yur rjes su lus/ khyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag kun/ /mngon sum tshad mas nyer gzhal ba'i/ /dus la bab ste nags kyi tshul/ /dge 'dun tsho gos pa'i khang par phyin/ /zas kyi dus la bab pa na/ /phan tshun mgo bo tho ba yis/ /bsnun cing khrag gis 'gengasapar byed/ /dris pas zas rtsod rnam smin zer/ /bshul du zhugs tshe sngar lta bu'i/ /dge 'dun tshogasanas gdugs tshone zas/ /lcags khur gyur pa 'dus sde yi/ /bsnyen bkur bkag pa'i 'bras bur gleng / /rim gyis drang srong lnga brgya yi/ /gnas su slebs dus lhas bskul nas/ /chos bstan dge 'dun srungs nyid kyang / /skad cig de la dgra bcom thob/ /drang srong rnams kyang dad gyur nas/ /gsol ba btab pas rdzu wol gyis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du khrid/ /gnyis skyes tshogos rnamasadagra bcom gyur/ /de yi sngon gyi rgyu mtshan kyang / /'od srungs dus su dge 'dun srungs/ /zhal ta byed pa'i grogs po ni/ /drang srong lnga brgya yin par gsungs/(68)/ri dwags las btsas(94ba)bud med ni/ /rkang pa bkod shul 'dab stong can/ /skyes pas padma ldan zhes pa/ /rgyal po tshangs byin dang phrad tshe/ /btsun mor dbang bskur sras skye bar/ /mngon du phyogs tshe gzhan dag gis/ /phrag dog g.yo sgyu'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /mig gnyis bsdams nasabatsa' ru bcug /khye'u gser mdog gnyis byung ba/ /sgrom du bcug nas chu la bskyur/ /btsun mo'i gdong la khrag byugs nas/ /bu zos srin mo yin zhes smras/ /rgyal pos gsod par brtsams pa na/ /blon pos thabs kyi khang par sbas/ /bu mos ma nyes zhes su lhas/ /sgra bsgrags rgyal po mya ngan gyur/ /chu yis khyer pa'i sgrom bu ni/ /nya pas rnyed de lha yi sras/ /yin par shes nas phul ba dang / /lhan cig blon pos btsun mo gtad / /rang gi khyo la ma rangs pas/ /phar grags drang srong mjal phyin pa/ /de nyid lnga pa'i dbang gyur nas/ /ma phrad gdung bas 'khyams pa na/ /wa ra ṇa sir kri kri yis/ /don du gnyer nas bdag tu bzung/ /tshul de tshangs byin gyis thos pas/ /thabs kyis rang gi gam du bkug /(69)rgyal po mya ngan med ces pas/ /bsod nams bye ba'i zhing mchog tu/ /klu yi yul nas sangs — 109

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)rgyas kyi//ring bsrel blangs te mchod rten byas//gnas brtan grags pa 'khor bcas rnams//rab tu gnas pa bya ba'i ched//nam mkhar song ba'i grib ma yis//'dzin ma'i khyon kun g.yogs pa 95na thar//der 'ongs rab byung rgan po la//sa yi bdag por ro bda'i zas//phun tsho gos rnyed bkur legs bstabs pa//ji bzhin longs su nyer spyad tshe//dge slong rnams kyis 'di skad du//rgyal po chos don gnyer ba'i phyir/khyod la bshad rgyu e yod ces//dris pas med snyam sdug bsngal gyur//lha yis tshigs su bcad pa bslabs//dam chos de nyid rgyal por bstan//brtson pas dge slong dgra bcom pa//thob pa'i ngo mtshar gtam 'di med/(7)/dgra bcom nyi ma gung pa yis/kha che'i yul byon gtsug lag khang //rtsig par brtsams tshe dug can klus//mtshon char phab pa padma ra gyur//ngo mtshar skyil krung rgya khyon dang //mnyam pa'i sa gzhi klu yis phul//rdzu 'phrul skyil krung yul dgu'i bar/khyab par gtsug lag khang mang brtsigs//sposang da ldan nas gur kum gyi//son blangs kha che'i yul du btab//ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar//chad med skye bar byin gyis brlabs/(71)/dge slong shā na'i gos can de//bcom brlag yul du byon pa'i lam//legs pa'i rang bzhin mched gnyis kyis//gang gi rgyu mtshan dris pa'i lan//rang rgyal snying nad gzir ba bsos//gos phul chagasabral mthong bas dad//de nyid 'das tshe gdung bzhu nas//mtshungs par 'gyur ba'i smon lam btab//bcom brlag yul du rdzu hrūl gyis//klu btul gtsug lag 95bstong bzang brtsigs//grogs ni yul de'i tshong dpon bu//na ḍa bha sna zhes pa'o/(72)/spos 'tshong rigs kyi nyer sbas la//nor lhasabyin gyis spos nyos shing //pho nya mngags te 'dod pa'i gtam//smras kyang bag yod mas yis ldog/smad 'tshong ma de'i khyim nang du//'dod pa don gnyer tshong pa slebs//slar yang de las phyug pa zhig/'ong zhes rten bzang 'phrin yig 'byor//gang tshe g.yo can bud med des//rang gi 'dod pa bsgrub pa'i slad//sngar slebs dug gi sbyor ba yis//bsad pas rgyal po'i chad pa phog/khrims kyis mnar la nyer sbas des//chos bstan rgyun zhugs thob naX'adas//nyer sbas shā na'i gos can drung //rab

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)byung dgra bcom mngon du gyur/ /chos ston bdud kyi bar gcod lan/ /gtor pa'i me tog mi sbrul khyi'i/ /ror gyur yid srubs lus brgyan tshe/ /'gyod pa skyes shing skyabs su song / /bdud kyis ston pa'i skur sprul pas/ /ro yis bcings las rnam par grol/ /nyer spas mthu yis yul de'i 'gro/ /'bum phrag bco brgyad dgra bcom thob/(73)/rgya mtshor gru zhig tshong pa rnams/ /nor dang bral bar gyur pa na/ /sa bdag mya ngan med gang der/ /klu la springs yig gnang bar gsol/ /the tshom gyur par mngon shes dang / /ldan pa'i lung bstan bzhin bsgrubs kyang / /re zhig klu yis nor ma gtad/ /'on te lha yis smras la nyan/ /dkon cog mchod (96na thang smon lam btab/ /dgra bcom stong phrag drug cu byon/ /gtso bo'i gsung ltar rgyal po dang / /klu yi gzugs brnyan gser la byas/ /sangs rgyas de gsung slob ma la/ /mchod pas rgyal po'i gzugs mtho zhing / /gdengs can 'dra 'bag nyer dma' tshe/ /springs yig btang bas nor rnams phul/ /sangs rgyas lta bar 'dod na yang / /chos dbyings klong du 'das zin pas/ /mgo che zhes bya'i ri bo las/ /nyer sbas rgyan drangs bkur sti byas/(74)/sabadag mya ngan med pa yis/ /dge slong 'bum phrag gsum mchod nas/ /gser srang bye ba dgu bcu dang / /rtsa drug phul zhing bsod nams bsags/ /nam zhig nad kyis thebs pa na/ /tsha bos mdzod bsrungs sbyin pa bkab/ /rang gi zos skal skyu ru ra'i/ /phyed cha legs byas zhing du btab/ /blon po'i gros ltar dge 'dun la/ /sa gzhi phul zhing mi yi rje/ /lhar skyes tsha pos 'dzin ma'i gzhi/ /gser srang bye ba phrag bzhis bslus/ /thub dbang rgyal byed tshal bzhugs tshe/ /'khor gyi dge slong tshogasarnams la/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba las/ /brtsams pa'i chos kyi dbyangs snyan bsgrags/ /'gro rnams ma rig rtsa ba yis/ /sna tsho gos las kyi 'du byed mthus/ /kun gyi byed bo rnam shes 'grub/ /de las ming gzugs skye mched 'byung / /yul dang yul can tsho gis pa las/ /reg pa dang ni tshor ba'i mthus/ /bde la sred dang len 'dod pa'i/ /byed pos (96bsgong srid rnam par 'grub/ /las nyone dbang gis 'khor ba sa /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal myong / /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ khyu —11/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'bras tshul 'di ngo mtshar med/(7)/sangs rgyas mnyan yod gshegs pa'i lam//ma he lta bu'i sems can gyi//lus smad 'bus zar sngon gyi gnas//dran nas gsungs pas 'tshal zhes gsol//'khor gyas rgyu mtshan zhus pa na//sa bdag bi du rar gyur tshe//btsun mos sangs rgyas 'bring mchod par/khros nas rang rgyal lus smad bcad//slar yang gtum po'i skyed tshal du//rang sangs rgyas shig gsod 'gyur ba'i//rnam smin dpag tshad brgya pa yi//lus blangs dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur//de nasami yi lus thob tshe//rab byung btsun mo'i mchod gnas gyur//rgyal po phrag dog lus bcad pas//rnam smin rim gyis byang bar gsungs/(77)/drang srong ke na ya ka dag/gdul phyir thub dbang gshegs pa na//sangs rgyas thugs rjes rgyal chen bzhi//dam pa'i chos ni mnyan par lhags//yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po//sngon tshe klur skyes 'phags pa'i rigs//gzhan gnyis mkha' lding gdug pa can//de tshe khyung sa klu la 'tshe//klu yis sangs rgyas 'od srungs la//skyabs su song bas gnod ma nus/khyu des 'dab bzang gnyis kyang dad//sngon gyi byung ba legs par gsungs//kai na ya ka ngo mtshar te//chos nyan phyir mi 'ong du gyur//mtshungs par shes las 97na tha den pa mthong //drang srong mang po smin par mdzad//(78)brgya byin 'chi ba'i ltas byung nas//dge slong rnams la skyabs gsol bar//'ongs tshe de rnams brgya byin gyi//gzi brjid ma bzod phyag 'tshal bas//kye ma bdag gi gzi byin kyang //mi bzod tshur la 'dud byed na//'jigs las skyob pa ci 'tshal snyam//mya ngan gyis mnar rang gnas log/slar yang ston pa'i drung du 'ongs//me yi ting 'dzin la bzhugs pa//zur phud lnga pa'i rgyud mangs kyi//sgra yis ting nge 'dzin las bslangs//brgya byin rjes bzung bden pa mthong //drin lan bsang par bya ba'i phyir/tu5 ru yi bu mo ni//zur phud lnga pa'i chung mar byin//sngon tshe grong khyer mdzes ldan na//lha dbang mi bdag skal bzang du//gyur tshe log par dad sel gyi//gdung la bya ba byas 'bras mtshar//(79)bram ze'i 'tsho ba bde zhes pa//rgyas pa chung mas ma 'dod nas//thabs kyis nor ni slong bar

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho spang rdza go bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)btang //lam du chom rkun tsho gos kyis bcom//lceb par brtsams tshe rgyal ba yis//nor stsal chung ma'i gam du phyin//dga' bar ma gyur yid byung ste//ston pa'i drung 'ongs dgra bcom thob bcom ldan dbang chen sder 'khrungs tshe//slong ba'i bram ze'i rang gi lus//bcings nas 'gal zla'i dgra bo la//bstod ces bsgo ba'i sngon byung gsungs/(80)/sangs rgyas mya ga bzlar bzhed 97bsgos//dri za rab dga'i gnas su gshegs//sna tsho gos thabs kyis khengs pa bcom//thub dbang sku gzugasabastan nas ni/khyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bur bkod//rab bzang u dum wa ra'i tshal rang gi mas las byung snyam khengs//me rtag nyams la sdug bsngal che//lha yis rgyu mtshan bshad pa na//sangasargyas la dad spyan sngar lhags//chos bstan bden pa mthong bar gyur//rgyal ba mya ga 'dar bzhed tshe/khu stegs can gyis mi g.yo zhing //me yis mi 'jigs tshangs spyod pa'i//grogs kyis 'grub par smon lam bto/(81)/tsas don gnyer kṣe pa 'ga'//rgya mas bgrod pas gru rdzings zhig/ded dpon bsod nams sde zhes pas//rgyal bar gsol btab bde bar bgrod//sangs rgyas bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan par//sman pas tsandan phan zhes smras//gser srang 'bum phrag tsho gos kyis kyang //sgos cung zad rnyed ma gyur//de tshe tshong dpon bsod nams sdes//tsas lde gu phul ba yis//sangasargyas rgyu yi mchog de nyid//bsnyun las rnam par grol bar gyur//de'i mthus ded dpon khron pa nas//thos dpag med longs spyod gyur//ma 'ongs de bzhi gshegs pa mchog/tsandan dpal du 'tshang rgyar gsungs/(82)/khyim bdag srid pa'i go cha de//grong pa'i bud med dang mdzar gyur//98nasgo yi mas mo sgo bsrungs pa//ral gyis de yi mgo bo bcad//mdza' mo'i sar phyin rgyu ma' bsnyad//de yang ma rangs mi mdzar gyur//rang gi nang 'ongs i rkun gyis//ma bsad ces ni cho nge ba 'a//'gyod pa skyes nas rab tu byung /khung zad dmyal bar skyes na yang //myur du lha yi lus thob pas//rab byung mthu las byung bar shes//sangs rgyas mchod phyir lhags byas nas//bsnyen bkur bsod na mas tshogos bsags//dam pa'i chos ni thos pa yis//myur du bden pa mthong bar gyur//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()(83)rgyal po me tog lha zhesapar//bu ni nyi zla'i ming can byung //nyi masadaka' tso bsten byasashing //zla bsargyal srid bzung ba'i tshe//nyi masaril ba spyi blugasanas//ma blangasachu ni gsasabasa'agyod//gcung gi drung 'ongasachad lasakyis//sdig pa 'dag thabasagyisazhesasmras//zhag drug bar 'gyangs bkres pa'i 'bras//tshe 'dir lo drug mngal du gnas//ba glang rdzi mo'i bu mo yis/khresani lci ba ma la bskur//rgyang gragasadrug phyin rnam smin la//bu yi mngal khur lo drug myong //nyi zla bu mo rim baṣka du//sangasargyasasgra gcan 'dzin de yum/(84)/mkha' lasarin cen sbrang rtsi'i char//btsa' ba'i dusasu babasapa yis//sbrang rtsi'i dbyangasasu grags pa des//kun dga' bo mthong pha la dris//'phrogadon sangasargyasamarga 98bajosadang /khyim du spyan drangasabasnyen bskur bstabs//rab byung rgyal byed tshal spangasate/khren tu dben pa'i ri brag bsten//dur ga'i ya stagasa'atshol ba'i ched//chom rkun 'ongasapar gzhan dag srog/'tsho phyir rang gi lusabatang ba//bcingasanasasrog gcod gnas der khrid//ma he sre po'i ltag pa na/sha rusalpagasapa'i ya stagasasogs//mi bzad sdig pa'i lasamathong nas//snying rje skyesapasadagra bcom thob//rkun po'i mtshon cha me tog tu//gyur pas ngo mtshar rab tu byung //thams cad rnam 'dren spyan sngar lhags//bcom ldan 'das kyis dbugs dbyung mdzad/(85)/grong khyer shi pi'i dbyangasazhesapar//nad rimasabyung bsasman pa yis//skyesanasaji srid bar dag tu/khro med khrag gisaphan zhesagasol//de tshe rgyal po gzhan phan 'tshol//rang bde gtong ba'i snying stobasani//'khor gyis ldog par ma nus pas//dpral ba gtar nasakhrag gisabasos//namazhig rgyalapo lusarid cing //gachogasabyed bskamasapar gyur ba na//sman pasa'adab chagasashang shang gis/khrusabyas chu yis phan zhesasmras//blangasatshe gshogasabaskamasarang rgyal gyis/khu de slongasapa 'phang med byin//rang rgyalabro 'tshalabasosapa dang //smon lamabawa pasasabadag bsos//sngon tshebacom ldan nye dga' dang //rang rgyalade'i blon bramazer gyur//rdzasakyisapho bo'i gshogasabaskams99nakong //bsosapa gnyisaka'i 'brasabur gsungs/(86)/4

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang si po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar ga/ 6)ba men ri bong spre'u glang po bzhis//n+ya gro dha yi ljon shing la brten nas//rgan gzhen brtagasate ji bzhin bsnyen bkur ba'i//gos bur sa bdag mngon pa'i nga rgyal skyes//mngon shes can gyis rgyu mtshan tshangs byin la//gsungs pas rgyal po 'khor bcas bslab la bkod//ba men sangs rgyasari bong shā ri'i bu//spre'u mo gal glang ོ tso dga' bo/(87)khyim bdag padma tso zhes pas//nye sder rab byung bsod snyoms rgyu//smad 'tshong zla ba'i ri mo yis//'drid kyang yid ni g.yos ma gyur//'dod can ma des 'gugs byed mkhan//gtum mo zhes pas bos nas kyang //thabs byas padma can khugs tshe//'dod pa bsten nam mer sreg smras//zhugs la mang bar brtsams pa ni/man tu brtan pa'i bag yod la//ngo mtshar chos kyis nyer tshim pas//lus phra gnyis kas dgra bcom thob//padma can yang chags bral te//rgyal ba'i spyan sngar 'ongs pa na//sngon tshe 'di gsum khyo shug ste//'od srungs bstan la rab tu byung //dge slong ma yi tsho gos khang du//chung ma gnyis bos yis mo dang //smad 'tshong ma zhes gcig gis gcig/sun dbyung tshig rtsub gos bur gsungs/(88)/rgyal bo gzugasacan snying po yi//glang dzin ga po zhes bya ba//'khor bar yid phyung rab tu byung //nam zhig rang 99bka khyim du 'ongs//sngar gyi chung mas khyo song shul//bran gyis brnyas sogs nyone mongs pa'i//sna tsho gis gtam gyis brid byas pas//brtan ba ma thob bslab las nyams//de tshe sa yi bdag posakyang //sngar bzhi gnag rnams skyong bar bskos//sangs rgyas der byon 'od zer gyis/khyim rnamasagang ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan//glang rdzis bsnyen bkur rab byung bskyar//dgra bcom thob gyur tshe sngon yang //rang rgyal mchod cing mar rten brtsegs//de yi gos bu yin par gsungs/(5)/chu srin nya yi mig ces pa//'dren byed nyi ma bcu gnyis kyis//gzi 'bar gangs ri'i so 'phreng can//rgya mtshor kṣ-i pa rnams kyis mthong //skrag tshe rna ba 'dzin ces pas//thub dbang dran par gyis shig ces//bskul ltar sangs rgyas mtshan brjod mthus//chu srin kha de zum par gyur//rgyal byed tshal du tshong pa rnams//'jigs dang dad pa 'gran bzhin du//phyin te rgyal ba'i spyan sngar lhags//chos wā

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung la bum/ (9)dgra bcom go 'phang thob//ti mi shi nas ro rul bas//klu yis phyir bton ri tsam spungs//chu srin mir skyes rab tu byung //ming yang chos sred ces su grags//de ni sngon gyi bag chags kyis//ji tsam zos kyang tshim pa med//de tshe sbyin pa'i brtul zhugs kyis//dge 'dun mchod ston zas kun zos/khyim bdag 'jigs te sangs rgyas la//mi ma yin nam zhes zhus par//100na than par bka' stsal chos sred la//na kra'i rus phung bstan pas grol//slar yang mkha' la 'dab chags bzhin//thogs med rdzu hrūl mthu la ni//brten nas mnyan yod gnas su gshegs//sngon byung ma lus rgyasapar gsungs/(90)/thub dbang bri dzi'i yul bzhugs tshe//yangs pa can gyi bram ze rnams//rgyal bar bsnyen bkur ma zin par//gzhan gyis mi bya'i khrims su bcas/khyim bdag nor can rang khyim du//rnam 'dren slob mar yos rnams//spyan drangs bsnyen bkur bu dang ni//bu mo rnams kyisanyin bzhin bstabs//gzhan gyis mchode skabs ma rnyed bas//gnyis skyes khros nas gnas dbyung bar//brtsams tshe thub pas bzlums mdzad cing //bram ze rnams kyis sangs rgyas mchod//nor can padma can zhes par//skyes tshe bu dang chung ma yis//rang sangs rgyas la re mos kyis//ras gos dang ni me tog phul/khyu des phreng rgyud mkhan khyo shug/bu rnams nor can khyim bdag ma//rigs brgyud bcas par tshe 'phos pa'i//da lta'i phun sum tshogs pa gsungs/(91)/rgyal po shi pi zhes bya ba//gtong phod ldan pa'i skyes bu byung //lha dbang srin po'i gzugs sprul nas//'ongs te chos kyi gtam gleng nyan//'bod grogs ji ltar smras pa ltar//legs bshad chos kyi skyes su ni//rang gi sha nasabacad de phul//sems can 'dren pa'i 17bston lam btab//rgyal po khyod lus gnad pa la//sdug bsngal ldan nam srin pos bris//gzhan phan gyur na cung zad kyang //med ces bden par rang lus bsos//brgya byin rjes su yi rang nas//e ma ngo mtshar zhes su smras//rgyal po de ni bcom ldan 'das//yin par 'khor la bka' stsal to/(92)/khyim bdag mdza' bo zhes bya ba'i/khye'u phal /ra shi ba'i mthar//bu gcig btsas pa gso ba'i

sku gsung thug rten gas 4khog dang rin po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar ga / 6)phyir/ /ming la mdza' bo'i bu mor btags/ /yul gyi tshong zong las rnyed pa'i/ /ga rṣa pa ṇi bzhi'i ldab 'phar/ /nyin zhag mtsho yi grangs de snyed/ /rang gi ma la gus pas phul/ /ma yis rgya mtshor ma 'gro zhes/ /bkag par rdog bas bsnun nas phyin/ /chu srin gyis ni gru bshig kyang / /de nyid thabs kyisaskam sar thon/ /rim gyis grong khyer bzhin phyin pas/ /lha mo bzhi brgya bcu drug dang / /soganyisakyis mchode bde myong ba/ /ma la pa ṇi phul ba'i 'bras/ /de nas lcags kyi khang par slebs/ /mgo bor 'khor lo bskor mthong nas/ /dris pas ma la gnod gos zer/ /thos tshe yid la 'jigs pa skyes/ /da lta'i sdug bsngal myong bzhin pa'i/ /zug rngu gsar byung skyes bu la/ /'phos zhes mkha' la sgra bsgrags tshe/ /'khor lo 'khor nas sdug bsngal gyur/ /gzhan gyi dus dang len pa'i/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa skyes ma thag /tshe 'phos lha yi lus blangs te/ /phun tsho gis bde la longs spyod gyur/ (93)khyim bdag (101nasgo gon med zas sbyin gyi/ /bu mo ma ga dha bzang mo/ khyu mchog byin la ster ram zhes/ /gsol bar rgyal bas snang ba stsal/ khyu mchog byin des brtag pa'i slad/ /slong mo'i chas su bsgyur nas 'ongs/ /bzang mo bu ram shing 'phel du/ /nyer song bag ma'i dga' ston bsgrubs/ /de na mchod gnas mu stegs pa'i/ /gcer bu ral pa can mthong bar/ /kye ma 'di 'dra'i spang bya la/ /skyabs gnas 'chol zhing bsting tshig dang / /bde bar gshegs pa bsngags brjod pas/ /sgyug mosasangs rgyas spyan drongs smras/ /bzang mos bkod mdzes mchode pa bshams/ khang thog phyin nas gso le btab pas/ /rgyal bas mkhyen nas kun dga' bor/ /bu ram shing 'phel grong khyer du/ /rdzu phrul stobs kyis nyer 'gro bas/ /tshul shing 'grems zhes bka' stsald to/ /nang par shing rta ri seng glang //gser pad mkha' lding 'od zer 'gyed/ /gser shing beeḍūr khang pa la'ang / /ngang pa nags la brten chibs rnams/ /ko ḍi 'od srungs mchogo zung gnyis/ /ma 'gags gang po rta thul dang / /nye 'khor kā tyā na nyi la/ /bi ling rna ba bye bar grags/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal sgra gcan 'dzin/ /tshangs sogs lhas bskor bcom ldan 'das/ /yin zhes bzang mos kun la bsnyad/ /thogs pa med par mi kha' la —/17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gshegs//phun tsho gis ngo mtshar gzi brjid kyis//mu stegasang na pa'i 101bcubs pa bcom/ma ga dha sogs phyogs de yi//bsod nams dbyar gyi mtsho ltar spel/(94)/mche ba dag las chu babs pas//zas la sred pa spong byed mkhan//grags pa'i bshes gnyen zhes bya ba//sangs rgyasamajal zhing dgra bcom thob//tshe sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs dus//dge 'dun rnams la chu brimasapa'i//bya ba byas pa'i gos bu mā/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to/(95)/ded dpon don sbyin zhes bya ba'i//chung mar bu ni mtshe ma skyes//pha 'das nor rnams zad pa na//bu gnyis cho me rkun byed par gyur//ma skyes dgra yis thos nas ni//gshed ma bskos te gsod par brtsams//bcom ldan rgyal bas rdzu phrul gyis//thogs med byon nas srog bskyabs mdzad//sngon tshe stag tu gyur pa'i tshe//ma yis bu gnyis zar brtsams pa//sangs rgya snying rje'i rdul zhes par//stings tshe rang lus byin nas bskyabs/(96)/sa bdag 'char byed btsun mo yis//drang srong lnga brgyar me tog phul//rgyal po khros nas drang srong rnams//rkang lag thams cad dum bur bcad//de tshe bcom ldan thugs rje'i mthus//bdud rtsi lta bu'i char phab ste//yan lag rnams ni legs 'byar zhing //phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob//sngon tshe drang srong lnga brgya pa//tshangs byin mdun na 'don gyur tshe//rgyal pos blon po lnga brgya bskrad//de rnams sdug bsngal gyur pa na//sangs rgyas02na'i nga chen la 'khrungs pas//sna zhags kyis ni chu blangs byin//g.yang sar mcho mes nas rang gi shas//bkresapas gdung sel gtam de mtshar/(97)/thub dbang rgyal po'i khab bzhugs tshe//lhas byin lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas//'ongs nas ston par mtshon char phab//mtshon rnams me tog char par gyur//drang srong tsho gos rnams ngo mtshar te//thub dbang la gas dgra bcom thob//de rnams tsho me par skyesapa'i tshe/gru zhig rus sbal gyis ni bton//de nyid gsod 'dod rdo 'phangs par//ma gnod 'on kyang rang lus byin//tshong pa de dag bkres pa las//thar byed rus sbal sangs rgyas so//mu ges bkresapa'i rgyad mang po//bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes bzuX nas//dgra bcom thob cing gzhan dag gis//

sku gsung thug rten gsar spu gos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)'phya ba spangs phyir mkha' la 'phur/ /sngon tshe sangs rgyas dka' thub can/ /dge ba'i ngang tshul zhes bya bar/ gyur tshe 'di rnams rjes bzung nas/ /mngon shes lnga dang ldan par gsungs/ /sangs rgyasathugs rje'i bdud rtsi yis/ /nad pa mang po bso bar mdzad/ /sngon tshe wa ra ṇa si sa /'gro rnams steng gdon zug rngus mnar/ /de la thabs gzhan gyis rdugs par/ /sman pas ro hi ta yi sha /byung na nad la phan no zhes/ /gleng yang rnyed par ma gyur tshe/ /thub dbang rgyal po padma can/ /zhes byar (102ba)gcings des snying stobs kyis/ khang pa'i yang thog nas mchongs te/ /nya der skye ba'i smon lam btab//bā ra zhes bya'i chu klung du/ /ro hi ta ru grags pa'i nyar/ /skyes nas sha yis nad pa kun/ /bsos nasabade ba che la bkod/ /dus der tshor ba drag bo yis/ /mnar ba'i gdung ba mi bzad can/ /da lta'i dge slong khyed rnams zhes/ /rgyal bas 'khor la bka' stsal to/(100)/sangs rgyas sa bdag rab gsal du/ gyur tshe glang po zhon nas phyin/ /'dod ldan glang po ma rungs pas/ /glang mo'i ched du phyogs kun brgyugs/ /'dod dang bral ba rnam 'dren zhes/ /thos pas byang chub sems mchog bskyed//de yang tshe sngon dzomakhan gyis/ /rgyal ba mchod pa'i 'bras bur gsungs/(101)/zas gtsang mya ga 'das pa la/ /thub bas mchode rten bzhengs par mdzad/ /bram ze sngo bsangs zhes bya bar/ /thub dbang gyur tshe pha ma mchod/ /gnyis skyes ri dwags pags pa'i shos/ /gyon nas chu klung 'gram 'ongasatshe/ /tshangs byin rngon par rgyu dang phrad/ /'phrul nas mda' 'phangs drang srong mes/ /mi gsum cig car bsad zer bas/ /rgyal po 'grod nas bzod par gsol/ /bum chu bskur ba pha mar gtad/ /pha mas gtam thos mya ga non/ /brgyal sangs bu yi drung du phyin/ /bden tshig brjod pa'i byed po yis//lha yi bdud rtsis me bsos nas/ /sngo bsangs can de nad (103na sgos grol/(102)/tshong pa 'bum phrag dug sbrul gyis/ /bskor tshe seng shes glang po la/ /nyon nas sbrul bsad dug rlangs kyis/ /glang seng gnyis kyang shi bar gyur/ /tshong pas gnyis 'thung seng ge'i gdung / /me la bsregs nas mchode rten brtsigs/ /seng glang sangs rgyas shā ri'i bu/ /dug sbrul lhas byin yin par gsungs/ (103)khyim —1196

rgyal dbang lnga pa ༅ dbang blo sang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)bdag rdo rje gas po yis//sa bdag lhun bo wo bcom nas//bu mo chung mar bdag tu bzung //bu btsas dga' ba'i gong bur grags//de tshe ma rungs blo ldan la//blon po ga pa'i yig rdzus kyis//dbyen bcos sa bdag lhun po yis//pho nya dang bcas springs yig mngags//dga' ba'i gong busabazlums pa'i slad//gaṅgā'i gru la zhugs nas phyin//mi rje lhun pos bsu bar 'ongs//phan tshun shin tu mdza' bar gyur/(14)khyim bdag 4 ba zhes bya ba//rab tu byung yang srid la zhen//sangasargyas mthu yis nyone mongs dag/zhi bar mdzad nas bslab la bkod//sngon tshe khyim bdag thub pa'i ming //rnam 'dren ri bong gsal smrar zhakhrungs//char med sngo gos bskams pa na//drang srong grong du 'gro bar chas/khyod nyid bkres na bdag zo zhes//gsal bar smra bas zhugs nang mchongs//dka' thub can gyis me las bton//ri bong gis ni bden pa bdar//char babs lo ma 'bras bu 'phel//thub bas de yi snying stobs dris//sangs rgyas103brkon du gnyer brjod pas//rjes su gzung zhes gsol ba btab/(05)/dge sbyong brtul zhugs gtsang ba zhig/chos gos tshoge kyis bsgyur ba'i tshe//bram zes be'u'i ror mthong nas//rgyal por gto de bzhi rar ga'i/༅ gnyis lo song nam mkha' nas//sgra byung rkyen gyis btson nas ba 'a//dge slong shin tu rid pa la//rgyal po 'gyod pa skyes par gyur//dge slong 'di yi skye ba sngon/sha brkus rang rgyal mdun du bor//gang de wo sa bcu gnyis bar//btson du a pa'i rnam smin no/(106)/grong khyer gser can zhes bya bar//sa bdag gser zhes bya ba'i sras//rgyal bu gser gyi go cha dang //sring mo gser 'od ces bya byung //rim gyis lang tsho dar ba na//blon tsho bu dang gser 'od gnyis//mthun pa yab kyis ma bzod nas/khrag dang 'bral ba'i sbyor ba brtsams//rgyal busathabs kyis gzhan du brdzangs//des rkyen sras kyang gnas nas dbyung //'khyams tshe grong khyer stongasapa'i dbus//4 gi sring modag dang phrad/khyu maX thos nas rgyal sras kyis//mda' bsnun gnod

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang si po tsho ma rdzo rdza kha bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)sbyin phal cher bsad/khring mo khyo shug gnyis po yis//rang gi ming po dpon du bsko//de tshe yab kyisapho nya mngags//gser gyi go ma rgyal sar bton//'khor rte ba'i rgyal po sa gyur pa de bzhi gshegs wo yin/(107)/sngon tshe khyim bdag zlas gtsang zhes//'byor ldan dbul po'i re skong can//bcu gnyis lo'i bar rgya mtshor 14na tha grod//nor bu rin rṣa dpag med lon//mu tig do shal phyag rten du/khyer nas spyod mjal bar phyin//de tshe rgyal po'i khang bzang steng //bu mo legasabashad glud byangs 'tsher//legs bshad gto gyis yid phrogs te//bas gnyis lor bsgrubs nor rnams kun//dam pa'i chos kyi skyes ga du//'phangs med byin pa ngo mtshar gnas//de yang slob pa lam gyi dus/khyim bdag zas gtsang zhes bgyi bar//nyi ma'i ga tshe gyur shā ri'i bu//sgos zhi rgyal po'i sras mor zhakhyungs/(08)/grong khyer gser zhes bya ba na//rgyal po sprin gyi tog grags par//gser gyi ljon par longs spyod byung //bu ni sprin gyi zhen pa skyes//yab kyis rgyal srid gtad nasakyang //dben pa'i gnas su bde bar rgyu/srus kyis yab dran drung du phyin//rim gyis nags mthar bgrod pa na//lha mo go ri'i gzugs kyis mdun//mchod pa byed pa'i mdzes ma ni//ma la ya can zhes bya mthong //phan tso yid ni chags par gyur//mngon 'dod rtse dga'i ro myong can//bag phebs gtam gyi sbyor ba'i skabs//pho nya zhig gis yab kyi drung /khog ces mdza' na mo de khrid//zla bzhin la 'khu'i smin legs de'i//yid kyi shing rta gzhen nu'i sar/khyugs tshe 'khor la nyer lta ba'i//zol gyis mig zur phyogs der g.yo//de dus sprin zhen lha mo la//chags pa'i kun rtog cher g.yosapas//nyen mongs me yis14bsko dungs pa'i yid//rnam 'gyur phyi rol lus la shar//gnyen bzang zhes bya'i grogs po zhig/der 'ongs phan tho gtam 'dres tshe//sngar gyi rgyu mas zhib bshad mthar//sprin zhen slar yang shugs ring phyung //grogs kyi gtam las yab rgyal pos//ma la ya can lha khyod kyi//khab tu bsu ba'i sta gon la//brel zhes thos pas yid kyi bsos//phra rgyas dbang gisanyin gcig a//lo zla'i yun ltar ring semasang nga //bag ma'i dus ston dga' ba ni//bsam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (9)gtan gsum pa'i drang sgong bzhin//sras kyi nags tshal mthar phyin bas//nam mkha' lding gi za resal//bab pa'i gdengs can gzhen nu yi//ma zhig sdug bsngal gyur pa mthong //the tshom med par klu yi tshab//bdag gi bya zhes rdo leb steng //gnas tshe khyung gi gtsug rgyan nor/sha dang bcas pa bcad nasa'aphang //yab yum gnyis kyi mdun lhung pa//mya ga gyis brgyalasangs pa'i mthar//myur phyin cung zad gtam gleng tshe//rgyal bu 'jig rten pha rol song //gdung de me thab nang ba byug tshe//'khor sgyur bas mo'i lung bstan la//ma la ya can yi chad de//me tog sreg khang nang du dor/khyu des lha mo go ri mas//'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis//rgyal sras sprin zhen lus bran pas//bsos te kun dga'i 'dzum zhal ngom//mkha' lding bdud rtsis rus phung bsos//brgya byin ngo mtshar me tog 'thor//rgyal bus 'khor ༷ rgyal thob//bde zhing skyid 1tson༄'i dpal la spyod//rtogasabarjod rgya mtsho snying po bdud rtsi'i bas//tshig co don tsha bum par legs gas 'di//ri bo sgril ba'i rtsol bar ltos min pa//dbyangs can rgyud mangs mgrin bar 'brol las so//

dga' ldan pho brang gi gzims chung rab gsal gyi ldebs bris la jo bo ོ po'i lam yig bris pa'i rten gtso'i mtshan byang phan bde'i srog 'tsho sogs/la ma tsā dzñā na dzinaḥ bar bidma piñtsa sthā tsakyu kho nā ṭa kya tsamā ā/ rdzu brgyu spo grwa ṇi hi mā ba snro su zhi yadzñā tsā rasgyuskṛ tu dzi de bee ka gro sdu pa//dpal ldan rgyal kun ye ༷ ma'i 'phrul//sdom brtson gnas lnga rig pa'i zlos gar can//mkhyen spyod bdud rtsis gangs can phan bde'i srog/'tsho mdzad lha gcig di paṃ ka ra rgyal//05bam snyi kyaganta ma ra tri tanā a nu byañdza sdi ni mi stonas pa tta a nutta ra sma kya su ku lha su ta rā tam ha:dzā lha ādikhyab rgyu sum na:ril kyabargya/ /bla med sku gsum dngar ba'i dri bsung can/ /mtshan dpe'i 'dab ma bzhed pa ma snyi ga sku kya'i rigs kyi thig le cher zhakhrungs pa//nyi ma'i gnyen gyi me rta go thod du 'ching //log spyod 'khyog po srong pa'i btsan po'i khrims//mkhyen yangs sgam pa'i thugs kyis legs gnon pa//lag na pad dkar bod yul rgyal po yi//sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar can der 'dud//srid zhi'i mtha' sgrol ma lus rnam 'dren yum//log 'dren gawo por khro gnyer bzhin ras can//rgya bal sras mor legs sprul lus phra ma//kong jo khri btsun mtshan snyan rna ba'i bsos//yab yum so sor shar ba'i nyal 'gro'i 06na ) tshogs//chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i klong du ro gcig pa//gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i chas kyi phreng //'phags 'a mdzad bzang mi zad ston pa bzhi//rnam tshon srasadang slob mar bcas pa'i sku//bskrun pa skal bar bsod nams tshong zong gis//'jal ba'i 'brasazhes mdo rgyud du ma las//bsngags nas blo dang ldan rnams cis mi 'jug/de phyir gangs can lte ba 'phrul snang la//sri zhu'i byed po spus srang gser khang pa//gso rig smra ba blo bzang nor bu yis//

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)rab bsgrubs chos rgyal btsun mo'i sku brnyan 'di/ /'phags yul bal bod rgya nag la sogs pa'i/ /gnas chen mang po'i sa rdo shing lo dang / /sna tshogs rin cen 'bru gos dar zab sman/ /legs brdar gong bur byas pa'i sku rgyu la/ /dbang sngon bad rag shel rgyan 'ja' 'dra'i tshon/ /btso sbyangasagaser gyi shog bu stong bam bcas/ /nor dar skal ldan la sogs bzo rig pa/ /sor rtser mig 'phrul ston pa'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /'jam rdor mi bskyod gshed dmar dgra gdong 'jigs/ /bde dgyesadus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje dbyings/ /rnam snang mngon byang gzungs chen sde lnga sogs/ /mdo sngags lasabyung chos sku'i ring bsrel dang / /bu ram shing pa'i sha rī ram gyi gdung / /bad 'byung sgong btsan na bza'i cha shas dang / /jo shāka zhal gser rang byon lnga ldan gyi/ /pañtsa li ga'i ras ma la sogs pa/ /(106bsgo dor na gsang sngags rnying ma bka' gdams dang / /dwags shangs zhi spyod sa zhal dge lugs bcas/ /gangs khrod ris med grub mtha'i skyes chen gyi/ /sku bal ring bsrel dkar dmar ngur smig gos/ /cho ge sman bdud rtsi ril bu las sbyor lngar/ /grags sogs rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ltar bsgrubs dang / /ril nag 'ja' tshugs skye bdun ming btags pa/ /bsgrubs min dam rdzas tshogisapa'i ril bus gtams/ /'dzad mi shes pa'i 'dod rgu'i char chen pos/ /yon gyi bdag po rmugasa'adzin 'byor pa yi/ /sbun zlar byed po gnod sbyin 'khor lo bcas/ /gzungs 'bum rab 'byamasa'ajam dbyangs grags pas so/ /sgo gsum rab 'bad sa bon legs smin 'bras/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'bar ljon pa'i shing / /mngon mtho nges legs phang phung lo 'dab kyi/ /grib mar phan bde'i ngal gsor longasaspyod shog /'di ltar gyis zhes bskul tshig zla zer gyis/ kho bo'i sgra 'dzin utpal 'dab ma'i kha/ /yang yang phye tshe rab dkar shog bu'i ngos/ /sor mo'i zlor gar ja yun gcig la bsgyur/ /tshig 'phreng gaṅgā mgrin pa'i lam gsum nas/ /skyug mkhas sngon med drang srong dzaḥ/ /za hor rigs las bya btang rnam g.yeng can/ /snyan dngags mkhan po tshangs sras ba 'ad pa yin/ /dwag po lcang ra bas skyong mgon po tshe —124

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ 6)༷// /rdo// sa mkhyen 107na〉 bsod nam rgya mtsho rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho shing rta par du brkos pa'i par byang sa spru dwa la rdzi bi dza snye//e ma ngo mtshar bye ba'i gtam gyi rgyud//dbyangs can lang tshosabaskul ba snyan pa'i sgra//rna ba bdud rtsi'i dpal la longs spyod glu//ma smad spobs pa dge ba'i mgrin par blangs//phyag na pad dkar 'dzin mdzad sgyu 'phrul gar//bshes gnyen dam pa'i gzug su legs bsgyur ba//lus can bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog de'i//rtogs brjod 'di ko sngon med yid bzhin nor//gang de'i chos sbyin mi zad gter gyi mdzod//gtong ba'i sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i snying stobs khur//rnam dpyod phrag par len pa'i lcang ra ba//sa skyong mgon po tshe brtan zhes su grags//sor mo'i 'du byed g.yo ba'i sgyu ma yis//mig dkyus rgya mtsho'i mthar yang khrid byed rta//snang brnyan mang por 'byam klas yi ge'i gzugs//par rkos blo gros bzang po'i mchog gyur pa//dar rgyas ming gi pha mthar yongs bsten pas//tsa ri skyon 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi ming //bsod nams ming zur don du ldan ba yi//kun thub rdo rje rgya mtsho bsam pa grub//dpal 'byor grub pa'i lha mo srid lasathar//rgya mon yul mthar grags ldan nor bu'i ming //'jam dpal dbyangs dngos rdo rje rnon po'i mtshon//rab 'dzin thon mi'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis bgyis//chu tshod srad bur 107bsgo rgyus pa'i nyin zhag 'phreng //bcu phrag sgoms su 'dzin pa nor bu'i rgyan//mchod sbyin za ma tog gi kha 'byed pa//blo bzang chos kyi dge ba'i dpal 'dzin ma//tshul 'dir legs 'bad dge tsho gos srad bu rnams//smon lam thags su btags pa'i za 'og can//tshe dpal stobs 'byor ri mo rnam bkrab//'di snang gos bzang 'dzad med longs spyod shog/legs byas rin cen them skas la 'dzegs nas//mngon par mtho dang nges par legs pa'i sgo//rab phye sku gsum rin cen khang bzang du//'jug pa'i skal pa bzang por bdag gyur cig/chu sprul wom dbyangs gong mas gnang ༅ tham kha'i wa cog me sbrel bsgos pa'i tham phud legs bya gnam gyi she mong / 2

rgyal dbang lnga gang ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)srid gsum dbang du sdud pa'i mthu stobs can/khams gsum kun la mnga' sgyur dmag zor lha//dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig ma//gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso mo'i drung //'jam dbyangs gong ma hong da'i lung las kyis//gnam 'og skye 'gro kun gyi cod pan du//rtags kyi lang tsho rnam bkra'i tham ka yi//bu yig bskrun pa'i mchod sprin rab phul bas//legs byas gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yis//srid zhi'i brtan g.yo kun la dbang sgyur ba//las bzhi'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho chen po'i rlabs//'phreng ba dus las yol med 'grub gyur cig 108na〉khi tho sirnyi ra stu/me sbrel lo spyi gnyer bla ma bstan pa yar 'phel/ngag dbang smon lam/gzhong kha ga gsum gyi do dam byas na chos sde rsā po dpal ldan lā sbung kyi tshogs khro gsar blug gi kha byang rin cen 'dus pa'i za ma rtag/e ma 'chi ba med pa bdud rtsi'i bcud//'thungs pas tshe ring don dang ldan pa'i ja//'byor pa'i dpal dang lhan cig 'khyil ba'i snod//phun tsho gis rin cen 'dus pa'i za ma rtag/dzā ti'i me tog 'dzum pa'i yul gru nas//za 'og thags su bskrun pa'i ljongs tshun gyi//longs spyod chad pa med pa chu bo'i rgyun//'bab pa'i yol gor 'jig rten mes pos sprul//rmad byung bsod nams gshin pa'i zhing sal//phun tshogs mchod sbyin sa bon btab pa'i 'bras//don gnyis myu gu g.yur du legs za ba//skal bzang yongs kyi bsod nams dbyid du smin//rin cen zhun ma'i khams las grub pa'i snod//srid pa'i 'byor ba dbang du bsdu ba'i mdzod//bsod nams yol med rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i mtsho//gtan bde'i yid bzhin nor bu'i 'byung khungs can/khrugs 'dzin bang mdzod phye ba'i gter gyi sgo//'dzam gling skye rgyasadrangs pa'i bsam 'phel nor//'dod pa'i re ba skong ba dbang gi rgyal//rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa ro brgya'i bcud//thos bsam zung du 'brel ba'i gshog rlabs can//legs dag dub 10yasil 'brol ba ngang pa'i sde'i//longs su spyod pa 'o mtsho'i zil dngar can//bkra shis mgrin pa'i dbyangs dang lhan cig 'khyil/me sprel lo dung gzhog la rgyu song kha gsal thebs pa bsto ༷di dpon blo bzang mthu stobs dang /dbu mdzad blo bzang yon

sku gsung sa rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ khom)to gnyis kyi ku tig/gser sogs kyi 'don cha'i rkang byas//de 'phro snyi so ba 'a phe do dam gnyer pa blo nga ༷ sbyin pasabya na phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i dung gshog gsar bzos kyi kha byang ba po shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i tshangs dbyangs/sarba dwa me ga la sirnyi ra stu/mchog gsum mchod pa'i dbyangs snyan tshangs pa'i sgra//bkra shisagayas su 'khyil ba chos kyi dung //phun tsho gos rin cen gzhog pa nor bu'i 'phras//bkod legasamadzes pa'i ri mo rnam par bkra/tshul 'di bsgrub la sgo gsum rab 'bad pa'i//dge ba'i sa bon las 'khrungs yongs 'du'i ljon//'di phyi kun tu phan dang bde ba la//spyod pa'i dbang gi rgyal po 'grub gyur cig/me sprel sto zla gtsog phe 7lo lnga'i zla spu wor bdang mkho du dus mesang na ril por sgringapa'i yi ge dpal ldan 'bras nga kyi sa dga' ra ba'i sgo ༅ mdzes byed mag sum 3 mas gzhal bya/na ma shrī ma tpā la tsa kro3 ༷ / nātha ka rla pā dwa ya/stong gzugs phyag rgya rṣa po'i rgyu ma mkhan//dus 'khor srol 'byed chos rgyal rigs ldan tshogs//dus zhabs rwa 'gro shong dbang bu ston sogs//phyogs 'di'i shing rta che gyur mkhas rnams dang /khyad par dang 109na cu'i sangs rgyasabatsong kha pa'i//dri med bstan la lugs 'di 'khrul med du//ston mdzad don gyi paṇa wo nor bu bzang //thams cad cho nges khyod ni gto gyi skyabs//phra khi rnam dpyod nyi zer gyis phye ba//rtsis gzhung 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i grwa phug ba//legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston sbyin mdzad pa'i//yongs 'dzin mkhas ba'i tsho gos rnams rgyal gyur cig/'phags yul skad sgyur gdong ga zhes 'bod kyang //rgya rtsis me bya gsar tshes lo'i thog ma//sa hor mchod yon zla ba bstogacig par//yongs grags dus 'khor lugs kyi dkar ba'i cha//g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dmar phyogs kyi//dbyangs kyi rgyal po o yig 'char ba'i tshes//dus sbyor 'khrig pa ka rka ṭa yi 'tshams//zla ba dbang phyogs sa 'dzin rtse mo la//'dzeg par phyogs tshe lha min dbang po yi//mjug mas byang shar phyogs nas thog mar sgrib//rnam par dag pa grub mtha'i gzhung lugs la//snga stogs rtse mig grangs yin ril por 'dzin//de bzhin phyi nang thun mong byed rtsis la//dkyil 'bor rdzogs par sgrib

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)pa mkhas pa'i lugs/ /lho nub phyogs gtong lcags bsregs mdog 'dra 'byung / /nyi zla gzas bzung mi dge'i 'bras kho nar/ /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud sogs rgyal gsung 'gar/ /gsungs pas slu med dka' las ci phyir 'gong / /(109bcun kyang drang srong gar ga la sogs kyis/ /sa chu'i skar ma bzang bar bshad pas na/ /grub pa'i mtha' bzhin chu khams lag gi 'bras/ /lo legs nad med sems can bde bar bshad/ /de lta na'ang res gza' gtso ba'i phyir/ /than pas rtsi shing skem shing mu ge yis//yul 'khor la gnod mi rje'i tshogs la 'tshe/ /tsha ba'i nad sogs 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ /zlog byed gangs can 'gyur ro cog gi bka'/ /sgrogs shing gnas chen rnams la sri zhur byed/ /dge 'dun bsnyen bkur ngan long sbyin pa gtong / /mdos zor dkar nag lto sogs rim gror 'bad/ /dusakyi sbyor ba 'khrig pa'i chu tshod gcig /gan ṭa drug seng ge'i longs spyod lnga'i/ /'bras bu ri brag pa dang rtsis mkhan gyi/ /chung ma nyams shing skya 'pham 'byung bar bshad/ /dus der dge ba gang byas 'bum 'gyur bdun/ /yin zhes 'jam dpal rgyud las legs par gsungs/ /dus gzhan dge las 'gyur khyad che ba sa /legs grub rgyud du ches cher bsngags pa mdzad/ /gsung rab phal cher mthun par zla ba la/ /dge ba khri ru 'phel ba'i 'gyur khyad gsungs/ /lugs 'dir ro rkyang rlung gnyis sgru ti'i nang / /chud pa'i phyi nang sbyar gos phan yon thob/ /de phyir skyed rdzogs gnas lugasabadag 'jug len/ /sbyin sogs rgyal sras rlabs chen spyod pa dang / /gzhan yang dbang por 'tsham pa'i rnam dkar gyi/ /dge tshogs gos bu 'byin la 'bad par rigs/ /(110na)dus 'dir nag po'i las lam mi dge bcur/ /spyad tshe dge ba ji bzhin 'phel 'gyur bas/ /rtag tu bag dang ldan dka'i tshogs rnams kyang / /ja yun gnyis par shes bzhin bya ra mdzod/ /dang po'i zhag la kha char babasagyur na/ /sa skyong tshogs rgyas gnyis gsum 'bru 'bras 'phel/ /bzhi la 'thab rtsod lnga par mu ge 'byung / /drug par mchog dman kun la dge ba ste/ /zhag bdun tshun la gtan nas ma babs tshe/ /nad mug dgra rtsod skya 'pham 'ong bar bshad/ /bde sdug legs nyes ston pa'i snang brnyan 'di/ /—128

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)rab dkar shog bu'i me long ngos su shar/ /kun rdzob tha snyad 'phrul snang bzang ngan rnams/ /don dam stong pa'i nga du gar ma mthong / /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur shar ba kun/ /chu nang zla bzhi rdzun pa'i rang mtshang rig /gnas lnga rig pa kun la legs sbyangs pa'i/ /dpyod ldan mkhas pa nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin/ /blun po dam par sgro btags bstan 'dzin ming / khun sprul mtshan mo'i zhags pas sa 'di khengs/ /zas kyis sto ba gang dang ma khengs pa'i/ /tshod tsam mi shes sgregs dris nang 'geng bzhin/ /lung bstan 'ja' la sbar 'dzin mkhan rnams kyis/ /rang mtshang bshang gci'i dri la sna ba spos/ /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor sgra gcan gyis 'dzin sogs/ /bzang ga bde sdug mngon sum ston nus pa/ /gtsug lag gsang rtsis ma rga shes rta bdun pas/ /zog rdzun mkhan gyi 'byung po'i bya tsho gos long / /shes bya mang por sbyangs pa'i rgan yus kyi/ /snyems pa med kyang blo gros mig bu yis/ /legs bshad mthong ba'i snyom las rtsis rig bas/ /mchog dman dge la bskul ba'i phyir du sbyar/ /phyag mdzod sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyi tham ka gsar du brkos pa'i tham phud 'phags pa lo ke shwa rar phul ba'i kha yig legs tshogs lhun grub sogs/phul byung rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i gter/ /gcig bsdus 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug drung / /rnam bkra tham ga'i ri mo 'di phul bas/ /srid zhi'i legs tshogos ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ su sti pra dzā ༷ ཿ chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i ri bo mar /ye shes rdo rje rnon tsho rtse mo yis/ /dug lnga'i rtog tsho gis ma lus 'bigs byed pa/ /'jam dbyangs dgyes dgur spyod pa'i zhing mchog tu/ /nyon mongs dgra tsho gos mtha' dag rab bcom nas/ /thar pa'i khang bzang che la gnasabacas pa/ /rig grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun lnga brgya yi/ /snang brnyan bkra ba'i lha khang sri zhu 'di/ /—129

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)ngos kyis gong ma chen po'i mdun son tshe/ /mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar rab 'byams na las kyis/ /dka' ba'i khur che blangs nas gegs med du/ /'grub 'dir lusang ga yid kyi ngal bsten dang / /zang zing dngos pos phan pa bsgrubs pa kun/ /ngo mtshar med byung bkod pa'i zhing mchog tu/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis zab cing rgya che'i chos/ /nyer bstan bla med byang tso thob gyur cig /gong ma hong de lo bcu pa sgrul gyi lo la lha khang gso ba'i mthun (111na)rkyen dang phan grogs byed dgos pa'i lam yig byas/ /zung chu rab 'byams pa 'phrin las kyis 'bad pa chen po'i sgo nas lo gsum la 'grub ste rdo ring ngos la rko rgyu'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/me bya sag zla ba'i nang du phral dgos kyi mdo sngag tha snyad rig pa'i glegs bam sum brgya skor gyi dkar chag bsgrigs pa'i mchod brjod tshom dpal rdo rje'i rno ma'/pā kho pradzñā11khaṅgā&rta dzā la snodaḥkṛ/ khrem ljo hā tā kā bā sgyu te3(srin lci nywa mju/ /phyag na shes rab ral gri rnon po yis/ /rmongs pa'i drwa ba thams cad gcod mdzad pa/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo de dang gnyis med yul/ /tshangs sras ma kye snying gi dbus na bzhugs/ /(111ba tā nga gcod rjes 'dzin nang don rig pa'i gnad/ /ston byed rgyal gsung dgongs 'grel gsung rab dang / /phyi rol grub mtha' smra mkhas gzhung lugs sogs/ /ngo mtshar glegs bam grangs su nyer bstar na/ /thos chud khron pa'i chu yis snyems ldan rnams/ /ris med gtsug lag legs bshad rgya mtsho che/ /mthong tshe rang gzhung phra mo'i nyal 'gro yis/ /cha tsam bskrun pa'i nus bral snying 'gas snyam/ /mi shes mong rtul 'jigs chen bam ro dang / /rig lam bye ba'i sems ldan phan tshun sna/ /thos bsam dbugs kyi rgyu ba yun ring por/ /'gro 'ongs bsten tshe mkhas pa'i grong du 'jug /de phyir 'chad rtsod rtsom la spobs pa'i mgrin//mthon por bteg nas snyan 'gyur rgyud mangs glus/ /dpyod ldan snying gi brtan pa 'phrog nus pa/ /pusta ka 'phreng gces pa'i yid bzhin nor/ /blun po 'dren par rlom pa'i gcan gzan mdun/ /mdo dang rgyud sde tha snyad rig pa yi/ /glegs bu'i rto ljang gzhen nu cher spungs kyang / /longs su mi spyod rang —130

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ 'dagi ngang tshul yin//rtag tu dge ba chos kyi so ga'i dus//'bod pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos yid 'ong bya//dpyid kyi rgyal mo mgrin dbyangs 'khrol pa'i tshe//yid kyi lhag phran dga' ba'i lo 'dab g.yo//khyad par ngag lang ga dbang lhag pa'i lha//zhugs pa'i smra ba kun gyi dbang phyug che//'jigs med phyogasalas rnam rgyal skad gnyis pa'i//mi mdzad gter gyi bang mdzod 'di na'o//112na spyo sbyor sna gi lha mo/sa gi57ho ni rā stog bu ddha pā ṅgānā ga myu:ta ni:wabo dha/ tham〉sdi tsā mukta sogs yatsāpru su da lha megalustsokhi rya/ra byung don gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas gtso//lung dang rtogs pa'i ga kho gyur dam pa'i chos//rig dang grol ba'i dpal ldan dge 'dun bcas//mchog gsum thugs rjes phun tshogs bkrashis stsol//'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rig sngags 'chang //slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma khrung //'jam mgon mi yi srid bzung zlos gar can//rgyal ba kun dngos blo bzang grags pa'i dpal//phyag na pad dkar legs 'dzin sgyu ma'i 'phrul//bsod nams rgya mtsho'i mtshan gyi gragasa'abar sogs//dngos dang brgyud pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi//snang bas yid bzhi nor bu'i za ma tog/rnam par rgyal ba rig sngags yong ba'i sde//12ba ) phan bde'i 'byung gnas rdo rje'i theg pa yi//smin grol 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i legs bshad dung //ri mo g.yas 'khyil khrims ldan 'dusapa'i gling //gang gi sngon 'gro bsod nams tsho gos gsog pa'i//zab lam dmigs rten rab bzhengs mthun rkyen dang //legs byas gan mdzod byin mas yid bzhi nor//'phyur bur yongs spungasadeb gter mdo tsam brjod//mchog thun dngos grub bsgrub pa'i yan lag tu//bskyed rim mtshan ma'i gsal snang 'don pa la//rtsa gsum gzugs sku'i snang brnyan rab bkra ba'i//byed po brisa'abur bzhengs las dmigs su med//de phyir nyi shus lhag pa'i brgya phrag gi/grangs ldan srang gi ljon dmar gar bu can//gser sbyangs bco btul rin cen sa le sbram//drug cur nye ba'i zho yi grangs ldan rnams//cha shas tsam min bzo rig phul phyin pas//mig la ngo mtshar ltad mo'i sgyu 'phrul mkhan//rdzu dha dha na dzñā na bha dra yis//legs pa'i cha la gtso bor brtan nas bsgrubs//rgyal bas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dbang po dang 'tsham dam pa'i chos//a mong theg par sku dang thugs kyi rten//bsgrubs tsam nyid nas lus can bsod nams kyi//zhing du 'gyur zhes bsngags pa ches cher mdzad//'on te theg pa'i yang rtse gsang sngags kyi//bgrang yas rgyud sdes mar gzungs 'bul dang //rab tu gnas pa rgya cher gsungs ba yi//rjes su 'phags bod tshad ldan mkhas kun 'brang //113na ti'i tshul yid chesadam pa'i gsung rab dang //phyag bzhes man ngag snyan brgyud zab mo'i gnad//'khrul bral ji bzhin ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi//gnod sbyin bang mdzod bcas pa'i bzhugs tshul la//zas gtsang sras kyi 'phel gdung ma skyes dgra'i//rten skal grub pa'i dbang phyug skyon pas//spyan drangs yar 'brog khri sgor legs byas kyi//zhing du bzhugs pa'i zhabrul med grags can dang //de bzhin lho brag gnam skas brag sgo nas//gter ston chen po chos kyi dbang phyug gis//spyan drangs sha rī ram gyis thog drangs pa'i//bstan pa spyi yi dad rten rim pa ni//rdo rje gdan gyi byang tso rṣa pho shing //rang sangs rgyas dang shā ri'i bu yi gdung //dgra bcom nyi ma gung pa'i snam sbyar dang /grub rigs dbang phyug sa ra ha pa yi//sgom thag reg 'jam sbrul lpags las grub pa//bod rje gnya' khri btsan po'i sku yi sha/'phags pa lo ke shwa ra'i gser chab kyi//gdan zhug phye dang sku phyis khrus kyi dar//gnubasarong chos lung 'phags pa'i bzhugs gdan shing //chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs phyags dang //de'i dus sprul pa'i khra ring stag gi pags//rgya mo bza' yi khrus long ras ma'i phye//desabaskrun sangs rgyas bas sku'i cha shas dang //rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i snyan gyi rgyan//mkhan wo bo byi satwa'i na bza'i dar//sprul pa'i 113bcu la rgyal mnga' bdag khri ral sha/rgya gar paṇa chen dha na shi la dang //rab 'byor zla ba gnyis kyi dbu skyes skra//'phags yul gshin rje'i grub thob dpal 'dzin dang /grub wo nā ro zung gi rus pa'i rgyan//dge slong dpal mo'i bum chu'i ril bu dang //rgya gar paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i skra//lo chen rin cen bzang po'i rten 'dam phye//byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan sku'i bla gos//ngam ring nas byon ma gcig zhal sgo'i phye//'jig rten mkha' 'gros

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i ma rdzo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / 'dargya gar phyag na la/ /gnang ba'i ngo mtshar rdo yi pus 'byud dang / /lho brag mar pa'i seng ge mjing bsnol ber/ /rngog pa'i sngags 'chang mdo sde'i na bza' dang / /rgya gar dam pa sangs rgyas zhabs kyi stegs/ /bal po a su'i rdo yi sgom thag phye/ /mi tri pa yi pus 'khyud kha ṭwāṃ ga /kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī yi/ /dbu skra snam sbyar lhung bzed shubs dang ni/ /byang chub ljon pa las grub 'khar gsil shing / /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbu zhwa dang / /sku bem gdung rus bzhugs 'ding zhabs sgrog bcas/ /rgya bod mkhas grub du ma'i dbang gi chu/ /ma nub gcig bsdus bum pa'i chu'i ril bu/ /lo chen byang chub rtse mo'i dbu lo dang / /rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal snam sbyar/ /jo nang dol po sangs rgyasadabu skyes skra/ /de yi phyag 'bar mdud pa can gyi shing / /bal po'i paṇa chen ma hā bo dhi dang / /(114na thun spangs chen po chos kyi rin cen zhabs/ /bsam sdings chos bzang gsum gyi dbu lo dang / /mkhan chen dkon cog bzang po'i na bza' rnams/ /spyi dang bye brag stan gcig jo zhal rten/ /yongs kyi phyogs lhung bral bar bsngags pa'i gzhi/ /bka' gdams jo bo yab sras dad rten la/ /dpal ldan a ti sha yi sku gdung rus/ /snam sbyar dbu zhwa phyag tsha'i sa phye ma/ /gang de'i phyag dreg ma yi rgya dpe dang / /'byom ston chos kyi rgyal po'i na bza' gdung / /rngog lo khu dpon gnyis kyi na bza' dang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgom pa pa'i sku rags/ /'jam dbyangs po to rin cen gsal snam sbyar/ /gsang bdag spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi skra/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha po sgang pa'i gdung / /zul phu bya 'dul chen po'i dbu skra dang / /lho brag phyag rdor sku sha dbu skra rnams/ /lha chosabadun ldan bstan 'dzin byin rlabs rten/ /bka' brgyad 'di yi gdams pa'i nying khu'i mchog /skyesabu gsum gyi lam rim ma nor bar/ /thos bsam sgom pas bstan pa legs 'dzin pa/ /mnyam med dga' ldan par grags dad rten la/ khams gsum chos kyis rgyal po btsong kha pa'i/ /dbu sgra chab ser ril bu phyag tsha'i phye/ /rdul gzan ber zlam phyag tsha phyag nas bcas/ /rgyal tshab mkhas grub rdzedang zha lu ba/ /ba so chos rgyan blo gros chos skyong dang / /blo gros brtan pa smon (114bsgom dpal ba — /33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)ste/ /'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud ces grags mtshan ldan pa'i/ /dbu skra phyag sen gcig bsdus ril bu dang / /mkhas grub dge legs dpal ba'i sman 'phreng phye/ /rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i zhabasang ra rus/ /ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan dbu'i lo ma/ /paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i na bza' dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub bla gos/ /'jam dbyangs smon lam dpal ba'i shangasaphyis dang / /chos rje mdung rtse ras pa'i dbu skyes skra/ /'dar ston blo bzang grags pa'i phreng thag dang //mkhas grub nor bzang dbu lo gdung rus bcas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho yi/ /dbu lo sku rags paṇa zhwa'i cha shas dang / /gling smad lha dbang rgya mtsho'i gdung rus phye/ /paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i na bza' skra/ /sngags ram rdo rje'i 'chang gi dbu skyes skra/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho yi/ /dbu klad dbu skra spur ras rten 'dam bcas/ /mgon khang dmar po'i rdo nag maṇḍal 'bru/ /mnga' ris lha yi btsun pa'i dbu skra dang / /rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho'i na bza' skra//thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho yi/ /dbu skra spur ras shangs mtshal phye ma bcas/ /mkhan chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi/ /na bza'i cha shas rten bsdus ril bu dang / /smra ba'i dbang phyug dkon cog chos 'phel gyi/ /dbu skra rten rnams bsdus(115na)pa'i ril bur bcas/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi/ /dbu lo thugs kyi phye ma phyag sen dang / /gdung tsha btab pa'i sgrol dkar spyan bdun sku/ /ngosakyi skra gos mtshal khrag la sogs pas/ /mtha' rten tsam du bgyis nasadage lugs rten/ /theg pa'i yang rtse gsang chen rnying ma pa'i/ /byin rlabs dad rten bzhugs pa'i rim pa la/ /dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / st+waṃ sidha bi ma la rnams kyi/ /dbu lo phyag sen skyon yab yum gyi/ /byang sems dkar dmar bram ze dung gi phreng / /ta thā ga ta ngan lam rgyal ba mchog /mnga' bdag yab sras cho sod bang thugs sras dang / /padma gling pa rnams kyi sku yi sha /chosasman sna tshogs gcig tu nyer bsdoms pa'i/ /rta brgya mdzo brgya ri ba'i ril bu dang / /bye brag shri sidha'i dbu skyes skra/ skyon chen po'i dbu skra lcang lo ma/ /de yi cho so gos gser gyi pa ṭa ris/ /rigs 'dzin —134

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhongs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / khom)padma gling pa'i gter mar bcas/ /skyon yab yum byang chub sems dkar dmar/ /paṇa grub chen po bi ma la'i sku rags/ /khri srong lde btsan dbu skyes lcang lo ma/ /mkhar chen bza' yi 'tsho rgyal dbu lo dang / /bsam yas lo paṇa dam chos bsgyur pa'i khri/ /lo chen bai ro cog ro'i phyag bris dang / /mkhasapa ldan ma rtse mang yi ge'i sgril/ /nyang ban chen po ta thā ga ta'i gdung / /lha lung dpal kyi rdo rje'i (115bdabu rgyan shing / /bsam yas bar khang rgya dpe zhabrul pa med/ /rgya ston shad khrom gter ma'i shog ser dang / /mnga' bdag nyang gi gdung rus dbu'i ral pa/ /de yi gter byon bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus/ /lha mo pa ṭa kun bzang shog ser zung / /thugs sras mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu skra dang //bla ma bya nag chen pos gza' bdud kyi/ /sgrub gnas khyab 'jug thim pa'i sbra nag gur/ /chos skyong khra bor grags pa'i ber cha shas/ gu ru chos dbang dbu skra sku yi sha /myong bas grol ba chos sman dam dzosamachog /thugs sras padma dbang chen sku yi sha /chos bdag skal ldan yar klungs sprul sku'i gdung / /gu ru me shes khyung grags shog ser dang / /g.yor po g.yung ston gdung gi sha rī raṃ/ /skyon phyag gi rjesaldan ngo mtshar ba'i/ khog ser phyon gling pas spyan drangs pa/ /gter ston dri med kun dga'i dbu skyesaskra/ /rigs 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru'i dbu ral dang / /yun ring bzhes pa'i dbu zhwa'i nang gi dar/ /de'i gter rnam sras 'jang yul ma'i dar lce/ /gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i dbu lo dang / /de yi gter ma'i dam rdzas rol pa che/ /skyon rdo rje gling pa'i na bza' dang / /grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po yi/ /dbu skra sle bem gtor ma tshe'i dam rdzas/ /gling pa gsum gyi mtshan ldan ratna yi/ /gdung rus gsil bu dang ni shog ser bcas/ /sprul sku padma gling pa'i spur gyi ras/ /dkar po kun gragasadabu skra lcang (116na tshe smo ma/ /mdo sngags gling pa mchog ldan mgon po dang / /gter ston kun skyong gling pa gnyis kyi skra/ /bse ston rin rgyan dbu ral sku sham dkar/ /mnga' ris paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal gyi/ /sku gdung rus pa'i phye ma snam sbyar bcas/ /mnga' ris rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje yi/ /dbu skra gdung rus skye bdun ril bu dang / /gter kha du ma'i tshe dpag med mgon gyi/ /sgo nas nye bar —133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)bsgrubs pa'i che'i dam rdzas/ /phyon las lo gling pa'i shog ser dang / /'bri gung chos rgyal rin cen phun tsho gos kyi/ /dbu ral dam rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman bcas/ /rgyal sras bstan pa'i 'byung gnasakyi rten 'dam/ /mnyam med nub dgon byams pa chos rgyan gyi/ /gsol phod rdo rje'i gong pa'i dum bu dang / /chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbu'i ral pa/ /sku rags paṇa zhu tshe bdag sgrub gtor phye/ /gsang rdzogs sgo nas 'i bsgrubs pa bdud rtsi sman/ /bka' dgu'i bum chu gcig bsdus ril bur bcas/ /lha bro rkarma gu ru'i chos sman dang / /snang gsal kun dga' tshem chog dbu yi zhwa/ /byang pa rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po yi/ /dbu skra 'gro don las sbyor ldang ril bu/ /de'i gcung rigs 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhes/ /mtsho skyes bzhad pa'i dbang po'i gdung rus dang / /yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu yi/ /dbu ral gdung rus bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun ril/ /rigs 'dzin kun bzang rnam rgyal gyis bsgrubs pa'i/ /thugs rje chen po'i las sbyor lnga'i ril bu/ /rigs 'dzin srog sgrub 'chi med tshe yi rdzas/ /rigs kun khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyi/ /dbu skra myong grol ril bu 'phel kha can/ /bde 'dus sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi sman/ /tshe dpag sku gsum rigasabasdus dbang gtor dang / /nyi zla'i phab rgyun bcapa ngo mtshar can/ /sprul pa'i skyes mtsho gi ratna gling pa sogs/ /gter kha mang po'i dam rdzas tshe ril te/ /'chi med grub pa'i byin rlabs gzi 'bar can//dpal ldan sa skya'i dad rten rim pa la/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun birlu pa'i/ /rus pa'i rgyan dang bdud rtsi ril bu bcas/ /klu dbang bsrung sogs 'khon ston rim byon gyi/ /gdung dang ring bsrel theg chen chos rje'i sha/ dkar po rnam pa gsum gyis legs bsgrubs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi ril bcasaphyogs gcig bsdus pa yi/ /rta brgya mdzo brgya ri ba'i ril bu dang / /'khon rog chen po shes rab tshul khrims kyi/ /rus pa'i rgyan dang gsang sngags bzlas pa'i 'phreng / /ba ri lo tsā rin cen grags na bza'/ /dkon cog rgyal po'i ka li'i na bza' dar/ /de dang thugs sras rje btsun brtse ba che/ /thun mong na bza' yun ring longs spyod pa/ /sa chen nyid kyi sku bem rus pa'i rgyan/ /slob dpon bsod —136

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (mnanams rtse mos yun ring du//bzhes pa'i na bza' dang ni gar phod bcas//117na ) rje btsun gragasapa'i phyag 'phreng me 'bar ma//bdud rtsi ril bu na bza' kha ṭwāṃ 'phan//sa skya paṇa chen snam sbyar dbu zhwa dang //'gro mgon 'phags pa'i rdo rgyud kyi pang khebs//sku bem nang sha phyag 'phreng lung thang ma//dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku'i bla gos//rje btsun gong ma'i phur pa'i rdul tshon sa//sngags yong gzungs kyi dpal ba'i phod ka dang //theg chen chos rje'i sku sha spur ras gdung //ngor chen kun dga' bzang po'i bla gos dang //chos rje rdo rje gdan pa'i sku'i sham thabs//bdag wo rgya gar sher rgyan gdung rus dang //bdag nyid rṣa po blo gros rgyal mas gyi//gdung rus bdud rtsi ril bu lung bstan ma//sa skya'i rten 'dam dpe bral ma yi phye//kun spangs rdo ring chen po'i spur gyi tshwa//sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i na bza' skra//sgo rum kun dga' legs pa'i dbu skra gdung //mtshar chen chosakyi rgyal po'i sku rags dang //dbu lo shangs mtshal gdung tsha sgrol dkar sku//tshe dpag med mgon rnam grangs du ma yi//sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i 'chi med tshe'i dam rdzas//thugs dam rtag gtor bdun tshar phye mar bcas//rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog dbu lo dang //'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug shangs mtshal gdung //gsar rnying tshe dpag med mgon du ma yi//sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i 'chi med bcud len rdzas//skye bdun bdud rtsi'i ril bu spyan ras gzigs//17bab ter mang lugs bzhin bsgrubs pa'i ril bur bcas//bod mkhar don grub rgyal mtshan dbu skra dang //mkhan wo gzhon nu blo gros kyis bsgrubs pa'i//bdud rtsi ril bu rtag gtor bdun tshar phye//bo dong mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gdung //sngags 'chang chen po bsod nams chos 'phel gyi//gdung tsha btab pa'i rnam rgyal gdugs dkar sku//bdag chen bsod nams dbang po'i dbu skra dang //dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bur phye mar bcas//rdo rje 'dzin pa dbang phyug rab brtan gyi//na bza' bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub gtor bcas//'khor lo'i mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi//dbu skra bka' 'gyur gegs sel sngags thun dang //kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi rdul tshon dang //sa skya par

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)grags grub pa'i mtha' yi rten/ shangs pa bka' brgyud grags pa'i dad rten la/ /nā ro'i lcam mo mkha' 'gro ne gu'i gdung / /zung 'jug sku brnyes yang po'i gdung thal dang / /mnyam med glog lcog rin cen brtson tsos gdung / /thugs rje chen po skyer sgang pa'i na bza'/ grub dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi bus lkod/ /de yi gsang yum kun dga' dpal mo zhes/ /mkha' 'gro 'gro ba bzang mo'i sprul pa'i gdung / /dwags po bka' brgyud phyogs kyi dad rten la/ /rje btsun mi las dgung lo bzhi bcu nas/ /brgyad cu'i bar bcangs sgom thag byin rlabs can/ /sgam po zla 'od gzhen nu'i dbu lo 'phreng / /dpal ldan (118na)phag mo gru pa'i dbu skyes skra/ /na bza' bdud rtsi ril bu phyag nasadang / /sku 'bum brag gi 'gro mgon gsung byon ma'i/ /sku sha byi bas zos pa'i ras ma'i sa 'bri khung skyob ba 'jig rten gsum mgon dang / /spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po gnyis dbu skra/ /yang mgon thugs kyi rdo rje'i dbu skra dang / grub pa mchog brnyes g.ya' bzang chos smon lam/ /rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag gling ras gnyis kyi gdung / snying rus mthar phyin rgod tshang pa'i dbu skra/ /spyan snga lha gzigasaras pa'i shangs phyis gdung / /'ja' tshugs ril bu ma bu rim pa gnyis/ khams pa dbu se pa lha gnyis kyi skra/ /skyon rin cen dpal pa'i sgom thag dang / /mkhyen pa'i spyan snga rang byung rdo rje'i gdung //chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i na bza' dang / /drung pa mthong ba don ldan shangs mtshal phye/ /spyan sga zhwa dmar bzhi pa chos grags pa'i/ khangs mtshal phye ma na bza'i dum bu dang / /'bab rong dharma dbang phyug dbu skyes skra/ /dpal ldan khams pa sga lo'i gdung sol dang / /mal yer chen po smon lam btsan gyi gdung / /'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa'i na bza'/ /bka' brgyud spyi dang bye brag bcas pa'i rten/ /yungs tso lta bu sku gdung sku bal gyi/ /ring bsrel gsum gyi grangs tsam brjod zin nas/ /gtso bor chos sku'i ring bsrel snying po can/ /mdo dang rgyud sde'i gzungs sngags rim pa la/ /rnam rgyal dri med (118bskosang ba ring bsrel dang / /byang chub rgyan 'bum rten 'brel snying po ste/ /yongasasu grags pa'i gzungs chen sde lnga dang / /che mchog yang dag 'jam dpal rta mgrin dbang / /phur pa —138

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mdam rga rdzogs rigs 'dzin dregs pa 'dul/ /stobs ldan nag po bka' brgyad spyi yi sngags/ /bye brag bcom ldan badzra gi lā ya/ /zil gnon sku gsung thugs sngags skye ring dang / /padma yang gsang khrag 'thung lha dgu'i sngags/ /gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje so gnyis lha/ /dgra gdong 'jigs gsum snying po phreng sngags dang / /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i nye ba'i snying / /rkang pa bas drug pa yi phreng sngags bcas/ /kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi snying po dang / /'phreng ba'i gsang sngags mchogo gyur ā lha'i gzungs/ /bcom ldan bdag med lha mo dgu yi sngags/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur gyi rtsa ba'i gzungs/ /de las gsungs pa'i khro bo bcu yi sngags/ /kye rdor bstobadun ma dang bdag med ma/ /kuru kulle rnams kyi gzungs sngags dang / /bde mchog lu nag dril gsum yab yum gyi/ /snying po 'phreng ba'i sngags ring dang bcas pa/ /bde mchog gdan bzhi rnal 'byor nam mkha' yi/ /yab ka yum ka gnyis kyi gzungs sngags dang / /bde mchog 'khor wa drug sgyu ma che/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyasathod pa rnams kyi gzungs/ /nā ro mkha' spyod snying po oṃ gsum ma/ /gur las gsungs pa'i yi ge brgya pa dang / /rdo rje dbyings dang kun rig rtsa ba'i sngags/ /(119na shor dbyings chos dbyings sngags dbyings snying po gsum/ /rab tu gnas par byed pa'i gsang sngags dang / /rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub sngags/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa dang / /sangs rgyas dri med snying bo sman gyi bla/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin 'byung 'od dpag med/ /don yod grub pa 'jam dpal blo 'phel dang / /'jam dpal rdo rje dpa' bo gcig sgrub pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs gzungs dang srog shing brtan pa'i sngags/ /tshe dpag med kyi mtshan sngags brgya rtsa bcas/ /rnga sgra'i tshe gzungs dpa' bo gcig grub dang / /sbyong rgyud rnams las gsungs pa'i tshe yi gzungs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag rdor gzungs ring dang / /'gro ba kun sgrol rigs drug gnas 'dren sngags/ /gdugs dkar rnam 'joms mi zhabrug kai ka ni/ /sor 'brang stong chen rab 'joms me bya che/ /gsang sngags rjes 'dzin bsil ba'i tshal gyi gzungs/ /rdor sems yi ge brgya pa zhal bzhi pa'i/ /gzungs dang rgyud sdo'og ma'i khro —139

rgyal dbang lnga dzing ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)bcu'i sngags//mtshams med sgrib sbyong byams pas dam bcas gzungs/shes rab phar phyin yi ge nyung ngu dang /sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa gnyis kyi gzungs//mchod pa'i sprin dang 'phags pa gtsug gi nor//rin chen khang bu brtsegs pa dag gi gzungs//ye shes mgon po phyag drug las gshin dang //rnam sras rta bdag 119ba tha rgyad kyi gzungs sngags rnams//dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khamasadabang phyug ma'i//snying po bhyo bdun la4 ga'i sha ri bhyo//gnam sman bdud dang ma mo gshin rje bdun//nyi shu rtsa brgyad so so'i srog gi sngags//gur mgon zhal dang pu tra beg rtse yi//bod rbad bsad pa'i sngags rnams ma tshang med//tshangs pa brgya byin khyab 'jug dbang phyug dang //lha mo brgyad dang phyogasaskyong nam mkha' lding //rgyal chen bzhi dang tshes grangs gza' skar gzungs//til gyi gang bu lta bur gang ba dang //nyes pa ma lus sel ba'i gzungs sngags te//pha rgyud ma rgyud yo ga bya spyod dang //chosaskyong so so'i 'dod gsol skabs thob sbyar//kun kyang sbyong rgyur dgongs pa ji bzhin du//rtsa ba'i rig pa sbrul 'khyi' ltar sgril ba//stod smad bar dang padma ra bcas pa'i gzungs//gong 'og ma 'khrugasadapyad bzod kho nar bzhugs//sprel zla'i tshes bcur bto pa'i skyon sku//sar ha dang klu sgrub birlu pa//jo bo wo po kha che paṇḍita//sa paṇa rje btsun dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs//drag po stsal dang phur pa dpal rta mgrin //rdo rje 'jigs byed nā ro mkha' spyod ma//tshe dpag med mgon sgrol dkar rnam par rgyal//'jam dbyangs gdugs dkar lo ma gyon ma dang //ku ru kulle lha chen 'dod pa'i rgyal//dpal ldan phyag drug pa dang gur gyi mgon//las kyi gshin rje rgyal chen rnam thos sras//bla ma yi dam byang sems cho me 120na skyong sku//dri bzang mdangs kyis mdog bsgyur srog shing la//steng 'og bri bya'i gzugs bas legs bkod phyir//srog shing brten pa rig pa chen mo dag/rin cen gser sbyangs khu bas dag par bris//sku gsung thugs gsum byin gyis rlob byed pa'i//mtshan ma sngags dang ting 'dzin zung 'jug dang //rigs lnga yab yum 'khor lo kha sbyor rnams//'byul pa med pa'i man ngag ji bzhin bzhugs//bye brag sku brnyan sgo so'i dmigs bsal la//rigs 'dzin skyon 40

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnapadma 'byung gnas skur/ /zang thal bde 'dus khyab 'jug bla brgyud mtshan/ st+waṃ sidha che mchog gza' gdong sku/ /chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i skur/ /gsang 'dus 'jigs byed rgya chen spyod pa dang / /zab mo lta ba nyams len byin rlabs brgyud/ /phyag drug rnam sras las gshin bla brgyud mtshan//lho brag grub chen 'jigs byed las gshin sku/ /pad dkar 'dzin pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i skur/ /'khor lo sdom pa nā ro mkha' spyod dang / /gur mgon zhal dang beg rtse'i bla brgyud mtshan/ /sngags ram rje dang bde mtshog beg rtse'i sku/ /'dra 'bag nang du sku gsum rigs bsdus dang / /'chi med dpal ster rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /tshe phur gsung ngag rnam rgyal dmag zor lha'i/ /bla brgyud mtshan dang bcas pa'i bla ma mchog /zil gnon re ma ti yi sku'i snang bas/ /dbang rtags cod pan slar skyes sbugs dang (120ba yo los/ /kun kyang bzhugs gnas 'khrul pa med pa la/ /rang rang skabs dang sbyar ba'i 'dod gsol can/ khyad par chos skyong rnams la dgon gnas ste/ /bshad sgrub bca' khrims phyi nang mthun rkyen sogs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas gnyer du gtad/ /sa sna rdo sna shing sna'i rim pa la//rdzogs sangs rgyas la klu yis phul pa'i khri/ /rgyal po'i khab dang ni rañdza ra'i sa/ /bal po shing kun bya rung kha shor dang / /stag mo lus byin yang le shod kyi phug /ti se'i sa rdo gaṅgā'i chu'i ril bu/ /ma pham mtsho yi bye ma rnam pa lnga/ /chu bo wo po ma dros pa'i mtsho zan/ /rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i sa dang rdo/ /'jam dbyangs chibs kyi seng ge'i zhabs rjes sa/ /lha sa bsam yas khra 'brug yer pa dang / /yang rdzong mchims phu shel brag g.ya' ma lung / /yum bu gla sgang mkhar chu zam phu lung / /te dror mkha' 'gros brtsigs pa'i phyon gyi/ /bzhugs dang ni mkha' 'gro'i kyi zas phye/ /bsam yas mchode rten dkar dmar sngo gsum sa/ /yer pa'i sgrub chu rnams kyi ril bu dang / /sgeg sri gcod pa gung thang khyi 'bum sa/ /me tog u dum wa ra utpa la/ /sbas yul 'bras gshongs sa rdo shing sna'i rigs/ /chos 'khor rgyal gyi dmag zor lha mo dang / /mgon po zhal sogs bla mtsho mang po yi/ /rde'u sa sna mtsho yi ril bu dang / /ye shes 'khor lo tsa ri tra'i mtsho zan/ /gnas de'i dngos grub len (121na)pa'i mtsho —141 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)bzhi la/ /legs par sbangs pa'i 'jam mnyen ras dkar te/ /bkra shis byin rlabs g.yang du nyer chags pa/ /mi zad snod kyi yon tan ngo mtshar gter/ /srid zhi'i brtan pa ma lus yongs 'phrog pa'i//bcom ldan rig byed lha mo'i 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom dang dpal 'byor sogs//dbyar gyi chu bo'i skrun zlar byed thabs dang / /sbyin pa'i bdag po'i longs spyod bsgrub pa la/ /dpa' bo gcig sgrub rgyud nas nyer gsungs pa'i/ /gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i 'khor lo yang / /zhabasasdormas dang bcas ma nor legs bris pa/ /dkar gsum la sogs gtsang sbra sngon 'gro bas/ /bgegasasbyangs dam tshig pa la ye shes bcug /mchod dang bstod par byed pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /'bum phrag nye ba'i bzlas brjod bsnyen pas bsgrubs/ /rnam rgyal mchod rten ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi/ khrog shing gnod sbyin bang mdzod la sogs pa/ /gong dang cha mtshungs tsam las khyad par du/ /dri med 'od kyi mchod rten srog shing sngags/ /mchod rten yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa'i gzungs/ /mchod rten rab gnas mchode skor grib sel gyi/ /gzungs dang 'chi ba med pa'i 'dod gsol rnams/ /legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi dag par bsgrubs/ /bum rdzas nyer lnga la sogs sman sna dang / /spos (121ba bong dri bzang gser dngul 'bru sna phye/ /dar zab ras sogs mkho rgu'i bdog pa yis/ /gser 'phyang zhesapa me mo bya yi lo/ /chu stod zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs nyid kyi/ /dga' ba dang po rgyal phur 'grub sbyor nas/ /yo byad kun la sbyangs gsum sngon 'gro ba'i/ /gang babs rab gnas mdor bsdus skyed chog sogs/ /rang bzo'i sla bcos min pa'i dpyad bzod kyi/ /gzungs rnams go rim ji bzhin phul ba'i mthar/ /tshes bzhi res gza' rta bdun dbang po dang / /zla skar khra 'dzom sbyor chen dpa' bo ste/ /sbyor chung me rlung sdig pa'i dus sbyor skabs/ /phur pa'i gzhung bsrangs brtse sgrom ma'i lugs bzhin/ /rab tu gnas shing bkra shis dga' ston gyis/ /phun tsho gos dpal gyis khyab de med du byung / /gang 'di'i byed por lusang ga yid gsum gyis/ /mi zad 'bad pa'i khur chen gnyer la thog pa blo rsāng sbyin pa/blo ba nga sangs rgyas/ blo bzang rab rgyas/ bsten pa dang / /mtsho la chu phran 'du ltar dge tshogs kyi/ /las —142
