sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar sha/ (mdadakar sa bon mthun rkyen rab blo slong mas stob dang blo stso'i yon to gnyis kyis zhal 'debs ga zang spyo /za du bgrag lnga dar ster sbyin bon sa/blo nga rī gas yon gyi za dus gnyis dar/blo bzang rgya mtshogazas dus galngadar 122na ) brag chos pas sa dus gcig lnga dar/bsam grub byam gling pas zhal 'deb zangs kyi ga lnga pa ga dbang rangabartan gyis zhal 'deb gser zho gang /brag chos pa dang mtsho smad ༅ dbang don grub ga spyi ri kyis sa dus snyag dang lnga dar/tsho gos pa//de lta'i dge tsho gos 'dzad med char gyi rgyun//sku gsum gos bu dar ba'i cho ga mkhan//gto bde'i dbyar gyi rnga gsang cher sgrogs pa//rna ba bdud rtsir myong ba'i bcud len mkha//tshul 'dir sgo gsum 'bad pa'i skye rgu rnams//tshe dpal bsod nams yar ngo'i zla ba ltar//'phel zhing rnam ba thams cad mkhyen pa yi//go 'phang mchog gi dga' ston rgyas gyur cig/bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba yi//rdo rje'i theg pa phan dang bde ba'i gzhi//smin grol legs bshad rig sngags 'chang ba'i gling //srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas gyur cig/rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rten du bzhengs pa'i sku bas rnamasakyi dkar ho mthong bas don ldan 'di ni las byed rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za sto gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo//dwags po lcang ra ba sa skyong mgon po tshe brtan gyis thams cad mkhyen pa yon to rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba par du brkos pa'i par byang nges legs sgo 'byed sogs/oṃ a tha/'dzad med mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i mtshor//22bajo mtshar gtam gyi gnyis skyes lus dkar can//snyan 'gyur lo rgyud gdub sil 'brol ba'i sgra/shes ldan rna ba'i gsos su bdud rtsi'i bcud//gang de'i glegs/ma bgrang yas gter gyi sgo//ris med 'gro la

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khed mkhas lcang ra ba//nor 'dzin skyong ba mgon bo tshe brtan gyi//ri dpyod lhag bsam rnam dag byed pos bskrun//mkha' gzugs zhag gi 'tshams su mas pa'i rkyen//gya nom btung ba'i longs spyod gaṅgā'i rgyun//lhag bsam mes po'i thod las 'dren pa yi//blo gsal skal bzang chos la mos 'dzin can//ljon pa'i shing gi mkha' la sor mo'i 'phrul//rnam dpyod 'dab gzhog ma cu yisabagrod byed pa//blo gros rtsal kun rdzogs pa'i dar po sogs//gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa ma nu'i grangs//tshul 'dir sgo gsum zang zing sna tshogs kyis//ngal brgyas 'bad pa'i dge legs rin cen la//mtho ris bgrod pa'i them skas rab 'grub nas//thar pa'i khang bzang mchog tu 'jug gyur go/gnas skabs nyer 'tshe'i gzhan 'phrul bdag po'i lus//legs byas mgrin sngon mig gi mes bsregs nas//tshe dpal stobs wor zla shel dkyil 'khor gyis//'di snang ral pa'i rgyan du mdzesagyur cig/dag pa gnyis ldan lhun grub sangs23na sa dang //yon to brgyad ldan de'i gsung dam pa'i cha///rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis//dus rnams kun tu bkra shisadage legs 365//su bha wa par ma tsadzñā na b.rā yakṣa rwa:pra hi ṇa di a ho9te shā ri ka su ba la bi pa ri shu blo dwa nā di tsā māhatad lha su kar mā su bee pā ni kodzā〉tsa//don dam rang bzhin rnam par yongs dag mtha' gnyis spangs pa ye shes mchogo gi 'gyur ba med pa'i sa gzhi la//sbyin sogs bsod nams phung po cher spungs ma smad rlabs chen spyod pa'i sa bon legs par smin las 'byungs pa yi 123baprabha wa ti su pha lhag kar ya:ri byen swā khe rda lo dharmāḥtshig riraḥmā ma rgyu tsā dzin su bha ga shubha ya gotamya sa rbhe ṇa kwa le khri tsa pra lnga tā sgyu li3drum//chos sku'i sdong bu dar la babs pa'i 'phrin las lo 'dab g.yur za'i rtse mor gzugs sku'i 'bras bzang rab dud can//bskal bzang rnam 'dren ljon shing dbus na shākya seng ge yongs 'du'i dbang pos dus kun dge ba'i bkra shis stsol//don gnyis dang ldan mkhyen brtse nus pa'i pha mtha' mi mngon sangs rgyas zheX 4bya'i chu ga kho las//sdug kun nyer zhi'i gas

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar sha/ (mna'aphreng yol med bden gnyis chos kyi mi zad bang mdzod sgo//legs yed rig grol gdengasakagayo ldan myang 'das gtsug na nor bu'i dge 'dun klu'i dbang po//ston dang bstan pa de 'dzin slob mar bcas pa'i dkon cog rin chen gsum la spyi bos 'dud//thub dbang dpal gyi mgrin pa 124nang ba mdzes bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung dkar po//smra ba'i ljags chen rab bskyod 'phrul gyis tshangs pa'i dbyangs su nyer bsgrags skad//yan lag bcu gnyis gsung rab sgra snyan srid gsum rna ba'i bcud len can//brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung po bsod nams ma dros mtshor 'khyil las//mdo rgyud bka' yi glegs bam pa ku'i klung / /gangs can ra ba dkar po'i khor yug 'dir/ /nyer babs mi dge'i dri ma kun 'khrud pa//legs byas gter gyi btung ba zad mi shes//mkha' ltar tshad bral sems can thams cad kyi//bsam pa'i khyad par shes nas drang nges theg/legs gsungs chosakyis 'gro rnams 'dren mdzad pa//sangs rgyas kho nar nges pa'i dad pa dang //mtha' med ma rgan kun la rjes brtse bas//drangs pa'i rab dkar lhag bsam rnam dag gis//rgyal gsung yi ger shar ba'i pusta ka/snying stobs brtson pas rab skrun byed pa po//rdo rje'i gdan las byang phyogs swā la'i ljongs//gser ldan lus phra dge bcu'i mngal khur can//nyang stod nor 'dzin yangs pa'i thig le che//sum rtsen sal 'phos 'dra'i yul gru na//mi dge sdig pa'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i//byams brtse'i ru mas 124ba tha sgreng mdzad mi pham mgon//sa skyong rje bo'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar//rab brtan kun bzang 'phags zhes srid na snyan//gang gi dge blo ston zla las dkar bas//sgrib gnyis mun pa ches srab legs tshogos la ma//rab gsal snang ba'i dpal ldan 'dus tshogs grwa/rnam gsum 'khor lo'i chos kyi sder por//bag yod khrims kyi rgyun brtan lnga phrug kyi//yon to rtse mor son la mkhan po zhes//chos sil gzhung brgya nas bshad dge ba'i bshes//rin cen 'phreng ba lta bur spel legs mthar//blang dang dor byar lta ba'i shes rab kyi//yon to phung po'i khur gyis rab lci bas//chos dang srid kyi mig dkyus ches ring ba'i //pha mtha' nam mkha'i ske rags la 'gong des//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'jam mgon thon mi'i ring lugs sor mo'i 'phrul//sdeb gzugs brda yi gtsug lag mig yangs ༅//mang por sri zhu'i gtong ba'i sgo 'phar brgya//phye bas dge tsho gos 'dod 'jo deng 'dir grub//snyigs mar spyod pas ches cher gdul dka' ba//'dul la dpa' ba shākya'i rtag gi bstan//lung rtogs nyi ma'i dngos po brgya yi lus//'od kyis 'jig rten phan bde gsal bar shog/bu ram shing pas gang gzigs shes bya'i yul//25nasgo rga sum mkhyen pa'i ston pa tshad ma'i mgon//blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyur btsong kha pa'i//chos srid grib mar 'gro rnamasang la gsor shog/bsod nams dngos spel mthun pa'i rkyen gyis mar//smon lam pir gyis tshe dpal stobs 'byor gzugs//ri mo'i bkod pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i dpal//srid 'dir dge sa gzigs mor mtshar gyur cig/rang rgyud sgrib pa'i dri ma 'khrud byed chu//legs byas skrungs pa dar ba gaṅgā'i rgyun//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgya mtsho cher//dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu 'jug gyur cig/'di snang bde ba'i dpal be snying khar 'khyil//tshogs gnyis gom pas gtan bde'i sa chen khyab//stobs bcu'i khyung chen gzhog pa'i rtsal chen pos//'phrin las nam mkha'i mthar khyab bgrod gyur cig zhes pa 'di ni nyang stod dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po yongs gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab yon to gyisasde snod gsum gyi bka' 'gyur ro cog dang rgyud sde thor bu gsar du bskrun skabs mar brjod dang 'dod don spel tshigs su bcad pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ming gas 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes garsā du 'bod pa'i sdom bu pas thun 'tshams kyi nges pa zhig pa sbyar ba shrī dza / /25ba'adzi:rna tha te dzod ba las geḥg lpamaḥsma ha grwa pa sna ka lkod yun ljag pa la lha da yi rutta ra sgyu:sbir/shāso tshisdo mya ma rgyud ya kan dzin lha baḥlha te༅rkyang grwa mi/nu/lhan kul dzin tsas pā dza:sgo ka/bzang po'i bskal par stobs bcu'i dpal gzi brjid pa'i mgon po stong gi dbus//snying stobs mchogo gis ma rga par dpa' bas snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro ba rnams/4/brtse chen thugs rje'i phyag gis dbugs dbyung nyi

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (mnama'i gnyer gyur shākya'i brgyud//ma 'dris skye rgu'i mdza' bshes dam pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod sdong rgyal//rnam 'dren rigs kyi myu gu gsar pa rnams//chos gzugs ste ma smin pa'i cho ga mkhan//drang nges gsung gsang bdud rtsi'i chu klung che//bzhi ldan 'khor lo can gyi snod du 'khyil//nangs kyi dus nas bskrun pa'i legs byas mthus//'khor ba sha khri /yi tshang tshing nags//za bar bag yangasaci bder rgyu 26na ) byed ba//sa srung dbang po'i gom 'gros 'di na mtshar//srid mtshan mun rum phag tu nyal ba'i 'gro//ma rig gnyid slong dge tsho gos skya rengs ma//'dren pa'i lhag bsam rlung 'gros kyis 'khor bar//dkar min nyi ma'i longs spyod des bzlog min//tshogs kyis legasabasgrubs rang snang dag pa'i dbyings//'og min gnas su spang rtogs kun rdzogs pas//dpal gyi mgur nas zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul//de snyed gsungs pa'i chos phung tshad bzung ci//'on te lasadag so skye'i dbang shes su//'char byed mchog gi sprul pa'i sgyu ma mkhan//rdo rje'i gdan gyis spa bar sangs rgyas nas//rnam gsum chos kyi 'khor lo'i grangs su bskor//gangs can phan bde'i dpal gyi zhabs bsil du//rgyal gsung yan lag bas gnyis gaṅgā'i chab//'dren pa'i lo paṇa skal ldan shing rta'i drin//'dzam gling nor bus bkang yang gzhal nus min//rnam gsum sdosnod phyogs 'dir 'gyur ro cog/rtsa bshad phyi rgyud thor bu dang bcas pa//brgya phrag brgal ba'i glegs bam rin cen 'phreng //mkha' la sgyu skar rnam bkra'i do shal bzhin//brda gzugs gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i mig/rab yangs sor rtses shar du sgyur ba'i 'phrul//gzigs mor ngo mtshar tshul 'dis sa sto ṭa//snyems pa'i ngal ba btang ste zhing gzhan song //26ba the ḍūr zhun ma byugs pa'i ba gsing ngos//'dzam bu'i gser gyi snye ma g.yur za ba//mtho ris dga' ba'i tshal la co 'dri bas//'chi med bdag po mig stong sprul nas lta//srid 'byor sgyu ma'i slu 'drid ya ma brla//'khor ba'i bzhi rar sku'i ba'i lcags kyi sgrog/rnam dpyod thabs shes rtsi yis su wa rjer//bsgyur bas gtan bde'i dngos po 'dzad du med//skal bzang a ga sdu yi sgra 'dzin zhe//thos pas rnam par grol pa bcud kyi ma//sdig

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)pa'i dri ma kun 'khrud mtho ris kyi/ /chu gnyer yig 'bru'i gzugs can stims su klas/ /gsang gsum nang nas mchog gi khyad par du/ /rab gyur gsung gi rdo rje tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /lus can kun gyi sgrib gnyis brgya phrag nad/ /ma lus sel bar byed pa sman gyi dpyid/ /mchod sbyin brgya yis legasabris dpal thob na/ /thub gsung ri mor byas pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /'bras bu bla med byang chub a shwa ttha/ /phan bde'i grib bsil rgyas la gcig tu spro/ /e ma nor bu ke ta gas/ khrungs pa'i chu klung rnyog med du/ /gzugs ba 'char ba'i rten 'brel gyi/ /ngang tshul de la su yis slu/ /dge ba'i sa bon sems skyed chus/ /rab gsher yongs 'du'i ljon pa las/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /ro brgya'i gos bzang cis mi dud/ /sdig rta'i tsher ma rnon po yis/ /nyer phug 'khor ba'i (127na)zug rngu dag /dbyung bar byed pa'i las dkar gyi/ /cha spyad 'di ni sman du che/ /rnam par gnag pa'i mngal khur gyis/ /sbrum min bsod nams brang stengs su/ /nyer bskrun bde skyid rgod ma kha/ /'khor ba'i mtsho mtha' brgal te 'bar/ /lus med brlab por spyod pa'i dpung / /gdong pa smad de 'dud byed pa//lha chen mig las sbar ba'i me'i/ /spun zla 'di ko las g.yin gang / /legs byas zad pa med pa yi/ /nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur bas/ /re ba yongs skong yid bzhin nor/ /gzhan du rnyed pa'i go skabs bral/ /dag pa'i sems kyi khyad par las/ /mngon par lci ba'i khyu mchog gis/ /nor 'dzin lus phra rngul ba yi/ /bzhin ras mu tig 'phreng dkar mdzes/ /de lta'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngang tshul rnams/ /me long nang gi gzugs ltar gsal mthong bas/ /dbang rnon chos kyi rjes stsong dad pa yis/ /gcig tu dkar ba'i rnam smin rgyu 'di bskrun/ /thos bsam sdong bu dar babs sgom pa'i dri/ /legs dngar thub bstan ma la ya yi nags/ /skye rgu'i gdung ba sel la nyi zla yis/ /'jig rten snang ba de srid 'phel gyur cig /'char dang nub pa med pa'i 'od wo po/ /sngon med nyin mor byed pa legs gsungs chos/ /(127bskong ba'i dpal gyis 'khor mun mthar bskrad de/ /'gro kun ngesalegs dpal la sbyor gyur cig /pha mtha' tshad du bzung dka'i mar gyur 'gro/ /mi bzad mya ngam thang —148

sku gsung thug rten gsar ba tshe pas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnal 'khyams pa rnams/ /rlabs chen spyod ba'i rin cen them skas la/ /khrid nas sku gsum khang par 'jug gyur cig /sngon goms bsod nams btsan po'i las shugs kyi/ /dpung pas nor 'dzin khyon kun 'degs pa la/ /snying stobs rab tu brtan pa mi yi bdag /mi khom skyon gyis reg min rten thob shog /skye bar smin pa'i ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs/ /'khor ba gnas ga len gyi rgya dral nas/ /myang 'das 'dab gzhog rdzogs pa'i rtsal chen pos/ /gtan bde'i mkha' la rtsed 'jor rol bar shog /rang bde gzhan la gtong ba'i tshong zong gis/ /don gnyis lhun grub yid bzhin nor blangs ste/ /brjod pa don ldan srid zhi'i gdung sel mkhan/ /bla med stobs ba na mnga' ba'i dpal thob shog /gtong ba'i sgo phye brtson pa'i lag bdar te/ /lusang ga yid kyis legs lam spel mdzod kha/ /'byed rnams tshe dpal 'od mtshan mgon po dang / /stobs lhor rnam thos bu dang thun mong shog /rdosabacas sgrib ba'i lus can spyi bo rtswa /lha yi lhar gyur mkhyen brtse'i gtsug nor gyis/ /reg tshe 'chi ba med pa'i 'od lus su/ /'gyur ba'i skal ba (12zhabazang bo thob bar shog /mi dge'i chu gter yongs su 'khyil ba'i klong / /'jigs chen brgyad kyi chu srin gdug can lus/ /legs byas skad snyan dung gi rab phug ste/ /kun dga' rin cen gling du bgrod par shog /dus gsum rnam dkar 'phel las tshes gang ba'i/ /zla zer gyis byugs 'ag rten khams kyi tshal/ /bde skyid dpal gyis 'dab brgya rab bzhad 'dzum/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston bsu bar shog /'khor dang mya ༅ 'das pa'i dge mtshan las/ /nye bar legs bltams mu tig 'khri shing gi /gcig tu rab dkar bsilaba'i grib ma la/ /lus can kun gyisang la gso thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang nor 'dzin gyi khyen la mnga' sgyur ba'i mdzod pa bsod nams rab brtan dus kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i tshe legs byasakyi rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i byed por bde bar gshegs pa'i sde snod gsum gyi glegs bam gangs can gyi khrod 'dir 'gyur ro cog dang rgyud sde rin po che thor bu dang bcas pa rgya shog bee ḍūrla lta bu'i ngos su rin po che gser zhun mas bris te bzhengs pa'i dus dkar chag dang 'dod don spel tshig —149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (9)mdor bsdus kyi tso du za sto gyi bzhes pho brang rpā po po ta lar bkod pa'i yi ge'i rig byed pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang gis bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu//124tshog mdzod ba nams rab brtan lad6khate bde tshogs mar rten brgyad bsgongs pa'i bang rim la sang sngag byin sa ro las tshol ba ca zad mgos pa'i bar stong ṣā la: 'bul tso 'dod ga i rgya skad du bsgyur ba mas don lhun grub/kyen a skṛ tu ma nā shālko ku lju gro di pa yu//nga sna:ཿsa mā lha ta wa nā ma sirnyi tsa//me tog mda' can las rgyal lha//'jig rten snang byed sgron me mchog/don kun grub pas mkha' mnyam 'gro/khyod mtshan bzhin du 'grub byin rlobs/ /129nasgo phag sa skyong bsod nam ra spu brtan gyi legs byasaspel ma ho du jo shākya yid bsto nor bur gser grang nyis brgya brgal ga las ba napa'i mkha phul ba'i kha yig byang chus ma zhi la legs stor//sdeb spyor me rtag phreng ༅/po dza me gon ro le khas dzha e rkam tshis ma rta shubha//gta〉rsārsā9seg ga rdo sa ma:dzagarnyed sgo ka ti//nor 'dzin lha mir tsos pa'i 'dod yon gyi//phung por legs skrungs kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin//rgyal dang de sras slob ma'i tshogs bcas par//mkha' mnyam sems can don du 'bul byed na/129babra kyi kṣa si bus bsiṅgā tu tsārsha na ra je khri tsā a ho//5ni rma po rmā a:skyi ཿpāṇa hri yo stogashas su wa to//ngo ma' dag pa'i ṣka khams rdul snyed du//de bzhi gshegs mang mdzo sum nyer bsten nas//theg wo chos kyi bdud rtsi zad mi shes//ro brgya'i dpal gyi gas bar longs spyod shog/30nadzo stirnya mi togati rjes blo dzñā mokṣa:be dza godaka/yo lte a nuṣṭha sga blo le puṣṭha ༅ zhin yaḥskye rga na 'chi'i chu las 'gro ba rnams//bsgral nas thar pa thams cad cho pa'i sar//sbyor nus bla na med pa'i byang lho gang //bsod nams rab tu brtan pas thob par shog/rin rpā snying po padma ra legs spungs pa//gser sa btso sbyangs grwa ba'i /ra yug can//sgra 'dzin mun pa'i mal nas slong

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag / 6)byed rgyan/ /ya rabs mdun sar 'os pa'i rnyaka /mthong bas don ldan rgyal ba'i sku brnyan mchog /shākya mu ner legs phul dge tsho gos kyis/ /sa chen chos bzhin skyong ba mi yi bdag /mngon mtho'i rten gyi yang srid 'dzin par shog /byu ru'i sdong po las grub rna ba'i rgyan/ /gser g.yu'i phra tsho mos dung gi kha rgyan can/ /rang byung thugs(130ba)rje chen por phul ba'i dges/ /sa spyod phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyi dgongs pa rdzogs byed du lha sabyang gling pa bsam grub rgyal pos g.yas g.yon gyi rna rgyan gnyis jo shākya dang rang byon lnga ldan la phul dus kyi kha byang du za hor gyi brnyes bris/sa phag gi lo tham shu gyo yig ma gsar du brko pa'i tham phud 'phag pa lo ke shwa ra dang dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang byug mar phul spu chos srid gzha pa gcig gyur/tshad med rnam bzhi'i sgo 'phar legs phye nas/ /'gro rnams bde chen gnas su 'khrid mdzad pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na padma dkar/ khres bya thams cad gzigasapa'i spyan ras su/ /nub phyogs chu lha'i bu mo'i mngal yangs por/ /sbrum pas lugs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i ljid/ /khur gyis nyer dud bde legs rngul chu'i rgyun/ /ri mo mu tig 'phreng mdzes 'di phul bas/ /kai la sha yi khor yug ra ba 'dir/ /ma smad bsod nams phung po nyer brtsegs pa/ /nam yang 'dzad med phun tsho gos dga' ston la/ /longs su spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por mdzod/ /'chi med bu mo bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /'dod pa'i re ba yongs skong yid bzhin nor/ /srid gsum bdag mo dpal ldan re ma ti'i/ /dri med dkyus ring spyan zur nyer 'jug rdzas/ /chos srid bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa'i gtam/ /rab snyan 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud kyi dbyangs/ /ma hā rtswa ṇa'i yi ge'i gzugs shar ba/ /rnam bkra tham dzi'i ri mo'i phud 'bul na/ /legs byas stong gi chu bo 'bab pa'i rgyun/ /dbang (131na)thang rgya mtsho chen por 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /chos srid gdengs can gtsug na 'od 'bar ba'i/ /phan bde'i rin cen snang bas khyab bar mdzod/phyag mdzod sa skyong bsod nams ra pa brtan du kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i tshe legs byas rgya mtsho'i byed por sa phag lo —151

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)dngul gyi bde tshogs 4 3 rten bas rin po tsho phra i mā grong gsar ba padma rab brtan gyis do dam bgyis te ngo ma' bkod pas khyad 'phags bzhengs pa gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du bzhugs pa'i mchod khang gsar pa'i de sgeg ter gyi 'go rgyang bsod nam rgya mtsho gas phreng /sdeb sbyor dbang pho ༅/gas su sha rir su ga ro dwa ra dri gaḥtsa a hos sto/ /kuṇḍa mya mi ti sgo pa rdzu ba na si po khe rtatadziḥrkaraṇḍa tsa//rgya chen tsho gis gnyis zla ba'i ma ma las//ngo mtshar bla na med pa chos gzugs sku//lo byung bdud rtsir 'khyil ba'i za ma tog/phan bde'i nyer 'tsho zas gtsang sras po rgyal//gang gi gsang gsum 131bsgo ṅka'i dbang po'i gzugs//'gro blo'i rin cen rtsig par shar ba yi//grangs med sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i mtha' dang tshad//tshur mthong skye bo'i gzhal bya'i yul las 'gong //'on te rdo rje'i gdan gyis ches spa bar//mchog gi sprul skur legs bstan rol gar las//bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten rnam brgyad ces//bsod nams rgya mtsho bskrun pa'i zhing sa'i dpyid//de'i tshul rtogs pa'i blo dang brtson pa yis//dbang gzhus lkos pa'i kai la sha yi ri//byed pos tshar du dngar bar bris 'dra 'di//kun gyi gzigs mor byed pa'i tshad du che//sal dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang na//'jam dpal snying pos zung 'jug sku bzhi'i dpal//mngon du mdzad pa'i 'og min zhing khams kyi//rab mdzes rgyan mchog khyad par ༅ gyis spud//byin chas gzi por rnam bzhi'i ring bsrel dang //rin cen du ma 'dus pa'i rgyu tshogs sogs//gsal byed dkar chag deb gter ā darsha//mthong bas don dang ldan pa 'di na bkod//ces ra du brjod pas sdun bsus te de yang bslu ba med pa tshad ma'i bka' bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa las mchod rten la bya ba byas pa'i phan yon nam mkha'i mthas kyang tshad bzung gzhal bar dka' ba lta bu'i bsngags brjod dang mas pa'i rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung ba gor ma chag par yid yongs su 132na gto de/mdzod pa bsod nams rab brtan dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa la gcig tu phan pa dge ba'i tshogs kyis yid du mi 'ong ba'i gos bu rnams kyang rnam smi/ dkar por 'dzag pa'i ོ du sku'i rten la chos

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho lang rdzas kha bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnakyi rgyal po btsong kha ba chen po'i gser sku mi tshad ma/gsung gi rten du bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'i glegs bam brgya dang bcu gcig gi grangs ldan gser zhun ma'i khu bas bris pa/thugs kyi rten du dngul dkar las grub pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad mukki ka dang g.yu padma rā ga sogasarin po che'i phra tsho mes kyis bkod pa'i khyad mtshar dang sa bzhengs pa'i thugs rten rnams gdan sachen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du bzhugs su gsol ba'i dkar chag gi rim pa ni/sa phag lo gnyer pa ngag dbang smon lam dang gzhong kha ga gnyis kyis khur khur te dpal ldan sa sa sa kyis: drugasadangul las grus ma drug gsar lo kyi kha yin g.yo byed sbreng shā ra gzhi/gtsang byed dri med chu rgyun sbreng ba'i snod//rab dkar rin cen las grub rgyan drug ma//ngur smig 'chang ba khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sder//nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad dam pa zung //lhag bsam padma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar dang //yod dang brtson pa'i sbyor pa la brten nas//sgo gsum ngal bar byas pa'i skye bo rnams//'di dang gto gyi mdun ma lhun grub shog/132bsgo pag hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcanas la 'go btsugs/lcag gi zla spu dang po'i tshes bcarsāg la srung ༅ dbu tso dar dpyang spos a dang bams pa gser zho sum brgya skor la ljang brdungs su bya par g.yu grang stong mu tig dgu bcaskor gyi sbra pa grong gsar ga padma ra spu gan gyi do dam bya nas bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas pha te 'phrul snang du 'phag pa 4 byon lnga ldan la phugo shā kha yig 'di phrigato 2na sa grub/dge ba'i 'od kyis bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i tshal//rab rgyas tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i skye rgu sogs//mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams ma' mtho nges legs su//'dren phyir rnam pa thams cad mkhyen gyur cig/sa phag zla spugs6g.yo chagasobadun la 'go btsugs/lcag byi zla ba lnga ye nyer gnyis la grub pa'i dbu sa dar dbyangs sa tso dang sa pa gser zho lnga brgyar nye bal ljang rang su bya par g.yu grang bon brgya skor/khu i brgyar nye ba/beeḍū rla dpangs la rtse sor do go la sor phyed do yod pa sbra pa grong gas ba padma rab gan gyi do dam bya na gzigs mor 'a du dngar ba tshil snang du byam pa chosakyi lor lor phul spu byams pa'i ldom khi mthong ba'i skal yong /byams brtse'i char gyis 'gro ba'i zhe sdang me//zhi nas bdag gas brje ba'i sems bskyed cing //yom bu'i gling 'dir khyod nyid 4sa rgyas tshe//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog/lcags byi rang byon lnga ldan gyi dbu rgyan rnying pa'i steng du slar gser grang lnga 133na〉snan pa'i bkod pa legs su btang /gci sa tig sogs phra rnying ga gang 'dug gis sbras na khra 'brug jo mo sgrol mar phul bsrong bzha bzhed pa'i re skong /'jigasachen brgyad sogs srid zhi'i sdug bsngal las//'gro kun nyer sgrol khyad par bod 'bangs rnams//bde skyid dpal la sbyor cig tā rī kye//srong btsan sgam po'i bzhed pa lhun grub mdzod/lcag byi zla nga gnyis pa'i nyer lnga nas 'go ga mis zla ba sto pa'i nyer brgyad la grub pa'i dbu ༅ dar dpyangs snyan rgyan dang bams po gser zho byed lnga brgyal lha pa brdungs su bya par g.yu grangs sum brgyar nye ba/mu tig sto brgya skor/shel bdun stolhag bcas kye sbra bgrong gsar nga padma rab brtan gyi do dam byas nas sgyu ma'i kheng pa 'phrog pa'i bkod leg 'phrul snang du dung skyong rgyal mor phu4shā kha yig gi sto legs rdza sa grub/nges pa'i don du rdo rje dbyings phyug ma//sna tshogasa'agro blo'i ngo por gdong bzhi pa'i//mche ba las zhabrungs dri za'i bu mo de//dung skyong rgyal mo'i sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan mas//rgya hor bod yul kun tu rgud pa'i mun//rab zhi phan bde'i snang bsalegs khyab cing //cod pan 'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad pa rnams//srid zhi'i legs tshogis lhun gyis grub par mdzod/lcag byi gdan tsho po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi dri gtsang khang sogs su thung pa tshul khrimatshoms gtsos pa'i rten gsum slar bsgrigs bkod byas pa'i deng ga kho gyi 'go brjod ngo mtshar phreng ba spel legs/133ba'i gro 'dir bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing //thub dbang de'i gsung slob mar bcas//phan bde'i 'bras bzang stsol mdzad pa'i//sngon med yongs 'du'i ljon pa rgyal//sangs rgyas kun gyis gang gzigs shesabya'i gnas//ma lus gsal bar mkhyen pa'i blo gros kyis//skal bzang 'gro la chos kyi grags pa'i sgra//sgrog mdzad kun mkhyen btsong kha pa la 'dud//bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing khams rdul snyed du//gsang gsum bkod pa'i ngo mtshar sgyu dra'i gar//legs bstan las dag skye rgu'i spyod yul can//ngo mtshar gnas kyi pha mtha' stims su klas//'on / mchog dman lus can 134nas ga shes kyi//

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnayul gyur sal gnas pa'i 'og min zhing / khung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi 'byung gnas che/ /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling zhes grags/ /ji snyed dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma lus pa/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i ga rjo la/ /mthong bas don ldan thos las rnam grol ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi snang brnyan tshar du dngar/ /bkod legs 'phreng bar spel sogs sri zhu yi/ /bsod nams rab dkar thod bcings mi na ka /'jam mnyen shing gi ma ma'i ngos yangs por/ /zlos gar bsgyur ba'i gzigs mor 'di na che/ /zhes pas sngun bsus te dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spel ba'i slad du ngur smig 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul bstan pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du/'phags yul ba sa spru lhan du 'bod pa kun ldan zhes pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo chu shel gyi dbang po ston gyis nya ba'i tshes grangs dge bar thub dbang tshul khrims mas gtso byas rten gsum rnams slar yang gsar bsgrigs byas pa'i deb gter gyi rim pa la/lcag byi'i lo rgyal khrims kyi byed por grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ rgyal po mched gnyis/ ju nang sogs (134ba)khrom thog nas mdzod kyi khur len du bskos skab thamag gsar du bskrun pa'i tham phud rdzo shākya 'phags pa lo sa sha ra dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang byug ma gsum la phul ba'i kha yig gser gyi gnya' shing 'dzin ri/ su sti pradzā naḥ dge leg tha(tsho gis gnyis sa bon yongs smin las/ /chos gzugs stong bu yal 'dab rab rgyas rtser/ /phan bde'i 'bras bu g.yur du za ba yi/ /thub dbang dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa'i drung / /ma smad phun tshogasabasod nams mang la yangs par/ /chos srid gser gyi sgo nga dar drag pa/ /sdebazhi'i ri mo rnam bkra tham spu'i phud/ /mi phyed dad dang gus pas phul ba'i dges/ /khrims gnyis gdugs dkar rab 'khor grib bsil la/ /bstan dang skye rgu bde bar ngal gso ba'i/ /bsams don lhun gyis grub pa nor bu'i tog /'od kyis 'jig rten ma lus snang bar shog /gangs can lha gcig lag na pad dkar —153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)'chang / /'phags mchog dkyus ring spyan gyi bhra ma ra/ /rab bkra tham ga'i 'dab brgya ba 'ad pa'i dbus/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i ze 'byur dgyes rol te/ /khrims gnyis gser gyi gnya' shing 'dzin pa'i ri/ /mchog dman kun la mngon par rab lci bas/ /chen po bod kyi ljongs 'dir sum rtsen grong / /'phos 'dra'i bde skyid dga' ston la spyod cing / /mgon khyod gdul bya'i zhing gyur swā la'i ljongs/ /bur rgyal bod kyi yangs pa'i rgyal khab 'dir/ /chos nor 'dod dang thar lam sde bzhi pos/ /(135na)legs khyab rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston stsol/ khams gsum kun las rgal ba'i mthu stobasagyis/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma ti/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan srung mas rtsal can/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gang de'i drung / /ri mo g.yas 'khyil tham ga'i dung dkar po/ /drang thig khrims kyi sgra dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa/ /'dren byed thos 'dzin yul du legasabastar bas/ /lha khyod dgyes zhal rtse dga' khong nas 'thu pa/ /mi bsrun gzhan srid ba dan sal stol//rang sde rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon sgrongs/ /chos srid nyi zla zung du 'jug pa'i 'od/ /rab yangs nor 'dzin kun la khyab par mdzod/ /lcags byi'i lo mchod yon thun mong gi tham ka dmar po gsar du bskrun pa'i tham phud 'dod khams dbang phyug mar phul ba'i kha yig 'dzam gling 'dod 'jo'i mngal khur sogs/srid gsum bdag mo 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i nor 'dzin 'dod 'jo'i mngal/ /dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che'i/ /chos dang srid kyis lci ba'i dga' ston stsol/ /lcag byi'i lo bstan 'dzin dwa yan rgyal po'i tham phud jo bo shākya mu ni dang dpal ldan lha mor phul ba gan mo kun la dbang —156

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnasgyur/bla med ye shes dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon//mtshan dpe'i 'bras bzang dud pa ro brgya'i bcud//yongs su smin pa'i nyi ma'i gnyen gyi 135ba'i//sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos po gcig gyur drung //gnam dang sa yi dkyil 'khor yangs pa la//bka' rtags phyag rgya gcig gis mnga' sgyur bas//nor 'dzin dbang po grub pa'i ming gi gzugs//rnam bkra ri mor legs shar tham ga'i phud//nyer phul bsod nams brgya pa'i dngos po'i lus//nyi ma 'bum gyi dpal 'dzin gzi 'od kyis//rtsod pa'i mun pa pha mthar yongs bskrad de//bde skyid rdzogs ldan gnyis pa'i dga' ston stsol//dam gzor mar/gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor kun la bsod nams kyi//rtsibs stong 'khor los ma rga par dbang bsgyur te//'jig rten kun tu rtogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron//'gugs pa'i skal bzang legs thob dga' ston stsol//mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od mtshon snang byed rgyun//mnyam med shākya mu nir phul ba yis//ngag dbang blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde//'og min zhing gi mgon ltar brtan gyur cig/mchod sprin stob byed bsam grub rgyal po sogs//tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rab 'phel zhing //yang srid kun tu rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal//de don nyams blangs sangasargyas thob par shog/ces jo bo shākya mu nir rgyun mchod btsugs pa'i kong gi zhal byang 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/lcags glang hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas 'go tshoms hor zla bdun pa snga ma'i tshes lnga'i nyi ma me bsto 'grub sbyor la jo shāka yid bzhin gyi nor bur gser ljang brdungs la rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra bkod pa'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs36na〉zha rgyan dang bcas grong gsar ba padma ra spu brtan gyis do dam byas na ngo mtshar bkod legs phul ba'i kha yig chos gzugs gser gyi snye ma/chos gzugs gser gyi snye ma yongs dud pa//tsho gos gnyis 'bras smin sdong bu dar babs dpyid//don kun grub pa rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras//sngon med dpag bsam yongs 'du'i zhal skyin la//bkod legs nor bu'i phras mdzes gser sbyangs kyi//cod pan phul pas nges pa lnga ldan ltar//'phrul snang zhing 'dir mi g.yo rtag bzhugs nas//bde skyid snang bas bstan 'gro kun khyab shog/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)tshul 'dir sgo gsum 'bad dang mthun pa'i rkyen/ /spel rnams 'di phyi'i legs tshogis kun 'grub cing / /mkha' mnyam ma rgan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /lcags glang hor zla bdun par jo bo rin po cher dbu rgyan snya sa dar dbyangs dang sa phul ba'i kha byang tshigs bcad lhug snyan rgyan g.yas g.yon la bkod godage tsho gis mi dag ter bum/ma 'dris snyan rgyan g.yas kun la brtse ba'i thugs rje'i rlabs/ /yol med sgrib bral gzigs pa'i spyan gyi dkyus/ /ring po brgyud lnga'i 'gro la nyer 'jug ba/ /gdul dka' gdul mdzad bu ram shing pa kye/ /bdog pa spel dang lag tu bstar ba'i 'bras/ /deng nas byang chub bar du zla zhun ltar/ /rab dkar phung po zad pa med pa'i rgyun/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /do dam rab stims kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang / /sdings chen blo bzang dbang phyugazung gi stengs/ /grong gsar padma rab brtan rnam dpyod kyi/ /bkod pas khyad 'phagasagazigs mor (136bsor du dngar/ /rdzu dha a mra sing dang la na shrī/ /mu ne dzña de su rtsa'i bal bu yi/ /sor mo'i 'phrul gyis zlos gar bsgyur ba'i tshe/ /sgyu ma mkhan yang khengs skrungs 'os su byas/ /ka ca'i 'brel 'jog dngos dang brgyud pa nas/ /dge 'dis bskrun pa'i byed por gtogos so cog /'jigasachen brgyad sogs rgud pa rnams zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen kun tshang bsam pa lhun grub shog /yang srid kun tu theg chen chos dang mjal/ /dad brtson shes rab tshe 'byor legs tshogos tshang / /ring min mu mtha' bral ba'i skye rgu rnams/ /'dren phyir rnam pa thams cad mkhyen gyur cig /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par gangs can 'dir/ /'thab rtsod nad mug 'byung ba zhabrug la sogs/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i nyes brgya drung phyung ste/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i rtse dga' dgod par shog /rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid de 'dzin sde dang sbyin pa'i bdag /nyi zla zung du nyer 'brel 'od snang gis/ /rab yangs nor 'dzin kun la khyab par shog /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i nor bu ge ta gas/ /rnam smin nag po'i dri ma drungs byas te/ /lus can rnams kyi grangs ring skye ba'i chur/ / phan bde'i bzhin ras gsal bar 'char gyur cig /—/58

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzheng dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)su sti bra dzā ༷ ཿsa sa gabon/longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du bzhugs pas na jo bo shākya mu ni brtan par bzhugs pa'i ched du chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa rṣa pos dbu rgyan phul ba 'di byin gas dang rten phrel gyi rgyun la ma yis par 137na phrod pa legs par mthong bas rang sor bzhag/gsar du bstan 'gro'i bde thabs dang tsho gos gsog gi rsā du nged rang gi bkod pa ltar mdzod ba grong smad pa phren las rgya mtshos khur blangs/do dam 'phyong rgyas rab stims pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/grong gsar ba padma rab brtan/cas li ba blo bzang dbang phyug/brdung 'phul phra gsum gyi bzo bo rdzu dha na/a mra sing /lan shrī/mu ni/dzñā na de ba/su rtsa rnams dang /gzigs mor sgo du dngar ba'i phun rdzas bkod pa'i khyad par grong gsar pa padma rab brtan gyi blo gros yangs pa'i sgo 'phar las nye bar 'thon pa'i cod ban snyan rgyan dang tsos 'di zhal 'debs kyi gser zho drug cu re brgyad the ba'i gser zho stong dang lnga brgya bdun cu skor/pha bong khe gdan sa pos ma dbyang grags pa/ra bcums pos dga' gas won/sgo rang mas po chosagrag gyo mtsho/grong gas rab/rtag rub/gabs sa dar ba/mkhar sa pa/skyar rdzob/gong rgyas shag dgo dgos/byang gling bzugang rgyal po/pu shud pa/zhi 'a pa/sbyar ra ba/spus grang gser kha pa/nabs smad pa/gong das bsod namasarnam kyi gser/zhal 'debs kyi g.yu glan tsor ya tha dang grang ru lhas gnang gi gtsug ga tshul nonor dang lha tshesagasag kyu/brgya dang bzhi bcu the ba'i g.yu stong dang dgu brgya skor//zhal 'debs g.yu pad gsum the ba'i g.yu pad grong gsar lidma rab gan/tso lha/lha spyi kha pa gsum gyi phung sgor/bco brgyad dang mu tig lnga brgya skor/dngul srang sum cu skor sogs las bskrun te rab byung bcu gcig pa'i 'gal ba zhes ba lcags mo glang gi lo hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes tshog nas dbu brtsams/137bstang zla bdun pa'i 'gor pho brang chen po po ta lar grub pa sa spru kā le su sti dza ( //lcagayang sto zla sku na ye nang du ra spo'aphrul snang gi deb gter gsar du phug pa'i dkar chaganam mkha' mdzod kyi gter/sdes sbyor me lha ge phreng 'dzin/ska rjeb lha dig/da ṭa ka bha wa lha lha gu6wa shā sa/nā /bya0ni mi gis ba na dhar tsā yi sto:ri re/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)bā mo tsarmādha spo ṣṭhanta spo bha wa tam tshwa gom hā ku lu(be karmā ྅ shākya rā sgo pa a wa tar pa ṭos na mo3sgo ta men/ /tshogs gnyis phung por spungs pa'i shugs kyis srid zhi'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /dbang du sdud pa'i mtshan dpe'i lang tsho nyi ma bye ba'i lus 'dzin bas/ /mig sman ltar gnag 'khor mun mthar byed 'phrin lasasnang ba 'od po che/ /ris med 'gro la nye bar 'jug mkhas shākya seng ger spyi bos 'dud/ /byamasabartse'i tshal du sa bon smin tsam nas/ /srid pa'i gdung skyob sgrib tu nyer bsil ba'i/ /thugs rje'i yal 'dab mthon por yongs dud pa/ /mi pham pad dkar can (138na)zung 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /gtsug lag ba gam brtsegs pa'i ri byi'i rnar/ /rgyal dang de sras rdul snyed gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /dog min gcig tu spungs pa'i 'phrul snang zhes/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis rtse dga' rgod/ /rigs gsum mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gar mkhan ma/ /'od gsal lha rigs dmu thag lam brgyud de/ /zla med gnam bskosayangs pa'i khab chen po/ /legs byon chos rgyal mu tig 'phreng bzhin mdzes/ /khyad par gdengs can zhags dkris lhun po'i shing / /snying stobs khyab 'jug lag bstar srid pa'i mtsho/ /bsrubs lasaphan bde'i bdud rtsis sde bzhi yi/ /'chi med dga' ston dbang phyug srong btsan rje/ shes byar srid la 'khrul pa phra mo'i chas/ /gos min tshad ma'i ston pa thams cad mkhyen/ /brjod pa ma nor blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yab gyur khyed min su/ /'jig rten brlang por spyod pa'i gnya' ba na/ khrims gnyis gser shing 'dzin ri mngon lci ba/ /dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che'i/ /chos srid nyi zla'i 'od snang zung du 'bar/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos kun dbang du bsdu ba'i mdzod/ /mi zad nam mkhar spyod pa rnam thos bu'i / /rin cen gter gyi ne la'i khar 'bab pa'i/ /nor bu'i chu rgyun deb gter 'di na 'khyil/ /zhes snyan 'gyur gyi tshig gis sngun bsus te lha rnams kyis ched du brjod pa don dang ldan pa'i bzang po'i bskal ba 'dir 'dul (138bar ka'i 'gro ba la ches cher brtse ba'i snying stobs kyis 'dren par thugs bskyed pa rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po'i bstan pa rin po che ni/ lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis —160

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga / khomanastong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar lo grangs de snyed song ba na dbus 'gyur 'chang nas bod yul du rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar ba yin cing / de la yang gdul bya'i zhing zhig dgos pas/ /thugs rje chen po dang sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa'i phrug gu gdong dmar sha zan gyi rigs las mi'i rgyal khams su gyur pa'i bod spyi'i rgyal por mang pos bkur ba'i brgyud las rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i sras rje gnya' khri btsan bo nas bzung rgyal rabs so gnyis kyi bar du byon pa rnams kyang rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul ba sha stag yin zhing / khyad par cho me kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /li tsa byi rnams rigs su byung / /de yang sngags kyis don bsgrubs te/ /longs spyod tshe dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rig ba longs spyod ldan zhes bya/ /mi yi bdag pos de yang grub/ /lo ni brgyad 〈rgyal srid bya/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten sgrol ma zhes grags dang / /lha mo gos dkar mo dang ni/ /dkar mo chen mo gzhan phan brtson/ /zhes sogs kyis lung bstan (139na)pa ltar 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa srong btsan sgam po bod yul gyi mi rje dang / sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gnyis kyi sprul pa kong jo dang khri btsun rgya bal gyi rgyal po'i sras mo sprul pa'i tshul gyis phan tshun gnyen du sbrel bar bsnyad nas sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par med pa'i jo shāka yid bzhi gyi nor bu zung spyan drangs/thog mar chos rgyal yab yum gsum gyis skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po bsgrubs/ bod srin mo gan rgyal du nyal ba'i dbyibs kyis sa'i me rtsa la mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi lha khang brgya gnyis brtsigs/ /sa dpyad ngan pa rnams bcos te ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang 'di nyid bstan pa dang skye rgu'i bde skyid kyi nyer 'tshor bzhengs te bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog dam par bzhugs pa la mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu dang rgya hor ya rtse'i rgyal po sogs mchog dman bar pa'i skye rgu thams cad kyis sri zhu rgya cher bskrun cing / khyad par khams —161—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)gsum chos kyi rgyal po thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal ni/'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/yi ge dang po ba grags pa//sdom brtson thams cad grags pa yang //ston ba'i bstan pa gsalabar byed/khes dang /bka' khol mar/de nas khyad par bsnyen bkur cher mdzad pa'i//dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku zhakhrungs pa//gsang sngags 'chang zhing rnal 'byor chen po ni//snying po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pa des//zhal 139bsgong bsgyur cing bsnyen bkur dam pa mdzad//cesapa ltar 'gro ba spyi dang bye brag bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi legs byas kyi dpal du rin po che'i dbu rgyan gyi rten 'brel nas brtan bzhugs/zhig gsos/cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus ston gyi rgyun la sogs pas mtshon te lha ldan gyi rten brten par bcas pa la gcig tu mdzad pa rgya che ba yin zhing /de yang bskal bzang las/nam mkha' dag gi tshad dag bzung ba dang //rgya mtsho chen po mthar gyi bgrang nus kyis//sangs rgyas dag la dad pa shes tsam gyi//bsod nams tshad bzung bar ni nus pa dka'//ji srid mya ༅ 'das bde ma reg bar//de srid mi khom sdug bsngal myong mi 'gyur//de bas rgyal ba bsod nams zhing thob nas//bag yod mi yis bkur sti mchod par bgyi//zhes gsungs pa ltar legs byas kyi 'bras bu mtha' dang tshad du gzung ba'i yul las 'gong pa'i mchod sprin mchog dman bar ba kun gyis bskrun pa rnams chud mi 'dza' ba'i ched du tshal pa drung chen sogs sde bdag rim byung rnams kyis de ba 'khod rnying pa tshor chad bsubs gsar 'jug sogs kyi brje sprod rim gyis song 'dug rung /jo shāka gi 'phrin las zad mi shes pas gser 'bul rim 'phar la brten/nye lam rab byung bcu gcig pa'i 'phar ba zhes pa lcags mo glang gi lo hor zla bdun pa nyis brtsegs kyi phyi ma'i dus lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi mchod dzos dkar chag deb gter du bkod pa la/bod yul kyi rdo rje gdan ra sa tshil140na skong gi gtsug lag khang du/rdzo shan yid bzhin gyi nor bu thog drang pa'i mchod yul dam pa rnam kyi spyan sngar gser dngul la grub pa'i maṇḍal ri ra pa mngon pa lug su bya pa'i gsar bzo lcag glang hor zla bdun pa'i nyis brtseg kyi tshes bcu gsum la la grwa /khyugs/chu rtog nag pa zla ba'i nang du leg par grub na phul

sku gsung thug rten gsar bstos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar ga/ 'daba'i mu ga stod smad kyi kha yig rdzo bar lhug ṣka kha rgya mtshor sbung pa'i leg byas/ga lo/tshan na sde ge sbyor me kho phreng gno//du:rya pa lhar dza snye9tsho pa ri skas༅da ṭa:skru/gu dza me ste sa ma ba the yas dziḥpuskayi bhā blo ka ti//snyo khams ngo ma' bkod pa rgya mtsho rdul//bsod nams phung po yongs su spungasaba'i gzugs//kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du legs spel nas//rgyal sras slob mar bcas la phul ba'i dges/ 40bashrī su khri ya pra pa tsā su pa lha shu shornyo da niḥb dar adhe gtsa//ā ga mā ka lnga zhiḥshā sa nā ba rṣa kā la su/lorka0bya waṅgādza tsā//phan bde'i dpal gyi gos bzang rab dud pa//stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang zasagatsang sras po yi//lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa dbyar dus kyi//zla ba'i ma ma ji bzhi 'phel bar 3gag/4nas sprugazhu su lha kirti'i shes ma/kho khri rtsa miḥsu dharmā rṣa kaḥshanta bha sa dzam kye gaṇa sheya yaḥd lngar grwa karasnye rya dzod ya tsa//khyad par kun ma' blo bzang grags pa yi//ma smad bshad dang sgrub pa'i ringasalugs cho me//srid zhi'i legs sa zung du 'jug pa gang //2skal pa rgya mtshor bzhi cing rgyasapar sna ga/4b.lo kaṅgā toḥn pa tsā pha lā pā pa rog bra pā dwa da ri kā la:ta/di rdzu brgyas skra tiñtsa sha rmi su khro stonazhe4re tu khu dzā//'jig rten khams su 'thab rtsod nad mug dang //dus min 'chi sogs sdig to'i 'bras mi smin/ /ring por 'tsho snyo phun lis 'byor ba rgyas//bde skyid dga' ston mag la spyod par shog/4nabakṣa rir pā maṇḍal lus rnyi kyag snyil ā bīrla spo/tsho::kya e 'al:yasaḥ.aḥnirwastog ga lnga dza lusang ga yid kyis mchode pa'i maṇḍal//tshul bzhin bsgrub la 'bad par ga rtagasasocog/deng nas kun mkhyen thob min de srid du//bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub par shog/6

rgyas dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)tā ri kā grel me snyiḥkhas mya sus dzagaḥshanta bha bya di bī ti ṇi tsa/pā shu ā dharmā ratna di pe pā ri ṇa ma tri kā yasutsi nywam kho〈re ka/dge ba'i gzings kyis mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun//'khor dang myang 'das rgya mtsho las bsgral te//chos kun gzigs pa'i rin po che'i gling du//sku gsum yid bzhin nor bur spyod par bsngo/ 43nakoṣa tsākra kṣa su badzi nu〉ku rgyu ku litsā sa nā kwa ya dri yi btsa/meg lu ni mi sten dza ya adhiṣṭha na belā li teḥkān ṇa sarba dwa/ rgyal kun gsang gsum mi zad 'khor lo'i mgon/ /mthong ba'i don ldan nyi ma'i gnyen gyi skur//rnam par rol pa'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis//dus kun ba po shis mtshan mas rgyal gyur cig/su sti sidhe bra dza raḥ'achi ba med pa'i snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis lan brgyar bsngags pa'i bzang po'i bskal pa 'di la rnam 'dren stong gi dbus na snying stobs mchog tu gyur ba'i rnam 'dren bu ram shing pa dngos dang khyad par ma mchis par sangs rgyas nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes shing nges pa'i don du gyur pa ston pa'i zhal skyin shākya mu ni phul byung bsod nams bye ba'i zhing mchog dam par nges pas yid drangs te kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang //143bcud par khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha chen po'i ring lugs dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing /mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag gnas skabs su rdzogs ldan gyi dpal bzhin bde skyid la longs su spyad de myur du don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob pa'i ched du zla zhun lan brgyar byugs pa'i gangs kyi lhun po ltar dkar pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pas kun nas blangs te/khor yug gcig tu gyur pa yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhin lhun po gling bzhi gling phran lha mi'i phun tshogs 'byor ba'i bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan tshar du dngar ba'i zhing khams so bdun ma 'di nyid/nged rang nas rgyu mtshan smed pa ltar mdzod pa grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos khur blangs/do dam grong gsar ba padma rab brtan/sdings chen pa blo bzang dbang phyug/mngon dga' ba ngag dbang tshe ring gsum gyis byas te/grong gsar ba'i rnam dpyod ༷ngas pa'i rig rtsal gyi 'phrul chen pos bzo phyed

yi dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tshom/ ()dam pa'i mdzod//srid snyo la tsho nub spangs pa'i brtse ldan spyan//dkyus ring lor ba'i mtha' brgal shākya'i gtso//45nabhā wa taskru mu lkos ri dzñā nas1kya skur dzākṣa lha su tsa/ /'a li bha bā yums rje ta yokhar grekhukog dngos dang de sras slob ma gaṅgā'i rdul//ye shes sa dpar yongs su bzhu ba'i khams//phrul snang snod bas dag ba'i rten brten pa//bsod nams bye ba'i wo gi rtse mor son//145bag bhā rim/ma su3dha re:dhe nā tsā lha wo bsil/sa8hom le khukhu tsaka mtshaḥko0mās kā ātpa ga/nor 'dzin bu mo 'dod pa'i mngal khur gyis//ma' par dud pa'i rin wo maṇḍal ra//dus gsum byas dang byed tsor bsod nams kun//bsdus te nam mkha' mdzod du legs 'bul na/ 46nags/lnga bya pā gas thag kha sa māḥg bā/4bā rje dzā ra nā thaḥg pos rdzo84lkosos rdzan//sems༅ bas pa'i pha mtha' de srid du//mgon khyod rnam dkar wen las rdzogasamin kyang //snyigs mar ches spyod rgyar tsoms ma rgan rnams//mgon po thugs rje'i phyag rkyong dbugs dbyung gsol/ 46b.lo ka sum rgya bee she97tsosaḥphaXpā pa su mā stan beeḥs khri/bhā ཿsu dha nā 'a ku khya ta rnyed ni snamalumis/'ag rten spyi dang ༅ par gangs ro 'dir//smogos sa zhi sa ldan gsar pa'i grogs//tha tshigs de'i rgyu gas shing pa //da dang sna ba pa'i bska pa rgyas gyur cig/47nashrī nas ses bha me kusaḥtshom dharmāḥbya di ba na/nas dzo bha25sko༅chu a gre3:7pa te sgo//dga' ba'i dpal ldan chos srid zung tshol bstan//phun rdzos sde bzhi g.yas su sul ba'i dung //blo bzang snyan pa'i grags pa lhun yi kho/cha med bdag tsho pho brang rtser sgrogs shog/47ba.ā gteḥd rta ma swā dha rgyan ba su bi rje raḥkhi/kāḥyi/ wa rṣa kā mukta lwa dwas a tro kha rdze su

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khog dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sa / 6)bha gye bha bi yis tsa/ /zhing khams gsar bskrun byed por rta rtag gas kun gyi/ /sgo gsum brtson pa'i bsod nams phung po las/ /'di dang gtan mdun mu tig 'khri shing char/ /'bab pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /sarba dā mig la shra ya bra yas ring nas goms pa'i tsho gos gnyis chu gter phul byung brtson pa'i ri bo yongs su dril ba las sku gnyis bdud rtsi'i za ma tog mngon du gyur bas spang rtogs kyi yon tan 'og min du mngon par mdzad zin kyang / bzang po'i bskal pa 'di la mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa ston cing ston par 'gyur ba stong gi nang nas 'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs kyi go cha btsan pos rang cag snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i rmu rgod gdul dka'i gdul bya rnams (148na)'dren pa la lhag bar dpa' ba'i kun mkhyen zas gtsang gi sras po'i sku brnyan jo bo shākya mu ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam par grol ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog zla med par yid gnyis kyi rgya las yongs su grol ba'i nges par yid drangs te/ rnam 'dren shākya seng ge'i sde snod gsum dang rgyud sdebazhis bsdus pa'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par 'jam dbyangs mi yi srid pa'i gar mkhan thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i ring lugs yar ldan du rgyas pa dang / mu mtha' med pa'i srid mtshor lan gcig ma yin par drin gyisabaskyangs pa'i ma rgan mkha' mnyam gyi lus can mtha' dag sangs rgyas zhes bya'i mtshan gyis gragasasnyan can de'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa dang / tshul de thob par ma gyur pa de srid kyi bar du'ang nad mtshon g.yul 'khrug mu ge dus min 'chi dang 'jigs chen brgyad sogs dkar min gyi 'bras bu mtha' dag ming gi lhag mar gyur nas ma ga par mtho ba'i yang srid kyi 'phreng ba kun tu ring por 'tsho zhing phun tshogs kyi dpal 'byor la longs su spyod pa sogs bde skyid kyi dga' ston rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i ched du lhag pa'i bsam pas kun nas blangs te/ rin cen lhun po gling bzhi gling phran lha mi'i 'dod yon ma smad mkho rgu'i 'byor ba yangs pa'i sa chen por yongs su bstar ba'i zhing khams so bdun ma 'di nyid nged rang nas mo la mchid (148ba)byas pa ltar mdzod pa grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya —167—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)mtshos khur blangs/do dam lha khang pa blo bzang dbang rgyal/mkhar ldan pa 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang /lha sbug pa blo bzang shes rab/phogs sogs 'phral dgos sprod mi byang gling bsam 'grub rgyal po//rdung 'phul phra gsum gyi bzo rig pa'i tshul la rnam dpyod 'phrul gyi sgyu thabs mkhan 'phul pa rdzu dha na/la na shrī/sa rdza/dha na mu ni/dzñā na pā la/brdung pa a mar sing /ha ri sing /bi nu sing /bkra shis/phra pa la na sing /mu ni/sung/bi dza rā/brdar gad pa ha ku/lwa lha'i yig rigs pa gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/bod yig pa dpal ldan phun tsho gis rnams kyis bgyis shing /dngul srang drug brgya/gser zho sum brgya skor gyi dngos po las nye bar bsgrub te/bstod 'grel ba'i bshad srol ltar rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du shwa bha gi zhes 'bod pa/'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khab tu zhin yin du grags shing /bsil ldan swā la'i ljongs 'dir dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo'i dag byed zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gsum pa lhag pa lha mtshams 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi dus dge bar dbu btsugs/lo de kha'i hor zla bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor la legs par grub pa'i dge bas 'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang /khyad par rgya hor bod kyi rgyal khams su phan bde'i dpal gyi dga' ston gyis yongs su khyab pa'i bkra 149na dbyangs rtag tu sgrogs par gyur cig/mam ma zhe ga lha sa mā sirnyi sham ma shanta3prakṣi lta phyasaḥdzagaḥsu kha sham bti kurba skyo//lus༅ tso la ris su ma ho pa'i sgyi nor gso nga rig pa'i gas lag tso gyi yang snying dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i par kur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos zhus dag mdzad pa'i par rnyang la ma dpe bya te chu stag gi lo dga' ldan phun tshogs gling dugs ra du bskos pa'i du kyi par byang lo med rga sku'i gan yi//rtsam sprul zhing lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer nas//rig pa'i ye shes gzugasagazhan ༷ ༷ ba//srog 'tsho'i mchod sbyin 'gyed mkhas byang ngos pa//gso rig dar rgyas byed pos bskul ba las//yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i bcud//'khrul med glegs bam za ma tog 'khyil ba//slar yang yid bzhin 'dod pa ༷/ ba'i par//sdebazhi'i dpal ldan po ta la nas

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar sa/ (mnaspel//gad spa dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che'i//chos srid rgya mtshor drang srong byang ngosapa'i//brtson tsos lcag gis ri bo yongs sgril bas//'dzad med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang gsar du 'thon//gang de'i kha byung zil dngar ro brgya'i bas//skal bzang lus can yongs kyis legasamyangs pas//'jig rten mes po'i tswa tshul ji bzhi srog/ring por 'tsho ba'i tshul las gas du ci/gags/khye yi rig byed dran pa tshangs pa'i rgyud//gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i rnam dpyod mig/dkyus ring gzhung brgya'i mtha' 'jal byang ngos pa'i //ston mtshan zla 'dra'i lhag 49bsgos ma gyis bskul tshe/khyud bzhi'i 'chi med gtsug tor reg tsam gyis//lha gcig rje yi lus su 'gyur byed pa'i//gzhan phan dbang gi rgyal po'i gter gyi sgo//gnam bskos rgyal khab po ta la nas phye//beeḍūs/sa:bā su ni mi snya18niḥsha rigatoḥdi lha ka tshu/sheko chu sta pa na ro bā:nā thosa'anāñtsa yos ntabhawa su su dha//ye shes nyi ma'i dngos po brgya yi lus//mas bzang bai ḍūr sa mar 'khyil ba'i khams/khrod zhi'i nad kyi gdung sel sman gcig bur/grub pa'i dpal gyi bla na ma wa zhe mtho'i mgon//gang gis ngo mtshar bkod pa'i lta na sdug/yid 'phrog sman gyi grong khyer nyams dga' bar//sprul pa'i drang srong gnyis kyi dris lan las//byin rlabs ro brgya'i bka' yi g.yang zhig chags//'dzad med bskal par gnas150nasgo ring po'i tshe//bsgrub pa'i srog 'tsho'i bcud len bdud rtsi'i ga kho//mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar legs phye ba//ris med skye rgu'i bsod namasazong gis rnyed//khyad par khri srong rje yis gangs ro 'dir//skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa spyan drangasapa'i//drin las snying rje'i yul gyur 'gro ba'i srog/'tsho ba'i gso rig gtsug lag 'byams su klas//de 'dra'i rig byed rgyu skar phreng ba'i dbus//li yi don rgyas rgyud bsto chu shel dbang //don gyi paṇa rpā 'jig rten mig snyag pu//bee ro'i ma' dpyod rma gi shing rtas drangs//sman gyi bla ma'i gsung rab 'o ma'i bcud//rang bzo'i chu yis bslad pa mi 'jug wo//gsang ba'i phyag rgyar rgyasabato sgo 'byed mkhan//sprul pa'i gter ston grwa ༷ 9mngon shes zhabs//dri med ring lugs ro med

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)gaṅgā'i rgyun//thos bsam tshangs pa'i ral klung nas 'bebs pa'i//g.yu thog mgon po'i ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i 'phrul//rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor spro bsdu'i byed por nges//gang de'i legs bshad ma dros chu bo las//'chi med lha yi rje bo dal 'gro'i rgyun//gangs can 'dzin ma'i khyen kun ma lus par//babs pas tshangs pa o yig zol gyis rdzu//'on te snyigs mar spyod pa'i khung bu nas//'khyog 'gro'i nyes par bshad pa'i lce brkyangs te//'gro ba'i srog la rgol ba gdug pa'i sprul//'chi 150babadag sman pa'i gzugs ga bsgyur bas gang //de'i tshe bee sgyu rya 'od sgyu dra'i gar//zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje khu dbon sogs//gso rig byed po'i dpyod ldan mang po yis//'gro rnams phan bde'i kun dga' khong nas 'dzu pa//de phyir gna' bo'i lugs zhes phyogs 'dzin gyi//ris su ma bcad lus can spyi yi nor//dpal ldan rgyud bzhi yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//blo gros rgyal posadrungs ba 'di ko mtshar//bod yul tshe yi rig byed mtho ris4//thos brtson lho kyis 'thung la mi ngal ba'i//byang ngos bstan 'dzin rgyal po dzaḥs//slar skyugs gso rig gaṅgā ho pa med//rgan po'i gtsug lag gdugs dkar rang rigs bur//gtad pa'i legs bshad yu ba nyer bzung nas//'gro mang bde ba'i grib mar ngal gso ba//de 'dra lha yi sman pa ma yin drang //'on te 'byog blosabarjod min drang po'i gtam//gna' bo'i lugs bzang dzā ti'i me tog dri//kun khyab gangs can ljongs kyi tshangs pa'i bu//dar rgyas mched por bcas pa'i byang ngos pa//gcen de'i lhag bsam dbyar rngas sgra 'dzin mngal//sbrum pas mi zad glegs bam gar mkhan can//phan bde'i spu sdug rnam bkra'i sgro gzhog gdugs//zlum por byas te sgyur la 'di na brel//zur sman legs bshad 'tshol des zhus chen gyis//rnam dag bgrang bya'i khur lcis mi gsal ba//slad mar mchod sbyin brgya phrag 'byed pa'i 151na ) par//nad sel sman gyi bdud rtsi che 'di bskrun//'byung ba'i 'phel 'grub mi mnyam rnon po'i tsher//lus mnar sems la zug rngu 'byin pa'i rma//theng gsos 'chi med bdud rtsi sman gyi bcud//gsar brkos par gyi za ma tog 'a/ra 'khyil//rab dkar dge ba'i sa bon yongs

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (mnasmin pa//legs byas rtsa ba sbom por bskyed bsring pa'i//ring por 'tsho ba tshe yi dbag bsam ljon//'bras bur lus can kun gyis spyod gyur cig/'gro rnams sngon las 'phral rkyen du lta'i nad//tshor ba drag pos mnar ba'i nyam thag kun//tsandan dris bgos tsha gdung mthar byas bzhin//sim pa'i bde ba nam yang gtong min shog/ro nus bzhu rjes bsdebs pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis//nad sel srog gi ka ba legs 'dzugs pa//ris med kun la brtse ba'i gso rig gi/ring lugs srid mtha'i bar du rgyas gyur cig/'khor 'das kun gyi 'du ba zhakhrugs byed gzhi//sgrib gnyis nad kyi rtsa ba drung 'byin pa'i//bla med byang chub mchog gi sman chen por//mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus spyod gyur cig/'di la yongs 'bad brgya byin gtsug gi nor//rin cen sems kyis:na pa'i spyi bo sa/reg pas lasanyon gyis 'phangs mi yi rten//sgrib bral lha yi lus su mngon 'gyur shog/blo gros rgan po'i rtsal 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs//bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i bstan pa la//ches dkar 'phrin las gragasapa'i sgra 51ba bo byangs su//len pa'i bku'i klung de rtag 'bab shog/dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che'i//chos srid nyi zla zung du 'jug pa'i 'od//snang bas 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel bar//'jig rten mes po'i dbang thang thob gyur cig/ring po'i tshe dang phun tsho gos lor pa'i dbyid//lus sems kun la bde skyid ro bda' ba//rnam smin dkar po'i gos bzang kho na la//spyod pa'i rdzogs ldan rtse dga' dgod gyur cig/de ltar mnga' bdag chos skyong ba'i rgyal po tshangs pa lha'i me tog khri srong lde btsan gyis kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas par mdzad pa'i 'phrin las kyi cha shas su gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa gso ba rig pa'i gtsug lag rnams//spyod 'jug las//rgyas sras rnams kyis mi bslab pa'i//dngos de gang yang yod ma yin//zhes pa ltar byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don bsgrub pa la shes bya rig ba'i gnas kun la bslab dgos pa yin zhing /der ma zad las nye rna gyi dbang gis srid par nying mtshamasasbyor ba'i skye rgu mtha' dag dug gsum gyis bskyed ༷'i bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i

rgyal dbang lnga pyong ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)lus la rang bcas su yod pa sngon las 'phral rkyen gyi byed pos 'du ba cha mi snyoms par nad sna tshogs kyis gtses pa'i tshor ba drag po'i ngang tshul myong ba rnams yongs gtad gyi le'ur/'gro ba'i lus 'di 'byung ba bzhi las grub//gso bya'i nad kyang 'byung ba bzhi yis bskyed//gnyen po'i sman yang 'byung bzhi'i ngo bo nyid//lus nad gnyen po bdag nyid gcig par 'brel//zhes gso bya gsobyed gso ba'i yul thams cad phan tshun gcig la gcig 'brel ba'i rten 'brel gyi dbang las/ro nus bzhu rjes bsdebs pa'i sman gyis zla ba gza' las grol ba ltar lusang ga yid gsum la bde ba'i bas len ོ po ster bar byed pa'i lus can kun gyi spyi nor bla na med par dgongs te mtha' dbus kyi sman pa mkhas pa rnams bsdus nas gso rig gi gzhung 'grel mang du bsgyur ba'i nang nas/kha che'i paṇa rpā zla ba mngon par dga' ba dang skad gnyis smra ba lo chen bee ro tsa na gnyis kyis bsgyur ba'i ston pa sman gyi blas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' dri ma med pa dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'di nyid/ji skad du/nyi ma'i 'od kyis zla skar zil gnon bzhi/khyud rgyal 'di yis gso rig kun zil gnon//zhes pa ltar tshig nyung la don rgyas pa gso rig kun gyi yang rtser son pa 'di ma 'ongs pa na lus can gyi srog 'tsho'i bas len du 'gyur bar dgongs te/skyon gyi slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas kyis dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i dbu rtser zab mo'i gter du gsang ba'i rgyas btab pa sprul pa'i gter ston grwa pa mngon shes kyis gdan drangs/rigs 'dusasman rgyal 152ba tha'i gzugs su sprul pa g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos dar rgyas su mdzad de phyogs kun tu 'phel rgyas su gyur na'ang /dus kyi dbang gis gso rig gcig pu ma zad rig pa'i gnas gang la'ang tshul bzhin du bslab pa ches nyung zhing /mi che ge mo dang dud 'gro che ge mo'i sprul pa dag skye ba yin no zhes pa tsam dang /bla ma che ge mo dang rgyal rigs che ge mo dag gi rigs rus lasabyung ba yin no zhes pa tsam gyi zol zog la brten nas tsha 'di'i 'byid thabs lhur len pa mang zhing /mkhas par rlom pa rnams kyang legs bshad rin / ༷'i gter las/bya ba 'ga' la mkhas pa yis//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga / khomanagazhan dag shes pa'i nges pa med/ /chu las 'o ma 'byed shes pa'i/ /ngang pas gzugs brnyan zas su bsgom/ /zhes pa ltar mdo sngags dang tha snyad rig pa'i nang mtshan sna re tsam shes pa la thams cad mkhyen pa dang paṇḍi ṭa sogs ming snyan por 'bod pa rnams kyis phyogs 'di dag la spyan gyi gzigs dkyus thung ngur gyur cing / lugs srol 'di la sbyangs pa'i rgan po'i khur ldan rnams kyang gzhung don la ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa'i drwa bar chud de gso ba rig pa'i gtsug lag gi tshul dri bcas su gyur pa las dus ring po zhig nas/ 'jam dbyangs thon mi gang ṭa'i gdung 'dzin pa nang so yar rgyab pas mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar/ zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rigs brgyud kyi dbon po zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po'am legs bshad 'tshol du grags pas (153na mi chen mdzad de par du brkos pa'i grwa thang gi rgyud bzhi 'di nyid shin tu khungs btsun pa'i gso rig gi bstan pa'i srog shing du 'dug na'ang 'phrin las ha cang ches pas yi ge'i tshogs mi gsal ba mang du 'dug cing / dwags po sgam por sprul sku nor bu rgyan bas gsar brkos zhig mdzad pa 'di kha'i bu dpe yin khul du 'dug kyang /mchan bu rnams logs su bkol te bris pas rtsa mchan ngo 'phrod dka' ba'i skyon dang / rtag brtan sprul skus gsar brkos grwa thang rgyud bzhi'i bu dpe yin khul de la lugs srol 'di dang mi gcig pa'i rigs ldan chen po sogs byang sman mkhas pa'i lugs dang rnam par bsres te lugs gnyis gang du yang ngos bzung dka' ba'i rang gi mdzad srol nyams med de ka yod 'dug pa nas/ dpal ldan zur mkhar ba dang byar po paṇa chen sogs mkhas pa du ma'i legs bshad kyi rgyun rnam dpyod kyi yol gor yongs su 'khyil ba'i drang srong byang ngos pa bstan 'dzin rgyal po'i rigs brgyud 'dzin pa dpon tshang nang so dar rgyas kyis zla gzhen lta bur dkar ba'i lhag bsam gyis grwa thang gi rgyud bzhi 'di ka 'bru len byas nas rko dgos tshul gyis bskul ba dang / snyigs mar spyod pa'i dus kyi dbang gis mdo rgyud tha snyad kyi don la thos bsam byed rlom phal cher gzhung gi stod nas le'u grangs kha shas las gzhung yongs su rdzogs pa la thos bsam byed pa ches nyung bas na/ gso dpyad rnams kyang rtsa bshad phyi —173

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)gsum dang 153bsgon ngag phran bu tsam thos pa la drang srong rpā por rlom pa'i dus 'dir par mkhan rnams kyis sor mo'i 'du byed bsgyur ba ngal ba'i rgyu tsam du 'dug na'ang /rgyal ba sman gyi bla'i thugs rje dang 'gro ba'i legs byas kyi byed pos lha rje ming don mthun pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan pa 'ga' 'byung srid snyam ste spro ba chen po'i sgo nas kha yig gi gsum pa tri/dbu lha dang rgyud so so'i 'jug tu par byang smon lam dang bcas pa gsar du bsgrigs shing /dngos gzhi grwa thang gi par rnying sor bzhag bcos bslad med pa'i sta gon byas pa bzhin phyag mdzod sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtshos khur len gyi bkod pas khyab par byas nas zhus dag pa slob dpon don grub dpal ba/rab 'byams pa dge 'dun chos 'phel/sgra pa kun dga' dbang ldan rnams dang /par yig pa gcen lung pa legasaldan slob mar bcas pa bzhi/par mkhan mkhas pa gzhen nu'i slob rgyud du byung ba yon bdag tshe ring sogs par mkhan nyer bdun dang bcas pa rnams kyis sgo gsum 'bad pas bsgrigs te dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu gcig la dbu btsugs te lo de nyid kyi hor zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer lnga la legs par grub pa la brten nas lus can kun gyi bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang de dag kun gyi rtsab wo mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad kun drung nas phyung ste phul byung bde wo ye shes mchog gi zlor gar rnam 'dren sman gyi bla ma'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig/154na.ā yuḥsdika bāḥs blo hā le tud yas/rang gi gam du nye bar wang pa'i rig sngag 44 phe 2 phe sdo rnam par rgyal tsho 3 ge legs bshad gling pa'i 'du khang lcag byi na mkhar las kyi 'go btsugs chu rtog nang du shing rtsi dang sa grub pa'i gsang sngag pho brang gi ming byang shing yong la bkode pa dngos grus ne kha mdzod/sdong sbyor glogang /sirnyi9loḥko kha shus sna dwa ra rgya/ā dharmā rakṣi7lha lha nu gyi sto suḥ/dngos grub dbang gi rgyal po'i mdzod//dgra bgegs tshogs rnams 'joms pa'i thog/chos skyong srung ma kun 'du ba//gsang ba sngags kyi pho brang dge/154ba 74

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (mnarnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i 'du khang gsang sngags pho brang gi sbug mgon khang zhi khro rnam rol gyi kha byang sgo'i shing bzang la bkod pa zhing khams rgya mtsho sogs// bee dhe re::has79bā ro maṇḍal he ru / shrī/snya zhes ṇḍarshas hi mā shā gi pra nas bee tsa lha kṣa//rigs 'dzin bla ma'i pho brang mchog/he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor che//mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i nyer bzhi'i gnas//dregs pa rnam rol bsil ba tshal//55na ) sde ba sbyor dkar mo/dzñā na ra smi tsitra pañtsa/la su da sdig lha30bakta zhwag lha//pas kṣus ha smra pādma kā ya so bsdu taḥsub ṇi tā rgyarnyikai/ye shes 'od bkrag rigs lngar legs shar dang //phung po gsum pa'i mdor gsungs de bzhin gshegs//sum sto rtsa lnga lag na pad dkar sku//bzang gos gzhi mar gser zhun las grub 'di//blo dang brtson pa lhag bsam bzang po'i mthus//snying stobs yon to dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba/ma rdzo sprin sgra dbyangs spro byed zung ldan gyis//zang zing bdog pa snying po legs sgril tshe//lha rje zur rigs brgyud las nyer son zhing //bzo rig gtsug lag rab dang phul gyi rtser//legs thon sngagasala'i gzhig ka shar pa yi//sor mo'i 'phrul gyi zlos gar 'di lo byung //zla 'od dung dang padma'i rtsa ba la//rab 'gran gcig tu dkar ba'i dge tsho gis rdul//55bsgo thon por brtsegs pa gaṅgā'i yab gcig las//legs byas pa klu'i klung chen chad med shog/bsod nams byas pa gang 'dir ga rta gos so cog/srid zhi'i rgud tsho gis rab zhi 'di phyi kun//bde skyid ro brgya'i g.yang du nyer chagasapa'i//dpag bsam yongs 'du'i 'bras bur spyod gyur cig/ces pa 'di yang mchod dbon blo bzang mthu stobs dang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gnyis kyis rigs lnga dang sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)thugs rje chen po rnams kyi gser thang bzhengs pa'i zhal byang 'dod gsol zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor kyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no//sdeb sbyor nyer gnasatri kā yar bi bhra lha sgo kyi rir dhe45ni/sgo stus ha rluḥ pa pā lu:ru pa khyo:ṣaṭa shāsta tsakra spo mi lu klu the yamem//sku gsum nyi ma'i dngos po brgya yi lus//'dzin pa'i thub dbang 'phrin las 'od stong gis//sdig tos nyer brlams ston pa drug gi dpung //me khyer bag la zha ba'i gto 'di mtshar//tshemasashing sal btsugs pas156na ji ma thag/dpag tshad lnga brgya'i dbangs dang khor yug can/mang rta'i 'phang lo'i tshad kyis me tog las//bre lnga'i bcud shong bongs tshad gos bus du//yal 'dab rtsa ba rin cen sna bdun can//bkrag mdangs la 'a ba nyi zla'i 'od rjes gongs//bdud rtsi la 'gong ro bda' dri bsung ngad//bde ster rma gis bskyod las chos sgra snyan//ngo ma sgo mdzo sum mthong ba'i dad pa dang //rgyal bas chos bstan gos thob lhar skyes sogs//phun tsho gos dge mas rgya mtshor 'gran byed pa'i//bsod nams tshes gcig spel 'di gsal rgyal lo//sngon med rin cen ri mtho zung ldan la//sna tsho gis lha dang mi yi nor bu'i tshogs/kha dog ma 'dres bkra ba 'ja' sto bzhin//'bras smin sgra snyan ljon shing me rtag can//sa 'dzin gcig rtser ro brgya'i dpal ldan pa'i//'bras kyi snye ma g.yur zas mi rnams dang //cig shos rtse mor bas ldan 'jam pa'i ci//dud 'gro'i skye gnas can rnams tshim par sprul//thub gsung chos kyis 'gro kun byang chub tu//semasabaskyed mtho ris lha yi lus thob pa'i//dga' ri tshes gnyis phu dud stob byed mkhan//nor 'dzin skyong bsgyu dra ya ṇa yin//zhal bsilas la dor bsag tso rdzing //dpag ra nyis brgya yod pa'i khor yug can//rin cen sna bdun gyis spras bye ma brdal//yon to brgyad ldan nyal 'gro rdzing bur 'khyil//sngo ser dmar dkar le brgan mar gad kyi//mdangs 'dzin padma shing rta'i 'khor lo tsam//rdzing bu'i sna 156bcu gis dngos kun kha dog mdangs//rab 'tsher 'od kyis gnam sa'i khyen gsal byed//'khor rnams chu rdzing la lta tso dbang gis//choXbastan der 'khod byang tso smos bskyed dang //

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho ma rdzo rdza khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnamangon mtho'i rgyu bskrun dus stone tshes gsum la//ri mor bgyid pa shu nyi da la'o//snga ṣka sprul pa'i yid 'ong rdzing bu'i 'gram//chu klung dal 'bab brgyad kyis bskor nga du//slar yang chu rdzong nyid du nyer 'jug pa'i//lhung lhung snyan pa'i skad dang bcas te 'khyil//dbang stobs rnam lnga byang chub yan lag bdun//'phags lam brgyad dang rnam par thar pa gsum//mngon shes phar phyin drug dang tshad med bzhi'i//chos sgra skal bzang 'gro ba'i rna bar sgrog/tshul des nyer 'khod 'gro rnams sangs rgyas dang /mtho ris rten gyi sa bon ches dngar ba'i//legs byas rtse dga' tshes bsto rab dgod ོ//sbyin pa'i bdag po ind+ra ba mi'o//bcom ldan dgyes pa'i zhal gyi 'dzum sgo las//dzasbu'i gser sbyangasarjes 'gro'i 'od zer 'phreng //stong gsum 'jig rten khams kun snang byas pa//nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid bsdus pa zhin//'od des reg pa'i skye rgu'i dug gsum dang //sgrib pa lnga bral lus semasarab bde ba//drang srong bsam gtan gsum pa'i sa thob tshe//yid la dga' ba'i kun rtog ji bzhin no//rnam 'dren yon tan la mos 'khor rnams la//chos bstan mthu yis mdzo mtho nges legasarten//bsgrub nus sa bon tshes lngar legs bto pa'i//rnyed bkur stob byed tshangs byin rgyal por grags//157na bzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes yon tan dang //mi ldan der 'khod skye bo ma lus pa//gser 'gyur rtsi yis lcags la ji bzhin du//lkog gyur mngon sum lta ba'i skal ldan mdzad//de tshe phan tshun gcig gis cig shos kyi//bsam pa'i khyad par yongs su nyer rig ste//dge dang mi dge las gos phra mo yang //rtogs pas yid la dga' ba'i spro dga' brtas//thub pa'i yon tan la bsngags chos thos bas//stobs bcu'i rtsal dang legs bris rten la sogs//rnyed byed skal bzang drug pa'i tshes kyi nyin//rab myong mas rkyen sgrub byed litstsha bī//zham ring tsho gos kun 'khor los sgyur rgyal gzugs//rin cen sna bdun sngon 'gro sras stong ldan//rgyal phran blon 'bangs rnams kyis bsti stang du//bgyid pa'i ngo mtshar sprul bsgyur bstan pa'i tshe//rang la de lta'i yon to mi ldan yang //'di ko zas gtsang sras kyi byin rlabs las/khyung snyam dad dang dga' spro phan tshun du//'phel ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)dbyar gyi rgya mtsho 'phyur ba bzhin//rgyal bas chos bstan 'gro rnams byang chub tu//sems bskyed lha mi'i rten gyi sa bon sogs//bdun pa'i tshes nyin yongs 'debs phan pa'i rkyen/shwakya'i rigs kyi sa la spyod rnams yin//phyag sor seng khrir mnan pa'i sgra skad las//gsang bdag srin po lnga thon ston pa drug/brtsal tshe de'i 'khor dgu khri rab byung zhing //rnam par grol ba'i dgra bcom 'bras bu rnyed//bcom ldan ba spu'i bu ga brgyad khri'i grangs//de snyed 'od zer 'phros rtser padma'i steng //bde gshegs157bsgong rang 'khor lo chos ston pa//'dus tshogis kun gyi mig gi spyod yul gyur//gang la dad dang dam pa'i chos thos pas//byang chub sems bskyed la la lha mi sa/skye ba'i bsod nams tshesabargyad rab spel ba//yon gnas mar byed lha dbang brgya byin no//tso dbang sku gzugs tshangasapa'i yul sa'i rtser//rab son blo yis gzhal las nyer 'das pa//mnyan yod grong khyer la 'khod 'gro rnams kyis//mngon sum blta ba'i skal ba can byin brlabs//de tshe sku las los pa'i 'od kyi zer//snang ba dam pa'i dpal gyi bang mdzod sgo//phye bas gnam sa'i khyon kun sgrib med du//gsal bar 'char ba'i cho 'phrul 'di ko mtshar//dad pa'i zhing sar chos kyi sa bon tshogs//btab pasamago par mtho dang myang 'das kyi//snye ma g.yur za'i mthun rkyen tshes dgu'i wo//g.yos sbyor byed po mes po gser mngal can//rgyal sku mas dang dpe byad rab wor ba//sa 'dzin dbang po'i ngosanas srid rtse'i bar//rnam par steg las los pa'i 'od zer ni//sa gsum kun gyi gsal byed sgron me bzhin/ /ri rab tsam yang mngon sum nyer lta'i bskal/ /ches phra 'phags yul skye rgyas khams gsum gnas//ma lus mthong ba'i cho 'phrul bkod pa yis//dka' ba med par 'gro mang grol ba bzhin//dga' spros myos pa'i gdul bya rnams kyis cho me//thos pa'i bla med sems skyed lha mi'i rten//spel ba tshes bcu'i nyin gyi yon sbyor ba//byed po phyogs bzhi skyong ba'i rgyal chen no//seng shes bteg pa'i rin 155than khri steng du//mdzes sku bzhin lag rnam pa mi gsal bar//sna tsho gos 'od zer dra ba'i khor yug gi/phung po gcig tu 'khyil zhi/ ༷phyo ba'i ngang //yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs snyan

sku gsung thugs rten gsar spu'i dang rin po tsho ma rdzo rdzas kha bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnagasung gi sgras//zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi tshig don kun//rang rang blo dang dbang por nyer 'tsham pa//drung du 'dus pa'i gdul bya'i rnar bsgrags tshe//sems bskyed phyir mi ldog dang dgra bcom pa//mngon mtho'i rten bskrun bsod na mas tshogos gsog pa'i//dga' ston bcu gcig tshes spel mchod sbyin sgo//rab 'byed khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin no//nang du byams pa'i ting 'dzin la zhugasapas//phyi ru gzugs sku btso ma'i gser mtshungs 'od//stong chen 'jig rten kun khyab 'khor tshogasal//reg pas dug gsum rtog tsho gis skad cig zhi//phan tshun pha ma bu dang phu nu sogs//gnyen bshes mdza' ba'i zhags pas ris med par//bcings pas ma smad snying rje chen po'i sems mag par skye ba'i rgyu thabs 'di ko mtshar//de tshe sangs rgyas thugs rjer yid ches pa'i//dad dang chosathos rkyen gyi myang 'das su//sems bskyed bde 'gro'i rgyu bskrun bcu gnyis tshes//phu dud legasasbyor khyim bdag tsinta 'o//lte ba las sa 'od zung 'dom bdun tsam//sku las 'phags rtser pad steng de bzhin gshegs//gang gi lte ba las kyang sngar bzhin du//'od zer 'phro dang de steng sangs rgyas sprul//de 'dra gcig las gcig los mang bstan pas//stong gsum 'jig rten kun gyi khor yug tu//bar 158bsgo tshams med par bkang ba'i sprul bsgyur gar//mnyan yod lhags pa'i skye rgu kun gyisamathong //dpal gyi mgur las gsungs pa'i dam chos kyis//'gro rnams theg gsum byang chub mngon mtho'i rten//bskrun la bcu gsum tshes nyin ri mor byed//sa skyong rgyal po shu nyi da la'o//lham mer 'bar ba'i rgyal ba'i sku gzugs la//mi yi bdag pos mchode pa'i me tog tshogs//gtor ba skad cig nyid la rin po che//sna tshogs rang bzhi las grub shing tor gyur//de'i grangs stong dang nyis brgya lnga bcu pas//stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten ma lus pa//mchog dman kun gyi mig la mngon sum du//snang bar byed pa'i rdo 'phrul 'byams su klas//dam chos sman gyis nyon mongs zug rngu'i tshogs//rab gzhil thar pa thams cad mkhye/ pa'i rgyu//bskrun pa'i bsod nams bcu bzhi'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo re rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)tshes kyi nyin//spel ba'i rgyu sbyor u dra ya ṇa 'o//bcom ldan 'khor bcas mchode pa'i zhal zas rnams//ro brgya ldan par byin rlabs zos rnams bde//dngos su bstan pa dmyal ba'i sems can rnams//sngon chad sdig la 'gyod pa'i smre sngags sgrog/'khor rnams brtse dang 'jigs skrag 'gran pa'i ngang //tshangs pa'i dbyangs las dam pa'i chos thos pas//theg pa gsum du sems bskyed lha dang mi'i//phun tsho gis dge ba'i rtsa ba grangs med spel//mi bzad dmyal ba'i 'gro rnams sangs rgyas zhal//mthong bas rab dad tshe 'phos bde 'gror skye//rnam dkar dge tsho gis bco lnga'i tshes kyi wo//rgya cher spel ba'i sbyin bdag gzugs can snying //rta chen zla ba'i gcig nas bco lnga'i bar//ngo mtshar 'dzad med cho 'phrul bkod 159na tha rnams//sor mo'i 'phrul gyis rab dkar kā shi'i ngos//tshon brgya nye ba'i shel bzhin rnam bkra 'di//bur dha ka sogs sna tsho gis 'gyur mdangs kyis//ma bslad pir thogs dbang po sman thang pa'i//lugs rnying kho nar yid gto ri mo ba//dgos skyes rdo rje zhesabyas dbu btsugs nas//de'i rigs dgos nor 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang dang //'jam dbyangasadon grub 'phags sdomakhas btsun zhes//ring nas bzo rigs gnas la sbyangs pa'i mthus//snang srid ri mor 'dri la goms rnams kyis//pha ma'i ched dang rang gi sgrib sbyong du//lhag bsam dag pas rdzogs par nyer bskrun pa'i//dge bas 'di dang gto gyi 'dun ma kun//bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i skal bzang shog/nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten mun sel bar//bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs rab rgyas shing //mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i ngang /khur du rnam pa thamasacad mkhyen gyur cig/ces pa 'di yang bzo rig pa'i gtsug lag la blo gros kyi snang ba ches dkar ba'i ri mo ba dgos skyes rdo rje pha bu rnams kyis cho 'phrul mchod pa'i zhing bkod bzabs ris su bgyis pa'i thang ga'i rgyab yig la 'dri rgyu dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnasaban 'jam dbyangs so//chu yos sto zla lnga pa'i yi pha la 'dod khas dbang phyug 'a mdo skang tshom ther gsasposkabs sgo ༅ spya thu shu gsar brkos kyi tham phud phul ba'i kha yig /༷zhi'i 'bras rsāng dud pa'i yongs 'du/kun khyab li shi'i

dri bsung 'phro ba nas/shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mthas gas nor 'dzin ma'i//chos srid drod kyisaphan bde'i gser kyi mngal//smin byed phyag rgya'i 59ba 'a mo rnam bkra'i phud//phyi ltar tshangs pa'i bu mo 'jo sgeg can//nang du 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī//gsang ba shes rab 'khor lo rgyasa'adebs mar//'grub sbyor shis pa'i tshes la phul ba'i dges//legs byas dzasbu chu bo'i gser sbyangs kyi//rtsibs stong thogs pa med par rab 'khor bas//chos nor 'dod dang thar pa'i yongasa'adu'i ljon//rab smin bsams pa'i 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzod//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i grwa tshang bkra shis khang gsar gyi bkra shis ka bzhi'i rten mchod kyi deb kyi mchod brjod 'dod don kun 'grub sogs/ldeb sbyor dag pa'i snang ba/sirnyi the:shu ste pa me hā shu klu musti ka yatsā akṣa ya//༷nga sne na a zhwa kuru shus rnyasaskandas dzen shi〉ka/ches dkar dge ba'i gos bu mu thi la//'dzad med 'dod dgur stsol pa'i don kun grub//dam pa'i chos phung byang sems slob mar bcas//dkon cog rin cen gsum gyis shis par mdzod//gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi lus 'dzin cing //dpal 'byor srid 160na tha' dngos kun dbang sdud pa//rnam mang thos pa'i sras zhes lha rnams la//phan bde'i ngal gso ster des rtag tu skyongs//legs byas dbyar mtsho lta bur spel ba'i zhing //bde gshegs sras 'khor snang brnyan tshar dngar ba/khra zhu skrun byed dngos po dang bcas pa'i//gsal byed yi ge'i 'phreng ba 'di na spel//rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i 'du khang gsang sngags pho brang du dgram rgyu'i yi dam chos srung gi zhal thang gra tshar 4khos pa'i che brjod gtso thang dang byin sa rten brgyud pa'i bka' bab kyi gzhir phye ba'i tho sde 'a so so'i thog ma gang yin gyi rgyab tu bkod pa'i dkar ga dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mthong ba'i skal bzang /sdeb sbyor me tog phreng can/pañtsa ba dzñā na sprul su pa kyi su la(tsasambha ṅgā dan go su ti ka /rka shi sha tu su tsakra su lha'i ras lha lha dre9sho lhanimi ste pil//lnga ldan ye shes rigs kyi bdag po'i dpal/kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po rdo rje sems//bye ba phrag brgya'i 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gis/ /phun tshogs dge ba'i mtshan ma bzang pos skyongs//phra rags bskyed rim gsal snang rgyas 'debs 160brkong //bsnyen sgrub dmigs rten bris 'bur gzugs bas lha//rgyud dang dam pa'i man ngag las 'ongs phyir//'bad pas bsgrubs la legs byas bye ba'i gter//tshul des snga phyir 8'gyur ba'i nges gsang lam//rdo rje'i theg mchog

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga / (mnagazhung gi dngos shugs don/ /bla ma yi dam zhi khro chos srungs sku/ /phul byung zhing gi dpe zlar deng 'dir bskrun/ /zla ba yon to grangs su spel bas mang / /dpangs tshad lhag bcas rgyug mtho bdun ldan che/ ras tshon pir snod ri mo mkhan po rnams/ /'khrul med phyag len ji bzhin bskyed byin rabs/yid srubs dpung bcas sgrod pa'i mtshon dpal dang / /bgegs rigs 'jug pa'i skabs bral rdo rje'i go /ye shes gzigs pa lhur mdzad spyan dbye ba'i/ /sngon 'gro'i rab tu gnas sogs zhib mor bsgrubs/ bka' babs brgyud pa'i gdung dang sku bal gyi/ /ring bsrel rten gyi gzi byin rnam 'bar zhing / /so sor dgos pa'i gzungs sngags rdzas sbyor yang / /tshad ldan mkhas pa'i lugs srol 'khrul med spel/ snang srid mngon sum lta ba'i skal bzang du/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i gzugs brnyan 'byed mkhas pa/ /sman bla don kun grub pa'i ring lugs kyis/ /'chi med bzo bo'i khengs pa bag la zha/ /mkhas 'dod dkar nag rgya sogs yul mang po'i/ /sna tsho gos ri mo'i bslad pa ma zhugs shing/ /rang rigs 'khrul med srol gyis tshugs bcad mdangs/ /mkha' la dbang po'i gzhu ltar spel byed mkhan//sman thang cho rigs 'dzin dang slob mar bcas/ /nyer gcig grangs ldan 'og tu ming gsal bas/ /rab (161na dkar rnam dag bsam pas kun blangs nas/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa chen pos legs par bzhedas/ khyad par gzugs snang ri mor 'dri ba la/ /gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i rnam dpyod can//stag lung dpal mgon zhes byas bris bkod dag /khur chen khyogs la bteg nas dag thon byas/ /tshul 'dir mthun rkyen sgrub la nyer gtogos rnams/ /srid zhi'i rgud tsho gos dgra
