las rab rgyal te/ /'khor 'das yon tan zad mi shes pa'i gter/ /bsod nams gzugs can bzhin du longs spyod shog /rgyal bstan spyi dang kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs ljon shing rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /gang gi grib tu bsil bar mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /bde skyid dga' ston dpal la spyod par shog /dus kyi bdag po'i las shugs dar drag pa/ /mchod yon zung 'jug dga' ldan chos srid bstan/ /tshe ring gnam gyi shing rta'i she mong gis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin kun la dbang sgyur shog /yid srubasasde—183—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā9)las rnam rgyal phan bde'i sgo/ /yongs phye nges gsang smin grol 'phrin las bzhi'i/ /legs bshad bye ba'i gter gyur khrims ldan gling / /rab rgyas yongs 'du'i mched zlar lhun grub shog /de ltar bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs dang mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan srid ring por 'phel zhing rgyasapa'i spyi sgos kyi rim gror rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams la snga phyir 'gyur ba rdo rje theg pa'i mngon dkyil sgrub 'phrin gtor chog bskang mdos sogs btsugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs rten tu bris thang gra tshar sum cu (161ba〉sgo gcig bzhengs pa'i bkod pa byas pa ltar mdzod pa grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos khur blangs/ do dam 'dar pa ngag dbang 'phrin las/ glang bu ba dgra 'dul tshe ring / sdings chen pa blo bzang dbang phyug /phogs sogs 'phral dgos sprod mi zhang mkhar dkon cog rnam rgyal/ tshe dbang dar rgyas/ byang gling bsam grub rgyal po/ gzer chen pa rnam sras bkra shis/ rnam dpyod sor mo'i 'phrul gyis zlos gar bsgyur ba po dbu mdzad che kha sman thang nas 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ stag lung dpal mgon/ dbu 'bring rong pa tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ dbu chung mkhar rtse dpon bsam/ mas gro lha 'phel/ sngags grwa bsod nams/ pho brang phun tshogs/ lha salhun grub/ rong pa rgyal mtshan/ byings kyi gras lha sa dkon cog /legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rong tshangasapa/ lnga 'dzoms/ tshe bdag /snye mo ga me/ tshe dbang nor bu/ lha lung mgon po/ za dam lo yags/ sprang chung / mkhar rtse nam mkha' tshe brtan/ skyid rong rgod phrug /srog 'khor dgos rigs rnams 'dri mkhan gzhis ka shar pa a gur dang / 'brong stod pa ngag dbang 'phrin las/ skye mched gzungasasngags kyi yig ris pa gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ e pa ngag dbang tshe ring dang ngag dbang dpal 'byor/ bstod tshig dkar chag zhal byang gi yig ris pa nyang stod dpal ldan phun tshogs/ gong gzham bzo bo/ skud pa sgrim mi/ ur rgyag mi dang bcas par skyon/ mos pa/ a skyag /ser shag pa dgos nor/ dar rgyas/ bkra shis bde legs/ dgos pa/ byams(162na)pa/ rin cen rnam rgyal/ byang gling dar rgyas/ su mchog /bzhi dga'/ drung gnas/ ngag dbang chos 'phel/ gnyis —184

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod jo khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnanor/ 'jam dbyangs/ ba 4 grub/ gi si/ gong dkar me khyung pha buganyis/ don grub rgyal bo/ sngo tshemasapa ga dze shag ba/ a nor/ jo bo tshe ring / tshe ring / u rgyan/ dbang po/ btsan skyabs/ dar rgyas/ a khug /gnyis dga'/ rtag gi chags pa dbu mdzad kyi gras khyung rtse rin cen/ g.yu rgyal lhun rtse ba bstan 'dzin dgos pa/ 'brong lha bsod nams dbang rgyal/ tshags pa byings kyi gras rgyan/ rtse chen tshe dbang lhas byin/ bsod nams dar rgyas/ lcags 'dam dgos 'dod/ rong pa tshe ring rgya mtsho/rin cen gyi bu bsod nams dbang po/ dbang ldan rdor legs/ tshar sna rta mgrin/ g.yu rgyal lhun rtse ba bsam grub dgos pa/ lha dar/ jo bo don grub/ jo bo bsam grub/ jo bo rgyal po/ngo bo nor bu/bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ jo bo u rgyan/ nor bu tshe brtan/ jo bo bstan 'dzin/ jo bo dar rgyas/ tshe dbang bkra shis/ lhas byin dgos pa/ jo bo dgos pa/ rong pa skyid gzhongs tshe ring / bya bzang tshangasapa/ pho brang dar rgyas/ skya rgyal nor bu/ 'brong rtse mchogo legs/ spe ser lha skyabs/ rab brtan gling pa nu/ pa rnam bkra shis/ tshe ring dgos pa nyug pa rdor legs/ 'dar dpal cher/ dmas ring dar rgyas/ shel dkar bkra shis/ tshe dbang g.yung drung / tshe dbang brtan pa rnams kyis bgyis te dge byed ces pa chu stag hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu drug zla ba gro bzhin kyi 'grub sbyor la (162bar bu btsugs/hor zla dgu pa'i nyer bdun dmag dpon khra 'dzoms pa'i dus las mtshams byas nas/ slar mdzesabyed ces pa chu yos ho me zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gcig phur bu dpo 'joms pa'i dus las 'phro btsugs/ hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer drug nam langs rgyal phur 'joms pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi dus legasapar grub pa'i dge bas bdag sogs mkha' mnyam kyi skye rgu mtha' dag gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i zab lam la brten nas mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa lhun gyis grub pa'i dga' ston rgyas par gyur cig /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba yi/ /thun mong min pa'i yi dam dang / /bstan srungs rnams kyi sku brnyan la/ /gzhan tshos med pa'i byin rten tho/ /gsang bde 'gas gsum/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu/ las gshin phyi sgrub rnams kyi sku rgyu'i byin rlabs rten —185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung /byang chub shing /bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi rus rgyan/rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i snyan rgyan/paṇa wo nā ro'i rus rgyan/jo bo rṣa po a ti sha'i gdung /mkhas grub khyung po'i gdung /rmog lcog pa rin cen brtson khrus kyi gdung /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i phyag nas/rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa/mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang /zha lu ba legs pa rgyal mas/ba so chos rgyan/rje blo gros chos skyong /rje blo gros brtan pa/'jam dbyangs smon lam dpal ba rnams kyi phyag len/rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i zhabasang ra/mkhas163na ) grub nor bzang rgya mtsho'i gdung /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i shangs mtshal/rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyi gdung /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbu klad/de'i gsang chab/rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gdung /rdo rje lang pha bong kha pa'i thugs/sku sha/dbu klad/sku rus rnams so//phun sum tsho gos pa'i byin rlabs kyi//gzi brjid nyi ma stong 'bar bas//bstan 'gro'i bde legs pa khro'i tshal//rab rgyas skal bzang bung ba'i dpyid//tshad ma bzhi ldan snyan brgyud bdag/'khon rigs 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi//yi dam chos srungs sku brnyan la//'os pa'i byin rlabs rten gyi tho//kye rdo rje/gas tor rnam rgyal/rdo rje rnam 'joms/gur mgon/zhal bram gzugs/rnam sras ser wo/gnod sbyin beg rtse rnams kyi byin rlabs rten ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung /byang chub shing /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rus rgyan/bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi rus rgyan/rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i snyan rgyan/paṇa chen nā ro'i rus rgyan/jo bo chen po a ti sha'i gdung /rje sa chen gyi rus rgyan/rje btsun grags pa'i thod 'phreng me 'bar ma/chos rje bla ma dam pa/ gdung /yab 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gdung /gcen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi gdung/gcung bdag rṣa rdo rje 'amang gi gdung /rdo ring rin po che'i spur tshwa/mtshar wo chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung /shangs mtshal/gtor ma/rdo nag maṇḍal gyi me tog/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang 163ba ga gi shangs mtshalaḥ/gdung /skye bdun/chos sman/ thugs dam

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdza kha bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)gtor ma//mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyi gdung /rin po che rta ra ba bsod nams chosa'aphel gyi gdung /mkhan chen gzhen nu blo gros gyi gdung /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse khu dbon gnyis dang /mkhan rṣa ga smo blo gsum gyis bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gdung /skye bdun/thugs dam gtor ma/rdo rje 'amang mgon po bsod namasamachog ldan gyi gdung /zur rdo rje lang chos dbyings rang grol gyi gdung rnams so//ho med dbang bzhi'i lam zab mo//mtho ris lha yi chu bo yis//sgo gsum dri ma kun bkrus pa'i//byin rlabaspomangon sum gzugs su shar//bka' gter rgyud dang man ngag las//nyer 'ongs rtsa ba gsum gyi lha'i//snang bas dbang gzhu ltar bkra bar//rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rten tho//rdo rje drag bo rtsal/bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs/phyag rgya zil gnon lcags 'dra/'char ka gnam skas ma/rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/khyab 'jug rā hu la/rgyal po sku lnga rnams kyi sku rgyu'i byin rlabs rten ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung /byang chub shing /o rgyan chen po yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar/bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi rus rgyan/rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i ba so'i snyan rgyan/paṇa chen nā ro'i rus rgyan/jo bo chen po a ti sha'i gdung /nyang ta thā ga ta'i sku sha/bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i shog ser//bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi shog ser/gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug 164na gi sku sha/de'i chos sman/mthu chen gang ba shākya 'bum dang g.yung ston pa thun mong gi phyag 'phreng /g.yung ston pa'i ring bsrel/skal ldan yar klungs sprul sku'i dbu thod/gter ston phyon gling pa'i khros nag shog ser/kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i phyag 'phreng /chos rgyal ratna gling pa'i gur drag shog ser/kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan gyi gdung /mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che'i gdung /mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po'i gdung /'bri gung pa chos rgyal rin chen phun tsho gos kyi sku sha/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gdung /nub dgon pa byams pa chos rgyan gyi gdung /cho se rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi chos sman/de'i tshe bdag 8sgrub gter/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)gdung /byang pa rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i gdung /de'i 'gro don las sbyor lnga pa'i ril bu/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi thugs/yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu'i gdung /rdo rje la4 mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan gyi gdung /zur kun ma' chos dbyings rang grol gi gdung rnams so//mkhyen ba tshe nus pa'i rdo rje'i marsā//rtse brgya gdengs pas yid grubs sde//lnga min mo yi mngal lhungs dang //lhan cig thub bstan lha rnams dga'//'khor lo rgyas 'debasadabyangs can lha//gdug pa 'dul phyir re ma tī//skabs 'gar dung skyong mtshan ldan pa'i//sku bas byin rlabs rten 'di ltar//'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon dang //gnod sbyin beg ce'i sku 164babs la//gang bzhugs byin rlabs rten gyi thog/thun mong min pa'i dam rdzas ni//kun mkhyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho yi/gangs mtshal phyag na pad dkar 'chang //bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbu klad dang //gsang chab ril bur bcas pa'i phye//ma smad thugs rje chen po yi//bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu las//srid zhi'i dgos 'dod lhun grub tu//stsol ba'i dga' ston e ma mtshar//dza ge : u kha sha rma la ( buddhā sum̐ ka ru ṇi na/mtshan bzang nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'bar ba'i gzis/khrid zhi'i gdung mun mthar sel zas gtsang sras//de'i gsung dam pa'i chos dang tshul bzhin du//sgrub mdzad slob mar bcas pa rtag tu rgyal//grangs med rig gnas smra la spobs pa mchog/thob pa'i dbus 'gyur 'chang gi kha spu can//gsung rab dgongs 'grel sgyur mdzad 'jig rten mig/mkhas grub lo paṇa tshogasarnams phyag gi yul//sangs rgyas kun gyi gang mkhyen shes bya'i yul//mngon sum gzigs pa'i ston pa btsong kha pa//'jam mgon mi yi gzugs su nges rnyed par//chos rjesangs pas la ga pad snying gar zum//thub dbang sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi//mdzad pas gaṅgā'i rdul grangs bag zha yang //dpal gyi mgur nas gsungs pa drang nges chos//phung por 'khyil ba'i glegs bam tshogasalo byung //khyad par chos ca don dam bden stong la//kun rdzob bya byed 'jog par mi bston pa//snang stong zung 'jug lam ston sher phyin bka'/ //nga phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam yid bzhin 165na

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (ma)nor//tshul 'di 'chang klog ཿbri dang ri mo sa/byed pa'i bsod nams phung po nyer spungs ri//mngon sum rgyu ba'i phan dang bde ba'i bcud//ro brgya'i g.yang du chags 'di skal bzang dpyid//de phyir mkhas grub du ma'i chos kyi khrir//legs son bsam sgang blo bzang ngag gi dbang //rab stims smra ba'i bshes gnyen gang de yi//sal ma yon tan spel ba'i byed po mā/blo bzang bstan 'phel ming can rim gro pa//rigs kyi tsha bo phun tshogs dar rgyas kyis//lhag bsam dpung pas yongs bteg sgo gsum po//'bad pas rgyal yum dum pa bcu gnyis bskrun//dkar 'jam shing gis ma mar yi ge'i ris//sdeb gzugs ngo mtshar lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin pa//'phan yul spras pa to gar dge bsnyen sogs//nyer lngas drug cu'i zhag la nye bar bsgrubs//snag shog phogs yon ston mor song ba'i rgyu//bzhi brgya drug cus nyer lhag stong phrag gsum//mkha' ru'i tshad du gzhal ba'i dkar mo'i 'bru//legs byas dpe slar spungs pa mkha' la 'phur//tshul 'di sgrub la nyer gags skye rgu rnams//'di snang ral par phan bde'i zla tshes shing //bslab gsum mig mes nyone mongs yid srubs lus//rab bsregs gtan bde'i 'chi med dpal thob shog/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan dkyus kyis//mtha' dang tshad du gzigs min ma rgan 'gro//sgrib pa'i lus can las 'das sku gsum grong //'ja' lus rdo rje'i gzugs su smin gyur cig/'jig rten spyi dang khyad par gangs can 165ba'i dir//mi bzad kyi dus chad pa nyer zhi zhing //rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i 'bras bu la//spyod pa'i skal pa bzang por rab 'gyur shog/blo chen tshangs pa'i yul sa las brgal ba//mkhas btsun bzang po'i snyan grags srid pa gsum//yongs khyab zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan//bskal brgyar mi nyams 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig/legs bsags bsod nams rtsa ba sbom po mā/skyed du bsrings pa'i myang 'das yongs 'du'i ljon//bde ba'i grib mar 'gro rnamasang la bsos te//byang chub mchog gi 'brasabus tshim gyur cig/ces pa 'di yang mkhan chen bsam grub sgang pa blo bzang ngag gi dbang po'i phyi rten du rgyal ba'i yum stong phrag brgya pa dum bu so // dbu shog gsum gser chos dang de phyin skya chos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)su blo bzang bstan 'phel dang phun tshogs dar rgyas gnyis kyis 'bur khur nas bzhengs pa'i tshe dkar chag smon lam dang bcas pa shig dgos zhes bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa'i sirnyi ra stu/ /mdze byed kyi lo gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs brgyud mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong gis ra sa 'phrul snang du dngul dkar gyi maṇḍal che rtser son pa phul ba'i kha byang la 'dri rgyu'i che brjod smon lam dgos tshul thong galtar bris nas byang chus rgya mtshor 'bag pa'i bsod nam chu bo/ srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' brgal sku gsum grong / /rab zhugs bla med ye shes bdud rtsi'i gter/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen par byed pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyasazhes bya'i mtshan snyan grags pa 'bar/ /legs (166na)bris su sti glur len bskal bzang 'dir/ /mya ngan med ljon grib tu nyer bsil bar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang rgyal bar 'gyur byed stong / /ma 'dris 'gro la rjes su brtse ba'i gnyen/ /kun khyab bde gshegs snying po lcags kyi khams/ /dri bral chos dbyings gser du 'gyur rtsi'i 'phrin/ /mtshan bzang gzugs skur brten nas drang nges cho me/ /ston mdzad zas gtsang sras po shākya'i gtso/ /snyigs mar cher spyod dmar cha gang ba'i mthar/ /rgyal gzhan bsil zer bye bas yongs bor 'gro /sgrib gsum mun pa sel la 'phel 'grib dag /spangasapa'i thugs rje'i nyi ma 'od stong 'bar/ /mgon khyod dngos mthong skal dman dbugs dbyung ched/ /khyad par mchis min zhal skyin gser gyi lha/ /'phags bal bod dang rgya hor lus can gyi/ /deng dusabasod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing rtser son/ /de phyir gcig tu rnam par dkar ba yi/ /gos bu ston zla zhu 'dra'i rnam smin la/ /spyod 'dod mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong gis/ /rab yangs blo gros brtson pa'i byed po las/ /gaṅgā'i yab gcig nyi 'od kyis byugs mdangs/ /lta bar bzod dka'i mdzes sdug 'phrog byed pa/ /dngul dkar rin cen las grub maṇḍal/ /kun bzod ma 'di tshad kyi 'jal ba bzhin/ khor yug khod snyoms yangs pa'i dbyig 'dzin steng / 'dzin dmar sa zlas legs byugs lhun po'i spo/ /'chi med 'dun sa'i pho brang rgya phibs togo /tshangs pa'i yul sa che las rnam par brgal/ /— 190

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnarin cen gan len nyis brgya'i srang ldan sogs//mchog dang dman pa'i dngos ( 1 slob ) po sna tshogs pa//dus ston lha gsol bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs//gla yon bdog pa phung por spungasapa'i khyen//gcig bsdoms drug sto rtsa dgus nyer lhag pa'i//stong phrag gnyis dang sum brgya'i dngulakyi srang //'dzad med mchod sbyin rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar brgya/khye bas rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i mdzod la 'khu//mig la ngo mtshar sprul pa'i sgyu ma mkhan//a mar sing dang dharma hā ri sing //la sogs ni pā la yul nas 'ongs pa//gtsug lag 'dir sbyangs nyi shu rtsa drug grangs//sra mkhregs lcags la 'dul brdung bzo yi las//ring nas goms pa'i tshul ldan khe dur kha//dar rgan ming sogs do dam lasabyed pa//kun kyis lusang ga yid gsum 'bad par brten//so sor ma 'dres smin par dkar nag gi/sa bon rang rgyud la btab snye ma'i 'bras//'byung bar rgyal gsung mdo sde'i me long ngos/shar ba'i mngon sum tshad mar su yis bston//de ltar gcig tu bsdo mes pa'i dge tshogs rnams//smon lam dag pas spel ba gzugs can du/grub na snod du stong gsum 'jig rten khams//mes pos sprul pa'i mthu de chung ngur 'khums//bsod na mas gaṅgā'i chu bo zad mi shes//rtag tu byang chub snying po'i rgya mtsho cher//babs pas 'di dang gtan 'dun 'grub pa'i rlabs//'phreng ba dus las yol ba med gyur cig khyu sbyor nye 'khor rtsal ga bcas pa'i tshe//rdzogs ldan dus ltar chos ring legs byas gzi//rab 'bar 'khor sgyur rin cen sna bdun pa//sngon du 'gro ba'i skal ba mnyam thob shog/yab mesabastan 'dzin chos rgyal yul du chi//bde ba can du 67na ) padma las skyes shing //rigs dang brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i mi bdag rnams//lugs gnyis dpal gyi nyi ma gung 'char shog/blo chen shes bya kun gzigs 'jam dpal dbyangs//mkhas btsun bzang po'i grags 'bar btsong kha pa'i//ring lugasazhwa ser cod pan legs 'chang bstan//kun khyab nor 'dzin lus phra'i mngal lcir shog/mi bzad gsod bkol phongs dang tsha grang gi/zug rngu'i tsher mar mngal 'cha' gnas ga can//gnod bral lus brtas mig mi 'dzum pa'i bde//skad cig tsaX la mngon sum myong bar shog/lha mo'i 'jig rten

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo rsāng rgya mtshogasung 'bum/ (9)khams na 'gyur khyab kyi//mi bzad duḥkha ming yang mi grag cing //phan bde'i dngos kun rang gisagang bsams pa//ji bzhin spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por shog/khyad par chen po rgya hor bod kyi yul//'jigs chen brgyad kyi mig gi zur mda' tsam//mi lhung 'dzam gling tshe lo brgyad khri pa'i//dus kyi tswa tshul ma lus 'dzin gyur cig/mtha' dang 3 bral nam mkha'i dkyus zheng la//'gran nus drin ldan ma rgan sems can kun//thar pa'i rin cen them skas la 'dzegs te//bla med kun mkhyen khang sdu/ ༷sa /shā / sdu/ /nyi ma/khro tsho lo mkha 'gro blo bzang gas skyong gis jo shākya yid bsto gyi nor bu la dngul kong phul phe kha thabs shes phyogs su 'phel dang 'grib min cing //wo mas dus la 'char nub nyer spangs te//rtag tu mun pa'i smag rum ming gi mthar//byed po snang gsal spong pa'i rin cen snod//dngul dkar ri chu mtsho'i grangs srang 167bsgos grub//bug gzugs zho yi sa zla'i mngal yangs por//nyer bskrun nor bu 'bar ba sdong rkang cas//rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar yongs spel mkhan//rab dkar dge la brtson pa'i snying stobs dang //bkod pas khyad par 'phags pas rnam dpyod ༅//sa dbang mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong zhes//grags snyan tshangs pa'i yul sa'i rtse mor 'bar//bsod nams byas 'dis gnas skabs brgya byin dang //dbang thang mnyam por spyod pa'i skal thob cing //thar lam sgrib med gsal mthong der zhugs nas//sku gsum yid bzhin nor bur longasaspyod shog/dwa na pa ti shāka suXshus na pā la su kā ya lhaX rnga/ dwa na pa ti su lha shā sa nāḥpā la〉yu rā stsebee:te::pra ya smo'ur sne lhanaḥsgo gas lha shā sa na pā la su tri mya bā dhi sirnyi ya smo/mgogasum nyer spyod kyi sku'i pa'i nang wo bog sbo kyi snod ra ma lug gi spos bor zung gis yig byang tso snying por las phyo tshulasang da ldang /rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi dri zhim bdug spos 'thul ba'i snod du ra ma lug gi spos phor che legs zung 'di'i gser gas kyi rgyur maX 2 blo bzang mthu stobs dang dbu mdzad blo

sku gsung gtson gsar 4kho dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas kha sang gi dkar sa/ (ma)bzang yon to gnyis kyis gser zho lnga bcu nga dgu dang se ba gsum phul/dngul tshags kyi rgyur spyi sos dngul srang brgya dang zho bzhi ba 'a/do dam khur len gnyer ba blo rsāng sbyin pas byas te/mdzes byed ces pa chu yos kyi lo bzo'i 'go btsugs/khro mo zhes ba shing 'brug gi lo 'gor legasapar grub pa dza ( //rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling 68na ) pa'i spos phor zung 'di'i gas skya sto nor bu/lha dar/bska lon dar rgyas/bsnya 'an bas grub/nor bu rdo rje/slob ma tshe bkras/phun tshogs/lcags bzo ba bsam grub rgyal po rnams yin/zhi khro rab mas bdug spos rgya mtsho che'i//kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo//legs hphu da byed po mtha' dag deng nas brtsams//byang tso bar du tshul khrims dri ldan shog/sarba da lnga ni rā stogadza/sarba kā le ma sgo lo//sdeb sbyor me tog g.yo cu hphu shing /pho brang chen po po ta la'i li ma lha khang gi deb ther gsar bsgrigs kyi mgo brjod nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo wod sogs/da smis dza su ka ri bha/sho kla yal ṅgār sho dhe kā dra rdo bya pā pi ka ma li ge rbu su khim sgye/e keshāsga'arnab la ba re di klogasuswā re pha mi kha ri pur kya sidhe dza ya skyo//bskal pa 'di la 'gro kun lasabazang snang ba ches dkar mdzes rgyan du//mi zad thugs rje'i sgron me rab spar stong phrag sangs rgyasa'aphreng brgyus dbus//gcig tu dpa' ba'i snying stobs mchoge la phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs ma lusapas//68bathags pa'i dbyangs kyis dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shākya seng ge rgyal gyur cig/dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang gsum dngos//zur phud lnga ldan mi lus zol brten pa//blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi zhabs go rdul//'khor 'das yongs kyi gtsug gis btud bya'i gnas//dag pa'i smon mthus srid sto chos kun gyis//༷ la skyabs su song bas skye rgu'i mtha'//rnyed med

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gzhan don dam bca'i khur bsnams pas//bsod nams zhing gyur 'phrin las rgya mtsho bzhin//'jig rten gsum gyi dge mtshan phun tsho gis rnams//utpal nyag phran gcig gis brtan pa kun//cig car phyogs te dbang du sdud mdzad pa//rigs byed lhag pa'i lha mos dge legs stsole//'bum phrag nyi ma'i lus 'dzin phyag sor gyis//btsir bas ne'u le'i mgrin las 'byor ba'i gter//legs byas gan mdzod yangs par nyer skyug pa'i//'dod dgu'i char chen phob cig ngal bsos po//sum rtsen ri mo gangs can ra ba'i ngos//rab bkra gnam bskos rgyal khab po ta lar//chos dkar bye ba'i sa bon 'phel ba'i zhing //mchod sdong ngo mtshar bkod pa 'dzad med ring /srus bcas rgyal bas yid can dbang po dang //'tsham par bstan pa sna tsho gos sprul bsgyur sku//bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing gi rdul snyed kyi//tshad du bgrang bar ma nus bag la zha//'on te shin tu phra ba mig dbang sgor//bgrang yas snod bcud 'gog med 'char ba bzhin//zhi khro rab stims snang bas li rigs las//'phags bod bzo bos legs sprul 'di med byung //sngon goms tshogis kyis bsgrubs pa'i skal can la//rnam 'dren 'phrin las rgyun 'jug dus69na thabs pa//rtsol bral yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes 'gro phyir//ri gzar 'bab chu rags kyis bzlog nus min//khyad par legs byas gser 'khor rtsibasastong can//dus kyi bdag por grub pa'i shugs 'gro'i rjes//kun bzod ma 'di 'dren dang lhan cig par//mchog gsum rten rnams rings par rgyu ba bzhin//sngon ra yi ger spel ba 'byam klas kyang //da dung srid zhi'i phun tsho gis gsar pa'i gzugs//mes pos dran nas sprul tshe deb zer 'dir//'jug pa'i sgo 'phar nam mkha' mdzod bzhin 'byor//ces snyan pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te de yang dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa dus la babs te gdul bya'i zhing du 'byon pa ni go la'i khyim du nyi zla'i bgrod pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir 'phags pod rgya hor bal po'i rig byed pa gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa du mas bskrun pa'i dkon cog gsum gyi rten mtha' yas pa gnam 94 khab po ta la'i pho brang chen po 'dir

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnabazhugs pa'i nang tshan li ma lha khang gi rten gyi deb rnying 'dug na'ang /slar yang legs byas kyi shing rtas drangs te mang du 'phel bar brten rab byung bcu snyag pa'i khro mo zhes pa shing 'brug hor zla gsum pa nyis brtsegs kyi sngon ma'i dkar cha dga' ba dang po pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor gyi thog deb zer gsar du bsgrigs pa la/sdeb sbyor dbu phra/〉kā la dza yu ko mā rab bee kaḥnā lha yi ki rte shrī na ra ta tho/dus gsum rnam 'dren thams cad kyi//yab gcig zur phud lnga ldan pa//mi yi srid pa'i zlos gar can//blo 169ba tha zang gragasapa'i dpal de rgyal/shangs bkra shis rtse pa bkra shis rab brtan gyi dad rten rgyal ba btsong kha pa wo po'i zhal thang gi sku rgyab la za hor gyi bzhes su ga bris su du ra dzāñtsa cho3yi brati ku la ru pa ma skyos rdi su re pāda.aḥd bishā ra taḥsu su bhā be sha brarmi lha kra/mas dpe'i ri mo ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i snyo gi rdul snyed grangs kyis mthong na mi mas med pa'i sku//snyan 'jebs sgra dbyangs tshig don rsāg gis sna tshogs 'gro ba'i rang rang skad dang dbang por 'jug pa chas pa'i gsung //70naya thamathi'i da taḥsnyi)tan(྅/lha ba don bisarba sgo ta stis kya su sku po87skyo ya shan ma gsadasatarsā gra bhā ba:me kho a(shu:bharnya paḥ//ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas la lkog gyur ma de cung zad mi mnga' rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs/'i kya'i skyes mchogo zas gtsang sras zhes grags snyan gdugs dkar srid rtser 'khor des dus kun dge legs char du bsnyil//yid 'phrog rin cen gdu bus legs spras 'jam ma smo phyag sor rtse mos bskul ba'i rgyud mangs sgrar//srid zhi'i chos kun skas dang tsor ba'i rgyan gyi glur len dri za'i na chung dbyangs can ma//mi phyed dad pa'i snying gi ze'u 'brur thugs rje'i 'jo sgeg gar gyis rtag tu leXs bzhugs nas//smra ba lce yi bang mdzod 'bum

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 79)sder 'dzad med ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i shis pa stsol/ /mkhyen rab rtsa ba sbom por bskyed bsrings mang thos sdong bu dar babs las/ /rgyal ba'i rnam thar yal (170ba'i dab brgya rtsa yongs 'du'i 'khri shing g.yur za'i rtser/ /bsod nams phung po smin pa'i gos bzang dpyod ldan 'chi med dga' ston che/ /spel mdzad dge ba'i dbang po yab sras 'phags yul mkhas mang gtsug gi rgyan/ /ye shes nyi ma 'og min mkha' dkyil nas/ khar ba'i rnam 'phrul 'od zer ches 'bar gzis/ /gdul dka'i gdung mun sel la snying stobs khur/ /bla nas blar 'degs don kun grub pa'i dpal/ /gang de'i sngon dang da lta'i mdzad bzang chab/ /rnam mkhyen mes po'i ral klung sbubs 'khyil las/ /rmad byung gtam gyi thigs gcig gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /log rtog dri ma 'khrud pa'i zhabs bsil mchog /da lha'i gzhung lugs me long gtsang ma'i ngos/ /sgra don rgyan gyi bzhi ras rab shar ba/ /legs bshad dkyus ring mig gi zur mda' yis/ shes ldan kun gyi brtan pa cig car phyogs/ /bod rgan drang srong mang pos blun dad kyis/ / dmod mtshon rtogs brjod mgrin sngon la phab mthar/ /grong tshig mtshan ma tsam la lhar bzung nas/ / dam pa'i gsung zhes 'dud rnams skal pa phra/ /gti mug mun tshobs log sgom khung bu sa /rlom pas rab 'khyil nyen mongs dug gi lces/ /thar 'dod srog la rgol ba phyag rgya'i khyu/ /tha snyad rtsis la phrag dog dbang gis gshung / /byings dang rnam 'gyur rkyen gyi cha shas gang / /lci yang sdeb sbyor ri dwags gzugs kyis mdzes/ /snyan 'gyur ga bur gzegs ma 'bum 'dzag pa/ /bstan bcosakunda'i gnyen la 'khu sems can/ /rnam dpyod mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor bag la zha/ /res 'ga' gdol gtam du ba'i (171na)mthug ma rkyong / /brtsams chos rgyu skar khrod na gnod pa'i zas/ /'gran des cher rlom mang po'i ngag bgros rgyan/ /rlung gis rtser g.yengs sbur ma stes dbang gis/ /mthon por chags min gong ma'i lung las kyis/ /sa gsum rnam 'dren 'phags pa'i bdag rkyen las//rtog brjod che 'di kha ba'i sman ljongs dar/ /phra mo'i 'gyur bcos tsam la lo wo du/ /rlom semasamagron bus mig dbang nyid min par/ /gtsug lag gangs ri'i spo na brda sprod kyi/ /rtsal gsum —196

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)rdzogs pa'i zhu li shong ston rje//blo gros dzaskru'i snye mas nyer gsas pa//chos phung rgya mtsho'i snying po legs bshad gser//'dren byed gangs can bstan pa'i shing rta che//don gyi gnas lnga rig pa lo chen dpang //sna bo'i lugs srol sgron mes khol bu'i mun//bsal tshe gcam bus bsngags dang mtshungasamin par//chos kun mkhyen pa'i nyi ma 'od po che//rgyal bstan yongs kyi mkhar shar chos skyong bzang //tshul 'di'i 'chad nyan ma rnyings utpa la//rna gong mdzes rgyan gsar pa'i spel legs su//skal bar thob 'di bsten la gces 'dzin pa//bshes gnyen rim byon bka' drin pha mtha' yas//khyad par lnga rig lang tsho na dar blos//drang srong phur bu'i khengs pa 'phrog nus can//swā la'i ljongs kyi lha dbang smon 'gro ba//nges par thams cad mkhyen de'i rnam dpyod mthu//dge dbang zhal lung dpyid kyi bser bu yis//mkhas mang 'dod ldan ba sbu nyer bslangs nas//tshig don mchu sgros ches dmar ro bda' bar//yid kyi shing rta lan brgyar rgyug la brel//de tsam 171bston byung gtam gyi skyar zlosalas//da lta 'khri shing chu gter lta shog gi/mkhas dbang dpa' bo'i gsung rab pakṣu yang //sgrolaba'i blo gros gru gzings nyin skar bzhin//sri sku'i mtshan ltas drang srong tshig gi mdas//chos brgyad lcags kyi gtun bu bdun skyes pa//bstan 'dzin khyab 'jug gya gyu'i gar mkhan phal//drang po'i glegs bu gcan gzan mdun gyi rtswa//'on te rgyal bstan lnga phrag drug pa'i dus//gnam bskosasaspyod las shugs dar la drag/skye rgu'i legs byas mtsho'i 'jing zab rgya ches//sngon byon mkhas pa'i skrun zla 'byung srid snyam//de phyir slob lam dus nas 'gro kun la//brtse bas bdag gzhan brje ba'i rnam thar dri//lo rgyus ma la ya rlung gis drangs pas//yid kyi tsha gdung sel ba'i mdza' gcugs ma//bla med byang chub ched du bya dka'i tshogs//grangs med bskal gsum bsags pa'i bden dpang du//sa yi lha mo kun bzod las 'phags phyir//rdzun 'phreng gzhan 'drid gleng mo'i rjes 'gro min//gdul dka'i zhing 'dir pad mtshor ngang pa ltar//dgyes dgur 'jug pa'i lhag bsam snying stobs la//sras bcas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ma luXpas//ches cher bsngags pa'i gtam snyan snying la

rgyal dbang lnga ming gdabang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)sim/ /dpyad bzod rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa'i zla/ /kun rtog 'bus phrag rdzing bur shar pa'i gzugs//gzhan rkyen rlung gis bskyod min rdo ba'i ngos/ /bris pa'i ri mo g.yo med dngos po'i gshis/ /blo gsal rgya mtshor rtag 'bab glegs bam klung / /'dzad med par gyi ma dros chu gter che/ /'phel 'grib med gang byed po gaṅgā'i yab/ /(172nasgo ba dkar sems kyi rtse mo mkha' la snyeg /dri bral 'byor ba'i 'o mtsho legs 'khyil bar/ /sgo gsum brtson pa'i ljon pa bsgril ba las/ /snying po tshogasaganyis cher spungs rtsi bcud mar/ /byang chub mchog gi zungs su 'gyur bar shog /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs de snyed lus can kun/ bsod nams sa bon grangs med skyed sring zhing / /btab smin g.yur du za ba'i snye ma la/ /spyod pa'i rtse dga' khong nas dgod gyur cig /ltar snang sna tsho gis grub mtha'i mtshan mun klong / /sgra tshad bzo gsonang rig rta bdun can/ /gung shar thos bsam sgom pa thub pa'i bstan/ /lung rtogs snang ba dam pa'i dpal 'bar shog /'jam dpal mi yi zlos gar btsong kha pa'i//ring lugs zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i sde/ /'dzam gling skye rgu'i bsod na mas mchode sdong du/ /nyi zlasamun sel de srid brtan gyur cig /tshangs pas ka ba med pa gnam gyi sgo/ /phye nas mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal srid du/ /nyer bskos sa yi brgya byin mchod yon zung / /dbang thang dpal mgrin can dang skal mnyam shog /spyi dang khyad par rgya hor gangs can 'dir/ /ring por 'tsho ba'i nya phyis khog yangasapar/ /sdig gos dri bral bde skyid musti ka /cher spungs thar pa'i srad bur rgyu bar shog /yongasa'adu'i gos bzang gtong bar lag rkyong ba'i/ /byed por gtogos kun 'di bstan rnam par thar/ /'dzin las ldog byed sdig dang rang gi rgyud/ /cung zad tsam yang lhan cig gnas min shog /nye ring med par kun la rab 'jug rgyal ba'i thugs rje nyin byed dbang / /srid zhi (172ba da pa'i mun stug rab bcil phan bde'i pad dkar dga' tshal du/ /mchog gsum dam par bstod bsngags dar dir blo gros bung ba gzhen nu'i glus/ /dus mkhyen rgyal po'i bsod nams de snyed 'gro kun gyisa'athob bkra shis shog /de ltar bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i dbang po de nyid kyi zab pa dang rgya che ba'i —198

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga / (ma)rnam par thar ba mtha' yas pa ni sangs rgyas nyag cig gis spyod yul yin la/ 'on kyang gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham par mdo dang lung las gsungs pa rnams tshad ma'i dbang por byas te 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇḍita chen bo slob dpon dpa' bos gzungs rabs sgo bzhi pa/ slob dpon seng ge zhabasa'abring bas skyes rabs sum sto rtsa lnga pa/ mkhas pa tsand+ra go mis 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlosagar/ dpal dga' ba'i lhas klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ chos rgyal dge dbang yab sras kyisartogs brjod rin bo che dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs mdor na mkhas pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcosakyi rigs gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'gyur pa ji snyed gcig yod pa'i nang nas rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'bri shing 'di nyid brjod bya don dang 'brel bas rtogs sla/ rjod byed rgyan dang 'brel bas rna bar snyan/ tshig rkang sdeb sbyor dang 'brel bas gcod mtshams phyed/ ming mngon brjod dang 'brel bas ngo mtshar ba ste khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa yin pas phun sum tshogs la/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu'i chos sting du 'di nyid la slob dpon gsung ba ni slob dpon dang rgyal po mi 'gal ba'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ don du 'di nyid sa spyod chen po yin pa'i (173na khungs ni/ dpal ldan rgyal ba'i cod pan blon/ /blo bzang mi dbang zhes rigs la/ /gdengs can dbang bzhin longs spyod can/ /longs spyod ldan pas dbang po byung / /zhes dpal ldan shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal po'i mdun na 'don du gyur pa'i mi'i dbang po'i rigs brgyud las byung ba yin la/ de'ang mes po rgyal po rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i sras sa spyod rab gsal du grags pa lugs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor phun sum tsho gos pa de nyid kyi sras su bltams pa'i chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang pos bstan bcos 'di mdzad pa'i rkyen yang / gnyisaskyes dam pa'i skye bo 'ga'/ /rtsom pa thams cad skul byed ba/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste/ de nas rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das/ /rang gi rmi lam du bskul te/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa ltar bstan bcosa'adi rtsoms shig par dang por bram zes bskul ba/ bar du grogs kyis bskul ba/ mtha' mar bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ rab gsal nas bzung zas gtsang ma'i rtogs—1sti

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)brjod kyi bar brgya rtsa bdun po rnams rgyal po rang nyid kyis mdzad nas/ sprin la zhen gyi rtogs brjod bkra shis kyis grangs tshang ba'i slad du dge ba'i dbang po nyid kyis rang gi sras zla ba'i dbang po la rtsoms shig par bskul bsan/ de yis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod/ /brgya rtsa bdun po 'di dag byas/ /ba po shis grangs ni rdzogs pa la/ /gcig ni rab tu 'bad pas bya/ /zhes gsal bar bstan pa'i yal 'dab brgya rtsa bar brgyad pa 'di nyid snyan dngags kyi tshig sbyor la ldog pa shar ba'i (173ba tshe cigs kyi tshig rna bar mi 'jebs shing don go dka' ba ma yin par dngos lho pa'i lugs kyi tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa kho na'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ tshigs bcad rkyang pa bsdams pa dag /lan gcig nyid kyi rjes 'brangs pa/ /mchog tu zab cing rab tu dka'/ /rgya cher bsngags pa rgyal ba yi/ /skyes rabs dag gi 'phreng ba yod/ khres gsungs pa'i lam gcig nyid kyi rjes 'brangs pa zhes pa'i tshig gcig po 'dis lho phyogs pa'i lam kho na dang mthun par dngos su bstan to zhes mkhas pa'i dbang po grangs chen lo tsā ba 'jam dpal rdo rjes ngom bshad du mdzad pa ni bla na med pa'i legs par bshad pa'o/ /de yang bod 'dir rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' 'dzin pa'i bla chen mang pos rtogs brjod 'di ni rgyal pos brtsams pas byin rlabs mi 'byung smra ba ni skyon gyi rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti dang bod kyi chos rgyal mes dpon sogs dam pa mang po la'ang smod par 'gyur ba'i ngag gis las ngan gsog par zad cing / /mkhas rlome la la dag dge dbang yab sras gzigs rgya chung bas bstan bcos sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar ma yin pa'i gang zag gzhan gyi rtogs brjod mang du yod pas/ de bzhin gshegasapa'i rnam thar kho na min no zhes smra ba ni smra ba po nyid rtogs brjod 'di la blo gros kyi 'jug pa zhib mor ma byas shing mdo lung rnams dang yang ma 'dris pa'i rang gi nang cha phyir ston pa kho na te/ dam pa'i grib bsil dang ldan brtan pa'i chos kyi rtsa bas bskor zhing bsod nams ra bar gnas/ /blo dang rig pa snying rje la sogs chu yis(174na skom mdzes rnam par rgyal ba'i yal ga can/ /chog shes dri —200

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)med yal 'dab grags snyan dkar ba'i me tog rtag tu dam pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /bsam kun yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa dpal ldan sangs rgyas ljon pa rnam par rgyal gyur cig /ces pa 'dis rtogasabarjod rin po che'i tshig don mdor bstan pa yin la/ /bstan tshul khyad chos dang po ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogasabasags shing / /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms byed pa/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang por byang chub tu thugs bskyed/ bar du tsho gos bsags/ mthar bdud bzhi bcom nas sangs rgyas pa ni ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i rnam par thar ba'i rtsa ba yin pas dam pa'i grib bsil sogs kyi don tshul 'di dang mthun par 'chad tshul ji ltar zhe na/ dang por theg pa chen por rigs nges pa'i dam bca' mi 'gyur bar brtan pa'i chos smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed kyi rtsa bas rab tu bskor zhing 'phel ba ni rgyas bshad yal 'dab dang po rab gsal gyi rtogs brjod dang brgya pa bsod nams rab gsal gyi rtogs brjod gnyis kyis bstan/ bar du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi ra bar gnas pa la byang chub kyi blo dang rig pa shes rab dang brtse ba snying rje chen po gsum dngos su bstan pa la sogs khong nas sbyin tshul bzod brtson bsam gtan lnga shugs kyi bstan pa'i sgo nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa'i chu yis rnam par mdzes par byas nas grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis kyi sdong bu (14ba༄sa cher rgyas pa yin pas/ de'i don rtogs brjod 'dir rgyas par phye ba'i skabs yal 'dab gnyis pa dpal sde/ gsum pa gtsug nor/ bzhi pa nga las nus/ lnga pa zla 'od/nyer bzhi pa thams cad sgrol/ zhe gsum pa gser mdog /nga gcig pa gser ldan/ nga gnyis pa bsod nams mi dman/ nga lnga pa thams cad ster/ nga brgyad pa bsod nams stobs/ re bzhi pa nor bzang / don dgu pa dbang chen sde/ gya lnga pa phan pa 'tshol/ go lnga pa stag mo lus sbyin/ go drug pa glang po/ go bdun pa rus sbal/ go dgu pa padma can/ brgya dang gsum dga' ba'i gong bu/ brgya dang bzhi ri bong / brgya dang brgyad sprin zhon rnams sbyin pa'i phar phyin la sbyar/ so gsum pa khyad par lo —201—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)ma/so brgyad pa lkugs pa 'phye bo/gya drug pa ba man gsum tshul khrims la sbyar/sum stob ka shi mdzes dga'/soganyis pa dge byed/sodagu pa bzod pa la dga' ba/zhe drug pa byas shes/go gnyis pa mdza' bo'i bu mo rnams bzod pa la sbyar/drug pa ba nga rar bgrod/zhe brgyad pa don grub/brgya dang drug pa gser gyi go cha rnams brtson 'grus la sbyar/nga bzhi pa sems can sman/re lnga pa rwa gcig pa/gya brgyad pa nag pa glang po bstan/go brgyad pa dga' thub pa/brgya dang gcig sngo bsangasacan rnams bsam gtan la sbyar/bco brgyad pa me long bzhin/sogacig pa gser logs/nga gsumapa legs bshad 'tshol/re drug pa snyan ngag mkhan/go gcig pa shi bi legs bshad/brgya dang gnyis pa seng ge/brgya dang bdun pa zas175na btsang ma rnams shes rab la sbyar/mthar ma' par rdzogs ba sangs rgyas pa'i tshul rtag tu dam pa'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi rang rang gi re ba dang mthun par bsam pa kun yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa yin la/de nyid rtogs brjod du rgyas par phye ba ni bdun pa mu tig 'khri shing /brgyad pa dpal sbas/dgu pa ma skyes/bcu pa mngal byung /bcu gcig pa mdzes dga'/bcu gnyis pa 'phags skyes po/bcu gsum pa 'phrog ma/bstobazhi pa cho 'phrul bstan pa/bco lnga pa lha babs/bsto drug pa brag 'phangs pa bstobadun pa byams pa lung bstan/bcu dgu pa shā ri'i bu/nyi shu pa gro bzhin bye ba rna/nyer gcig pa a sgra skyong /nyer gnyis pa rgyal byed tshal yongs su bzung ba//nyer gsum pa yab sras mjal ba/nyer lnga pa mngon par byung ba/nyer drug pa bdud bcom pa/nyer bdun pa shākya 'byung ba/nyer brgyad pa gro bzhin bye ba nyi shu pa/nyer dgu pa nor skyong /so bzhi pa dga' bo nyer dga' btul ba/so lnga pa legs sbyin/so drug pa gdangs can/so bdun pa gang po/bzhi bcu pa ser skya/zhe gcig pa u drwa ya/zhe gnyis pa mkhas pa/zhe bzhi pa gser lag/zhe lnga pa ma skyes dgra/zhe bdun pa sa li'i sdong bu/zhe dgu pa glang po can/lnga bcu pa las bcu spyad pa/nga drug pa ba lang skyong btul ba/nga bdun pa mchod rten/nga dgu pa ku lwa la/drug cu pa klu gzhon/re gcig pa zhing pa/re gnyis pa grags byin/0

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga / (ma)re gsum pa 'od srungs/ re bdun pa dge 'dun srungs/ re brgyad pa padma ldan/ /(175ba'i dgu pa chos rgyal rab gnas/ bdun cu pa nyi ma gung pa/ don gcig pa shā na'i gos can/ don gnyis pa nyer sbas/ don gsum pa klu la springs pa/ don bzhi pa sa gzhi phul ba/ don lnga pa rten 'brel bcaganyis/don drug pa bi dā ra/ don bdun pa kai na ya ka /don brgyad pa brgya byin lhung ba/ brgyad cu pa rab bzang / gya gcig pa rgyu'i mchog /gya gnyis pa dmyal ba mngon ldan/ gya gsum pa sgra gcan zin/ gya bzhi pa sbrang rtsi dbyangs/ gya bdun pa bad can/ gya dgu pa chos sred/ dgu bas pa nor can/ go gsumapa ma ga dha/ go bzhi po grags pa'i bshes gnyen/ brgya dang lnga pa ri pa ta'i yal 'dab rnams ma ro rna par sangs rgyas pa 'bras bu'i mdzad pa la sbyar nas bshad ma thag pa'i mdzad pa de dag thams cad khyad chos gnyis pa rjod byed kyi tshig rgyan nyams dang 'gyur ba stong gis ngo mtshar bas 'di las lhag pa gzhan du 'tshol mi dgos pa'i chog shes shing rgyan sbyor tshul log pa sogs rtsom pa'i skyon gyi dri mas cung zad tsam yang sbags pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad pa ngo mtshar pa'i rgyan gyis blo ldan rnams kyi yid rang dbang du 'phrog cing / khyad chos gsum pa rnam par rgyas pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi yal ga mtha' klas pa can rin cen 'byung gnas sogs nas bshad pa'i lci yang zhakhrul pa med pas gcod mtshams phyed/ khyad chos bzhi pa phul du byung ba'i grags pa'i snyan pa ming gi mdzo brjod mdzes bas dkar ba me tog gi lan dzar g.yur du za ba la brten nas dpal ldan sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das(17na)kyi rtogs brjod kyi ljon pa chen po skyes bu dam pa'i thugs rje'i grib bsil dang ldan pa la lus can kun bde bar ngal gso ba 'di nyid phyogs dus kun tu rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod pa'i mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi legs bshad nyi ma chen po 'di nyid mngon sum du lta ba'i skal bar gyur na log rtog gi mun pa thams cad sangs par 'gyur ro/ /de yang sa paṇa gyi gsung chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i thugs la nye bar bzhag ste bla ma chos kyi rgyal po dang dpon chen shākya bzang po gnyis kyis bdag rkyen la brten nas 'jig rten gyi mig gcig —203

rgyal dbang lnga par ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()po snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shong ston lo tsā rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis 'phags yul gyi snyan dngags mkhan chen po la: ka ra la brten nas mang yul 'phags pa'i drung du bod kyi skad du legasabar bsgyur/de nas gzung ste zha lu lo tsā ba rin cen chos skyong bzang po dngos kyi slob mar bcasapa'i bar du gtsug lag 'di nyid la dbyis phyin par sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bur gyur cing /de nas dus kyi dbang gis legs par sbyangs pa'i dpyod ldan ches cher dkon na'ang rgyun cung zad ma nyams tsam gnas pa las rtogs brjod rin po che 'di'i dka' ba'i gnad rnams kyis zhib mor bshad pa'i brgyud pa ni shong ston nas rim pa bzhin/gcung lo chen blo gros brtan pa/lo mchog pa/thams cad mkhyen pa dpang lo chen po/lo chen byang chub rtse mo/lo chen nam mkha' bzang po/lo chen shes rab dpal/lo chen thugs rje dpal/mtshungs med burnya'i mtshan 17bcan/gnas brtan legs pa rgyal mtshan/zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po/de'i dpon pad dkar chos skyong /grangs li lo tsā ba 'jam dpal rdo rje/smon 'gro paṇḍita rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa tshe dbang don grub/rigs chos kyi sras 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje'i drung du skad gnyisasmra ba za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos thos so//lung rkyang gi brgyud pa ni/chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang po/sras zla ba'i dbang po/paṇḍita 4 /shong lo rdo rje rgyal mas/gas blo grosabartan pa/dpon chos skyong dpal/dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/lo chen byang chub rtse mo/lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa/kun spangasarnam rgyal grags pa 'bum/rab yims pa rin cen chos dbang /rab stims pa tshul khrims dbang phyug/dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can bsnyems pa'i sde/mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/'brasaspungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/rje tshe dbang kun mkhyen/kun bzang rtse ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/dpal 'byor gling pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zur rdo rje 'chang chos// zhe grol/yang na dpal khang lo tsā ba nas/

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhings dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs kun mkhyen tshe dbang nas rje chos dbyings rang grol gyi bar gong bzhin te/ de la bdag gis nos shing / bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun la bsams nas thosabasam gyi ched du 'chad nyan sgo gsum 'bad pas bsgrubs pa (177na tshe pas bzang rdzu'u ga pa sbos pa'i 'gying tshul lhur len pa rnams dang 'dra ba ni ma yin no/ /de yang srid pa mtha' dag me 'bar ba'i klong ltar sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can du shes nas 'khor ba las rnam par grol ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba'i nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa'i gang zag ches dkon na'ang / dus kyi dbang gis 'dod pa'i longs spyod la sred pa ches cher 'phel kyang mang du thos pa'i tshul la blo sna bstungs te nges yang spu sud kyi rnam pas gsol 'debs thang thung dang bzlas bsgom sems khrid sad sud kyi yig cha la sha rul la sbrang ma 'thib pa ltar 'du zhid gzhud chen po rnams yal bar 'dor ba'i dbang gis gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir dus 'khor lo'i yig cha la mkhas rlom gzhan gyi brtsams chos gang gis kyang bsgrun du med pa grags pa don ldan gyi mkhas grub chen po nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i sngon med kyi legs bshad dri med 'od rgyan par du 'khod na'ang don du gnyer ba ches dkon pas/ rtogs brjod rin po che 'di nyid kyang par du brkos pa par mkhan rnams kyi yan lag ngal ba'i dka' thub lhur len pa tsam du zad mod/ 'on te rgya gar gyi paṇa chen kha spu can rnamasakyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par thar pa gsar du brtsams pa dang / skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsgyur cing rjes 'jug gi bstan 'dzin mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnams kyis dar rgyas su mdzad pa ni rang nyid mkhas par bsgrub pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang gya tshom gyis tshul der zhugs pa ma yin par de bzhin gshegs (177ba)pa la dad pa med pa'i 'gro ba rnams dad pa gsar du spel ba dang / dad pa dang ldan pa rnams gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur bas rang gzhan gyi bsod nams dpag tu med pa gsog pa'i phyir dkon cog tā la las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pas—203

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)bde 'gro'i grong khyer mtshon pa yin//zhes pa dang /mkhas mchog dpa' bos/grags pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa bzang bo 'di rnams kyis//bde bar gshegs gyur lam rnams gang yin bstan par 'gyur//yid la dad pa med pa rnams kyang dad par 'gyur//chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis dga' ba nyid du 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa'i don dang mas zhing /lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i bka' drin las sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/dpon bad dkar chos skyong /skyogs ston smon grub lo tsā ba/dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can bsnyems pa'i lde sogs skad gnyis smra ba'i lo chen mang du byon cing /de dag las brgyud ba'i yang slob dang nying slob rgya cher gyur pa'i nang tshan sgang rgan 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang grangs chen lo tsā ba'i drin las smon 'gro ba yab sras sogs tshad thub kyi mkhas pa kha yar byung yang deng sang ni zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po'i gsung las/tshul de lta na yang pur rgyal 'dir//gzhan kun la phyogs med gtong ba dang / /rang legs bshad 'tshol bar rlom na yang / /don byin len gnyis ka gser las dkon//zhes gsungs pa ltar glegs bam 'di nyid la gzigs 178na / ba lhur len pa dkon pa 'dra zhig 'dug kyang /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas par bshad pa'i da lta lnga brgya phrag drug pa'i nang du yod pas gzhung lugs 'di dag 'chad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' zhig 'ong srid snyam rang gis rang la blo bag nye bar bsgos te skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi ma dpe 'di bzhin rgya dpe dang bstun nas thams cad mkhyen pa lo chen chos skyong bzang posazhus dag mdzad pa'i dbe rgyun yin pas 'khrul pa ga la srid kyang /bu dpe gcig nas gcig tu brgyud par yi ge nor ba'i skyon 'dra yongs 'dug pa nas rin spungs sa spyod dbang po'i phyag dpe khungs dag tu byed pa dang bstun 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs 'bru zhus dang dogs gnas kyi sar sgra'i dpyad pas gto la 'bebs pa dang rgya bod kyi tshig rkang re gnyis chad pa ston pa dang bsgyur du bcug/khyad par yal 'dab gnyis pa'i/bdag ༷ ma bsgrubs nas ni//zhes sogs〈 ka gcig gi byed snga ma'i rkang pa gnyis pa'i skad dod rkang pa gzhan /༷sa ltar kha sgo yang ma'i sdeb sbyor/yal 'dab

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho slar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnagasum pa'i/snying stobs ldan rnams nang nas ni//zhes sogs blo ka gcig gi phyed phyi ma'i rkang pa dang por dga' ba'i tshal gyi skad dod 'bru gsum chad par bri ya ni zhes pa bcug/yal 'dab drug pa'i//phyis kyang lam ni de nyid nas//zhes sogs blo ka gcig gi byed snga ma'i rkang pa dang po'i skad dod chad pa rkang pa phyi ma gsum dang mthun par kha sgo pa na pa'i sdeb sbyor/yal 'dab brgyad par/mi shesarmongs pa sel ba'i bcom ldan 178ba'i das ni snying rje bsod nams la brtson pas//zhes sogs blo ka gcig gi phyed snga ma'i rkang pa gnyis pa nas 'bad pa'i skad dod yig 'bru gsum chad pa a gong du 'tshams sbyar ma srog med la a nu'i a bcug pa'i dngos bstan pa tho ma zhes pa bcug/yal 'dab dgu pa'i/nyi zla'i 'od zer yis byed rin cen rnams dang sa srungs 'od ldan glang po dang //zhes sogs blo ka gcig gi byed snga ma'i rkang pa dang por 'od zer gyi skad dod yig 'bru bzhi ho par bha na lā /zhes pa bcug/yal 'dab brgya gnyis par/de nas dus kyis bdag gi/zhes sogs blo ka gcig gi phyed phyi ma'i rkang pa dang po'i zhes byang ba'i skad dod yig 'bru gsum chad par nā sī ya zhes pa bcug/yal 'dab bcu bzhi pa'i/za byed rnams kyis mthong bar gyur//ces pa 'di mthong bar gyur gyi skad dod chad pa darsha sogs yig 'bru drug bcug/yal 'dab sum cu rtsa drug pa'i rgya skad tsa tu ra sogs rkang pa gcig bod skad du ma bsgyur 'dug ba/yongs su spyod pa bzhi yi ni//zhes par bsgyur/yal 'dab zhe gcig pa'i burnya sogs kyi bod skad rkang pa gcig chad pa/'jigs pa rtogasashing khong chud pas//zhes par bsgyur/yal 'dab bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa'i//de dag dregs pasakhegs pa dang //zhes pa'i skad dod chad pa gzhan rnams dang mthun par kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/yal 'dab lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa'i/chos min mang ba'i rgyal srid ces sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi skad dod ho pa rkang pa gas gnyis dang mthun par kha sgo mthun par kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/yal 'dab drug cu rtsa drug pa'i//mkha' dang ral gri 'grogs179na ) pa yi//zhes pa'i skad dod rkang pa gcig chad pa rkang pa gzhan gsum dang mthun paX kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/yal 'dab bdun cu rtsa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9) drug pa'i//dben par rnam bar gnas pa yi//zhes pas skad dod rkang pa gcig chad pa rkang pa gzhan gsum dang mthun par kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/yal 'dab bdun cu rtsa dgu pa'i//rang gi gnas su sa bdag de//zhes pa'i skad dod rkang pa gcig dang /yal 'dab brgyad sto rtsa bzhi pa'i/gter ni brgya yig bskor ba de//zhes pa'i skad dod rkang pa gcig chad pa rnams 'dar pa lo tsā ba'i rnam dpyod las legs par 'thon zhing /yang yal 'dab gnyis pa'i/kye ma sa spyod dpal gyi sdes//zhesasogs glo ka gcig gi rgya skad/yal 'dab drug pa'i nang gi/de nas gsum pa'i grong khyer bee ḍūrya rang bzhin//zhes sogs〈 ka gcig dang /yal 'dab zhe brgyad pa'i nang gi/de yis gsal bar 'di brjod tshe//zhes sogs glo ka gnyis/yal 'dab re gnyis pa'i nang gi/sa yi bdag po tshangasapas byin//zhes sogs glo ka gnyis la skad shan sbyar yod pa'i glegs bam rnams sgo mthun par rgya skad mi 'dug pas/yal 'dab gnyis pa'i blo ka gcig po sdeb sbyor dbang po rdo rje/yal 'dab drug pa'i blo ka gcig po sdeb sbyor nye dbang rdo rje/yal 'dab zhe brgyad pa'i blo ka gnyis pa'i sdeb sbyor kha sgo ta yang ma/yal 'dab re gnyis pa'i blo ka gnyis po sdeb sbyor rkang bkra'i sgo nas rang gis rgya skad du bsgyur/yal 'dab dgu pa'i nang gi/me dang 179ba7yangs pa'i 'od ldan pa//zhes pa'i rjes su rgya dper te ṭwāṃ sogs tshig rkang gcig gi rgya skad ma gtogs bod yig mi 'dug par/gsal bas de rnams bar khyab bas//zhes bod skad du bsgyur/yal 'dab re drug pa'i nang gi/de la dung gi kha zhes pa/khyi ra 'gas su rung ba yod//ces pa 'di rdzogs mtshams su rgya dper/pa smi sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyi skad dod 'dug pa skad shan sbyar yod pa'i glegs bam tshor bod skad du ma bsgyur bar sa stong bzhag 'dug cing /thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen po'i phyag dpe skad shan sbyar med pa der yang tshig rkang gnyis po de mi 'dug bas/lam gnas mtha' dag gang mthong ba//gdon mi za bar rnam 'joms pa//zhes pa'i tshag rkang gnyis po 'di rgya dpe las bod skad du bsgyur yod pa slar yang rgya bod kyi yi ge khungs btsun pa'i rigaX 0/da na mkhas pa rnams kyis le tshan 'di rnams la

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)dag mi dag gi dpyad pa mdzad dgos yod cing / rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnams la skad shan sbyar yod ba 'di blo bskyed shin tu che ba 'ong 'dug pas par du brkos shing mchan bu rnams brkos tshe glegs bam rdzob por song dogs pas/ rdul khrod du g.yo 'gul med par 'jog pa rnams la mchan gyi dgos pa med cing / blo gros dang brtson par ldan pa rnams kyis mchan bu rnams slar bris chog pa'i dbang du byas te bar gyi ma dpe'i sta gon byas pa bzhin sa stong phyag mdzod 'phrin las rgya mtshos bkod pas khyab par byas nas zhugadag par rab 'byams pa dge 'dun cho me 'phel/ lo tsā (180na)ba kun dga' dbang ldan/ par yig pa byams gling pa legs ldan slob mar bcas pa bzhi dang / par mkhan mkhas pa yon bdag tshe ring sogs par mkhan rnams kyis lus ngag yid gsum 'bad pas bsgrims te khro mo zhes pa shing pho 'brug lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga res gza' phur bu dang skar ma rgyal gyi 'grub sbyor yod pa'i nyin dbu btsugs/ shing mo sprul gyi lo'i tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga legs par grub pa'i dge bas lus can mtha' dag rnam 'dren bu ram shing pa slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs kyi mdzad pa dang mtshungs par bslabs te 'bras bu chos gzugs kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i dga' ston mchog la spyod par gyur cig /mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong gi tham phud lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du phul ba'i kha yig 'tshams sprin gsar pa'i lang tsho sogs/jo bo/ ris su ma chad thugs rje'i skya rengs mas/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyid las nyer bslangs te//thar pa'i gzugs kun mngon sum ston mdzad pa/ /bu ram shing pa'i zhal skyin yid bzhin nor/ khyod drung rang sems mtshon pa'i dar dkar ngos/ /mi 'gyur rtags kyi ri mo thun 'tshams ma'i/ /gsar —209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa'i lang tsho thog mar sgos pa'i phud//bdag gzhan dge tsho gis dang bcas phul ba'i mthus//rtsod ldan sal bsod nams 'khor lo yis//sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rigs las dpa' mdzangs kyis//blo bzang bstan pa skyong ba'i springs yig don//'bangs rnams bo'i rgyan du len par shog/sa rje rsā po/'gro 180bsgo gcig tu brtse ba'i rjes chags spyan//dkyus ring kun la gzigs pa lhur mdzad kyang //bdud rigs snying ga bsreg pa'i ye shes me//spro ba'i rang byung lag na pad dkar kye//mtha' med 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs dpung /'joms byed de snyed sna tsho gis sprul pa'i gar//gaṅgā'i rdul grangs bag la zhan ston kyang //zhing 'dir nam mkha' rgyal po'i mtshan gyis snyan//lag rtags padma rā ga'i 'od 'bar can//srid pa'i phun tsho gos dang bcas legs 'bul na//mnga' 'bangs mgrin sngon gnag snum ral pa'i rtser//tham kha'i zla ba rtag tu tshes gyur cig/rtsa'i se'i kha pa/rnam dpyod dpung pas bteg pa'i utpal rtser//mkhyen rab ral gri rnon pos dri bcas bstan//log rtog drwa ba gcod pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs//ngur smig gos kyis klubs pa'i btsong kha pa//mgon khyod gtan gyi skyabs su nges rnyed nas//ring lugs bla nas blar 'degs yi dam du//snying la bca' ba'i ri mo mtshon nus pa'i //legs sbyar yig gzugs bkra ba tham kha'i phud//mi phyed dad pa nor 'dzin khyon yangs par//sgo gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i maṇḍal//lhan cig spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin spro na//sa la rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal thob shog/dpal lha mo/sgrib gnyis dag pa'i mdzes sku gaṅka'i yab//bcu drug dga' bzhi rdzogs pa'i lang tsho can//rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug bcom ldan ma//res 'ga' dka' bzlog sgeg mo'i rnam 'gyur ston//dbang 181na ga brgyad ldan dung skyong lha mo la//dbang gi mdangs ldan tham kha'i phud 'bul na//dbang thang tshangs pa'i skal ba dang mnyam par//dbang du sdud pa'i srid gsum nus pa stsol//ri sras lha mo pa sangs lta bur dkar//dkar phyogs srung ma kun gyi gtsug rgyan gang //gang zhig deng nas byang tshub ma thob bar//bar mtshams med par mgon skyabasadapung gnyen mdzod// 0

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnapho brang 'a po po tā la'i gnyer sgo sder yig gi de0kyi mar brjod phun gas ro btso dpal lon/rjes chagasaspyan zur lhung dang lhan cig par//utpal rgyud las 'phos pa'i me tog mdas//srid zhi'i dpal 'byor rang gir dbang byed pa//bcom ldan rigs byed lha mos dge legs stsole//nyi ma'i dngosabargya'i lus 'dzin ngal bsos pos//ne'u le'i mgrin pa btsir las 'dod yon gter//mi 'dzad skyug pa'i phung po dbyig 'dzin stor//lci ba'i khur ldan shis pas 'di na skyong //'phags bod rgya bal hor sog mtha' bzhi yi//bgrang yas mchogo dman skye rgu'i dga' ston du//rmugs 'dzin ro bda' bza' bca'i g.yang chags pa'i//dran tho'i deb gter gaṅgā'i chu rgyun spel//khro mo zhes pa shing 'brug lo/phyag mdzod sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtshos khur len dang /gtsug lag gnyis po shes pa'i mig yang stag lung dpal mgon gyis dbu mdzad byas pa'i sman mkhyen mkhas pa'i lugs 'dzin rnams kyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi bar skor ldeb bris la cho 'phrul bkod pa/sangs rgyas phal po che'i zhing khams rgya mtsho/stong phrag 81ba brgya ba'i gleng gzhi/byams pa'i mdzad ༅/bri sku mthong bdon ldan/bde gtso gyi ṣka bkod rnams4khos pa'i nang wo/cho las yabakod pa'i zhal byang yid srub g.yul las rgyal ba'i rab snyan (rnga/ldeb sbyor dag pa'i snang ba/pra(brel dzam kyar sna gaṅgā tpa lnga gam dzā ta bai lha ka/kā dra/sha ta pha lu de ldan nanda bas nta so bha ga/thabs shes zung 'jug nor 'dzin las//zha spungs pa'i rnam ma' yongs 'du'i ljon/thugs rje'i gos bu ro brgya pa//skal bzang 'chi med dga' ston dpyid//brgya phrag byed gsum bcas pa'i dge 'dun dang //thabs cig 'od ma'i tshal na nyi ma'i gawo//bzhugs tshe dbang rnon chos kyi rjes gong pa//gzugs can snying pos phun tshogs mchod sprin spros//dus der sa dbang gcung sogs 'gro 182namang pos//rgyal dang ston pa drug po chabs cig par//mchod tshe nyi ma'i drung na me khyer ltar/gyur pas skal dman rnams kyang lam bzang 'khrid//sa mthar bros pa'i mu stegs sdo bcas rnams//zhe sdang me yis rang sems nyer bsreg kyang //thub la 'gran nus rdo phrul rtsal med pas/ma pha par mug pas yid ni khong du a//dus der bdud kyi rdzogs byed la sogs pa//so sor rang min grogs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)lnga'i gzugs bsgyur nas//rdzu tshil bstan tshe bdag nyid nyam chung las//gzhan rnams mthu che snyam ste sbobs mthor gyur//rkyen des mu stegs rnams kyis sa spyod la//bdag dang go ta ma cho 'phrul rtsal//'gran pa'i gnang ba zhus tshe mi bdag gis//rnam 'dren la gsol de don zhal gyis 'tshes//rim bzhin yangs pa can dang ko — //war gyi ti ga tsa shrī phug ral can//ser skyar bsod namasamagron gshegs cho 'phrul rtsal//'gran nus min par byol snyam mu stegs sems//mnyan du yod par da ste zhag bdun nas//cho 'phrul 'gran par dus btab tshul de la//blta 'dod lhar bcas skye rgu mtha' dag pa//dbyar gyi chu 'dzin bzhin du lang long g.yo//tshes gcig mi dbang gsal rgyal gyi mchod tshems shing sa la btsugs ma thag/skyes pa'i ljon pa dbangs su lnga brgya'i dpag tshad de snyed khor yug can//me tog shing rta'i 'phang lo dang mnyam gos bu bre lnga'i bcud shong bongs//yal 'dab rtsa bar rin cen sna bdun bkrag mdangs snang bas gling 182ba ) mun sel//zhim pa'i ro dang dngar ba'i dri 'thul rlung gis bskyod par chos kyi sgra//nyams su myong bas mi phyed dad dang thub pas chos bstan 'bras bu las//phun tshogs lha yi lus bzang thob sogs ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dpal//mngon sum mthong ba'i bskal bzang 'di ko legs byas rgya mtsho'i thong gis rnyed//tshes gnyis u dra ya ṇa sa mchod tshe sngon med rin cen ri bo gnyis//mtho zhing brjid chags lha mi'i nor bu gcal du bkram pa rab tu bkra//rkang 'thung 'phreng ba'i me tog 'dab 'dzum 'bras bus dud cing sgra snyan 'brol//g.yas rir ro bda'i 'bras kyi snye mar mi rnams dga' mgur longs spyod cing //g.yon rir sngo ljang bcud ldan rtswa yis dud 'gro'i tsho gos rnams legs tshim pa'i//ma smad rnam par sprul pa'i cho 'phrul mchog dman kun gyis mngon sum mthong //rgyud mangs glu ltar snyan pa'i chos sgras 'gro kun byang chub sems bskyed cing //'chi med phun tshogs rtse dga' yongs dgod rnam 'dren thugs rje pha mtha' yas//tshas gsum 'a shu lhad las yon sbyar zhal bsil gser ldan la dor bas//chu rdzing bee ḍūr zhun

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (ma)ma 'khyil 'dra dpag tshad nyis brgya'i khor yug can/rin cen bdun spras bye ma yongs brdal chu skyesashing rta'i 'khor lo tsam//sngo ser dmar dkar le brgan ma rgad kha dog rnam bkra dbang gzhu'i spun//rdzing bu de la nyer brtan me tog rin cen la sogs dngos kun gyi//bkrag mdangs ches cher 'tsher ba'i 'od kyis nyin byed dal med chu lhar bros//nyer gnas lha mir bcas pa'i 'khor rnams yid 'ong 83na la gzugs ltad mor g.yengs//dam chos sgra yis de kun sems bskyed mtho ris sa bon bla med rnyed//tshes bzhin ind+ra wa mis bkur tshe snga nyin sprul pa'i rdzing bu'i 'gram//lhung lhung snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs legs 'khrol nyal 'gro brgyad kyis yongs bskor cing //slar yang gzhan du 'gro ba med par rdzing bu nyid du nyer zhugs pa//chu klung tsho gos rnams rgya mtshor ro gcig ngang tshul mngon sum ston ba bzhin//de'i tshe 'dab ldan skad las gdangs snyan lus can rna bar son pa'i dbyangs//dbang stobasarnam lnga byang chub yan lag bdun ldan 'phags pa'i lam brgyad dang //rnam par thar gsum mngon shes phyin drug tshad med bzhi yi dam chos sgrar/shar bas 'gro rnams rdzogs sangs rgyas dang mtho ris rgyu tshogs srid rtser spungs//tshes lngar tshangs byin rgyal pos g.yos sbyar thub dbang dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal las//gser rir nyi ma'i dngos brgyas da 'dra'i 'od zer 'phrong ba grangs med pa//stong gsum 'jig rten khams kun gsal zhing 'od des lus reg skye rgu rnams//sgrib lnga'i smag rum mun stug rab bsangs sngon med bde ba'i ro yis myos//de tshul rang gi mthu yis ma yin bde bar gshegs pa'i byin rlabasasu//nges pas yon tan rgya mtsho la mos 'khor la tshangs dbyangs chos bstan mthus//skal bar ldan pa'i lha mi'i tsho gos rnams mtho ris thar pa'i rten bzang po//sgrub nus sa bon dad pa'i zhing sar yongs su btab pa'i med du byung //tshes drug dra ma'i tsho gos kyis mchode tshe yongs khyab thub 183bapa'i thugs rje ches//der 'khod mngon shes mi ldan kun la gser 'gyur bzhin du byin brlabs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)pas/ /phan tshun gcig gis cig shos khams dang bsam pa'i khyad par rab shes te/ /dkar nag las 'bras ches phra rtogs pas dga' 'jigs spro rnams 'gran pa bzhin/ /da lta'i phul byung yon tan thob pa'i rgyu gzhan med phyir rgyal ba'i mthur/ /nges nas bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing la bstod bsngags dka' thub lhur len cing / /yon tan la dad bka' drin gyis gus dam pa'i chos thos rgyu rkyen las/ /ye shes mchog dang 'chi med rten rgyu'i chos dkar dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel/ /tshes bdun shākya'i rigs kyis bsnyen bkur ye shes mchogo gi sgyu dra yis/ /der 'khod zham ring tshogs kun gnas gyur rin cen bdun ldan 'khor los sgyur/ /sras stong rgyal phran blon 'bangs rnams kyis ma smad phu dud rab stob pa/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi khengs pa skyung byed ya mtshan gzigs mo tshar du dngar/ /tshul de mngon sum nyams su myong ba thub byin rlabs las byung sems pa'i/ /lha dang bcasapa'i skye rgya'i tsho gos rnams mi ldog dad brtan spro dga'i blo/ /dkar phyogs zla ba'i cha shas bzhin 'phel zab rgyas chos tshul thos pa'i mthus/ /theg chen rigs kyi nus pa yongs sad la la mngon mtho'i sa bon bskrun/ /tshes brgyad lha dbang sri zhu bskrun tshe phyag sor seng khri mnan sgra las/ /phyag na rdo rje srin po lnga 'thon ston pa drug po phyer 'thag pa'i/ /drag shul stobs kyis me tog mda' can sdo bcas dpung pa rnam par zhig /log lam 'khyams pa'i (184na tshe tswargor 'bangs dgu khri rab tu byung zhing dgra bcom gyur/ /thub dbang ba spu'i bu ga brgyad khri de snyed grangs kyi 'od 'phros rtser/ /padma'i gdan la bde bar gshegs rnams rang rang 'khor la chos ston pa/ kun gyis mthong byin brlabs pas mos thob rna bar dam pa'i chos thos pas/ /mchog rnams sangs rgyas sa ru sems bskyed dman dga' lha mi'i legs byas spel/ /tshes dgur mes pos mchod pa'i sprin spros bu ram shing pa'i gtsug tor rtser/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar mngon par 'phags pa'i gzugs sku mnyan yod khrir bzhugs pa/ /so skye'i yul las —214

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)yongs su 'das kyang der 'khod 'khor gyis mngon sum du/ /lta ba'i skal ba can byin brlabs tshe dag pa'i snang ba stims su klas/ /de tshe sku las nyer los 'od zer dra ba'i yug rab sbrel ba'i/ /gnam sa'i khyon kun sgrib pa med par kun gyis mngon sum gsal bar mthong / /chos rjes 'brangs pa'i dad pa yongs 'du yal 'dab g.yur du za ba'i rtser/ /mtho ris thar pa'i 'bras bu rab ldan phan bde'i ro bde'i bcud du smin/ /tshes bcur rgyal chen sde bzhis yon sbyar mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar zas gtsang sku/ /srid rtser khyab las los pa'i 'od snang 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me yis/ khams gsum gnas rnams ri rab tsam yang mthong min skye rgu'i mig shes kyis/ /mngon sum lta ba'i skal bar sbyor 'di sangs rgyas nyag cig yon tan yin/ /brgya phrag 'ching bas bcings (184ba)pa'i 'gro mang 'bad pas bsgrub la stosamin par/ /skad cig grol 'dra'i ngo mtshar tshul la lha mir bcas pa'i yid can rnams/ /ches cher dad pa'i sbu long rab g.yos chos thos rgyu las sems bskyed cing / /mtho ris rten gyi rin cen 'phreng ba legs byas srad bur brgyud 'di mtshar/ /bcu gcig mgon med zas sbyin gyis mchod mtshan dpe ldan pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ /sna tshogasa'od zer dra ba'i khor yug gcig tu 'khyil ba'i phung po nas/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan yan lag drug cu phang 'gro'i sgra las dam pa'i chos/ /tshig don rang rang skad dang dbang por 'tsham pa ji bzhin nyer bstan pas/ /der 'dus lha mir bcas pa'i gdul bya mchog dman bar pa'i skye rgu kun/ /rnam ba thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed phyir mi ldog dang dgra bcom pa/ /mtho ris rten bzang bsgrub pa'i bsod nams til gyi gang bu bzhin 'phel dang / /mthong thos dran reg rnam par thar la dad pa'i sbu long ches cher g.yos/ /bcu gnyis tsinta sa g.yos sbyar de tshe byams pa mchog gi ting 'dzin mthus/ /gzugs sku 'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs 'od dras stong gsum 'jig rten kun khyab dang / /lhan cig 'khor 'dus rnams la —215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)reg pas dug gsum rtog tshogs rab zhi ste/ /phan tshun pha ma phu nu bzhin du ma 'dris mdza' ba'i bshes su gyur/ /sgang gzhong med par kun la byams dang snying rje chen po rab bskyed pa'i/ /sgyu thabs 'di ko zas gtsang sras kyi thugs rjer shes pa'i dad pa dang / /dam pa'i (185na spro65sgra rna bar lhung las myang 'das sa la sems bskyed cing / /gling bzhi'i mi dang sum rtsen gnas kyi bde skyid rgyu tshogs bskrun la brel/ /bcu gsum shu nyis mchode sbyin de tshe lte ba las 'phros 'od zer gnyis/ /sku las 'dom bdun tsam 'phags rtse mor pad steng bde gshegs legs bzhugs shing / /gang gi lte ba las kyang 'phros dang sangs rgyas sngar bzhin grangs med pas/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khor yug ma lus bar mtshams med par yongs su bkang / /sprul pa'i zlos gar cho 'phrul bltar 'ongs lus can kun gyis gsal mthong zhing / /bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i mgrin las dam pa'i chos kyi dung dkar sgra/ /thos don snying gi za ma tog 'khyil skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams/ /rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa'i byang chub mtho ris sa bon yongs su spel/ /bcu bzhir u dra ya ṇa sa mchod pa'i me tog rgyal skur rab gtor ba/ /skad cig de nyid sna tshogs rin cen khams las legs grub shing rta'i dbyibs/ /de'i grangs stong dang nyis brgya lnga bcus stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten kun/ /lus pa med par yongs su nyer khyab 'gro rnams mig gis mthong byin brlabs/ /sna tshogs theg pa'i chos kyi rtsi sman dus gsum nad brgya sel ba'i bcud/ /spang rtogs yon tan rin cen them skas thar pa'i khang bzang bgrod pa'i lam/ /skal ba bzang po'i yid can tshogs rnams bde ba'i 'jug ngogs gcig pu ba/ /(185bsgom thar 'dis kyang zas gtsang sras la dad pa'i lag pad snying gar zum/ /bco lngar gzugs can snying pos yon sbyar zas rnams ro brgya'i dpal ldan zhing / /zos kun bde ba myong bar byin brlabs der 'khod tshogs la mngon sum du/ /bstan pa'i sems can dmyal ba —216

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (7)pa rnams nyam thag smre sngags 'o dod 'bod//tshul der 'khor tshogs snying rje'i sems dang 'jigasaskrag phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin//gdul bya kun la dam pa'i chos gsungs la la theg gsum semasarab skyed//'ga' zhig mtho ris dpal mo'i bzhin la chags pa'i bde ba lhur len byed//dmyal ba'i 'gro rnams thub dbang zhal mthong dad pas skyabs su nyer gsol bas//tshe 'phos lha mi'i srid pa legs bzung bde skyid dpal la spyod 'di mtshar/shwakya seng ge'i 'jigs med nga ro'i sgras//mu stegs ri dwags lkog mar snying los rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)snang mdzad gangs can mtsho shes pa/ /zhing kun sku la rdzogs pa'i ston pa bzhugs/ /phyag mthil bslang ba'i snod 'khrungs chu skyes kyi/ /'dab ma nyer lnga'i bcu gsum ze'u 'brur/ /rang gnas gzhi dang snying po me rtag gis/ /brgyan pa'i zhing khams bkod pa tshar du dngar/ /tshul de dman blor shong min 'gal ba'i khur/ /dag pa'i snang bar go sa mi 'gog pa/ /lhun po mig gi dbang por 'char ba bzhin/ /theg chen chos kyi zab gsang pha mtha' yas/ /bcom ldan zhal las 'od 'phros shar phyogs na/ /rgya mtsho padma dri med snang rgyan du/ /chos kyi chu bo rnam par sangs rgyas pa/ /nam mkha' mtha' yasargyal po'i mtshan kyis snyan/ /byang sems cho me kyi padma rnam blta ba'i/ /rgyal mtshan lus kyi sprin bcud mang 'phel las/ /rin cen ri bo sil snyan shing gi mdzod/ /spos sogs kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin spras/ /thub chen rgyal ba'i spyan sngar nyer lhags te/ /mgon la gus pa'i blo yis phyag 'tshal nas/ shar phyogs ngos bstan me rtag sna tsho gis kyi/ /snying po seng ge'i khri la skyil krung bcas/ /lho phyogs rgya mtsho rin cen snang pa'i snying / /kun mkhyen 'od dpal rgyal mchog 'dren pa la/ /byang semasachos kyi rgya mtsho rnam snang blos/ /sngon bzhin 'dzad pa med pa'i cho 'phrul bstan/ /nub phyogs rin cen 'od kyi snang ba du/ /bde gshegs (187na phos ldan yon tan rin cen rgyan/ /sems dpa' spos 'od 'phro ba'i rgyan zla'i 'od/ /༅ byung rtogs brjod gong ma'i rjes su 'jug /byang phyogs bee ḍūr padma 'od snying na/ /'dren pa ye shes dpal kun dbyangs kyi rgyal/ /de sras seng ge'i 'od snang mthu 'byin blos/ /rdzu 'phrul 'dzad med gter sgo sngon mar 'khru/ /byang shar dzasbu chu klung shel mtshon na/ /thub pa chos kun mi 'jigs sgron ma la/ /rgyal sras chos yon mi zad gzi brjid gyis/ /mtha' klasamadzad pa gong gi tshul la 'phya/ shar lho bee ḍūr 'od snang gser brgyan na/ / kun tu dga' ba'i shugasaldan dpal gyi rgyal/ /sems dpa' ye shes 'od zer kun sgron blos/ /sngon rabs rjes su rkang 'jog rgya snyul bstan/lho nub nyi 'od rab 'bar kun snang snying / /thub pa ye shes rnam par snang ba'i dbyangs/ /sras —218

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (ma)mchog me tog kun 'phro gtsug phud 'chang //gsang gsum bkod pa gong la rnam par 'gran//nub byang rin cen 'od zhing bcu phar 'das pa'i//'dzad med 'jig rten yul khams gsal/shar phyogs gser gyi mdog ces par//'dren pa rig byed mi g.yo'i mtshan//de yi khams na byang chub sems//'jam dpal dbyangs zhes grags pa 'phrul//sangs rgyas dpal ming 'dzin rjes 'gro//byang phyogs tsam pa ka yi mdog/'dren pa rig byed kun tu spyod//sems dpa' rin cen dpal gyi mthu//nor bu'i dpal la gcig tu sdang //byang shar utpa la mdog dpal 'dziX pa'i//rnam thar yon tan dpal rjes 'gro//smo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nub rin cen mdog ldan par//rig byed dam pa'i thub pa mchog/rgyal ba'i sras po brtson 'grusadapal//rtogs brjod mig gi dpal dang mtshungs//nub byang rdo rje'i khams kyi mdog/kun mkhyen rig byed dbang phyug mas//de sras cho med pa la gsang gsum gar//brtson 'grus dpal la rkang ba 'jog/'og phyogs man shel zhun ma'i mdog/bde gshegs rig byed tshangs pa'i dbang //semasadapa' ye shes dpal yon mtha'//'jal bar chos kyi dpal yang ngal//steng phyogs drwa ba'i mdog 'dzin par//bde gshegs rig byed sna tsho gis mtshan//rgyal ba'i sras po bzang po'i dpal//4 tshul ye shes dpal du grub//rdul snyed zhing rnams rgyal sras kyi//ngo mtshar gar gyis 'geng bzhin du//gangs༅ mtsho yi g.yon ngos na//lhags pa'i cho phrul 'di ko mtshar//ded dpon rigs las bla med byang chub tu//sems bskyed gzhen nu nor bu bzang po las//lho phyogs grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas su//'jam dpal dbyangs kyis lung bstan rjes su bzung //dngos dang sprul ba dag snang 'byam klas par/ /bsas lhag yongs 'dzin brgya phrag dang mjal zhing / /kun tu bzang po'i drung du theg pa che'i//dam chos bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang gtams/188ba ) ( tshwa ji sdeb spyor 'phags ma/sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa'i gleng gzhi'i zhal byed don dam dbyings nas shar ba'i nyi 'od sogs/bidhis ra lha ma swā na phya96mri gyug rdzasaḥ//par 'aḥgayo bad tso rmā ta9//sgos dbyangasaseng ge'i nga ro yis//mtha' gnyis ri dwags srog 'phrog pa//zas gtsang sras kyis don dam bden//ma smad chos 'khor bskor de mtshar//bya rgod phung por spungs pa'i sa 'dzin ngos//byang sems yi rang lha mi'i 'khor tshogs la//rgyal bas mtshan nyid med pa'i chos bstan tshe//sku las 'od zer gaṅgā'i rdul snyed spros//de mthong shar phyogs rin cen yod pa'i khams//sangs rgyas rin 'byung zhing 0

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga / (mnanas sems dpa' che/ /'od zer kun nas 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ /rnam 'dren de drung lhags nas rgyu mtshan gsol/ khris ga rgyas par bstsal nas shākya'i rgyal/ mchod slad chu skyes gser sbyangs mdangs 'dzin pa/ /bkur ba ji (1yon)bzhin nyer bgrod mchod gsol tshe/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye bzhin/ /nyi ma'i garsā gyis 'dab stong tso po de/ /gtor tshe shar phyogs 'chi ba med pa'i lam/ /khyab pa'i padma ra nyer bzhugs bde gshegs kyis/ khrer phyin bstan tshe thos kun byang chub rnyed/lho phyogs 'od 'phros mya ngan med zhing gi /ming 'dzin sras kyi de mtshan rgyal ba la/ /dris lan tshul gyis nyi ma'i garsā gyi drung / /gshegs ma rdzo bkod pa'i ngo ma sgo sngon bzhi grub/ /snang zer nub phyogs nyer zhi'i zhing khyab tshe/ /rin cen 'od 'phror spyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ /gsol bas bya rgod phung po'i rir lhags te/ /sngar bzhin phun tsho gos rnam thar sgo 'phar phye/ /byang phyogs rgyal zhing 'od 'phreng 'khrugs pa las/ /rgyal dbang spyan sngar sems dpa' brgya byin gyis/ /sngon byung ji bzhin mdzad pa'i rnam thar las/ /smin grol lam gyi gos bzang g.yur du za/ /byang shar ṣi 'dzin 'od 'phros snang ba'i mthus/ /ting 'dzin glang po dam par rnam gnon gyis/ /gsol pa'i rgyu las phul byung 'bras bu'i gter/ /sngon bzhin dag pa'i snang ba stims su klas/ shar lho byang chub rgyan dung yid 'ong 'od/ /'phros tshe padma dam pa'i bde gshegs la/ /lag na pa blos zhugs sher phyin gyi/ /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sngar bzhin rna bar 'brol/ /lho nub rdul bral mkha' la nyi zla'i 'od/ /kun kyang rgyal ba byang sems rang snang gis/ /thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol ba nyer btab tshe/ /sngon bzhin zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pa gsal/ khub byang dbang sgyur snang khyab gdugs dam pa'i/ /spyan sngar byang sems rin cen (15ba)mchog gshegs te/ /gsol dang de lan bzhin du zas gtsang sras/ /thugs rje bskul ba'i 'bras bzang yongs su dud/ /'og phyogs pad can gsal bas dpal mo'i dpal/ /spyan sngar sems dpa' padmo dam pa yi/ /nyer lhags rgyu dris de tshul bka' bstsal las/ /bsam gyisami khyab rdzu snyul gzigs mor che/ /steng phyogs mdangs dkar 'od dras dga' ba'i dpal/ /drung du —22/ —
