bsnan//mkha' klu bkra shisachu mtshamasayongasatshang ba'i//gser shog 'od kyisamun pa'i smag rus 'phrog/'tshamasasprin mdangasal 'bu ba'i 'jon dmar khal//ri bor thub pa bseru bzhin du gnas//rin cen sna tshogasa'adusapa phra yi rgyan//dbang po klu yis spun zla lta bur phyug/gzugasa'abyung ri bong bkra ba 'od dkar grogs//rab mdzes

rgyaladabang lnga pa ngagadabang blo bzang rgya ma༅ gsung 'bum/ ()grad bur brgyusab monyi rka/zong mchog g.yu yisabargyan sprasaga'u brgyad//ri skyesapadma'i 'dab ldan lha yi mig/gtsug rgyan dbral bar mdongasaltar yid 'ong ba//gamu mtha' gser gyis legasabaskor lag ba bgrod//sog rna busadusa.a rdzar sba hril drug/phyed pa gnyisabacasardo yi rgyalapo gcig/me mig bse ru yongs tshad si rā dza//gter rtsa mtsho zung byu ru'i zhagasapa can//mkha' srin zla ba'i ra hor spa ṭika/klu dusa'od dkar spur len spel ba'i 'phreng //bug ri mkha' mtsho sna tshogagashelagyi rigs//gzi mchong mu men bcasapa go mdangasabakra/de lta'i rin cen phung po cher 'dusapa//rnam pa bde bar gshegasapa'i thugs kyi rten//sngon byon mkhasapa'i cha tshad ji bzhin du//194nanai pā la yi bzo bosanyer bskrun par//ring bsrel rnam bzhin bcasapasathog drangasapa//sku gsung thugasarten la sogasabyin rlabasagater//phung po zad mi shesapa nam mkha'i mdzod//tshangasaganasasar snyeg 'phyur bur spungasapa bzhin//mgon de'i sku dngosabalta ba'i skal dman pa//'byung 'gyur yid can mig gi bdud rtsi'i dpyid//mthong bsadon ldan rin cen gnyisapa las//legasagrub sgo khyim dbusan mngon par brjid//dngul dkar za ma tog bzhugasarin cen gdung //phyag dreg rdor dril ting shagasathugs༅nga dang //na bza' zhal dkar bzed zhal sna tshogasasdod//dbang rdzas ṭa rtsom yig brisagadan ris//gzhan yang sagasum 'gro ba'i mgon gcig pu//chosargyal 'phagasapa'i zhal dkar 'bragashel ma//'jam dbyangs blo grosabartan ba'i gsol lhung sogs//sngon byon dam pa'i nyer spyad 'ga' yang snang //gsang bde 'jigs gsum dusa'akhor dgyesardor gyi//snying po nye snying 'phreng sngagasa'akhor gyi gzungs//dri med rnam rgyal gsang ba byang chub rgyan//rten 'brel snying po chosasku'i ring bsrel tshogs//'dul lung sher phyogasamado mang 'gyur ro cogakhyud 'bum thor bur bcasapa'i bga' 'gyur rnams//mthing shog ngosasu sazla zhun ma yis//brisapa'i glegasabam lha mkha' gzugasakyi grangs//'dzam gling rgyan gyur mkhasamachog dbyig gnyen gyi/zher phyin bsdusapa'i rgya dpe 'khrul pa med//tshig gsal rig pa'i 194bsgonu byug phyag bris ma//'phags yul paṇa 6

sku gsung thug rten gas 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdza khang bzang gi dkar sha / (ma)chen pu sta ka khyad mtshar/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i thugs dam rten/ /gaṅgā skyes las grub pa'i brgyad stong pa/ /de bzhin bee ḍār khu bas dris pa mā /grags pa'i gzhon nu blo gros phyag dbe'i gras/ /rgya bal yul gyi paṇa grub du ma yis/ /mdo rgyud dgongs pa bkral ba'i bstan bcos dang / /sa lo bu ston rkarma rang byung sogs/ /gangs khrod snga rabs 'ga' yi gsung kha shas/ /rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam mgon blo bzang grags/ /sras kyi cu bo rgyal tshab rjes mtsho ni pa'i/ /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan 'dzin gyis/ /mdzad pa'i bstan bcos glegs bam pha mtha' yas/ /yon tan stobs lasalegs byung 'phags gsum gyi/ /ring bsrel chos dkar skye rgu'i zhing yin phyir/ /thub dbang sha rī ram gdung rgya mtsho dbang / /de bzhi sangs rgyas 'bring por gyur de'i gcig /rwa dang rus pa'i nā ro'i sku rgyan gyi/ /cha shas mi tri'i sgom thag rdo rgyud ma/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa di paṃ ka ra'i gdung / /snam sbyar mar mi'i gsol zhal pus mkhyud par/ /khyung po rin cen brtson 'grus sku rus dang / /spyan snga tshul 'bar phag mo gru ba yi/ /dbu skra na bza' grub chen gling ras dang / /bshes gnyen sha bo sgang pa'i gdung gi phye/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag sdom brtson bsod snyoms pa/ shākya shri kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i mthar son thogs med pa'i/ /dge sbyong mchog gos na bza' slong sdod chas/ /rigs gsum sgyu dra'i gar mkhan lha rigs(195na)mkhon/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan phyag 'phreng rdo rgyus las/ /legs grub bang khebs 'gro mgon bsod nams ba'i/ /tshul khrims dri ldang bla gos dum bur bcas/ /'phags yul mkhas dang grub pa'i kha spu can/ /gangs khrod bka' gdams sa zhal stan gcig pa/ /dwags shangs la sogs ni sa bral rnam 'dren 'ga'i/ /sku gdung sku bal byin rlabs rten gyi ris/ /rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam mgon btsong kha pa'i/ /tshems lasalegs 'khrungs dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil/ /dbu skra rnam sbyar bla gos cha shas tsam/ /dge 'dun grub kyi ngur snyig rgyal mtshan tog /yongs rdzogs mdor na mnyam med dga' ldan pa'i/ /ring lugasagasal byed du ma'i sku rus mtshal/ /slar skyes chos gos rnam gsum bsil byed dang / /dbu zhwa rten —227—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)bsdus la sogs grangs las 'das/ /bya yul ba dang khams pa lung pa yi/ /thugs dam spyan rten rjo bo yab sras skus/ /mtshon pa'i bla ma rgyud sde'i lha tsho gos kyi/ /bris thang me mig lag pa'i grangs dang ldan/ /ba po shis do kha gtsor gyur sna tsho gos rgyu/ /las grub 'bur sku rgya mtsho ri bor 'gran/ /sum khri brgal ba'i par gyi sku bas dang / /de snyed 'debs pa'i tsha par gter tshe ma/ /bum snang bla bre yol ba'i bkod mdzes can/ /gur kum sman spos dri bzang mngon par 'phro/ /rdo ris dngul dkar gu gu shel sogs kyi/ khrus bum yol go maṇḍal tshar du dngar/ /gdong lngas rnam par bteg pa'i khri yi nang / /lnga brgyas lhag pa'i nyis stong nas kyi khal/ /de bzhin bzhi brgya'i lan tshwa sna tshogs 'bru/ /(195ba)dri ngad bzang ldan sdong dum phung por spungs/ /sman sna dar zab go khrab ral gri dang / /rkang 'thung lo ma'i bam po gsar rnying brtsegs/ /sa rdo shing chu rto sogs mtha' klas pa/ /gnod sbyin dgyes bskyed rin can du mas gtos/ /bstan srungs du ma'i sku dang yig sna'i ris/ /chos skyong nor lha'i gzungasasngags shis brjod 'phreng / /rmugs 'dzin steng du nor rgyun lha tsho gos rnams/ /zhal sbyar 'khor lor bcas pa legs par bzhugs/ /lha bcas 'gro kun lag pad snying gar zum/ /pus mo sar btsugs gus pas lus btud nas/ /ma smad kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /dngos bshams yid sprul 'bul ba'i zhing dam par/ /mkha' mda' thub zho'i grangs snyed sa le sbram/ /'jon dmar mig stong zla ba las grub pa'i/ /gdugs dkar gser nya bum pa padma bzang / /g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u rgyal mtshan 'khor lor bcas/ /'byung bug srin po 'jig rten la grags srang / /dngul dkar las grub maṇḍal gzugs mig mthong / /dri 'thul gzhong pa kong gnyis bdun tshar steng / /ja ma bum sogs yol go nam mkha' bgrod/ /ma na ho dang g.yang ṭi las grub snod/ /nyes pa'i skyon gyi dri ma rnam par dag /gya bdun gyis lhag brgya phrag gser sbyangs dang / /zangs khal bzhi bcu'i mar me sbo snod zung //de rgyu'i chu skyes ba 'ad pa'i bum pa gnyis/ /grangs mtshungs dag las grub pa'i kā la sha/ bse ru'i rwa gnyis bcu dgu'i dkar yol snod/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad gshog ldan dung dkar po/ /tong 'byun —228

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho ma rdzo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnargyal khab las 'ongs lha me dang rgya'i//snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'brol 196na ) ba'i sbug sil dang //bur rgyal yul gyi bzo pos brdungs pa cha//rna ba'i bcud len rgya rnga rang grib mched//ding phon bum gdan gyis mtsho ni hor dus dang /ta ming gan mdzod las thon bzang gos kyi//gnam rgyan thog khebs rgyal mtshan 'phan gyi ris//sum cu'i grangs ldan 'ja' tshon lta bur bkra//zur 'dogs theg chen gan dril la sogs pa//'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa'i bye brag rnams//rgya hor 'phags bod ya tse kha che dang //li bal yul gru'i dngos kun bsdus pa bzhin//dri med gcig tu lhag bsam chesacher dkar//bsod nams byas pa'i rdul mang mthor brtsegs pa//dge tsho gis gaṅgā'i yab gcig las babs klung //byang chub snying po'i rgya mtshor rtag 'bab shog/thub bstan mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal khab khrir//gser mdog zhwa yi cod pan nyer bcings nas//bshad sgrub gling bzhin dbang sgyur btsong kha pa'i//ring lugs rtsibs stong rtag tu mkhar 'phags shog/ba po shis ri mo g.yas 'khyil dung dkar sgras//khrims ldan 'dus tshogos yongs bsdus lhun po'i spor//brgya byin nye dbang tshogasakyi bskor rjes su//'jug pa'i ngo mtshar dpal de 'dzin par shog/blo bzang grags snyan cher 'bar dam chos kyi//rgyal mtshan 'dzin khyod skye ba'i srid pa gang //'khrul ba'i ri dwags gzugs bral sngon med zla//gangs can ra ba'i kun gsal la 'char shog/sbom por bskyed bsrings 'khor ba ljon pa'i rtsa//tshul 'dir 'bad rnams legs byas mtshon rnon pos//nyer bcad sdug bsngal grib ma ga re zhes//nges legs nyi ma'i 'od kyis dros gyur cig/mchog gsum bden stobs shis pa brjod pa'i 'phreng /khyud mangs glu las 96bsnyar drangs rab snyan sgra//kun khyab rtag tu rna bar legasa'ajebs pa//phun sum tsho gis pa'i dga' ston dpal 'bar shog/ces rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa'i bshes ga' chen po bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan chen 'gro ba'i bla ma blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i bzhugs khang lha las babs pa'i mchod stong mchod rdzas dang bcas pa'i che brjod deb ther 9 tshul du bkod pa rnam mang thos pa'i bang mdzod

rgyas dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)ces bya ba 'di ni rje btsun gang de'i rim gro pa phyag mdzod blo bzang dge legs kyis ring nas bskul zhing nye char phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan kyis dpon kṣe tsha rong pa dge slong blo bzang dbang rgyal zhes tshe'i rig byed sogs gtsug lag mang por thos bsam gyis gtan la phab bas smra ba'i spobs pa dge ba'i dpyod ldan gang des gzungs dbul gyi khur blangs pa'i rgyus yod dang bcas ched gnyer du mngags par brten za hor gyi rigs las sdom brtson klog pa mkhan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes shing 'brug dbyug pas nya ba'i shes rab cha'i rgyal ba gnyis pa la sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar rnam par phye ba pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs kyis bgyis pa dza / /bkra shis lhun po'i dngul gdung gsar pa'i deb kyi mchod brjod rin cen gan mdzod sogs/lha mi'i ston pa stong phrag 'byung 'gyur gtam snyan thos la ngo mtshar bas/ /mig mi 'dzum rnamasa.a ho zhes su bstod bsngags glur len skal bzang 'dir/ /rnam 'dren sgyu skar 'phreng ba'i dbus na snying stobs cha shas yongs rdzogs pa/ /zas gtsang sras po 'od dkar can kye lus can tsha gdung ring du bcil/ /mi 'dzad (197na gsang ba gsum gyi rnam thar pa/ /bde gshegs kun gyi mgrin pa gcig gyur nas/ /che brjod legs so'i tshangs dbyangs 'khro po ba'i yul/ /blo bzang chos gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin de rgyal/ /rmugs 'dzin phyag gis ne'u les rab wa/ /phun tsho gos 'dod pa 'jo ba nor bu'i dpya/ /sngon med mchod sdong dkar chag yol go'i nang / /'khyil ba'i ri mo ma 'dresab po 'di'o/ /go khams ge thabs su gsungs ge khro rol na bla sogs ga sngags gsum gyis bsgrung dgo kyi rim gro bstar chag dang —230

sku gsung thug rten gas 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)'phar mar gos gtong deb kyi 'go brjod ljagos ldan 'gug pa'i lcags kyu/sdeng sbyor mu tig phreng bcanapā bya dharmo sna snananta kān ṇa g.yab ti shu klu dhi ci lha ma pāḥtwas dwa dza rgyu no tā ga nes mānta ta tha tshindanagre padaḥsdig chos dri 'gyud thugs rje gaṅgā'i dzo//ches dkar lhag bsam ti gi las babs rgyun//khyod bar 'gro kun mi ga kho dam yo'i mtha'//rdzogs min de srid ho ba med 'dis shis//mchog dman 197ba ) gnya' ba'i khri la btsan po'i khrims//rab lci bod 'bangs legs skyong chosagyi sto//mes dpon rim par byon rnams rigs gsum gyi//sgyu dra'i gar du nges rnyed dang bsa'adud//phan bde'i gzugs grib tshul min khrung po'i mun//'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags brtul tsos gzis//mthar byas gangs can dga' skyid snang rten mkhan//sngon med wo byed padmā snar rgyal//tso bstan log rtog gdon bto 'khrul pa'i bam//yang dag gser bsgyur smra rtse ral gri'i marsā//rnam dpyod dpungs pas yongs ba ātpal rtser//rab mdzes blo bzang grags pa'i dpal des skyongs//bsod nams yol gor ye shes rgya mtsho gan//zung 'jug yid bzhi dbang gi rgyal po las//lus can yongs la bde skyid nor bu'i dpal//stsol bar bsnyen sring med khyod kun gyi bshes//dgra bgegs snying khrag gas bsam si par//da dung brdzi ba'i stang stabs zlos gar mkhan//dpal li he ru /yi rdo rje'i mardzo//gzas pas gduld ma lus khrul de bsngags//lnga brgya'i nags klung khrod du thugs rje'i grib//cu bsil sman gyi bla dang zhi khro rol//tso gsung klog dang ma rdzo sogs rnam dkar zlas//rang gas snying gi kunda khong nas bas//nad 'khrug skya mug stobs ldan dbyig 'dzin 'og/tshegs sa dka' ba med par gnon byed ba//gnad gsang zab mo'i tha gu'i sto can gyi//rnam par 'phrul pa'i mtha' ṣka gzung nus su//tshas pa'i yul sa'i rtse nas 'char ba'i snya//rtsod ldan smag wo 'jig pa chos nyid mā//bod yul rdzogs ldan 19ni'adab brgya bas pa la//rjes sa snyan pa'i glu dbyangs 'di na len//zhes snyan 'gyur phang 'gro'i sgra las blangs pa'i shis pa brjod pas sngun bsus te/de yang 'jig rten gsum gyi ma 'dris pa'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6bemadza' bshes chen bo thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogasargya chen po bsags nas/ bla na med pa'i ye shes ma' du mdzad pa'ang mkha' mnyam skye rgu'i kun gyi ched yin la/ ma rgan sems can rnams kyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las shing / de yang kha che paṇa chen la khro phu lo tsā bas bee ḍūrla'i tshong 'dus nas zhu shog phul bar/ ma ga dha sogs rig 'byung gnas na sdig to yi/ /dmag tshogs kyis bcom skyon kha che bal yul yang / /log spyod kyis khengs deng sang bstan srog legs gnas ni/ /bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogs zhabasabaskyod zhu/ /zhes pa ltar/ sngon bstan pa ches cher dar ba'i rgya bal sogs yul gru mang po dus dbang gis kla klo sdig spyod kyis gang bas dri ma med pa'i thub bstan gnas pa'i sa gangs can kyi ljongs 'di yin pas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i ched du/ bsod nams kyi phung po mngon par 'du bgyi ba rnams kyi nang nas gtso bo ni/ ji skad du phal chen las/ su zhig sangs rgyas yul la dad sems pa/ /de ni chagasamed thub pa kun gyis dbang yang bskur/ /rdo rje lta bur sra zhing brtan la mi shigs pas/ /rkang gnyis gtso pos mdzad pa rtag tu dran shes shing / /'dren pa'i spyod yul snang rab shin tu rnyed pa rnams/ /gzhan gyi dring la mi rgyug byang chub sems kyang skye/ /zhes(194)thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul du byas te dad pa spel ba ni gnas skabs mthar thug gi legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba yin zhing / rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dad pas kun nas blangs te mchod pa'ang / phal chen las/ rtsa bskam spungs pa'i ri bo'i mchog tsam yod gyur kyang / /me mdag yungs 'bru tsam gyis de ni 'tshig 'gyur te//de bzhin bde gshegs mchode pa cung zad ci byas kyang / /nyon mongs thams cad tshig byed mya ga 'das rgyud 'gyur/ /zhes dang / pad dkar chen po las kun dga' bo gang dag kha cig sangs rgyas la dmigs nas tha na me tog gcig nam mkha' la gtor na/ kun dga' bo dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyi 'bras bu mya ga las 'das pa yin te/ zhes pa ltar sangs rgyas dngos sam kun rdzob brdar btags pa'i dkon cog gsum la bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i mchod pa phul bas srid —232

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho ma rdzo rdza khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)pa'i yang srid kun tu phan bde'i 'bras bzang smin par ma zad bcings pa las rnam par grol ba zhi ba mya ga las 'das pa'i go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur ba yin shing /bka' 'gyur ro cog dang 'bum brgya sogs bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab zab mo klog pa dang kha ton du bgyis pa dgashes rab khri pa las/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha rtan du byed pa dang /khyad par 'chad par byed pa na bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med/grangs med/tshad med/bsam gyi mi khyab/gzhal du med pa mang po dag bskyed par 'gyur/zhes pa ltar mi khom pa'i gnas rnams las yongs su skyob cing tshe dang longs spyod dpal 99na 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i mtho ris srid pa 'dzin la/yi rang gi byang chub dang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa sogs bsod nams kyi tshad gzung dka' ba yin par gor ma chag/de bzhin gshegs pa bdun ni snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus su thugs rje'i mthu dpung ches cher lhags pas bde gshegs bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i mdo sde las bsdus pa'i mdo'i cho ga dang /yid srubs sdodang 'i bcas pa g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhi khro rol pa gnyis lha btsad po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus mdo khrol gnyis zhes bod 'bangs kyi rim gror grags shin tu che/gas yang gtsug tor dkar mo/mtshan brjod/tshe chog/swā :khrusachog/gzungs sngags/mnan bsreg/bskang ba/mdos gtore sogs ban sngags bon gsum soso'i lugs kyi rim gro gang la gang 'tsham rdo rje'i gsung bslu ba med pa gter kha so so'i lung bstan las byung ba dang bstan srungs chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rnams kyis lkog gyur dngos bstan gyi shog khra/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba/ju thig sogs gtsug lag gi me long du ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi gzugs bas mngon sum du 'char ba dang bstun sgrigs chug dang gsar 'phar du bya dgos pa'i brjed byang gi deb ther sgos pa'i yul sa'i rtse nas bde skyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bad med du 'char ba la/yul dbu 'gyur/dwags kong dang bcas pa'i ban sngags bon gsum kyi sder mang 'gyed/mnga' 'bangs la 0 〈 da star

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo slong rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sa sug sto ba'i de po kyi 'go brjod bsod nam nyi 99bsgo stong 'bar/sdes sbyor byed minas pa'i britta la kun sgrogs56so:a mā bi shekho dzā'i bā 'tsho gum//bee ras hi btsan waṇi de sha shornyo dan gnugrosgo/thub rnams tshogis gnyis mnyam bsags las khyad par//snying stobs mchog gi yon tan phung po la//sangs rgyas sras bcas mgrin gcig bsngags brjod yul//zas gtsang sras kye 'gro rnamasarjes su bzung //rgyal ba'i chos tshul zab yangs ring po'i mtha'//de srid ma' spyan dkyus kyisarjes gzhal bar//ngal min tshad ma'i mgon po btsong kha pa//'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i dpal des skyongs//snying rjes 'gro kun rgyud la bsod nams kyi//sa bon rgya mtsho bzhi yi ska ragasams//changs par 'khod snyom bkram de mgo mtho dang //nges legs myu gu smin par mdzad khyod bsngags//ris su ma chad srid zhi'i legs tshogis kun//khro chags spyan zur tsam gyis 'gugs byed lhas//mchog 2yin dman yongs kyi snying la kun dga'i dpyid//sbyin pas sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar cig car che//tshul khrimasang da ldan dbu zlum ngur smig can//gos dkar lcang lo'i phreng mdzes sngagasa'achang ste//bod rje lha gcig khri srong lde btsan dus//bla yi mchod gnas gnyis zhes grags pa dkar//dkon cog rnam gsum bla mar legs 'dzin pa//ris med rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs so cog/bsod nams snya du sa bon bto pa'i gos//ti se'i gtsug tor lta bur dkar zhing mtho//phun tsho gis bde skyid g.yang du 'gugs pa'i bod//yangs pa'i sa chen yul gru 'dzin pa'i 'bangs//ma rdzo sprin ri snye mas btungs pa'i dzo//bsod nams gser gyi phung por gyur 'di ma'//sdig rta'i brtul zhugs gdon brlams dpung bcas mun//sangs byed 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me mchog/gtong ba'i dge tsho gis zer 'phreng 'bum 'phros pas/zhom smin dkar po'i gzugs kun mdzo sum la//bshad sgrub tso bstan bla nas slar 'degs shing //khrims gnyis gser gyi gnya' shing lci ba las//'gro rnams bde ba'i grib mar ngal gso'i ched//phun tsho gos 'dod 'do'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye//zhes shis pa brjod pa'i di gis sngun bsus te/ji skad du rin cen sdud pa

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)las/'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing //me tog 'bras ldan sman dang nagasatshal skyed byed pa//ma dros gnas pa'i klu dbang klu bdag rten 200bskonas te//de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mas dpal yin//rgyal ba'i to thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang //lar dang rigs ba dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang //mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi gos thob pa//de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu//zhes 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir phan ba dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i sgo dam pa ni thub pa'i chos tshul lung gi sgo nas bshad pa dang mngon par rtogasapa rang rgyud la mag du byed pa'i tshul gyis gtan la 'bebs pa la rag lus shing /de ni de bzhin gshegs pas zhal nas gsungs pa/rjes su gnang ba/byin gyis brlabs pa sogs kyi mthu la brten nas rgyal sras nyan thos dang bcas pas legs par bslab cing gzhan la ston pa'i rgyun nyams pa med pa 'dzin pa'i mdo sngags kyi sde kun rdzob brdar btags pa'i dge 'dun dkon cog rnams bkur sti dang ri mor bya ba'i yul bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog bla na med bsan/ji skad du/'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu//bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas//bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang //bcas te zhes 'byung ba ltar yin la//de yang bstan pa'i rtsab ni/gleng gzhi las/btsun pa ji tsam gyis na dam pa'i chos ma mis pa zhes bgyi/ji tsam gyis na zhig pa zhes bgyi/lku pa li ji srid du las byed cing nan to byed pa yang yod pa bar du ste/las byed pa la nan tan byed pa yang yod na dam ba'i chos yod ces bya'o//las kyang mi byed la nan tan byed pa dag kyang med na de ni dam pa'i chos zhig pa zhes bya'o//zhes 20na sgongs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni dge slong so so thar pa'i bslab pa la nan to du bya ba dang blang du yod pa zhig la dgongs shing /lha btsad po khri srong sdebatsan gyis/mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs nas/thog mar sad mi mi bdun gyis ngesa'abyung gi khrims blangs/de la brten nas rab tu byung ba'i sde rgya cher 'phel ba las/rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar ba dang /glang dar gyi rab byung rnams bsnuXs pa'i rgyus bstan pa nub pa'i tha snyad byung ba yin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo slong rgya rsha gsung tshom/ (9)pas/gtso bor phu dud kyi yul ni sa'i snying bo 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/de la ji ltar na kun rdzob kyi dge slong zhe na/skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig rgyan cing rab tu byung la/so so thar pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan na de ni kun rdzob kyi dge slong zhes bya'o//zhes pa ltar so so thar pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i rab byung gi sdo nyid bsngags shing theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi lam sgrub pa'ang /ji skad du/dge slong mchog yin dge tshul 'bring /khyim na gnas pa mtha' ma yin zhes gtso bor rab tu byung ba'i rten wo gsungs mod/'on kyang sa'i snying po 'khor lo brgya pa'i mdo las/skye bo gang khyim na gnas shing skra dang kha spu yang ma bregs/chos gos kyang ma rgyan/rab tu byung ba so so thar pa'i tshul khrims thams cad kyang ma mnos/gsol ba dang /zhu ba'i las dang /gso sbyin dang /tshul gyi lasathams cad kyi nang du mi chud mod kyi 'phags pa'i chos dang ldan la 'phags20ba ) pa'i was bu thob pas na de yang don dam pa'i dge slong du bsdus te/de dag ni don dam pa'i dge slong zhes bya'o//zhes khyim ba gos dkar can gyi rigs 'dzin bshad pas na/ji skad du/slob lar grwa la rje yisams rkyen sbyor//bod kyi ban sngags dbu zlum lcang lo can//zhes btsad po khri srong lde btsan gyi dusasu bla mchod sde gnyis su grags shing /'dul ba'i dzisnod du rab byung gi rtags rnams mkhan posabaskos pa zhig dgos par bshad pas dge bsnyen sogs kyi cha lugs de 'dzin mi 'os par shugs la bstan na'ang theg pa chen po'i sde snod las/yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims la gnas bzhin par tshangs par mi spyod pa'i skabs kyang bshad pas/slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes/theg chen dam tshig la gnasan//'og ma'i 'dul sdom dam tshig kun//bsrungs ba med par thub pas na//dge slong byang chub sems dpa' dang //rnal 'byor dbang phyug ces bya'o//zhes 'byung bas rtogs par nus la/bstan pa phyi dar nas/sgom chen pho mo dang /ser khyim pa sogs cha lugs dang spyod lam mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa'i lung du ma bstan pa sna tsho gos byung ba dag/lung rnam 'byed las/lcags gong me lce 'dra ba dag/zos par gyur pa mchog yin gyi//tshul 'chaX yang dag mi sdom pa//yul 'khor bsod snyoms

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar sa / (ma)za ba min/ /zhes dge 'dun gyi rdzas dang mnyam por spyod pa rnam smin shin tu lci bar gsungs na'ang /de dag bsal pa'i khyad par dkon cog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing bla mar 'dzin (202na)pas na/slob dpon sharnyi pa dang mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ /phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs 'gros 'byed par gsungs la/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i cha shas su yang don gyis chud pa dang / gshen rabasames po'i rjes su 'jug pa'i gos pon ni rnam dkar kyi las rjes mthun pa sgrub cing / rgyu bon snang 'phrul phywa dur bzhi bod 'bangs kyi rgud pa sel zhing mthun rkyen rnams spel bas gnas skabs kyi rkyen sel la dgongs nas/ chos rgyal mes dbon gyis kyang ma nub pa mdzad pas mchod pa'i gnas kyi bgrang byar 'os shing / 'bangs rnams ni 'jug pa las/ de tshe de la rdzogs byang byang chub rgyu/ /dang po sbyin pa nyid ni lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes byang chub mchog gi rgyu'i gtso bo dang / sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyi sde/ /zhes yang srid kun tu dbul ba dang bral bar byed bas/ bstan 'gro spyi dang bre brag rang gas gyi don rgya rpā po bsgrub pa'i ོ du/ sngon chos skyong ba'i rgyal po mes dbon rim byon gyi dus su ru bzhin grags pa las/ dbu ru dang g.yo ru ste dbus kyi rgyal khams/ zhan byung byar gnyal dwags kong so gos kyi char 'khod pa'i mdo sngags kyi sde che phra/ ser khyim/ sgrub pa pho mo/ bon dgon 'bangs rnams la mchod sbyin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam par dbye ba'i deb ther phun tshogs 'dod 'do'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ba la/ (202ba) —237

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()g.yas ru gtsang gi ban sngags bon gsum gyi sder mang 'gyed dang mnga' 'bangs la 'bru 'gyed star chags su gtong ba'i deb kyi 'go brjod legs byas ga ba'i chu rgyun sogs/su lha ni kra lun go ru pā:tā gyurā shā ta su zhi kuṇḍa lo yaḥnog cu binā ya ā praṅgā no ta〉shā mbha lus nā thin su smo/'dus byas dam bca' 'jig pa rdo rje'i skur//'chi med tshe yi g.yung drung legs 'khyil gang //dpag med rnam 'dren kun gyi gtsor bzhengs pa//bde ldan zhing gi mgon des dge legs stsole//dug gsum nad kyi rtag mnar 'khor 'khyams 'gro'i//mi bzad gdung ba'i zug rngu gzhil byed mkhan//sngon med sman gyi bla ma btsong kha pa//ris bral lus can yongs kyi ngal gso'i stegs//rgyal kun tshogs gnyis sa bu ro tshog par//ris su tsod de snying rje ches dngar dad//las ba skye rgu'i bsod nams gzugs can bzhin/grub pa'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab rgyal//brgya phrag nyi ma'i dpal 'dzin gzi 'bar ba//zhal khyim 'dzum las 'bab pa 'dod 203na kho'i char//kun gyi re skong sbyin pa'i pha rol tu//phyin byed ngal bsos bu des shis par mdzod//bstan rtsa rang rgyud 'dul ba bag yod gling //theg mchog nges gsang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde//yid can chos dkar spel ba'i yul gyur zung //mdo dang rgyud sdomang por ches cha bsngags//rnam 'dren ston pa bden gnyisams nyid can//thob byar legs 'dzin de don sgrub pa'i grogs//dge 'dun nye bar bstan na cha byad dang //lung du ma bstan gyur kyang mchod pa'i gnas//gangs can lha chen mgu ba lhur len pa//gshen rabs mes po'i rjes su 'jug rnams dang //bsil ldan gling dgu'i cha la nyer spyod pa'i//skye rgu'i tsho gos kun bsod nams yul gyi phul//dge sdig gang bsgrub de rgyu slu med 'bras//'byung ra spyi dang sgos su rgud pa'i mun//sel byed gtong ba'i zla ba lhag bsam gyis//gser ri'i sbubs nas8

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo na khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)'bum phrag la tsho 'di mtshar//'dzad med bgrang byar kun tu dga' ba'i dpyid//chos nor 'dod thar ldan ba'i pho brang nas//'bangs rnams rtse dga' khong nas dgod byed pa//bkra shis rnam bar bkra ba'i sgo mang phye//zhes bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa sngon du btang ste/ji skad du/rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo las/dge 'dun la dge ba'i rtsab bskyed pa ni bgrang ba dang 3 gzung bar mi nus te/'khor ba zad par mi 'gyur/yongs su gtugs par mi 'gyur zhing /mya ga las 'das pa mi zad pa yang thob par byed do//zhes rang gzhan 203bar mas kyi rgyud kyi zhing sa la bsod nams kyi myu gu rgya cher skrun par byed pa bla na med pa'i sa bon legs byas kyi zhing dam pa ni dge 'dun yin la/de la yang mdo sngags kyi sgo nas phye ba'i rnam grangs mang du yod na'ang /bshes springs las/khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa ba'i na du//yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs//zhes sa chen po 'di la snod bcud kyi 'jig rten brten pa bzhin srid zhi'i yon tan thamasacad 'phel zhing rgyas pa tshul khrims la rag lus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la gdul bya'i bye brag gis theg pa sna tsho gis byung yang /bstan pa zhes ngos 'dzin rgyu yod med ni sems 'dul ba'i rim pa gtso bor byed pa'i snod la rag lus shing /de'i rgyu mtshan/'phags pa thogs med kyis/dam pa'i chos zhig cing nub pa na ni dge slong gi sdom pa ma blangs pa ni blang du med la/blangs pa ni yongs su mi gtong bar rig par bya ste/zhes rab tu byung ba'i sdom pa blangs kyang mi skye bsan dam pa'i chos nub par bshad cing /glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs zhes pa yang 'dul ba'i bstan pa la dgongs nas/thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen chen po ye bzang rtse bas/de ltar bod yul bstan pa la 'phel 'grib cher byung mod kyi/theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi bstan pa ni deng sang gi bar du nub ma myong zhing /zhes 'byung bas tshogs gsog gi zhing ni/ji skad du/so thar gyi mdo las/sems rta kha klan dka' ba la//mthun pa'i gzer rnon btab pa yi//srab ni so so 204na / thar 'di yin//zhes gdul bya nyon moXs kyis rengs pa'i sems rta rgod lta bu 'dul

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)thabs so so thar pa'i tshul khrims kyi srab la brten dgos pas/spyir so thar ris brgyad du bshad na'ang gtso bo rab tu byung ba'i sdom pa dang ldan pa nyid yin zhing /nges gsang theg pa mchog gi smin grol bsgrub pa yang /bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba las/phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa bsrung //nang du 'dusapa'i don la dga'//zhes nang gi rnal 'byor theg pa bla na med pa la brten kyang phyi rol nyan thos kyi bag yod dang ldan pa la bsngags mod/mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa/bya rgyud kyi spyi rgyud legs grub las/nyal dang khrus byed ma gtogos pa//sngags pas mthang gos mi spang zhing //dkar la shin tu 'jam po ste//nyin re bzhin du bkru bar bya//zhes gos dkar lcang lo can khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sde bshad pas/mnga' bdag khri srong khri lde btsan gyi dus su zhabs 'og gi rde'u dbu'i mchod gnas su btan pa'i mdo sngags kyi sde gnyis yod par grags shing /theg pa 'og mar rab tu ma byung bar de'i rtags mi 'dzin pa shugs kyis bstan na'ang /pha rol tu phyin pa'i de kho na nyid dam/gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor spyod pa dag la mtha' gcig tu rgyas khebs pa/pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'i mdo las/gal te byang chub sems dpa' bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du khyim na gnas te/'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams la brten cing longs spyod pa/nyan thos kyi sa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi sar 244ba / yang mi bskyed na/de tsam gis ni byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims 'chal zhes mi brjod do//zhes gsungasapas go bar nus la/rgyal khrims zhig nas yul gru der rang bzo'i cha lugs sna tsho gos dang spyod lam bag dang mi ldan pa'i dgon pa bar khas 'tshes pa'i sgrub pa pho mo dang /ser khyim sogs rgya cher byung ba dag/mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/lhun po dang ni 'dra ba'i me//blangs par byas te zos pa bla'i//khyim par gyur pas dge 'dun gyi//longs spyad pa ni mi bya'o//zhes lung du ma bstan pa rnams kyis/dge 'dun dang mtshudas par bsod nams kyi yul du rlom pa rnam par smin pa shin tu lci mod/'on kyang pad dkar chen po las/kun dga' bo phyi ma'i dus zad pa'i dus/dam pa'i chos 'jigs par 'gyur ba'i dus na gang dag nga'i bstan pa 'di la ༷༷ tu byung bar 'gyur ba dag rab tu byung nas bu'i

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)lag nas bzung ste/bu dang lhan cig tu chang skyogs gang gi phyir chang ma'i khyim nas chang ma'i khyim du lkoms pa/nga'i dam pa'i chos 'di rjes su slob pa de dag kyang kun dga' bo bskal pa bzang po 'di la yongs su mya ga las 'da' bar 'gyur ro zhes pa ltar na/tshul de dag dngos su bstan pa'i shugs la sgrub pa pho mor rlom pa sogs lta spyod yang dag pa ma yin pa rnams kyang dkon cog la dad pa'i skyabs 'gro'i bslab gzhi rjes mthun pa tsam 'dzin pa sogs nas 'khor rnam bzhi'i char gtogos las dkar kyi 'brel ba dang ldan pa dang /g.yung drung gi bon rnams chu bo'i pha rol tu sgrol ba'i gzings bzhin gangs can pa rnams kyi gnas spun bas su phywa g.yang legs tshogs spel ba la gcig tu mkho bas mchode yul du gtogs la/mnga' 'bangs kyi skye rgu rnams la sbyin gtong du bya ba ni/bzhes springs las/longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas//dge slong bram ze bkren dang bshes rnams la//sbyin pa tshul bzhin stsal bgyi pha rol tu//sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma ma mis so//zhes gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan bde'i legs tshogis rgya chen po 'grub par gsungasapas/rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang yid can rnams kyi bde skyid spyi dang /bye brag rang gas gyi phyir du dmigs pa'i legs byas gas po che bsgrun pa'i go du hor gyi bstan pa byung skabs khri skor bcu gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan/gtsang khri drug/'brog khri skor/lho brag lung gsum dang bcas pa'i yul gru'i char/mdo sngags kyi sde che chung /ser khyim/sgrub pa pho mo/bon dgon/skye rgu rnamasalamachod pa dang sbyin gtong skabs sbyar gyi rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang 'os su bya ba'i brjed byang gi deb ther bkra shis rnam par bkra ba'i sgo mang phye ba la/shing sprul zla bsto pa'i tshes gsum la che rṣa dpon po blo sang chos 'phel gyis 'phrul snang dang ra mo cher gos 'a gyi phye phur phul ba'i kha byang bde rpā zhing du khrid pa'i them skas bye ma phur ma'i kha yig/tshogs kyi dus nas bsgrubs pa'i 'og min ces//phra rab rdul grangs bag la zha nus shing //sal gcig gyur mngon sum 'phrul snang gi/sras sa rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i spyan snga sa/wo po /'a dang bur rgyal bod nas bcu mi'i//nang gi rtsa

sto dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tsom/ (9)khams rma las sna tsho gos skad//so sor snang ba sgyur byed lo tsā ba//che wo blo bzang chos 'phel lhag bsam gyis//bzang gos bye ma dri ldan phur ma ༅//ma rdzo sprin nam mkha' mdzod sprul sgo phye ste//bdag gzhan dge tsho gis dang cas phul ba'i 'bras//'gro kun bla med byang chub thob rgyur spel//'jig rten kun gyi mthun snang me long du//ring tsho tshe dang stobs lhor phun gsagazugs/shar ba'i mdzes sdug gzigs mor mtshar ba la//rtag tu blta ba'i skal bzang 'thob par shog/las sto gyis bcos skye rga na 'dri'i yong //bgrod tshe skyel bsu mdzad de bde ba can//yid 'phrog lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer du//khrid nas gto 'dun sgrub par bdag byin rlobs/shing sprul zla ga pa'i tshes gas la che rsā dpon po blo bzang chos 'phel gyi phrul snang dang ra mo sgo go ra gyi 'a3 phul ba'i kha byang sto mongs nags klung stsog pa'i me dbung /'phan gyi khi byang sgo tha' med ma rgan ched du dus gsum gyi//rgyal rnams tshogs gnyis bsags sa rnam 'dren sku//mi bskyod rdo rjer grags wor spyan gyi zur//thub stegs bdud las rgyal ba'i ba dan zung //rang gas ma lus sangs rgyas go 'phang che//sgrub 'dod rṣa tsho blo gros bzang po yis//chos dkar phung po 'phel rsā 'bul byed na//de don mdzo sum myong ba'i dga' ston stsol//sim pa'i nags klung wo mongs mes bsreg pa//mtha' med srid shul mya 4 thang 'khyams tshe//bde skyid grib tu bsil byed legs byas kyi//yongs 'du ri ljon pa 206nasgo la 'dab dar drag shog/byang tso snying po gser gyur glang po'i mches/rsām pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'byor ldan pa//yid srubs mi bdag g.yo sgyus gzho me min pa'i//'dzad med bcud kyi ro brgya myong bar shog/byang ོ la bsngos kha khyer mthon pa'i rtas//dkyus thog gcig gcod zhan la gnas skabs kyi//rgud pa'i me rtag drungs phyung rdzogs ldan thang //yangs por gcod pa'i gcong rong dmigs med shog/dpal ldan gos spung kyi kun dga' ra ba'i rten deng kyi 'go brjod sum rtsen lor phe tso zla/sdeb sbyor byed mnyam pa'i britta la myur ༅ dbusag lhag te re lu7dzan tsaṅgā rtsa'i zhe khaXte/ 7༅mkhas mā na ga mā pi ni ti ri rgyas ga46ta

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)ya snying po bde gshegs gser du bsgrub pa'i lcags//sems can khams kyi khyad par de snyed du/drang nges chos phung ston byed zas gtsang sras/shākya'i gtso kye mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams skyongs//206bzhing rtogs yon tan dus gsum rgyal kun dang //pha das par 'byog blos ma gzhal ngesamanyam par//gnyis mi za ba chos kyi rjesangs nas//dad pa'i yul gyur blo bzang grags par 'dud//zhabs sen zla tshes dpal gyi mgrin la sogs//yid can yongs kyi gtsug tor rtser mdzesapas//gaṅgā'i rdul gra pas bag zha'i bsod nams kyi//rgya mtsho'i zhing gyur 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal//spyan ras zur tsam lhungs pas srid zhi'i dpal//rang gir byed la gnyis 'thung 'gram ba'i chang /dngar por bung ba'i rol rtsed rjes 'gro'i las//lhun grub rig byed dbang mo snying dbus bzhugs//mtshan thos tsam gyis phongs sel dran pas kyang //brtan g.yo'i 'dod pa 'jo ba ngal bsos pos/legs byas nyi ma'i dngos brgya bla nas blar//rab 'bar gzi byin 'od po che de stsol//sgo gsum bag yod ngur smig gos klubs mdzes//mngon tshad pha rol phyin par thos bsam grwa/byang phyogs nor 'dzin dpal mo'i stor smin pa//gos dkar skrungs 'dra'i chos kyi sde chen po//ye ma gzhung brgyar dpyad bzod dgag sgrub khrir//rkang stegs byed ba'i mkhas mang 'di rnams dang //'phags yul grags pa'i dpal 'bar paṇa chen tshogs/kha skru tsam las khyad par dbye nus min/snyam dpyod ma dros las 'ongs legs bshad klungs//skal bzang rna ba'i chu gter cher babs nas//snying la kun dga'i rtsed 'jo ra ba zhes//sum rtsen bdag po'i pho brang 'phos wa gang //tshangs pa'i 'phrin brgyud gnam gyi she mong las/khrims gnyis 207na / rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab mi yi bdag/blo dang brtson bsabaskrun te 'dzam gling gi/nor bu'i spyad kun bsdus nas spungs pa bzhin//dge legs bon smin las phan bde'i ljon//'bras bzang ro brgya gda' ba'i g.yang chags pa'i//rnam 'dren sras bcasasku bas mchod pa'i sprin//sri zhug chos bzang 'dun sa'i dpal la 'gran//rmugs 'dzin phyag sor gyis btsir ne'u le'i//mgrin sku gsung sa sa rten gas 4khos dang rin po tsho spang rdza kha bzang gi dkar sa/ (ma)'byul pa'i rnyog ma kun mkhyen ye shes kyis//phra rab rdul tsam gzigs pa'i gnas ma gyur//'on te bye brag smra bas sher phyogs rnams//thub gsung min zhes rgol ba ji bzhin du//gzhung lugs mang thos mkhas pa'i go shāka gis//rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung la rnam par gsung //tshul der ma bzod 'jam dbyangs ches dga' ba'i//blo gros rnam par yangs pa'i bshes garsā dang //rje bzhi chos kyi rgyal mas dpal bzang bos//rtsod lan rdo rje'i thog gi rjes 'gro mdzad//phan tso dam bca' 'gog pa'i lung rig gis//thal 'gyur 'phen pa rgya bod mkhas pa'i lugs//smod tshig ku re'i tshul smra rtog ge yi/ngang tshul yin gyis khon du won rnams chas//mi bsrun bas por spyod sems mi ldan yang //rang bstan grub mtha'i kha 'dzin rpā tsam du//ser 'bras chos rje rnam gnyis legasabashad sman//'dzad med par gyi za ma rtag 'dir 'khyil//dge des phyag rgya ba sogs grub mtha' yis//ma bslad mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i//ring lugs spyi dang khyad par dbu ma yi//ming don zhakhrul med bstan pa rgyas gyur cig zhes rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha pa chen po'i gsung rab rin po che la/dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun mkhyen go rams pa dang /paṇa chen shāka mchog gnyis kyis rtsod cing /de lan ser tsos chos rje 'jam dpal dbyangs dang zhal gnyis pa rnam gnyis kyis mdzad pa mtha' dag/'phags 26na tshond paṇa grub rnams kyis rnam par thar pa dang mtshungs pa kho na yin pas/rjes su yi rang pa'i yul du gyur la//rtsod pa'i yi ge rnams par du 'khod 'dug na'ang /rtsod lan par du ma 'khod pa'i dpe rgyun dkon pas thal mo ya gcig ltar du song bsachos sbyin mi zad pa'i ོ dga' ldan phun gas gling du par du bskrun tshe za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o//sgrib gnyis 'ching rgya'i sprin las rnam grol ba//mas dpe'i gzi 'bar zhal sgo'i nyin byed kyis//rab phye chos phung rgya mtsho'i 'dab brgya'i tshal//theg gsum gdul bya bung bas spyad bya'i yul//mchog dman blo dang 'tsham par dam pa'i rgyaladabang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khri9)rim kyisatheg chen lam du nyer bkri ba/ /rgya bod mkhasagrub kun bzhed dgongasapa'i dpyid/ /'on te la lar thub pas gang zag gi /bdag yod bstan ltar kun mkhyen dol po ba/ /phyogasargyal nya dbon g.yin stong lta ba la/ /gtsor 'dzin gdul byar dgongasakyi spyod mul min/ /tshul desaklu sgrub gzhung la log rtog blo/ /bzlog phyir kun mkhyen bu ston red mda' ba/ /'jam mgon blo bzang gragasapa'i dpal sogasakyis/ /rtsod cing rgol ba mkhasapa'i ngang tshul yin/ /thub bstan rnyog mar byed la log smon 'bras/ /smin nasagrol min grol rdzu'i mun sprulagar/ /bsgyur nasatheg mchog (216brkobu mar gragasagazhung sogs/ /mu stegasalasagazhan kla klo'i chosekyi grogs/ /de phyir sgra tshad pa dang rin cen tog /rnam gnyisalegasabashad par gyi chosaspyin sgo/ /phye tshe yang dag chosakyisaphongasarnamasal/ /thar pa'i 'chi gsosabadud rtsideng 'dir 'grub/ /zla ba'i mched gyur dge tshogasabasil gzer gyis/ /'khor gdung zug rnguga'agro rnamasam mnar bar/ /ngesalegasathar bkri thub pa'i ring lugasamachog /'khor mtha' zad min de srid rgyasagyur cig /cesakun mkhyen shesarab rgyal mtshan/ rje phyogasargyal ba/ mkhasapa nya dpon kun dga' dpal sogasakyisagadul bya'i blo tshod bgam pa'i ched du gzhan stong gi lta ba gsungasapa la drang ngesakyi rnam dbye ma phye bar rjesa'abrangasasu rlom pa 'gas chos log gi yi ge theg mchog dbu ma chen por gragasapa sogasabartsamasashing / klu sgrub kyi gzhung la bskal par thosabasam byasapa bas thogasamed lugs kyi glegasabam spyi bor blangs ba'ang byang chub nye zhesagazhan stong gi lta ba de thogs med kyi bached pa min bzhin du rgya gar mkhasapa la rdzun khag bkal nas g.yin 'drid pa'i sbyor bsab lang rdzi lta bu'i blun po mang po lam log par 'phyan pa dag de lasaldog 'dod kyi lhag pa'i bsam pasakun nasablangasate thugasasras rin po ches mdzad pa'i bde gshegasasnying po'i mdzesargyan dang / gnasarnying pa rin cen tog gi yig cha gang rnyed rnamasadaga' ldan phun tshogasagling du par du brkos pa'i tshe za hor gyi bandesasbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangasadapal bzang ngo / /(dzi radabyid kyi thigalesmo217na)—254

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)tsista su ba lha ha ri da zhwa kusha lha ka the tadzdza zu te dza sha ta bha lika tsā wa bha su/sa rshasirnya a tha yatsā ma skyo rlan mikazhe khu tsā ra kar nā zhal aḥkār/bzang po'i bskal pa 'di yi snang ba sa/snying stobs nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'bar ba'i gzis//snyigs mar spyod pa'i smag rus gzhil mdzad pa//don kun grub mas snyan posab po lhas stsole/khyod zhabs rdul gyi ma tsam lhung bas kyang /khrid zhi'i snod bcud yod do chog kun gyi//nyes brgya'i dri ma drungs pa'i khyad par mthus//bsngags 'os shākya seng ger mgos phyag 'tshal//gang gis grangs med bskal gsum bsags pa'i tshogs//skyed bsrings yongs 'du'i gos bzang mngon par rtogs//rgyal kun mnyam por myong ba ro brgya'i zas//gto 'dun thob byar bsgrub pa chosadakon cog/de don sa dbyangs rgyud mangs sgrar drangs te//rtag tu bden 27ba po sung g.yasa'akhyil mgrin ba las//glur blangs chos phung ming tshig yi ge'i gzugs//legs shar yid can bsod nams mar sdong che//tso gsung mang thos yid ngor goms 'dris mthar//sal ma yon to lang tsho dar drag pa//mchog dman theg pa gsum gyi dge 'dun rnams//byang chub bsgrub la slu med snying gi grogs/shes byar srid la ma bsgribs gsal ba'i spyan//ris med 'gror gzigs sangasargyas spyi lugs kyang //rgyal gas gyis bor lnga bdo'i yid can rnams//rjes 'dzin zas gtsang srasakyi khyad par tsam//gzhan rgyud sdig dbral cha byad dam pa'i chos//skye rgu'i bsam pa'i mtha' snyed ston pa'i 3//gzhal bar 'jig rten mes po ngal gyur na/khung mthong byis blo'i yul du gal zhig/'on te thog mtha' bar gsum rgyal ba'i bka'//rim gsum btus pa'i chos kyi phung po las//gangasaljongs 'gyur ba'i mdo 'dul sher phyogs dang //thor bu'i rgyud kyi glegs bam bcas pa rnams//lung nos 'dzin 'chang waṃ dang sri zhu sa/bsod nams byas pa'i mtho ris a mu byu//'di snang gaṅgā'i yab kyi gtsug tor nas//kun mkhyen rgya mtsho'i klong du ro gcig 'dres//tshul 'dir nges rnyed sngon byon rgyal blon dang //mang thos chos sbyin yangs pa'i mkhas rnams kyis//dpyad cing bstar ba'i dkar chag legs btab nas//bsod nams gzugs shar glegs bam grangs med spel//dge sdig

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rnam rtog kun 'char yid kyi shel//yang dag bsam pa'i tshon gyis22༷ ba na//sngon rabs dam pa'i rnam thar rjes 'jug pa'i//lhag bsam 'ja' ris gzigs mor ci yang mtshar/yid srubs mda' lngas snying phug rlom pa dang //rgyags dang dregs pas kun blangs las dkar la//rnam smin nag po'i gos 'byin dge ba'i tshogs/khrid pa'i 'khor lo bskal srol//de phyir phun tshogasadage bcu'i mngal khur gyis//yongs dud gangs can ru bzhi'i g.yor po'i cha//nor 'dzin rab dkar thig le gra nang zhes//'chi med grong khyer sar 'phos yul gru na//thu rigs nor 'dzin skyong ba mi yi rje'i//lugs gnyis kha lo sgyur ba'i mdun na 'don//dpa' mdzangs dra ma'i rigs brgyud bsam dar ba//mda' dpon blo bzang bstan 'dzin zhes bya des//rnam dpyod rig pa'i srang la srid pa dang //gtan bde'i lci yang shes nas gas phan blos//rgyal gsung ri mor 'dri ba ches dka'i khur//snying stobs brtson pa'i dpung gis phrag par blangs//dngos bstar 'dis mtsho ni byas dang byed bzhin pa//byed 'gyur dge ba'i sa bon rang rgyud la//btab pa'i gos bu bla med ye shes kyi//ngo mtshar snye ma g.yur du za bar shog/nam mkha' bzhin du pha mtha' rnyed min pa'i//'gro dang mi 'gro'i sems can mtha' klas pa//las kyi me long 214khos shar gdung ba kun//sum rtsen bde ba dang mtshudas gnas 'gyur shog/lus can yongs kyi phan bde'i srog gi zungs//lung rtogs bstan pa'i rtsi sman ljon pa'i shing //rab 'phel sgrib gnyis zung rngu drungs snyan byed//'khor ba stongs min bar du gnas par shog/rigs kun bdag po mi yi gar mkhan gyis/ā kya'i lugs 'dzin rje btsun bla ma rnams//nges pa lnga ldan bzhin du gzugs kyi sku//'khor ba mtha' can de srid g.yo med shog/dus kyi bdag por gnam gyis bskos pa'i lha//sal stobs kyi 'khor nge pa'i rgyal//mchod yon nyi zla zung gi sku tshe dang //mas byus mnga' /nga sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)glang chen gom stabs lta ci smos//mig zur tsam yang gangs ljongs pa blo yi//rdzing bur mi lhung lusacan rkang bzang 'thob par shog/skye rgu rnams la bde gshegs snying po yis//nam yang gtong ba min yang srid mtsho sa/ring por du gsas mnar ba sgrol ba'i ched//byang chub mchog gyur legs byasa'adi 'gyur shog/ba po shis gang zhig dkon cog rnam gsum gyi//thugs rje yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po las//phun tsho gis 'dod pa 'jo ba'i char chen pos//sa 'og sa steng sa blar khyab gyur cig/ces ston pa mnyam med thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa shākya seng ges dpal gyi mgur nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi sgra las nye bar drangs te zhal gyi sgo nas ljags kyi dbang po bkrams te bka' stsal pa dang rjes su gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' rgya mtsho chen po las chu thigs tsam zhig mkhan slob chos gsum dang lo paṇa rim byon gyi bka' drin la brten nas gangs can swā la'i sman ljongs 'dir 'gyur ba las 'dul ba sher phyogs mdo mang yongs rdzogs dang rgyud kyi skor thor bu rnams g.yo ru grwa pas bsam dar ba mda' dpon blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nasablangs te bzhengs pa'i dus rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 19)bsod nams kyis/ /rtsa ba rab brtan 'byor pa'i mdzod 'dzin zung / /'di phyi kun tu phan bder spyod par shog /lus kyi bzos mtsho ni por khros pa srin po'i gzugs/ /thub bstan bsrung ba'i dam can rgya mtsho yis/ /nam yang g.yel ba med par mel tshe mdzod/ /dus babs 'phrin las gzhan du 'jug pa'i sgo/ /slebs min de srid rku 'phrog 'khyer byed rnams/ khyu ma'i skyes bu srog dang bral ba bzhin/ /bde stong zung 'jug dbyings su bsgral te drongs/ /pur rgyal gling dgu'i yangasapa'i rgyal khams(223ba〉kyi/ /rdzogs ldan dga' ston yongs 'phel rtsal ga tu/ shwakya seng ge ma smad ring lugs mchogo /byams bstan shar min bar du yar 'phel shog /khyad par 'jam dpal rdo rje bsdung kha pa'i/ /chos srid bstan dang de 'degs mi yi bdag /mchod dang yon sgror kun gyi srid dang zhi'i/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyi mthu dbal dar drag shog /sal rnam par bkrab 'dus pa'i sde/ /tshul gnasathos dang bsam pas rab tu shis/ /lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams rnam par thar/ /lhun po bzhin tu mi g.yo gnas par shog /nam yang bslu med sangs rgyas zhal sgo nas/ /stsal ba'i lung rtags de 'dzin slob mar bcas/ /rtag tu bden par gsung ba'i tshig btsan pos/ /'jig rten gsum du dge ba'i ba po shis shog /ces yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i dngul gdung rin po che dri gtsang khang rgya phibs mchod dzos dang bcas pa phyag mdzod snga rting gnyis nas rim pa bzhin spel ba'i rtogs brjod snying po —262

rgu'i bde skyid srog 'phrog dug gsum nad//rab bcom mdo rgyud 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud//kun la ster ba'i sngon med tshangs pa che//don kun grub pa shākya'i gtso bo mchog/mthong thos dran dang reg bas bsam grub rgyal po'i lhag bsam gyis//'dul mdo sher phyogasagangs ljongs 'gyur ro cog/thor bu'i rgyud sdebacas pa'i glegs bam bskrun//bden par gsung ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi//zhal gyis nyer la rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()long du//'char ba'i nges pa 'di la su yis 'god//bsod nams byas pa'i dngos po gzugs ro du//grub na snod du khams gsum 'di chung pa'i char rsā por//spyod la sa yi lha mo bden pa'i dbang //waṃ med lus phra'i tsho gos rnams rin cen rgyan//rab dkar du kū la yi gos gyon nas//rgyal ba'i gsung la mchod rdzas me tog 'phreng //mthor bas lha yi lam kun dog bor 'god//bstod bsngagasaglu dbyangs len dang lhan cig par//snyan pa'i rgyud mangs 'grol tshe klu dbang rnams//gdengs ka ro/ra bu'i 'od stong 'tsher bzhin du//mgrin pa bteg nas sbyor ba//mtha' dag 'khor 'khyams de srid bde ldan zhing //myur du 'og min gnas kyi gtsor 'gyur shog/rgyu spyor bsam grub rgyal po khyo shug zung //bu tsha rigs brgyud yos la 'jig rten dang //'jig rten las 'das dbang phyug yon to brgyad//'grub pa'i skal ba bzang por spyod par shog/nyi ma'i garsā gyi lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan//tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i sde rnams rab rgyas shing //de 'dzin bshes gnyen dam pa'i tsho gos rnams kun //chos 'khor bskor phyir bskal brgyar zhabasabartan shog/nyi zla zung tshol sa dbang mgo yon gyi//sku tshe byu srid mnga' thang rab 'phel snyo //gser gyi gnya' shing ltar lci bka' yi khrims//༷༷ can kun gyi phrag par gnas par shog/sems

sku gsung thug rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (ma)can spyi dang khyad par bod yul 'dir//'jigs chen brgyad sogs nyes brgya'i zug rngu rnams//ming tsam mi phyogs bod 'dir 'gyur ro cog/gsang sngags rgyud sde thor bur bcas pa yi//brgya phrag glegs bam bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing //226na skon po hor gyi yul nas wa du sus//nyer drangs sgyu ma'i nor la snying po sa/len mkhas dwags stod sa skyong lcang ra ba//mgon po tshe brtan chos 'dzin ming sring zung //thub pa'i gsung la ri mor byas pa yi//'bras bu yang srid kun tu bde ba'i rgyun//chad med 'bab rten gsum//phan dang bde ba'i snang bas khyab par shog/rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'di bzhengs mthun rkyen du//sgo gsum gtong bas phan pa bsgrubs pa kun//'di snang lha yi bde skyid la spyod cing //myur du 'dzeg shog/mchog gsum thugs rje

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras//skye rgu'i legs byas rgya mtshor nyer lhungs pa/khrid zhi'i bde ba ri gser sbyangs su//khrung ba'i phun lis dga' ston ho med shog/ces ga du su chos rjes rgyu sbyar ba nor 'dzin skyong ba lcang ra bas khur blangs/mdo mangs sil lung sher phyogs rnams sgo dang rgyud thor bu rnams bzhengs tshe smon lam zhig dgos zhes 26ba tha skul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtses bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu//chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi dri gtsang khang gi mchod rdzas kyi deb ther 'go brjod srid zhi'i dpal 'byor 'khyil ba'i gser gzhong sogs/po yo'i dzaḥbrikṣa su phaX.a lha li rtsa sus kha ta bye/kṛ spo rsārsā ha tatpanti rā lha so brtigamyus kṣa//rgyal rnams snying stobs dzaskru ljon pa'i gos//ma smad brtson pa'i rgya mtshor nyer zhu ba//bya dka'i khur rṣa bzod nus gser sbyangs su//legs bsgyur don kun grub pas 'gro 'di srungs//'jam mgon mas dpe'i dpal 'bar 'ja' lus sku//tha mal gdul bya'i mig gi dbang shes su//dur smig gar gyis rol ba'i btsong kha pa/khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma gtsug na mdzes//thog mtha' bar dge ba po shis chos kyi glu//rnam dpyod 7na da mangs sgra las nyer drangs nas//lusacan rna bar snya pa'i 'dod 'jo mkhan//dpal ldan bla ma mkhas mang yongs kyi rgyan//sgrib gnyis rtsod pa'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba//dge bcur rtag 'dun gser sbyang 'khor lo yis//sku gsum rdzogasaldan dga' ston rgya mtsho cher//spyod mkhas nges par thams cad mkhyen de rgyal/kṣa yi la dmar po'i nyag phran wa khog gis kyang //srid gsum brtan pa ma lus 'phrog byed pa/khro chags gar dgu'i nyams kyis zlos gar mkhan//bcom ldan rigs byed lha mos rtag tu skyongs//gdug pa'i rlangs kyis sbyin 66

snyeg /sgyu ma'i nor la snying po blangs pa yi/ /bdog pa chud mi 'dza' phyir mi bskyud slad/ /a 'dus ka 'phreng (227bskon pa'i yi ge mā /'god pa phra zhib mdzangs rnams spyi yi lugs/ /'jig rten gsum na grags so cog gi nor/ /legs byas gser gyi gzheng par spungs pa yi/ /deb ther 'dzam gling yongs gyi 'byor ba rnams/ /mngon sum ston pa'i me long gcig tu gsal/zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gi 'phreng ba sngon du btang nas gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'i ljongs ru bzhi las dbu ru'i cha skyid shod 'dzin ma'i spo las mngon par 'phags pa chos sde chen por dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i gtsug lag khang chen mo rten dang brten pa mchod rdzas dang bcas pa zhib mor bkod pa'i deb ther gyi rim pa la/ /mkhyen brtse nusapa'i 'od mtshon snang byed rgyun/ /mnyam med shākya mu nir phul ba yis/ /ngag dbang blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /'og min zhing gi mgon ltar brtan gyur cig /mchod sprin stobs byed bsam grub rgyal po sogs/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rab 'phel zhing / /yang srid kun tu rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal/ /de don nyams blangs sangs rgyas 'thob par shog /ces jo bo shākya mu nir rgyun mchod gtsugs pa'i kong gi zhal byang la smon lam 'di lta rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo slong gyom gsung las/ ()rgyal pos bskul ba ltar ba hor gyi bzhes sbyar// 2zha zhe tshur sa ga rkang po gsam 4 'a44/bhra ma ka bha ba na tshos stunta kā ho snas rgya sumaḥkānta rer bibha ga' mi to dwas smi rgyu rsāmatshitha lo skyo rir su pa//ltor ba'i a gsum mthar byed sems bskyed skya rengs rdzogs pa'i pha mtha' na//mas dpe'i 'od stong dku cher rab 'bar sku gsum nyi ma'i dngos brgya'i lus/sa ka la dzagatas karādzin ṅgā to lnga'i gyi97ni dze stor ya ṇa da hi bha bta9thag do thugarañtsakra bhā pā yan sti rka/'gro tso legs byas 'a dbyings lam du pa ra pa rtag rgyu tshe//yod mi shesapa srid pa'i nyes mu smag rus dpung byu ga re// 4〉cos mu 'khor ba'i 'gro la mi rje ryā//rgyalas ma' pa wom dbyangs ga nu'i skur//legs bas 0 po bod kyi rgyal khas ni//mi yigazugs4na btsong kha pa las su//gang gi ring lugs nor 'dzin dpal tsho mngal//'degasapa'i snying sa gos ser mā gyi grogs//ngo ma' skyes rabasang won dben sab//blo bzang chos kyi sto mas bsgreng de bsngags//ṣka khams rgya mtsho rdul snyed 4sa rgyas kyis//bar pa'i 'gro don khur wo rtag khyer nas//grangs med chos lor bskor ba'i don tso grub//rna gsung yid can kun la phan pa'i sman//༅ mongs dug ldan 'gro rgyud nyal 'gro'i rgyun/khrungs byed tshul khrimasabaslab pa ā ga sdus//mtho ris chu bor bsgyur ba sdebasto lung //tso bska yongs kyi rtsal ga rsāg pu wo//rdul phran i gyi las kyang mi slu'i gos//nges rnyed la 'a ba'i me long sna rdzas mdo//gdul bya'i khas dang mgo dman theg pa rnams//mas gsal ba dbang pho gzhu ris bzhi//bdag med gnyis ston 'khor lo bar pa dang //legs par rnam phye dkon brtsegs phal rsā sogs//zab gsang brjod bya rgya che theg rṣa zlas//skal bzang snying gi tshol khong nas bas//mas cas mas med bskyed rdzogs them skas la//gas nas sa kyis bsgrubs pa'i 'og min du//rang sams dag pa'i khyab bdag rdor sems skur//bgos byed rnyed dka' rgyud sde yid bzhi nor//bstan 'tsho don mardzo thugs kyi dpal be'ur/68/229na thagasangs sngon byon tso blon lo

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4kho sgo dang rin po tsho ma rdzo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)paṇa gyis//'bad pas bsgyur ba'i thub gsung glegs bam 'phreng //gangs can skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing gi dpyid//rnam 'dren mdzad kun gas phan ho rtsom yang //rang rtog sgrib lus ro rgyud spo ba'i nus//med phyir chos rna bden pa bstan don du//legs par gsungs 'di kun gyi gtso bor bsngags//thog mar yar klungs 'phang thang ldan dkar ma//bar du dbus pa blo gsal bcom ral rje//mtha' mar tshal ba kun mkhyen bu stone sogs//mkhas pa'i dkar chag mi 'dra sna tsho gos las//mthing shun shog bur gser sbyangs yi ge'i gzugs//rab 'bar mdo 'dul sher phyogs gang 'gyur dang //rgyud sdo thor bu them spangs ma'i rjes su 'brangs te dam pa'i dgongs pa skong phyir bsgrubs//mgon de'i dbon rigs las 'ongs rim gro pa//phun tsho gos snying sto bos rab brtan blo brtson gyis//phrag par blangs pa'i dge tsho gos gzugs can du/grub na 'jig rten gsum 'di snod du chung //chu srin rgyal mtshan phyar g.yeng bag zha ba'i//gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin zas kyi char//ro bda' nyamasasu mkha' mnyam lus can gyis//mngon sum myong ba'i bskal bzang 'thob par shog/chos kyi mu ge'i nad las 'gro ba rnams//thar byed thos bsam sgom bstan snye ma yi//'brasabu 'dzad med phung bor cher spungs pa//rtse mo tsha pas pa'i yulas las brgal shog/gser tso mdangasaldan zhwa yi cod pan can//dga' ldan sna bo'i ring lugs gaṅgā'i chab//srid pa 229ba tshe/rgyagasacan sgyur min de srid du//rgya hor bod tshor rtag 'bab ro rsāg shog/blo bzang don yod grub pa'i dam chos kyi//rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad 'khrungs rabs bcu gcig pa//rang rigs mes kyi khri la legs bzhugs te//'phrin las nam mkha'i ska rags 'ching bar shog/rgyal kun ye shes ngo bo mi gtong yang //tshur mthong byis blor mi yi 'jig rten na//gang 'tsham gdul bya'i blo brid sgyu ma yi//cho phrul rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)snying po'i snye ma dud pas mes po'i blor/ khong min sngon med gzigs mor tshar dngar shog /bkra shis chos dung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'dzag pa'i rdzi/ /langs tshe yang srid brgyud ma'i sa gzhi la/ /mtshan dpe zla lha'i ras dkar cher dgram shog /gtan 'dun nam mkha' thal mar phyung ba yi/ /rmongs chen (230sko 'khor ba'i ri bo 'bigs byed de/ /gzung 'dzin rnam par mi rtag sar stol ba'i/ /sems bskyed phrag par gzhan phan khur 'byer shog /bcu gnyis khyim gyi 'khor ba sgang gshong mar/ /pha mtha' mi mngon skye ba nyi zla'i 'gros/ /chad med rgyu ba'i gtan gyi ngal gso mā /myang 'das sgra gcan mngal du nyal bar shog /bdog ba gtong dang sgo gsum sgrim byed pa/ /srid pa'i dgra las rgyal ba'i rdza rnga che/ /brdung dang lhan cig lag /mi 'chor thar srog zungs 'gyur bkra shis shog /sngon byon mkhas grub rnam thar thosapa'i mod/ /ba spu'i 'khri shing g.yo ba 'gram pa'i chu/ /ldang mi dgos par grub pa'i mtha' kun la/ /chos spyod rnam bcur spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /yang srid lha mi'i bde ba'i ror sred dang / /rang don zhi ba'i lam du 'byar 'dod rgyur/ /ma song bsags pa'i bsod nams phung po rnams/ /mtha' med ma rgan rdzogs byang 'thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen 'gro ba'i bla ma blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i dgongs pa chos dbyings zad mi shes pa'i slong du rdzogs ched/ phyag mdzod phun —270

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)tsho gis rab brtan gyis sa'i zla ba tso ma'i khu bas bris pa'i mdo 'dul 230bskor phyogs yongs rdzogs rgyud sde'i glegs bam che longs dang bcas bzhengs pa'i dkar ga gi mjug tu 'dri rgyu'i smon lam 'di ni/dpyod ldan tsha rong ba tsho rig byed 'dzin pa'i gnas brtan can rdzong sta byas te bskul ba la brten nas/sde snod gsum pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha tso bstan lang tsho'i sdes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o//sdeb spyor zlum po/spro(nom skyi/tsa sbad dzñaḥyakā du lha ba bas rtog lha kho dha〈bhi brta su ā mi ma rga sto/ /gtso med 'dus ma byas par lhun grub ma' brtse nus mnga' rdzogs sangs rgyas//rang rgyud la goms mdzo du bsgyur bya bden pa gnyis ldan sa lam chos//231nashī la ba0ṅgā na tsatri ya rgyas gha ni rtsa su༅ra ṇa snyirwa ma nutta ra tri ratna myurta5ya//tshul bzhin bsgrub pa theg gsum dgra bcom slob mar bcas pa dge 'dun te//mi slu gto gyi skyabs gnas bla med das cog lhu go gtsug na rgyal//dge ba'i sa 'dzam stan la skyil mo krung //legs bcas gtsig gi ring la bo bsto dpung //bas nas byang tso mchog brnyes don tso grub//khas kyi padma ra gusabaco mgos phyag 'tshal//bka' rnams sgo pa gsum du bsdumadzad nas//ring por bstan gnas bya ba legs byas pa//mi brjed gzungs thob dgra bcom 'dus tshogis kyi//rnam par bsams tshe lag pad snying gar zum//gangs ljongs smag wo dam chos sgron spar nas//tso bstan snang bas231baches cher rab dkar ba//zhus li 'gyur bcos mdzad pa'i lo paṇa dang /mas pa'i rkyen sbyor rgyal blon dam pa'i drin/khyad par lag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i lha//zur phud lnga ldan gsang 'dzin mthu wo thob //chos ldan sa skyong sgyu 'phrul rol gar mkhan//mes dpon rnam gsum bod 'bangs phan bde'i phyog/nag phyogs lha srin gdug pa lcags kyi khams//dkar bo cho ge kyi srungs ma'i gser sbyangs su//mthu stobs rtsi yis bsgyur mdzad padma khrung //bka' drin srid gsum sto bar shong nusamin/༅ mongs klung rṣa drag por zhabrug pa'i rba//tshi khrims bslab pa'i chu lon gyis bsrung ba//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bstan rtsa so thar yongasa'adu'i grib ma la//'gro rnamasangal gsor spyod pa'i zhi ba 'tsho//don rtog gdon brlamasachosalog ro langs lce//rnam dag lung rig ral grisagacod mdzad pa//padma'i ngang tshul paṇa chen mar me mdzad//saskya pa zhesasnyan pa'i gragasapa dkar//blo grosagazingasakyi gtsug lag rgya mtsho che//brgal nusa'ajig rten mig gcig shong dpang zung //kun mkhyen bu ston 'jam mgon btsong kha pa//rnam dag thub bstan 'dzin par bgrang bya'i 'os//'dren pa 'jig rten byon pa'i gshegasabazhugasakyang //'gro la sman pa'i phan yon mtha' klasamod//sgrib gnyisa'aching rgya gcod pa'i mtshon rnon po//legasagasung dam pa'i chosakyi phung por nges//'chad nyan 'dri klog sri zhung gang bgyisapa//'di dang gtan bde'i rgyur 'gyur tshad ma'i gsung //mi slu bden pa'i dpang du sa'i lha 232nazo//lusaphyed 'dzin ma lasathon bzhin mdangasangom//snyigasalasacher snyigasalnga bdo'i dusakyi tshe//rgyal gsung ri mor bgyisa'adod lhag bsam la//phyogasabacu'i bde gshegasarnamasakyisamagrin gcig tu//cher bsngags dbugasadabyung mdzad par gdon mi za//yangasapa'i pur rgyal gling dgu'i rgyal khamasakyi//bye brag gtsang phyogasagayasaru ru lag ces/khyu skar sal bkram pa lta bu yi//hor dud khri skor drug phye'i yul ljongasan//dpa' gtum srin po'i byin sha 'dar byed pa//rgyal po'i zho shasa'atsho ba'i rkang thang dpung //tsho chen mda' dpon lasa'adzin gzer chen pa//rnam rgyal tshe ring rang lo zhe gnyisathog/dge sdig so sor spyad pa'i rnam par smin//lcagasardul lta bur phra yang dkar nag 'bras//mi slur yi dam brtan po'i gtan tshigasakyis//legasabyasaspel 'di'i khur chen 'bad pasablangs//gangasaljongasa'agyur ba'i rgyal gsungasapusta ga'i//dkar chag sngon rabs mkhas pas mang spel bar//yul dus gnasaskabasadagosadabang dpyad brdar gyis//bzhed tshul mi 'dra'i khyad par pha mtha' yas//sgrib med gsal ba'i chos can bhra ma raḥ/shes bya kun gyi padma'i sbubasa'ajug pa'i//nges par thamasacad mkhyen pa bu ston rje//rga ma'i dpang por dpyod ldan mgrin gcig gleng //rjes 'brangs yum sras bcu bdun lung sde bzhi//mdo mangs phyi 'gyur rgyud 7

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho ma rdzo rdzas kha bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)sde lhad brtan steng //mdo sgyu sems phyogs sgrub pa sdebargyad sogs//theg mchog snying po'i glegasabam rnam gsum 232ba tha snan/khred 'byor bsgrub brtson chu shing snyem la//mtshar 'dzin byis pa'i blor nges rnam dkar dge/dza lha'i gos bu mtshor lhung gto 'dun gser//'grub na sras bcas rgyal bas legs so ster//'dis mtsho ni tshe rabs bsags pa'i bsod nams kyis//rdul brtsegs phung po ti se'i gtsug tor las//chad med 'bab pa'i dzaḥ'i bu mo'i rgyun//kun mkhyen zla ba'i ma mar 'dren gyur cig/skye bar gzhal dka'i drin ldan dge ba'i bshes//rang snang mos ngor rgyal kun ye shes gzugs//bzhin lag rnam pa shar ba'i sku'i bkod pa//bskal brgyar 'gro la ma ho sum snang bar shog/bde ldan zhing mgon byin rlabs rdo rje'i khams//thugs rje bskul ba'i me lces bzhu blug pa'i//srog gi ka bas a lha yongs bsten pa//mi shigs rdo rje'i ngo bor lhun grub shog/rnam dag bshad sgrub bstan pa dar ba'i yin//mos pa'i phyogs kyi rtags tsam 'dzin rnams kyang //rang gi ngang tshul mi gtong dkon cog gsum//rjes dran dge ba'i blo des yar 'phel shog/zhwa ser 'dzin pa'i chos srid nyi zla zung //gur kum dri bsung 'phro ba'i grong khyer nas/shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar lha lam ngos//rtag tu 'phel 'grib med par 'char bar shog/rgyal rigs su la pa ltar mngon mtho ba//gnam bskos mchode yon zung du 'jug pa'i khrims//tshe ring gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yis//'dzam gling yongs kyi gnya' na lci bar shog/spyi dang khyad par gangs can bod yul 'gro//tshe yang ring por 'tsho ba'i mas ma dang //rmugs233na 'dzin 'byor pa'i dpal 'byor longs spyod pa'i//bde skyid nyi ma gung nas 'char bar shog/skye ba'i ṣka sar rtag smin chosadakar gyis//sa bon 'debs pa'i byed po sbyin pa'i bdag/'khor ba nyes brgya'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing //tshe ring stobs 'byor dbang po'i spun slar shog/'di'i ho sgo gsum ngal ba brten pa'i mir//ma zad tshong 'grul khal sogs byol song yang //'khor 'khyams de srid mngon mtho'i rten 'dzin ṣka //ring min thar pa'i grong du 'jug pa/ shog/

rgyal dbang lnga par ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gang bsags dge tshogs sems can thams cad dang //mnyam por byas shing lus can mtha' dag gis//thos pa'i bsod nams thun mong longs spyod pas //bdag gzhan dus gcig myur du la'i rgyar shog/tshe yi g.yung drung 'khyil ba rdo rje'i srog/rigs brgyud ho pa med pa chu bo'i rgyun//stobs lhor rnam thos bu dang mdzod gcig pa'i//rdzogs ldan rtse dga' dgod pa'i bkra shis shog/mchog gsum drang srong lha dang rigs lon gyis//brjod pa'i bden tshig dngos su grub pa'i gzugs//'khor 'das yon tan kun tshang dpal be lnga khyu sbyor snying dbus g.yas 'khyil shis pa stsol//zhesamada' dpon gzer chen pa rnam rgyal tshe ring gis rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa'i glegs bam brgya phrag bzhengs pa'i dus dkar chag brtan bzhug smon lam zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi rigs las sdom brtson sde snod gsum pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdos pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge 233ba lnga ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o//legs byas thags su btags pa'i ri mo la//dang pa'i sems kyi rdo thal byugs pa ltar//ras dkar zla ba'i spun zlar snang bas tshogs//ri dwags gzugs kyi mdzes pa 'phrog pa bzhin//dam tshig pir gyis bris pa'i bzhin lag can//rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i ting 'dzin gyis/ye shesasems dpa'i mdangs bkrag 'od 'tsher bar//grangs med me rtag gsil ma'i char chen phab//'dir btab bsod nams sa bon bsngo ba'i chus//mtha' klas skye bar lus rdzogs a mra'i shing //gto gyi bde ba ro bda'i 'bras bu la//spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog zhes pa yan lag bzhi ga'i rjes yod pa'i 'dra 'bag dang /lag pa'i rjes kho na yod pa'i thang gar/ti se'i gtsug tor dbang po'i gzhu ris kyis//'byud pa ji bzhin rnam bkra'i ri mo can//mos pa'i bsil zer gyis phye snang bas gyi//kunda'i 'dab ma ma rga sum 'dzum pa bzhin//ye shesa'ajug pa'i cho ga lan gnyis steng //rten 'brel snying pos byin brlabs 'bru dkar tshogs//zla lhag bar du brgya phrag legs gtor bar//sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs zhugs pa bzhin//blo ldan

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang ran po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sa/ (ma)gzhan phan bzang po'i bsam pa yi//lus can kun gyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen//mthong thos brtse rpā gzings gis ga bon nor//rnyed khi tshe ring 'byor pa lhun grub shog zhes pa 'di yang gsol dpon ge re ba blo bzang mkhyen brtses dad rten gyi thang ka gnyis bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgosatshul byung ba ltar zla hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang ma' brtse'o//234nasdeb sbyor a gas dang pos ma pa'i char 'bebs/pho brang byu po po ta la'i go mdzod rdo rje gling gi g.yul mas rnams kyi deb ther le phywa gyi 'go brjod sdeb sbyor rgyun chags dang po gtum po'i char 'bebs sogs/bin yam gtso snom luḥdzan po spo rta go skor stu:yi bi ka kho su tsarme:tsho༅ro lhasardib pa ta grwanta taḥ/log 'dren bsad pa'i mgo 'phreng rgyu ma ga shar byas kyang ma tshim par//khrag 'dzag pags rlon lding stabs gyon nas bam ro 'dam star brdzi ba yi//a tir ba ṇa sharī ra kā la su sha cabi lā li kyi marnya badzre jig kro tan sti ka sti skotsā dzwa tru lha ñtsakra shirnyerlugs mo pa ti6kus/srin po'i gzugs kyis dus dgrar rnam rol 'jam dpal rdo rje khro bo'i dbang //mtshon rnon wor bas dgra dpung mgo bo go car sal lhung bar mdzod//2347samasapa tsam gyis 'dod pa'i dngos grub kun//'bad med rtsol la yongs2'i mar gyur kyang //yid grubs gshed du gnam lcags rdo rje thog/dmag zor lhag pa'i lha des rtag tu skyongs//gya gyu'i sems ldan rgol ga glang po'i mgor//gsod rtags ka ra wa ra'i me rtag 'phreng //rab 'god 'jigs med rgyud kyi nga ro can//beg tse lcam dral bla tshe srog gi bdag/zhe sdang nyi ma 'char ka ltar dmar mig/zlum por blta ba'i zol gyis dgra bo'i bla//'gugs mdzad sprul pa'i chos rgyal sdo lnga

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung la gum/ (9)po//gsang yum sprul blon tshogs kyi mthu dpung skyed//gang gi bka' gnyan btsan rgod gnod sbyin che//dkar nag las rnams 'byed pa'i mel tshe mkhan//gangs can chos srid bstan 'dzin phas rgol gyi/khrog snying khrag dron ro bda'i skyems su gsol//dkar nag rtsis kyi lo zla zhag gi lha//gza' skar spar sme sa bdag rgyal blon 'bangs//thugs kar sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa//stobs ldan dgra lha'i tsho gos kyis rtag tu srungs//yid can yongs kyi phan dang bde ba'i gzhi//don kun grub pa'i ring lugs bla na med//yun du gnas 'phel rtsa lag gnam bskos lha'i//khrims gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i srid kho na//skye rgu'i bde skyid 'phrog pa'i chom rkun mun//mthar byed 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me che//rgyal thabs yan lag rnam bzhi'i dpung tshogs nyis//rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i snang ba ches cher sbar//gsar 'gros gom gsum 'dzoms pa rta rmig gis//bsnun pa'i sa chen 'dar ba rdul gyi 'tshub//bskal ba'i 'thor rlung rjes 'gro'i shugs drag 235na rko pung //lha dmag rtsub 'gyur tshal du bsgrigs pa bzhin//pha rol dgra sde srog phral grangs de snyed/khro gnyer smin mtshams bsdus pa ri mo sa/'dri ba'i dpa' gtum rtsal ldan tsho wo zhes//rgyal po'i zho shas 'tsho ba'i stag shar tshogs//glog ltar 'byug pa'i dpa' po tu sa ska/hor dang mdo khams stod smad byang 'byog sogs//skad dang lugs srol mtha' klas rnam thos bus//g.yar mo'i thang du mngon sum bkug pa bzhin//mi bsrun sbyor ga rtsom la zhe snang me//gser srang stong gis brngan yang zhi min pa//rab khros blo de yid srubs lus phra ma'i//mngon 'dod rtse dga'i 'phrul gyis tshod nus min//rgya byi dmar bal g.ya' ma skya chen dang //li ting me rur grags pa gsar rnying bar//legs byung sgrog phyis kha thi sha dom gzham//bkod mdzes srog skyob ches btsan rdo rje'i go/li gzha' la sogs rigs bcu sra mkhregs rmog/rgyal mtshan rgod phur dom ru ang seng dang //gzha' ris rnga gsus la sogs brjid ldan pa//'jigs med dpa' bo'i ring rtags mtshar du dngar/khong shes srog gi bsrung ba lcagasagazhibs go/che chung phub dang lcags zhol rnga mas so/sa//dbang gzhu ltar ba po 'chi med dpung tshogs

sku gsung thug rten gsar bgos dang rin po che'i mchod na khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (ma)rnams//lha min 'dul phyir g.yul du zhugs pa bzhin/ru mtshon ba dan phyar ba srid rtser snyeg/dpag chen mda' dang 'phrul skyogs me yi mtshon//ral gri'i 'od sngon 'phro la dpung rgyan du//skrud pasadagra snying shubs nas lkog mar thon//phru ma'i dbus na gur dkar lhun bo ltar//mtho brjid yol ba'i 235bskogs ri khor yug can//lding gur bza' btung spyod pa'i yol go sogs//mkho dgu'i 'byor ba gnod sbyin mdzod bzhin gtams//log 'dren srog bral mgo bo med pa'i ro//'dab chags sha za'i gsos su bkram pa'i gtam//thos pa'i mod la gya gyu'i sems ldan gyi//yid la gnag pa'i dam bca' ring du dor//chen po rtul phod sgyu rtsal 'phong skyen po//sto bos ldan rwam ṇa yi rjes 'gro bas//rgyal rnga lan brgyar brdung dang lhan cig par//bstan byus yid bzhin tog mdzes rgyalamatshan 'phyar//rang srid bstan dang de rjes 'brang kun gyi//byus legs rdo rje'i srog shing rab tshugasapar//dkar phyogs dga' ba'i lha rgyal 'then pa dang //skyid pa'i dbyangs snyan sgrog la gcig tu brel//gangs can mang bkur rgyal khab chen po yi//go mdzod rdo rje lta bur sra brtan gling //gragasapa don ldan dbya yis rab gtams pa'i//brjed byang deb ther yi ge'i 'phreng mdzes spel//zhesashis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sbun bsus te/'jig rten khams ler/gling ni zla ba 'od dkar can dang rab mchog ku sha dag ni mi'am ci dang khrung khrung dang //drag po yang ni longs spyod ba ste bdun par pa mi rnams gnas pa dag ni las kyis//zhes spyir gling ban gnyis po thams cad 'dzam gling chen por bshad cing /de'i nang nas dzasbu'i ljon bas nye bar mas pa'i lho gling 'di la 'tham gling chung ngur grags pa ni/gdan bzhi las/rgyu gling du legs skyes pa//dngos grub sa par shesapar bya//gling gsum por ni skyes ba ni//'bras bu 'byung ba'i bsod nams gnas//zhes dang /bde 236nasgo cho go mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/'dzam bu gling ni chen po yi//dum bu bcu gnyis kyi ni dbus//'dzam bu gling ni chung ngu 'dir//bdag gi shākya'i rigs rjes 'gro/zhes lho 'dzam bu gling 'dir bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rnams byon cing 'byon par 'gyur ba'i gnas//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 19)mi rnams kyang dbang po rno zhing grims pa/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i rten khyad par can du gyur pa dang /rdzogs ldan gyi dus su 'khor rte ba'i rgyal po byung ba'i tshe/ gling 'di nyid nas 'go brtsams te gling gzhan rnams la dbang sgyur bar bshad cing / gling 'di'i lte ba rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi ma ga dha rdo rje gdan yin na'ang / khro phu lo tsā bas kha che paṇa chen la phul ba'i zhu yig tu/ ma ga dha sogasarig 'byung gnas na sdig to yis/ /dmag tshogs kyi bcom skyon kha che bal yul yang / /log spyod kyis khengs deng sang bstan srol legs gnas ni/ /bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogs zhabasabaskyod zhu/ /zhes dus kyi dbang las phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa'ang bod yul kho nar dar bar gsungs shing / yul de ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du/ nga yi dusanas lo brgya na/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /swā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gangs kyi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i su la'i ljongs chen po ru bzhin grags pa ste/ de yang pu rangs/ mang yul/zangs dkar gsum skor ra khrig /li/ gru sha/ sbal sdogasum skor gcig /zhad zhung / khri sde/ stod smad gsum skor gcig ste stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ mdo khams la smad khams btags pa (236ba)khams gcig /mdo smad la g.yar mo thang btags pa khams gcig /btsong kha la gyi thang btags pa khams gcig ste smad mdo khams snang gsum/ dbus na dbu ru dang g.yo sa gtsang na g.yas ru dang ru lag gis dbus gtsang ru bzhin grags pa'i nang nas/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ lha ldan yul zhes bya ba 'dir/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /li tsa bi rnams rigs su 'byung / /zhes lung bstan pa'i lha ldan ni/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang ngam/ yongs su grags pa chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa'adi yin la/ yul 'di ni gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sa padma 'dab brgyad/ logs bkra shisartags brgyad de dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus na/ rigs gsum mgon po'i bla ri gsum yod pa'i nang tshan/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bla ri glang po che dres la btags pa lta bu dmar po ri'i rtser gnam bskos rgyal po'i pho brang mdzes sdug rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la rngam brjid laṅka mgrin —278

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)bcu'i grong khyer lta bu'i rgyal khab wo po'i go mdzod rdo rje'i gling du gsol go'i rim pa//drung 'khor gyi yo khrab ta go dang cas pa/dbus tsho wo bzhi'i gzabs mchore dang /thang ring du bgrod pa'i yang chas gyi go cha dang /gzhung skyong gi hor sogs khams 'brog gi go cha/mdor na ral gri/mda' mdung/tsher 'a so gos mtsho ni cha/dkyil sgar gyi gur wo//yol skor/lding gur/lding zangs so gosachar skyob 'tsho mas kyi nyer mkho ji snyed pa rnams yod pa chud mi 'dza' zhing /go rim mi 'khrugs par byed pa'i ched du 'phags yul ba pra wa sgor 'bod cing /rgya nag gi yul du ting wal zhes pa 'byung ba sum 237na skon me lug hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu dgu dmag dpon tha skar gyi 'grub sbyor thog gsar du bsgrigs pa'i deb ther g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba 'dzad pa med pa'i gter gyi sgo 'phar phye ba la/thog mar/sdeb sbyor lag 'gro nga bsu gcas lha lha pa rākra mya bha byod lha shwa ltarakṣa stunāñtsa3pa/25nirti lwa li tu rje shā sa nā ra/senā pa te rdarbate༅ga sna//bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi nus mthu'i rtsal//rdo rje srin po'i gzugs su legs shar ba//thub bstan 'byung ba'i dregs pa'i sdod pon kye/khrag po'i las la dga' ba'i gar gyis rol//sog bod hor 'byog la sogs cha lugs skad//mi gcig yul nas dpa' mdzang rtul phod rtsal//'dzom kun byed pos gcig tu rab bsdus ba//brgya sbyin g.yul du zhugs pa'i rta dmag bzhin//lha dbang mtshon gdengs tsam gyis bcud bral mo'i//mngal rnams cig car lhung na ya mas na//phasargol srid sder tsos pa'i snying shubs nas//'don byed go 237byu yang rtse'i gnyis pa ma'//zhes shis 'byor bya spyod sher phyogs dang //'dul mdo mu tig 'phreng ltar yongs bsgrigs par//bka' rnams 'gyur ro cog gi ming du snyan//dkar 'jam shog bu'i me long dngas pa'i ngos//sdeb gzugs ngo mtshar snang brnyan rab gsal ba'i//brgya phrag glegs bam 'di bskrun byed po mā/gtogs kun 'di phyi'i 'dun 8

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ma lhun grub shog/ rgyal bstan nor 'dzin lus phra'i mngal yangs por//ris med skye rgu'i bde skyid tsandan ljon//legs sgrum lang tsho dar ba'i dri bsung gis//dkar min las kyi tsha gdung mthar byed shog/bsod nams byas pa 'dis mtsho ni dus gsum du//bsags dang gsog 'gyur dge ba ma lus pa//snying rje'i yul gyur mkha' mnyam ma rgan tshogs//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//zhes dkar chag smon lam gi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni lha sa chu mig kha pas bka' 'gyur rin po che bzhengs pa'i dus bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ba 'jam dbyangs so//246naskanta ma hā ga9su dzagaḥso gro khyasu kalbe di pa tsa rā sha/tsistab le rgya rotta ra go ro sgo sta3pā lu kya mu ni sa/lus can tsho gos kyi bsod nams phung po che//spungs pa'i sgron me'i bskal pa bzang po la//snying stobasamachog gi bla nas blar mtho ba//bcom ldan shākya seng ges 'gro rnams skyongs//g.yas 'khyil mgur nas tshangs dbyangs chos kyi sgra//rigs gsum gdul byar bsgrags pa'i bka'i sdud bo//mi brjed gzungs thob smra ba'i spobs pa can//mtha' dag bstan pa rin cen srog gi shing //thub gsung zhabrul med dgongs pa yongs 'grel zhing //de don nyams bstar 'phags yul paṇa grub tshogs//ljongs 'dir sgyur byed zhus wo 'jig rten mig/rnam thar zla 'od bdag snying kunda bzhad/khyad par chosargyal mes dpon mkhan slob zung //thugs rje ma la 246ba〉 yi dri bsung gis//gangs can nyesabargya'i tsha gdung rab bcil ba'i//mdzad bzang yid kyi nad sel bdud rtsi'i bcud//ma 'dres kun la rjes brtse'i lhag bsam phul//med byung jo 'byom de sras rigs kyi tsha//yang dpon bcas pa'i bka' gdams rin cen 'phreng //gtsang ma'i rnam thar rdul bral ston zla bzhin/shes byar gang srid blo chen spyan ras kyis//mngon sum gzigs pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan//brjod pa don ldan blo bzang grags pa'i dpal//sangs rgyas kun dngos zhabs pad gtsug na mdzes//rnam 'dren mdzad pa'i rtse mo'i pha rol tu//phyin pa'i gsung ༷sang mi zad 'khor lo'i mdzod//'bri klog lung

sku gsung sa rten gsar 4kho dang rin po tsho yeb rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (7)nod bsod nams gzugs grub na//mes pos sprul pa'i srid gsum snod du chung //de phyir phan yon dkyus tshad ring po'i mtha'//brgal ba'i mkhyen pas gzhal dka'i ngo mtshar gyis//rab phyogs yid dbang rma bya tshul 'di la//'jug 'dod dga' ba'i sgro gzhog zlum por 'khyil//bye ba phrag brgya'i rdul gyi grangs mnyam zhes//chos phung rgya mtsho 'dren par nus min yang //swā la'i ljongs 'dir snga phyir legs bsgyur bka'i//deb ther mkhas mang gsung gi 'phreng bar spel//ma dang mkha' 'grosagasang ba'i rgyas btab ba//zab cing ches cher gnyan pa'i yo ga gsum//phang thang ldan dkar mar grags glegs bam du//ma bkod khri srong bkas bcad tshul dang mthun//phyi dar snar thang chos kyi grwa chen por//bsgrigs dang si tu dge blo'i bzhed pa sogs//dri med thub bstan rin cen srid mtha'i 247na thar//mi nyams yun du gnas pa'i rtsal ga mchog/mdo phyogs phyi 'gyur rgyud sde'i rnyog ma rnams//kun mkhyen bus dbyung snga 'gyur dpyad ba ched 'phror//lus mas them spangs ma steng rnal 'byor gsum//gtso bsdus tshal ba'i pu sta ka bzhin bkod//'jam mnyen shog bu'i do ra'i nags klung du//mig sman mdangs can gzugs legs yi ge'i ljon//brda dag yal 'dab kyis dud a ma'i 'bras//dpyod ldan ro brgya bda' ba'i g.yang zhig chags//chos dkar rā ma ṇa yi dpag chen mdas//sdig sgrib laṅka'i mgrin pa nyer bcad nas//thar pa'i sī ta grogs su rab bkug ste//bde chen rtse dgar 'gro rnams rtag rol shog/spyi dang khyad par 'jam mgon btsong kha pa'i//bstan srid dpag bsam rtsa ba ches sbom pa//bskyed bsrings sdong po dar drag grib bsil du//rgya hor bod kyi lus can nyer 'tsho shog/bsod nams gser gyi 'khor lo mkhar 'phags pa//ya pas pa'i sa la dbang sgyur mi yi bdag/phren las rgya mtsho skye bar bde 'gro'i srid//bzung lta ring zhi rnam ma' 'thob par shog/tshul 'dir lusang ga yid kyis phan pa'i las//ches phra rdul gyi cha yis mtha' brten nas/byed por gtogs kun brgya byin legs byas la//bgo bshar byed pa'i dbang thang 'thob par
