shog/'jig rten gsum dang khyad par pur rgyal ciXdir//snyigs mar spyod pa'i dkar min 'bras

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bu'i tshogs//ming yang mi grags rdzogs ldan skye rgu ltar//ma smad bde skyid dga' ston la spyod shog/myur 'grib lcags khams 'dzad med gser sbyangs su//sgyur byed mkha' mnyam ched du bsngos ba'i rtsis//'gro dang mi 'gro'i yid can ma 47ba tshe cis pa//sku gsum gter chen bum bzang la spyod shog/da rka ne cog thugs rje mtho ris chu bo yis//mi shis bgrod byed dri ma rab bkrus nas//phun tsho gos khyab 'jug rkang pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser//dge legs nor bu'i tog gi gzi 'bar shog/cesaphyag mdzod sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtsho dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe mngon mtho nges legs kyi sa bon khyad par can skrun pa'i slad du bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dri ma med pa gsar ma'i rgyud 'bum mdo 'dul sher phyogs 'gyur ro cog dang /gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud gtso bsdus glegs bam gsum dang bcas yar klungs thang po cher bzhengs skabs dkar chag smon lam gyi tshul du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no//sdeb sbyor dpyid kyi thig le.o dzor be ka dra ṇa ma rgya tsanā yu gyi ka lcesgro sgo ka karā ā rnyika a kār//sgru tāḥta tri da sha go tam dwa warā pā du chushubha nu su kha lhaḥ.a khya dza ya:/mgon khyod thugs rje chen po'i nyi ma'i gzis//'jig rten gsum gyi smag rum mthar byas te//grangs med phan bde'i 'od snang mchog sbyin mkhan//lha yi lhar gyur zas gtsang sras po rgyal//248na / byams thugs 'jam mnyen padma skud pa yis//yid srubs glang smyon 'ching ba'i mi pham mgon//mkhyen rab mtshon gyis mi shes grwa ba'i tshogs//gcod mkhas zur phud lnga pa phyag gi yul//chos phung ji snyed thos kun mi brjed pa'i//gzungs thob rnam par grol ba'i dgra bcom che//'od srungs la sogs bka' bsdu legs mdzad drin//stong gsum nor bus bkang yang gzhal nus min/khyu 'bras mchogo dman theg pa mtha' klas pa//'grel mkhas shing rta chen po zung la sogs//dbus 'gyur lnga rig sogs dang ches mtho'i sar//rab gshegs grub pa'i dbang phyug yongs la dad//kun bzang rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar//gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir//legs rol sprul pa'i rgyal blon 9/ma byon rnams//sangs rgyas thugs rje mngon sum

sku gsung sa rten gsar 4khog dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang yong gi dkar ga / (ma)gzugs can gzhan/ /gdul dka'i lha srin srog snying rab blangs nas/ /bod yul dkar por sgyur mdzad padma 'byung / /nyes lhung skyon bral tshul khrims dri bsung gis/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ /log lta'i ri dwags mgo 'gems 'jigs med kyi/ /sgra dbyangs cher sgrog ka mā la shī la/ /ska cog zhang gsum rin bzang 'brog mal mar/ /sa rngog shong sogs mkhas grub tshogasal 'dud/ khyad par smon lam shing rta bdun pa'i shugs/ /btsan po 'gog pa med pas ljongs 'di'i mkhar/ /rab bgrod bstan pa'i nyi ma a ti sha /'brom ston brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' gdamasargyal/ /srid pa'i (244〉 khrul rmongs sbyin skyes stobs ldan gzugs/ /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i goms gcig sgyu thabs kyis/ /'og bcings shākya'i ring lugs mig mi 'dzum/ /rgyal ba'i ru mtshon rtser bsgreng btsong kha pa/ /rgya gar ni pā la dang bod yul du/ /zhi ba'i sgo brgya mkhyen dpyod lde mig gis/ /'byed mdzad dam pa'i tsho gos kyi rnam thar la/ /bsam gyin gdul bya'i lus can skal bzang dpyid/ /rang bzo'i dpe hrul tsam min dgongs 'grel rnams/ /tshad mar bsgrub pa'i lung khungs rgyal ba'i bka'/ /nges par bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa 'di/ /yi ger 'bri las lhag gzhan bsod nams su/ /snyigs dus thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rje'i/ /chos yang ji bzhin yid ches tshad ma'i steng / /mkha' 'gro'i kha rlang dngar por 'thul ba'i ro/ /snga 'gyur rgyud kyi glegs bam gtso bsdus bzhugs/ /thub gsung ri mor bris dge gaṅgā'i yab/ /ches dkar gtsug tor nas babs mtho ris chus/ /gnam bskos dwa yan rgyal po'i rang rgyud kyi/ /las nye zhe dri ma ma lus drungs na shog /mi rje rigs kyi thig le'i btsan po'i lung / /'dzam gling kun gyi gnya' bar rab lci ba/ /dus kyi bdag por grub pa'i dbang thang shugs/ /dar drag shis pa'i mtshan ma rtag 'bar shog /mnga' 'bangs nya phyis yangs pa'i khog pa sa /bsod nams mu tig 'khri shing nyer spungs pa/ /rin thang tshad bral bde skyid mi 'dzad pa'i/ /dga' ston mchog dman kun la gtong bar shog /rin cen gsum gyi thugasarje'i spyan ras rdul/ /rje 'bangs rang rgyud snod du lhung ba'i mod/ /sngon shoms sdig 'bras brtsegs pa —291—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānenag po'i dris/ /cha tsam (249na〉kos pa med par drungs par shog /gzog yos bkod pa bran dang yang bran du/ /nyer bkol tshul 'dir mthun rkyen bsgrubs so cog /chos dkar gzings kyis ra ba'i mtsho bsgral te/ /thar pa'i rin cen gling du bgrod par shog /der ma gyur pa'i srid 'khyamasamatha' dag tu/ /lha mi'i rten bzang rab rnyed sdug bsngal gyi/ /zug jus gtses pa med par bde ba la/ /sgo gsum ngal gsor longs su spyod par shog /sa 'og sa steng sa blar gnas pa'i 'gro/ /spyi dang khyad par bod yul sman ljongs 'dir/ /rgud pa'i ming tsam btsal yang grags min par/ /sum rtsen bdag po'i ngang tshul nyams myong shog /ris med sems can kun gyi phan bde'i gzhi/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin cen rtser son pa/ /blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs nyi zla yis/ /'jig rten mun sel de srid rgyas par shog /dkon cog byin rlabs yid la yongs sim mthus/ /bkra shis dpal gyi be'u snying ga sa /g.yas 'khyil phun sum tsho gos pa'i khyu mtshog la/ /zhen nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar shog /ces gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin dwa yan rgyal po dus kyi pho lhas drangs pa'i tshe yang srid kun tu mngon mtho nges legs kyi sa bon khyad par can bskrun pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rnams yi ger bkod pa'i tshe dkar chag smon lam gyi tshul du za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge po ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /sa bya yar klungs ri bo chos gling gi dngul gdung gi deb ther 'go brjod du bkod pa lhu (249ba〉na mdzes pa'i phra tshoms/(༷ me rta ge phreng can/)di rgyu nā phye bha bgres ra/tri ṅgā'i shaṅgā mahā de ba pā du du liḥ/ sna〈tub༄shitā ṅgā na senā phya:ya dwa kṣi6kun kus ring po'i sna zhags srid pa'i rtser brkyangs nas/ khams gsum dbang skur lha chen zhabs sor gyis/ /reg tshe nel le'i kha nas skyugs pa'i nor/ /sde 'di'i yol gor g.yas su 'khyil bar mdzod/ /phun tshogs su la'i ljongs kyi ri bo'i ngogs/ /zhi ba'i lam bzang don du gnyer ba'i chos/ /thub gsung ji bzhin nyams len 'dus pa'i gling / /yid can bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing gi dpyid//—292

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)gang de'i kun dga' ra ba'i rten kyi gtsor//rin cen gnyis pa'i mar sdong sgo dngar ba//sna tsho gos nor bu'i phra yis legs mdzes pa'i//gsal byed dkar chag yi ge'i 'phreng bar spel//zhesashis pa brjod pa sngon du bto ste phun tsho gos dge bcu tshang ba'i 250nasgo la gru yar klungs kyi sa'i char bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing gyur ri bo chos gling gi dngul gdung wo mo'i deb ther bkod pa la/sa bya sa cha yar klungs ri bo chos gling gi gtsug lag khang gtsang khang mgon khang cas pa'i mchod rdzas kyi deb ther 'go brjod du bkod pa nel le'i kha nas babs pa'i nor bu dga' 'khyil sogs/sdebastor chu lon phreng ba/ 45sgru khyem la bha sa su rnye giḥdwa ri snyirnyan ma ka shiṣṭhanti la:shantibha bi ka hikame dhe nojeḥte:ཿdha na pa ti shu:yas khyod zhal 'dzum 'phreng las sa 'od snang gis//dbul mun ming gi lhag mar mthar byas te//phun tsho gis srid zhi'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gter//rgyal chen ngal bsos po des dge legs stsol//gangs can ri bos bskor ba'i g.yon ru'i char//thos bsam sgom par byed pa'i chos kyi tshul//legs bstar khrims ldan gling gi gas la'i//deb ther mu tig 'phreng mdzes spel byed na//myur mdzad mgon po las kyi gshin rje gshed//srid 250bsko sum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī//bstan srungs rgya mtshos mel tshe legs mdzad nas//bsams pa'i re ba skong ba'i las mdzod cig zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig sngon du bto nas dge ju kun kṣe yar klungs kyi sa'i char khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde ri bo chos gling gi gtsug lag khang dang gtsang khang sogasakyi mchod nas rnams deb ther du bkod ba la/sa bya zla po brgyad pa'i char snyan gi bza' tshes bzang ༷ wo mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs srid skyong gi khur len du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)bsgo bzhag bgyis skabs 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan re ma tir tham dzi'i phud phul ba'i kha byang phun tshogs bzhir spyod pa'i skal yong /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tir/ /bkra shis ri mo rab gsal tham ga'i phud//phul bas phun tshogs sdo bzhi'i dga' ston la/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag byin rlobs/ /lho brag gung rgyal gyi yong sgo len theb 'go brjod ཿga lon bang mdzod/ swā sti bra dzā ༷ ཿ 'jam mnyen utpal nyag phran 'phangs tsam gyis/ /'khor 'das brtan g.yo 'gugs pa'i sgyu thabs mkhan/ /rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma rigs byed mas/ /srid zhi'i 'dod dgu ma lus 'jo bar mdzod/ /gser gyi lhun po nyi ma'i gos gyon pas/ /bsgrun min rnam mang thos pa'i sras khyod kyis/ /phyag sor gyis btsir ne le'i khar babs pa'i/ /nor bu'i phung po deng 'dir 'khyil bar mdzod/ /dgung ltar ches mtho rnam rgyal bka' btags lung / /mnga' 'bangs ral pa'i rtser 'god gzhis ka yi/ /'bru sha rtsi bcud la sogasadapya khral rnams/ /sdud pa'i dngos don deb ther 'di na spel/ /zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus nas 'phags pa'i yul du stod (251na 'grel ba'i rjes su 'brangs te zhi bar 'bod pa gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir rgya nag po'i gtsug lag dang bstun sa mo bya'i lo'i zla ba che ga mo zhes bya ba'i gza' skar dus sbyor phun sum tsho gis pa'i nyin lho brag gang rgyal bka' lung gzhis ka'i 'bru/ sha mar/rto sog /dpus cha sogs kyi deb ther gsar du bkod pa la/don kun grub zhal ma dros chu klung las/ /lta spyod lam gyi rim pa'i gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /rnam dpyod hub gcig gis 'thung 'phags bod kyi/ /mkhas grub brgyud mar legs byon snang brnyan 'di/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtshor lta ba'i mig yangs pa/ /dzi drug mkhan chen dkon cog bstan 'dzin gyis/ /kun bzang la sogs gnyen bshes rnams kyi don/ /pad rtsa ltar dkar lhag pa'i bsam pas bsgrubs/ /sna tshogs rdzo dang nye ba'i man shel bzhin/ /ma smad ri mo'i byed po 'jam dbyangs zhes/ /'dren byed ngo mtshar 'phrul gyis 'drid nus pas/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi khengs pa bag la zha/ /'bras bu dmigs yul gyis mtsho ni nam mkha'i mthas/ /'ching bar nus min mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ /ye shes mchogo gi khang —294

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (mnapar legs 'khrid pa'i//sal ma rin cen them skas 'grub rgyur bsngo//zhes sde drug mkhan po dkon cog bstan 'dzin gyis nang so kun bzang sogs gnyen bshes rnams kyi don du lam rim bla brgyud kyi sku thang bzhengs pa'i dus zhal byang 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no//25ba ) sde ba sbyor rgyun ga gsum pa rgya mtsho/su li khas kal to3ti de khu bla so ba rje so kalpi ke des ha pra su bu chu li mokta gra thi:ru pā yu9skar ṇa tsakarma bishusu tsitrañtsa par yanta grwa mā ma ter sna zhi ke lha bzhi swā de yi rmā ya rka/legs bris rnams kyis chos cher rab bsngagasabaskal bzang 'di la sangs rgyas stong gi / yi ka phreng tshar dngar ba//sku tshe mdzad wen sna tshogasarsā ris mtha' klas 'gro blo'i man shel ngos su cir yang 'char ba'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul/sgo da ya ka sha ka ni kas cas mā se:be rdzu suḥg le yukta ka skas ma rwa ni1dhe hi su da yar pi ma ya pudzin lnga nyutadzdzabra2klesha tā sku rna〉sgyi ta sin rdzas te mi sho4kus mkhyen brtse nus kun gcig bsdus dngos zla 'o skol rtsod ldan snyigs mar spyod mtshor 'gog med legs shar zas gtsang sras//rgyud lnga'i yid can rsā mongasatsha gdung thugs rje'i ga bur gzegs mas mthar bcil phan bde'i snang ba ches dkar mdzod//52na po nyis med gsung zhabs 'khor los mtshan min swā la'i ljongs zhes byang gi phyogs lasabyang phyogs 'dir//gdul bya'i yid can thabs kyis brid nas yang dag lam sbyor chos rgyal mes dbon rim byon tshogs/khyad par skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing mchog thub pa'i zhal skyin rgya bal yul nas 'dren mdzad pa//lag na bad dkar sa skyong tshul 'dzin srong btsan sgam po'i snyan pa'i gdugs dkar srid rtser 'khor//'jam dpal rdo rje mi yi tshul bzung khri srong lde btsan mdzad bzang gis//sdom brtson dam pa zhi ba 'tsho dang skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa sogs//mkhas grub lo paṇa thod du bkur te thub bstan zla ba'i cha gang tshe//'phags yul chos kyi nyi ma'i spun slar byed pos chu gter bsrubs pa bzhin//mes kyi mkhyen dpyod brtson pa'i sku ring la//legs 'gyur bka' dang dgongs pa 'grel ba'i gzhung //gsar gcad skad kyis gto 'beXs sbyin pa'i bdag/khri lde srong btsun mya ga med

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)pa'i spun//mda' lngas snying gzer dar ma glang po'i gom//thub bstan bad mtshor bkod kyang stod smad nas//mdo sngags dbyar gyi chu gter ltar 'phel tshe//rgyal ba'i 'phrin las chad med ston pa bzhin//so zur gnubs dang gong 'og gter ston sogs//theg mchog chos kyi gling bzhin dbang sgyur yang //drag sngags mthu yi lcags ris thub pa'i bstan//bsrung la he ru ka dpal mi yi gzugs//shing rta che gnyis bzhed gzhung dngos sbas don//skyes bu gsum du bkri ba'i gaṅgā'i rgyun//thub bstan 252bskor 'jug zhabs zung bsil byed mkhan//mar me mdzad dpal drang srong dzaḥ//lung rig mardzo gyis log rtog dra ba rnams//gcod mdzad rngog lo cha gtsang rjes lā nga bcas/khong dpang brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin 'jig rten mig/mkhyen dpyod nyi mas rmongs mun pha mthar bskrad//smin grol rgyud bshad nges gsang rdo rje theg/'dzin mdzad 'jam pa'i rdo rje sa skya pa/shes bya'i sa gsum blo gros gom gcig gis//dbang byed don gyi paṇa chen bu ston rje//rgyal bas gang gzigs ji lta ji snyed chos//mkhyen pas ma rga sum yongs gzhal btsong kha pa//brjod pa don ldan thams cad mkhyen khyod la/shes bya kun gyis skyabs gzung 'dud bya'i yul//ljongs 'dir mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor ༷ /khyu skar lta bur bgrang yas sngon byon pa//lha ldan na yang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul sogs//bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag nyams pa med pa'i drin//'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags brtul zhugs kyis//nag phyogs lha srin srog snying rab phyogs nas/khrag 'thung gar bsgyur grib rjes rmang bting ba'i//lugs zung mi 'gyur lhun grub gtsug lag khang //rgyal dbang padmas rnam mang thos pa'i bu//pho nyar mngags nas gtsug lag dkor srungs su//nyer bkug sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga zhes//drag shul gnam lcags thog gi rjes su 'gro//bka' sdod li yul sdom brtson dmod pa'i 'bras//btsan rgod mched bdun nang nas mthu rtsal can//tse'u dmar po dregs pa'i sdod pon gyi//dpung tsho gis kha lo sgyur ba'i las byed mkhan//253na skong des blang dor nyer bstan rang nyid kyis//snying stobasaphrag par blangs te gas lar//sri zhu'i byed po sa /༷ dga' ldan pa//gzugs can snying po sa 'dir

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bstos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (mna'ongs pa bzhin//bsod nams rlung bzhen gyis drangs dkar ba'i 'bras//tsandan dri bsung bskyod pa dngar ba'i ngad//byang wo nor 'dzin mtha' snyed bsil ba'i bde//sbyin pa'i cho ga rdzogs la gcig tu brel//thub pa'i rtogs brjod thos pas yid 'phrog na//byin rlabs mthu dpung yongs 'dus byang chub cher//mngon sum mthong ba'i yul 'dir me tog rnams//sems ldan bzhin du dad pa'i 'dab ma 'dzum//'bras bu 'di dang phyi mar bde ba tsam//ma yin grags chen sangs rgyas go 'phang de//ring min 'thob pa'i bden gtam dpang po sa/lha mo bstan ma lus phyed sa nas thon//sgrib pa'i lus can nor dang 'khrul ba'i gzhi//yin phyir yid brtan ma gyur som nyi na//phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs kun gyis mgrin gcig tu//bsngags dang lhan cig me rtag 'thor min nam//rtsab rab brtan sbom por bskyed bsrings pa'i//yongs bo sa brtol gos bu'i khur lci ba//dngar ba'i khyad par gzhan gyis zla med pa'i//ro bda'i g.yang du chags pa dngos po'i gshis//zhing 'dir ri mor bgyid 'dod lhag bsam mtshor//brtson pa'i ri bo bsgril las nyer 'thon pa'i//mi bdag bsod nams nyi mgung shar ba//'char nub spangs pa'i snang ba rtag tu gsal//ma smad chos ra zan yang dri gtsang khang //rten dang brten par bcas253na〉 nyams gsos dang //ri mor bskrun tshul zhib mor brjod pa'i khur//a ma'i tshig gis chu gter 'jal ba bzhin//'on te mdo tsam gleng pa'i dbyu gu yis//'byung 'gyur mi rje'i thos 'dzin dus bhi//bskul bas rlabs chen dge tsho gos sgrub pa'i sgra//phyogs bral rna bar 'jebs pa'i rin cen rgyan//de phyir mgrin pa skye ba lnga pa'i dung //brjod don ldan ri mo g.yas 'khyil ba//gleng 'os ngo mtshar gtam gyi sgra snyan por//dpyod ldan rna ba'i dbang po blagasate nyon//de yang ston pa stobs bcu mnga' ba mtha' dag 'og min gyi zhing du nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'gro ba rnams kyi dbang po dang 'tsham par sprul pa sna tshogasakyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni chos nyid ༷na pas//grags can gyi bskal ba bzang po 'di

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang gyo mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)la sangs rgyas stong 'byon pa'i nang nas 'o skol gyi ston pa ma lus pa spangs pa/mtha' dag mngon du mdzad pa'i nyi ma'i gnyen ni khri brgyad stong pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rigs phun sum tsho gis pa gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rigs chen po dag tu skye ste de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rigs phun sum tsho gis pa yin no/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i cho rigs phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal rigs shing swā la pa chen po dag dang / bram ze'i rigs shing swā la pa chen po dag tu skye/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i cho rigs (254na)phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /zhes pa ltar gzigs pa rnam pa lnga las rigs phun sum tshogs pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i brgyud zas gtsang ma'i rigs rus la gzigs nas sku bltams te rgyu rtsal gyi gnas sogs 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi rim pa mu stegs byed sogs kyis 'phya ba spang ba'i ched du bstan nas rdo rje gdan gyi spo la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul gyis rigs can gsum la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bstan pa rin po che rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du ches cher rgyas pa yin la/ de yang lha mo dri ma med pas zhug pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar lung bstan pa'i lo grangs ni rgya gar du phyed lo 'dren pa lta bu la dgongs pa 'dra zhing / nges pa'i don du ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas yom bu bla snang gi yang thog tu dpang skong phyag rgya pa sogs babs pa'i bar la lo stong dang sum brgya las ma song ba gtan tshigs kyis kyang shesanus so/ /bstan pa dar bar gdul bya'i zhing zhig dgos pas/ lha las phul byung gi bstod pa'i 'grel bar/ skya seng bu lnga dang dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis 'thabs pa'i dus/ rgyal po ru pa ti dmag dang bcas te gangs ri'i ngogs su bros pa las bod kyi mi yi 'gro ba 'phel bar bshad cing / mkhas pa —298

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha / (ma)la la dag rgya bal sogs yul gru gzhan ltar bcud kyi sems can chags pa'i dus nas byung bar bzhed pa sogs mang na'ang / nges pa'i (254brkon du 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang jo mo sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las 'gro ba drug nas chad pa'i phrug gu gdong dmar sha zan gyi rigs las mched de mi'i rgyal khams su gyur pa yin la/ de yang rje rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa drug pa sa lug la lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyis dam pa chos kyi dbu bstengs/ de nas lo nyis brgya dang bcu gcig song ba'i gdung rabs lnga na 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /li tsa bī rnams rigs su 'byung / /de yang sngags kyi don bsgrubs te/ /longs spyod tshe dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rigs pa longs spyod ldan zhes bya/ /mi yi bdag pos de yang 'grub/ /lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid bya/ /zhes pa ltar sa glang la mnga' bdag chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po sku 'khrungs nas bod srin mo gan rgyal du gnas pa'i sa'i dbyibs la mtha' 'dul yang 'dul sogs kyi gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis dang / rang lo nyer gnyis lcags phag la lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang ra mo che dang bcas pa bzhengs/ rgya bal nas sangs rgyas dngos dang dbyer ma mchos shākya mu ni dang / mi bskyod rdo rje sogs spyan drangs/ bod du yi ge med pa la yi ge'i srol gtod/ dge 'dun gyi sde ma tshugs kyang thugs rje chen po zhi khro sogs 'grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa mang du byung / lha sabatab nas lo dgu bcu go dgu pa lcags rtar 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan sku (255na7ltams nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs/ pho brang rlung tshugs su kha che ā nanda sa lo tsā byas nas dge ba bcu/ khams bco brgyad/ rten 'brel bcu gnyisakyi chos gsung/ /bar srid pa'i lha chen dang bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs bod kyi lha srin rnamasam dga' bar yang klungs phang thang chus khyer/ dmar po rir thog dang mi dang phyugs la nad sogs 'tshub che bar byung bas bod kyis ma dul ba 'dul bar 'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rig sngags kyi brtul —2glu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo ba nga rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)zhugs grub pa slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas spyan drangs/ thang lha/ sham po/ bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs lha srin gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ rgya gar gyi o tanta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas rang lo nyer gnyis pa lcags yos la dpal zan yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gegs med du grub/ mkhan slob gnyis dang paṇa chen sharnyi sko sogs kyis rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ mkhan pos sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ste bstan pa'i rtsa ba btsugs/ slob dpon bi ma la mi tra dang / lo tsā ba sba gor bai ro tsa na sogs lo paṇa mang pos mdo sngags kyi chos rnams bsgyur cing gtan la phab/ slob dpon chen pos sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi gnas lnga sogs gnas chen rnams byin gyis brlabs/ rje 'bangs nyer lngasamatshon te snod ldan mang po smin grol la bkod/ chos dang nor gyi gter kha grangs med sbas/ rgyal po'i bzhed pa skong phyir yun ring po'i (255ba thar zhugs na'ang / sba bzhed du blon pos skyo ma byas te slar brdzangs zhes zla ba bco brgyad las ma bzhugs pa dang / la lar de las kyang yun thung ba sogs sna tshogs snang ba bdud blon sogs slob dpon bzhugs par mi dga' ba rnams kyi snang ngor de ltar shar zhing bstan pa don la mi gnod de/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las/ gang yang lhas byin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa gsad par bshams pa dang / bal glang nor skyong btang ba dang / rdo'i skyogs char btsugs pa de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs la mkhas par shes par bya'i/ zhes bshad pa dang mtshungs par mngon zhing bskal ba'i mdzad pa'ang skad cig ma gcig la zin pa dang skad cig ma'i mdzad pa'ang bskal bar spel nus pa'i phyir gang zag gzhan gyi lo rgyus ltar gtan tshigs kyis bsgrub pa'i yul min no/ /mnga' bdag tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi sras sad na legs mjing yon la sras lnga yod pa'i btsan po khri lde srong btsan ral pa can gyis 'on cang rdo'i lha khang bzhedas/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po dzi na mi tra/ su renda bo dhi/ shī lend+ra bo dhi/ dha na shī la/ bo dhi mi tra dang / bod kyi mkhan por ratna rakṣi ta/ dha —300

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khosadang rin po tsho mardzo rdzasakha bzang gi dkar sa / (ma)rma tā shī la/ sgo na sen/ dza yarakṣi ta/ mañdzu shrī wa rma na lenda/ rasne nd+ra shī la la sogasalo paṇa rnamasakyisayab mesakyi dusabasgyur ba'i gsung rab dka' zhing mi legs pa rnams byā ka ṇa'i lugs dang bstun nasaskad gsar bcad kyisagatan la phabs/ bshad grub kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyasapar mdzad/log pa'i smon lam gyi mthus glang dar mas 'dul ba'i bstan pa snubs shing gtsug lag khang rten brten pa 'jig pa sogs(256na〉rgod mun pa'i smag rum du yud cig gyur na'ang / 'phags pa rigasagasum gyi mgon po'i thugasabaskyed dang / skye rgu'i legasabyas kyi phung po zad mi shesapar brten/ dpal gyi rdo rjesargyal po sdig can pa bkrongs pa'i rjes su so so thar pa'i bstan pa stod smad nas me ro bsosashing / ngesagasang rdo rje theg pa'i chos tshul ni sngagasa'achang grub brnyes gos dkar lcang lo'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa rnamasal rgyun ma chad par gnas bzhin pa dang / bstan pa phyi dar du gragasapa'i lo paṇa mkhas grub gnam gyi skar ma dang sa'i dreg pa lta bus khyab par gyur pa mtha' dag lha sa bsam yas sogs chos 'khor stod smad rnamasam nyams par gnas pa'i rten 'brel gi mthu kho nar ngesashing / rten brten pa de dag la mchod pa dang nyams pa gso ba sogs kha ba can gyi phan bde'i srog shing du 'gyur ba lta ci smos/der ma zad sangs rgyas phal po che las/ skyesabu la lasardo rje zos gyur de la ni/ /zhu bar mi 'gyur gdon mi za bar phyir 'byung 'gyur/ /de bzhin stobs bcu rnams la mchod byasabasod nams kyi/ /ye shesardo rjesanyen mongasam lusa'ajomasapar 'gyur/ /(skam spungasapa ri bo'i mchog tsam yod gyur kyang / /me mdag yungasa'abru tsam gyisade ni 'tshig 'gyur te/ /de bzhin bde gshegs mchod pa cung zad ci byas kyang / /nyon mongs thams cad 'tshig byed mya ngan 'das rgyur 'gyur/ /zhes dang / lungagazhi las/ gang zhig rab dang semasakyis sangasargyasakyi/ /mchodarten la ni 'jim gong 'jog byed na/ /dzasbu chu (256bsta'i gser gyi gong bu ni/ /stong phrag brgyas kyang de dang mnyam pa min/ /zhesadang / gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa las/ thub dbang mchod rten rdo thal byugasapa yis/ /—301 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6belha mi 'jig rten dag na tshe ring zhing / /lus sems nad dang mya ga byed spangs te/ /rtag tu skyid cing nor gyis phyug par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dngos sam/ de'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi rten dang / de dag bzhugs pa'i ga smyo la sogs zhig pa gso zhing / rdo thal 'byug pas mtsho ni te sri zhur bgyis pa'i 'bras bu gnas skabs lha mi'i bde ba phun sum tsho gos pa dang mthar thug mya ngan las 'das pa 'thob pa'i phyir shes ldan rnams kyis bsgrub bya kho na yin na'ang / sems can las kyi dbang gis blang dor ma shes pa dang / gal te shes kyang lag tu bstar ba ches dkon pas/ dusaring mo zhig nas dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang 'di la stobs dang ldan pa rnams kyis zhig gsos byed pa nyin skar lta bur gyur cing / gsang sngags rnying ma'i bla ma grwa rigs 'gas bsgrub pa'i bya ba la zhugs na'ang stobs 'byor dang mi ldan pas nyung zad tsam las rngo ma thogs kyang 'gro 'di'i legs byas kyis drangs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams mkhan slob chos gsum gyi dus lta bur dar zhing rgyas pa'i byed po ni thog ma'i 'byung khungs tshal pa khri dpon tre hos dga' bde bzang po'i zham ring ba mi chung don rgyal du grags pa des tshal pa dang gzhis ka sne'u pa'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur bar brten mi rabs gsum gyi bar je 'phel du gyur cing / de nas nang so bsod nams (257na sgom rgyal zhes dga' ldan a bsod du grags pas rin spungs pa'i zhabs rtag bsgrubs pa'i lag rtags su lo sprel sna gdong man nas snye mda' chu so kha yan gtan tshigs kyis chod/ ring por ma lon par dpal phag mo gru pa ngag gi dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba kwan ding ta'i gu shrī chen ho wang gi dgongs par 'byor pa'i don du bde chen la gtogs pa'i chu lto byang rnams gnang zhing / chos 'khor dpal kyi lha sa sdom lag dang bcas pas gtsos skyid shod lung pa'i khrims bdag tu lung bzang pos phud/ gtan khra shel tham gyis cho de cing 'ja' sa stsal/ de'i sras ra nu lha srung mgon pos chu shur du rin spungs pa'i dmag la byus nyes btang pa'i gong ma chen po'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur bar brten dmag dpon bsod nams rgyal po zhes pa'i las ka gnang —302

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)bas de ltar du grags/ de'i sras gcen dmag dpon don grub rgyal pos skyor mo klungs kyi rdzong dma' 'bebs su btang pa'i dpung shed kyis skyid 'phan mtha' dag chab 'og tu bcug /gcung bkra shisarab brtan ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can dbang po'i sde lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen dpyod mtha' klas shing / gzhan sde'i dpung rnams rmeg med du gzhom pa'i dpa' rtags kyi grags snyan can/ mched gnyis kyi yang tsha sa stong dga' ldan pa rdo rje rnam rgyal dang / hor bsod nams dar rgyas su gragasapas gnam gyis bskos pa'i sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos bi ri dpon po dang gtsang sde srid sogs(257ba tshe stobs 'byor gyi dregs pas myos pa'i dbang phyug rnams 'dul ba'i dpung tshogs chen po bteg pa'i dus zhi drag gi zhabs tog tu 'gyur bar brten yab mes kyis rigs phal che ba 'jags pa'i thog tu rgyal bzang nang sor bka' bkyon byung skabs nged rang nas mtshams sbyor ba'i thog tu mchod yon gyis shing mo bya lor tshong bos brag kha dang zung mkhar bsam yas rnams kyi rdzong gzhis rnams 'jags gnas gnang ba nas bzung / bsam yas gtsug lag khang la zhig gsos dang /mchod rdzas sbyar ba sogs sri zhu mdzad pa rnams mchode khang so so'i nang gses kyi lo snga phyi go rim bsgrigasate dbu rtse nas star chags su bkod pa la/ shing mo bya'i lor byang chub chen po la bkras btagasaganas bcu ma'i bla bre lcam gling khebs pa gcig /rgya 'phen se'u ma gling gsum gser gyi bab le dang bcas pa/ me phag bstan srungs gnod sbyin chen po nas bskul ma mdzad pa'i mgon khang rnying pa'i mdun du ka ba brgyad kyi sags ra bzhengs/ shing rtsi ldebs ris lnga dgongs lha mgon gyi bskang gsorgyun 'dzugs/ sa byi nas dkar me rgyun 'dzugs sdong rkang lnga la khro kong mngags bzos zla ba drug re ldang ba lnga/ chu sbrul li ting bdun cu don lnga/ shing pho rta lor byang chub chen por kha thi yug bdun la bzos pa'i rnam sbyar nang sha sman tses byas pa/ shing lug kha thi blon thi gser ma sogs kyi 'phan chen lag bcas ring ba cha drug /kha thi thin thi chan spel gyi phye phur thog tshad lhag tsam pa cha/ chu stag lo mkhan po bo dhi sa twa'i dbu thod la zhal khyim (258nasgo jal bar mi gnod pa'i dngul gyi na bza'/—303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 69)byang chub chen por gser zangs las grub pa'i dbu gdugs/ chu yos kha thi tshos kha bdun khra bsgrigs khyad thon gyi phye phur thog ṣka ma nang sha dar rbod dang bcas pa cha gnyis/ shing pho 'brug lo nang skor gyi byang star bsgyud la zhabs 'bong tshan che ba'i steng lcam len gyi tshugs ka 'ang mo sprul lo byang chub chen po'i g.yon sbug tu sa gnad gso ba'i byang chub mchod rten/ me rta tshal pa bka' 'gyur gzhin bzhag po ti brgya dang brgyad/ me lug gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud 'bum po ti bzhi bcu zhe drug rnams bzhengs pa'i po ti so so'i dbu shog lto gar bcu bcas gser rkyang / zhal khebs kha thi dang ling tshos kha gnyis re bcas pa gsum brtsegs/ glegs shing rtsi ma gdong la gser shog yod pa/glegs thag gi tshang lcags kyi 'phrul ma khyad thon/ kun dga' ra ba chos 'khor 'phrul bzo ma/tshogs khang gi byang du bka' 'gyur khang ka gnyis kyi sags ra du bzhengs shing / zhal zas gsum re dang mar me'i rgyun btsugs lo re'i khongs su bka' 'gyur tshar gsum re 'gro ba'i rgyun 'dzugs rgyur 'bru kha ru'i khal stong phrag gcig dang brgya bcu gcig bre phyed dgu dgos pa 'on smon grong bogs steng nas sbyar/ byang chub chen po'i sku mdun du tshes brgyad nam byung la rab byung pas sman bla tshar gnyis re/ zla re'i nyer dgu la mgon khang du bskang gso gtong ba'i thebs su ya bo khang gsar gong / dkar yol/ stag tshang rnams sbyar/ khor sa bar pa lte (254tha'i thigs 'dzad zhig pa rnams gsos/ chos rgyal dpon blon gyis dbu rtse tsho gos khang zhig gsos dus babs dang rgya bskyed dgos pa'i lung bstan ltar bshu 'bub mdzad pas lta ma sum cha gnyis tsam dang ka ba'i rtsa ba rnams rul bar brten lhag par lung bstan la nges pa rnyed de lcags sgo'i mdun gyi rdo padma can nang du chud pa'i ka ba bco brgyad kyi sa shul gsar bzhengs lta bu ngo mtshar ba la sa pho spre'u'i lor ldebs bris bka' thang dkar chag nang bzhin dang / pho thog gi lho byang gnyis kyi nang star gsar bskrun/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi lha tshogs/ shing rtsi bzabs rgyas kyi ka ring gi gdung ldebs la dbus su gu ru mtshan brgyad/g.yas su dus gsum sangs rgyas/ g.yon du chos rgyal mes dbon/ rnam thar sku gsum gyi gdung —304

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdza kho bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)bus sus skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/g.yas sumakha wo zhib 'dzing paṇa 'dri med bshes ga/g.yon du lo chen bee ro dang g.yu sgra snying po/lcags sgo mdo'i rta babs 'og seng ge'i bar du gnasabartan bcu drug/sgo 'gram la rgyal chen/lho'i gsang sgo'i steng du rigs gsum mgon po rnamasabazhengs so//ring bsrel snying po'i rten mchod rgyal ba'i gsung //'dri klog gas lagaso bsnyen bkur sogs//dge tsho gos dzasbu'i snyem bsod nams mtsho me//lhung bas gto bde'i gser du 'gyur bar shog/bar khang du sa pho byi lo dkar me rgyun 'dzugs sdong rkang gnyis la khro kong mngags bzos zla ba drug re ldang ba zung /chu sbrul li ting sum cu tham 259na ) pa/shing lug gos bzang bsgrigs kyi phye phur 'dom gang tsam dar rbod dang bcas pa cha/gos 'phan ljang khra dbangs thog tshad legs pa cha/chu yos gos gser ma chos kha drug khra bsgrigs khyad thon gyi phye phur thog tshad ma che legs cha/shing sprul gtso bo'i g.yas su rdo rje phur pa dang /g.yon du zhing skyong gi sku rgyan sprod phyag mas rnams rin po che las grub pa gsar bzhengs/snyan shal dar tshos kha sna tsho gis nyi shu rtsa gnyis smon yig dang bcas pa/me lug tsho gos khang steng thub ba lha khang gnyis kyi bar ka ba bcu bzhi'i sa dang /bar khang sgo phibs rnga khang ka ba bzhi 'phreng gnyis gsar brjes/sa sbre lo ldebs ris dkar chag bzhin bris thog/rta babs 'og seng ge'i bar la mtshan brgyad/tho ri snyan shal/srong bas sgam po/khri srong ldebatsan/mu rtag btsan po/khri ral pa rnams gsar du bzhengs so//rnyog bral chos dkar mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun//deng nas yang srid lam gsum las babs te//rtag tu bde ba'i gtam snyan lhung lhung sgra//sgrog bzhi ca mas rgya mtshor rogacig shog/steng khang du sa pho byi lo dkar me rgyun 'dzugasasdong rkang bzhi/chu sprul rnam snang mi bzhi rgyab sprod kyi mchod pa'i nyer spyad du li ting sum cu/lcagasaglang lo steng gi gdung chen gnyis chag pa gsar brjes/lcog bzhi lcags ri dang bcas pa rtsa bslangasakyi thog gser thog ma bu lnga gsar bzhengs dang /gañdzi ra rnying pa'i brje tshab tu gsar bzo'i rgyur gser thig 259bsko'i lhad med spus legs daXs zho stong phrag lnga dang brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga se ba bco

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6bebargyad/ zangs khar rgya'i khal stong phrag gcig dang sum brgya bcu gsum nyag phyed/ dngul chu khar rgya'i khal bzhi bcu zhe gnyis lhag gang / tsha lar dngul srang sum cu so dgu zho phyed bdun/ ti tsha mkhar rgya'i khal drug nyag phyed do/ /bsha' dkar rgya thur gyi srang bcu gcig dang zhe drug rnams gsham gyi bsdoms thor 'thus na'ang / der mi gsal ba zhal 'debs kyi gser dbus zho nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig se ba bcu dgu /zangs khar rgya'i khal bzhi bcu zhe brgyad dang nyag phyed bcu gsum/ dngul chu rgya thur gyi srang nyis brgya dang dgu rnams song bar yun du brtan ched kyi sa zhu/ ka gdung / lcam/ thog dbangs/ wa rgyug rnams ya bral mi thub pa'i lcags kyi gzer sdoms/ zangs shing dang sgrog lugs sogs phrul gang thon/ lcog rer dril bu legs pa skyon med brgyad re/ shing 'brug kha thi tshon spel gyi phye phur 'dom phyed do re yod pa cha gnyis/ gos dkyus ma'i phye phur gcig zhang sbrul lo skyon gtso 'khor gsum/ g.yas su mkhan po/ g.yon du chos rgyal rnams kyi sku gsar bzhengs gser risashin tu rgyas pa/ g.yu byu ru mu tig gi rgyan sprod/ khri pang rgyab yol tshon rtsi'i thog gser shog dang gser ris kyis spud pa/ skyon rin po cher za 'og gi sku ber sram rgyan ma/ snyan shal dar tshos kha sna tsho gos kha 'brel brgyad/ lha lcam/ 'tsho rgyal/ mkhan po/ chos rgyal bzhi bsdo mes par snyan shal dar sna tsho gis nyi (260na) rtsa bzhi smon yig dang bcas pa/ gos bzang bsgrigs kyi bla bre/ gos 'phan lag bcas cha/ li ting nyer gcig mchod stegs dang bcas pa/ dkar me rgyun 'dzugs sdong rkang gcig la zla ba drug ldang ba'i khro kong mngags bzos/ mkhan po dang chos rgyal gnyis la li ting bcu bzhi/ me lug rnam snang mi bzhi rgyab sprod kyi dbu thog tu gos bzang bsgrigs kyi bla bre che ba/ gos mang lug gi 'phan lag bcas khra ring cha/ dbu rtse lte ba'i mda' yab gong 'og gnyis/ mdun gyi rta babasagong 'og gsum sgo khang chen mo'i steng gi g.yu thog rnams chag grum che zhing shing cha rul bas gtsug lag khang 'jig tu nye bar rgya nag nas g.yu rtsi bzo mkhan ma khugs pas skor cig gyo thog las 'os ma byung bar 'phan yul lan par rdza bzo'i sta gon skabs za dam nas ljang du g.yu rtsi bslab bcug pa'i —306—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnamagon po zer ba rtsad chod pa'i lag len la gzhi byas spar bcag gi thabs 'phrul tha'i ji rang gis mdzad pa'i g.yu thog rgya nag lugs dang mthun par bzos/ sa sprel lo skor khang phyi lta la dkar chag tu mi gsal yang phyis su bris pa'i gnas bcu/ mtshan brgyad/ sgrol ma nyer gcig /rigs lnga sprul sku'i cha byad can/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo nas gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rigs lnga longs sku/ sangasargyas rabs bdun/ mkhan slob chos gsum/ lo paṇa/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs phal cher zhig par de gsor gnas kyi nyams gsos/ dra mig gi shing rnams kyi thog shar du rdo rje sems dpa' (260brko ngul/ lhor rin 'byung gser/ nub tu snang mtha' mtshal/ byang du don grub spang ma rnamasakyis so sor stong sku re gsar du bskrun/ skor khang nang lta la dkar chag nang bzhin gyi ldebs risagasar bzhedas/ sgo khang gi rgya phibs dang khams gsum sogs la g.yu thog bkal ba sngon ma lasakyang gnad things pa'i legs su song bar rten/ slar dbu rtse'i so chu'i skyon gyi g.yu thog rnams kyang gsar brje mdzad do/ /sngon goms bsod nams mu tig 'khri shing khur/ /skye ba kun tu nam yang mi gtong bar/ /rnam 'dren sras dang slob mar bcas rnams kyi/ /byin rlabs snying gi dpal ber 'jug par shog /nyi ma lha khang dang zla ba lha khang gnyis la me bya mar me sdong rkang re dang zhal zas gsum re'i rgyun gtsugs shing zangs dmar gyi mchod kong re phul/ sa mo phag gi lo rtsig rmang nas bslang ba'i phyi nang gsar bzhengs thog /thub pa gtso 'khor lnga'i 'bur sku nyi ma lha khang du zhig gsos dang zla ba lha khang gsar bzhengs lta bu/ ldebs bris dkar chag nang bzhin gsar bzhengs/ nyi gling gi khyams la sngar med kyi padma bka' thang gi zhing bkod dang / zla gling du rjes 'bangs nye tsho lnga/ bka' brgyad lha tshogs/ shing rtsi dang bcas pa gsar du bskrun zhing / so sor li ting bdun tshar re phul lo/ /gang gi 'bras bu srid zhi'i dus kun tu/ /thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug gzhog brlab kyis//'khor 'das yon tan mkha' la bla nas blar/ /mthor bgrod phun tsho gis yul sar phyin par shog /—307

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()shing rta 261nasgo cho de rten dkar po'i khor sa ka ba lnga bcu nga gnyis kyi sa'i ka gdung dral lcam gsar brjes/mchod rten byang ma'i zhas su sa gnad gso phyir gsar bzhengs mdog dbyibasamatshudas pa'i thog tshad/chu stag char khebs kyi thog gsar 'bub/mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum re'i rgyun 'dzugs/mchod rten dmar po'i pad gdan zhig gsos/de'i nub 'khris su mdog dbyibs mtshungs pa'i ma rdzo rten thog ro/ma rdzo rten nag po'i pad gdan la zhig gsos/de'i lho sus su mdog dbyibs po yos pa'i ma rdzo rten gsar bgos thog rgo/mar rten sngon po'i lha khang bcu drug sku dang bcas par zhig gsos/shar 'khris su mdog dbyibs mtshungs pa'i mchod rten thog tshad gsar bskrun/gong gsal gsar bzhengs kun la gzungs bzhugs rgyas pa/samo phag mo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i bzhugs khrir zhig gsos shing rtsi logs bris rnams grub bo//mar rten bya rung kha shor bgos pa'i dus//mkhan slob chos gsum yang srid gong ma yis//smon lam nyer btab tshul bzhin smin pa'i 'bras//gnyis pa bdag gis 'grub pa'i skal bzang shog/sa byi 'jam dpal gling gi 'og thog ma gtogs de yan gsar bzhengs/steng khang du 'jam dpal gtso 'khor lnga dang sgo srungs gnyis bcas pa'i 'bur sku phyi nang gi ldebs ris dang bcas pa dkar chag nang bzhin sngar gnas gsar bzhengs/lcags 261ba tshe smros 'jam dpal zhing gi yon to bkod pa dang /skor khang phyi lta nang lta gnyis la mi zhabrugs pa dang tshe dpag med kyi stong sku rnams gsar bris/chu sprul li ting nyer gcig/mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas lnga re'i rgyun btsugs khro rkang mngags bzos zla ba drug re ldang ba gcig tsheng 'brug kha thi tshon spel gyi phye phur cha rnams phul/blang dor lta la yangs pa'i dkyus ring mig/ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas lugasakun//mdzo sum mthong ba'i blo gros byang tso mali/ma rnyed de srid stsol cig wom pa'i dbyangs//brda sbyor tshang mang gling sa pho byi lor phyi'i rtsig pa'i phyed yan thigs khang dang /nang gi zhal ba 08

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)shing rtsi bcas pa gsar bzhengs/lcags yos thub pa gtso 'khor bdun la zhig gsos/ldebs risadakar chag sor gnas kyi thog mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo sna tshogs kyi rgyud ris bsnan pa bcas gsar bris/chu sbrul li ting bcu bzhi/me bya mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum re'i rgyun btsugs/zangs dmar gyi mchod kong gcig mang 'brug ling tshon spel gyi phye phur dzom gos ser gyis byas pa 'ja' bcas cha rnams phul/bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing gyur dge 'dun la//'tsho ba'i zas kyi bsnyen bkur legs stob pa//mgon med zas sbyin bzhin du bskal bzang 'di'i//'dren pa slob mar bcas kun mchod byed shog/sa pho byi lo bdud 'dul sngags pa gling gi rtsig pa'i byed yan thigs khang dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs/me bya mar me sdong rkang gcig dang 262na〉lta zas gsum re'i rgyun btsugs/zangs dmar gyi mchod kong /shing 'brug ling tshon spel gyi phye phur dzom gos gser mas byas pa 'ja' bcas cha/shing sprul li ting bcu bzhi rnams phul/byang chub chen po gtso 'khor lnga la zhig gsos/ldebs ris dkar chag nang bzhin gsar bris/shing rtsi dang bcas pa legs par grub/kun mkhyen thob min de srid mdo rgyud la//thos bsam sgom par gegs byed yid grubs shing //rig sngagasa'achang ba'i zhugs kyis rab bsregs nas//srung byed ye shes me lce 'bar bar shog/lcags yos ārya pā lo'i gling du mgon khang gi 'cham sku gsum la na bza' gsar bzos/mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum/de mtshungs rigs gsum mgon po'i lha khang du'ang btsugs/chu sbrul dkyil 'khor steng du dkar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas lnga re'i rgyun gtan 'dzugs/khro kong mngags bzos zla ba drug re 'khyongs pa gcig dang /shing lug bla bre mthongs gos dmar se'u ma bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa gcig/kha thi dang thon thi spel gyi phye phur rdza ma 'ja' bcas cha/me bya seng ge sgra'i mchod khang du mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum de'i rgyun btsugs/lcags phyi phyi'i rtsig pa'i phyed yan thigs khang dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs/shing 09

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)sbrul mgon khang ma gtoges pa'i 'bur sku rnams la zhig gsos/ dkar chag nang ldebs ris gang yod thog rgyal ba btsong kha pa yab sras dang bcas (262bta gsar bzhengs/ sa gnad gso phyir rta mgrin gyi g.yas su dregs pa zil gnon gyi 'bur sku gsar bzhedas snyan shal dar drug smon yig dang bcas pa/ li ting nyer gcig /seng ge sgra'i lha khang du sa gnad gso ched du gu ru mtshan brgyad/lo ke shwa ra/ sgrol ma'i ldem sku rnams gsar bzhengs grang gser sbyib byugs/ dar tsho semadog sna tshogs drug cu re gsum gyi snyan shal smon yig dang bcas pa/ nub byang gnyis su bkras btags dang thon thi'i gnam rgyan gung logs khebs pa gnyis/ mchod cog rtsi ma gcig /ting nyer gcig khyun 'dzugs mchode me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gnyis re rnams phul lo/ /ya mtha' mi mngon 'khor āo mas de srid du/ khyud la grangs med bsgos pa'i sdig pa'i las/ /stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshagasan 'phags mchog kye/ /thugs rje'i chab kyis myur tu dag mdzad gsol/ /sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling gi lte ba khyams bcas kyi rtsig pa dang shing cha phal cher sa pho byi pa'i lo gsar du brjes/ chu sbrul shing rtsi dang ldebs ris dkar chag sor gnas kyi steng khyams la phung po gsum pa'i mdo nas bshad pa'i sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga dang rgyal blon gyi snang brnyan lnga bcas pa gsar du bzhengs li ting bcu bzhi/ me bya mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum gyi rgyun/zangs dmar gyi kong gcig zhang 'brug ling tshon spel gyi phye phur rdza ma gos dmar lwa3 mas byas pa cha gcig dang bcas pa rnams phul/ bye ba phrag (263na7rgya'i mun pa'i gling rnams su/ /sdosnod rnam gsum bsgyur ba'i snying stobs kyis/ /dam pa chos kyi sgron me rab spar te/ /'gro la phan bde'i snang ba 'gyed par shog /chu sbrul lung bstan bee tsa gling du li ting bcu bzhi/ me bya mar me stong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum re'i rgyun/ zangs kyi mchod kong gcig /chu stag sum thog khyams bcasartsig rmang nas bslangs ba'i gsar bzhengs/ steng du gu ru mtshan brgyad/ tshe dpag med/ mkhan po/chos rgyal/ bee ro tsa na rnams kyi 'bur sku gsar bskrun/ sku dang zla gdan padma bcas par gser spyib —310

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (mnabyugs/g.yu/byu sa mu tig/spos shel rnams kyi phra rgyan can/ldebs ris la sis rgya mtsho'i zhing bkod cha tshang /shing rtsi bzabs rgyas/dar sna tshogs kyi snyan shal lnga brgyang dgu/lcam gling dbusamar gos kha thi dmar khra/g.yas su sngon po 'brug ma/g.yon du thon thi dmar khra las grub ba'i gnam rgyan gos bzang bsgrigs kyi mtha' 'ja' can dar dmar gyi sham bu yod pa/kha thi'i phye phur thod gos bzang bsgrigs kyis byas pa cha/yang de dang phyogs 'dra ba/ding phon gyis mkhan mgo dang kha thi thon thi bzang bsgrigs kyis ma lag byas pa'i 'phan legs pa cha/mchod stegs rtsim/gser zangs kyi maṇḍal mañdzi dang cas pa/li ting nyi shu rtsa gcig/zangs tir gcig/ra gdam cha/silasnyan wanyu la skyon med gcig/mchod dung gcig/mchod 263bsnga gcig/dkar yol rag stegasadang bcas pa gcig/dkar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas bcu'i rgyun 'dzugs/mchod kong mngags bzos zla drug 'byongs pa/dril bu bdun yod pa'i dril gdang gcig/lha mo khang gi ldebs ris la mgon po lcam dral dang mdo khyams la rgyal rabs gsar bris/chu yos lo 'bur sku rnams la zhig gsos dang /ldebs ris dkar chag nang bzhin gyi thog skor lam nang la sangs rgyas stong sku dang rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po yab sras kyi sku rnams gsar bris/dbu thog tu gos dmar 'brug ma'i bla bre/mdor gos sngon kha'u ma'i bla bre/dar ling tshos kha sna tsho gos kyi phye phur gam gos dmar lā nyu ma 'ja' bcas cha/shing 'brug mdo khyams kyi khor sal bee ro'i rgya bod kyi mdzad pa 'dra 'bag nang ltar gsar bris rnams so//mchog dman 'gro ba'i dbang po dang 'tsham par//'jug sgo sna tsho gis theg pa'i chos kyi tshul//thub bas legs par gsungs bzhin 'khrul med du//tshe rabs kun tu nyams su bstar bar shog/sa glang dga' ldan byams pa gling gi rtsig pa'i phyed yan thigs khang dang bcas gsar bzhengs/chu sprul li ting nyi shu rtsa gcig mang lug steng 'og gi 'bur sku rnams kyi gtso bo'i bzhugs khri rang 'khor phran bu ma gtogos gas ra bzhengs lta bu'i zhig gsos/ldebs ris dkar chag dang mthun

rgyal dbang lnga pa nga gdabang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ ()par gsar bris/shing sprul gtsang khang nang du sa gnad gso ched la dus gsum sangs rgyas dang mesadabon rnam gsum gyi 24na po bur sku gser sbyib byugs ma gsar bskrun/snyan shal bzang dar sna tsho gos sum cu smon yig dang bcas pa/bla bre 'brug ris ma 'ja' bzhi gshibs/gos 'phan lag ring cha/gos sna rnyas gyi phye phur dzom thon thi dmar pos byas pa 'ja' sa sa cha/dkar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas lnga re'i rgyun btsugs/zla ba drug re ldang ba'i mchod kong mngags bzosagacig rnams phul lo//mi pham mgon gyis yid dga' chos 'dzin nas//dgyes pa'i 'dzum bcasagasung gi gsang ba yis//legs byas 'bras bu ring min byang chub tu//dbugs dbyung lung du ston par bdag byin rlobs//sa mo glang lo mi g.yo bsam gtan gling gi phyi'i rtsig pa'i stod dang rnam snang gtso 'khor lngar zhig gsos/chu sbrul lo li ting bcu bzhi/me bya mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum rgyun 'dzugs/zangs dmar gyi mar kong gcig mang 'brug kha thi thon thi rdzo spel gyi phye phur dzom thon thi sngon pos byas pa 'ja' ldan cha/mang lug ser po'i bla bre gung khebs gcig mang sbrul ga song sbyong ba'i rgyud ris la rdzo gsos rnams bskrun pa'o//ma dul sems kyi glang po chags sdang rjes//'phyan par dran shes lcags kyu nyer btab nas//g.yo med ting 'dzin chu yis dug gsum me//mngon gyur tsha sreg rtag tu bcil bar shog/sa mo glang lo rin cen sna tshogs gling gi rtsig pa'i phyed dang shing cha rnams gsar 264babaskrun/chu sprul thub pa gtso 'khor lngar zhig gsos dang /ldebs ris dkar chag nang ltar gsar bris/me bya mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum re'i rgyun 'dzugs/zangs kyi mchod kong gcig mang 'brug gos tshone spel gyi phye phur mgo gos nag gis byas pa 'ja' bcas cha rnams phul/dug gsum rlabs gzug 'khor 'tsho las thar nas//myang 'das rin cen gling du bgrod pa'i gzhi//g.yo med bsam gtan gru gzings gtong ba la//rnam g.yeng mi mthun rlung las grol bar shog/sa

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i ma rdzo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)mo glang gi lo byang chub sems skyid gling gi rtsig pa'i phyed yan thog bcas zhig gsos dang shing rtsi/ chu sbrul lha tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa bdun la zhig gsos dang ldebs ris la tshon gsos/ li ting nyi shu rtsa gcig /dkar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas lnga re'i rgyun/ khro kong mngag bzos zla drug 'byongasapa/ gser bsgril btags kyi bla bre/ gos tshoni spel gyi phye phur thod thon thi dmar pos byas pa 'ja' bcas cha rnams phul/ mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams sgrol 'dod smon pa dang / /de don lag tu bstar ba 'jug sems kyi/ /gzings la brten nas srid zhi'i rgya mtsho che/ /rab bsgral kun mkhyen rin cen gling bgrod shog /chu sprul dpe har dkor mdzod gling du li ting nyi shu rtsa gcig /me bya mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum re'i rgyun 'dzugs/ zangs dmar gyi mchod kong gcig /sa phag rtsig ming nasabaslangs te shing cha (265na gis ra brjes/ ldebs ris dkar chag dang mthun par gsar bris dang shing rtsi/ mdo khyams g.yabs ring ka ba bco brgyad kyis shing cha phal cher gsar brjes/ lcags byi gtso bo'i sku lam tsam ma gtogs khri bad rgyab yol drug mgyogs dang sems dpa' brgyad kyi phyag zhabs khri bad sogs phal cher gsar bzhengs/ lcags glang bstan srungs chen po'i lung bstan ltar steng khang gsar bzos kyi ldebs ris la gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi brgyud rim/ mkhan slob chos gsum/ rgyal po sku lnga rnams bzhedas shing / mdos shig kyang btsugs/ gos tshoni spel gyi phye phur dzom gos dmar lha lha ma 'ja' bcas cha rnams/ mkhyen brtse nus pa mes po'i ral klung las/ /bde ba'i nyal 'gro ras dkar sham bu can/ /srid pa'i khyab 'jug zhabs sen lhab lhub rtser/ /thar pa'i rkang tog mdzes 'od 'bar bar shog /chu 'brug dpe har lcog gi rgyal po'i sku 'bag slob dpon chen po'i phyag bzo mar na bza' gos dmar ta hung rgyu legs da ris 'byug tshon tshogs kha'u ma/ rdor gong gos nyer tshos kha lu ma/sag theb kyi sham bu'i gong pa gos dmar 'byug ma sham bu dar bcas/ rlung gnon rgya 'phan brgyad/—313—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung la rtsam/ 69)kha thi'i phye phur chung ba cha rnams phul/ /dpa' bo'i sdang mig dmar zlum 'khyil ba'i nyis/ /yid srubs rtsa lag kunda zum pa dang / /lhan cig bde skyid puṇḍa ri ga'i tshal/ /rgyas pa'i pad dkar chun po thod du chings/ /sa pho byi lo rnam dag khrims khang gling gi 'og khang rtsig pa dang shing cha gsar brjes/byang chub chen po gtso 'khor lnga la zhig gsos/ lcags yos shing rtsi dang logs ris dkar chag nang bzhin bskrun/ chu sbul li ting bcu bzhi/ mang lug steng khang sbug dang mdo khyams so sor ka bzhi thigs khang dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs sngar med gsar bzhengs/ rten rnam snang rigs bzhi/ mi 'khrugs pa/ slob dpon chen po'i sku rnams gser sbyib byug gzungs zhugs dang bcas pa/ sku rer dar kha dog sna lnga mthing khra dang bcas pa'i snyan shal dngul mtshal gyi smon yig can drug re/ dbu thog star brgyud la thon thi sngon po'i bla bre/ mdun dkyil du gos sngon gser 'brug ma dang g.yasagayon du mang lug ngur smrig 'brug ma'i gnam rgyan/ ldebs ris kun rig ga song sbyong ba'i rgyud ris/ khyams lto byang du tshe dpag med dang sgrol dkar nyis stong / gos kha thi dang gser ma tshon spel gyi phye phur dzo ma se'u rgya bya mas byas pa cha/ mthon thi ser phra'i 'phan ngur smig gser ma me tog masa'aphan mgo byas pa cha/ stod se'u la smad ya shel sngon po gser gyi gzungs yod mngags btags kyi kyi 'phan mgo thon this byas pa cha/ dril bu brgyad yod kyi dril gdang / li ting nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ ser ting bdun tshar/ li ma khar gyi ting bdun tshar/ li'i maṇḍal gsum lcags kyi mañdzi dang bcas pa/ ljang gser gyi me dam cha/ hor dam cha/ zangs ting gcig /bal sbug gcig /mar (27nas sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas bsto re'i rgyun 'dzugs/ khro kong mngags bzos zla drug ldang ba/ me bya mchod khang rnying par mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum re rgyun 'dzugs/ zangs dmar gyi mchod kong gcig zhang 'brug kha thi thon thi tshon spel gyi phye phur dzo ma thon thi sngon pos byas pa cha rnamasaphul/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i mkhan slob cho ga la/ /brten nas rab tu byung ba'i khrims mnos te/ /lha mi'i rin cen them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i khang par 'jug par shog /—314

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod nas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)chu sprul khams gsum zangs khang gling gi steng khang bar khang 'og khang gsum so sor li ting bdun tshar re/ lcags byi khor sa phyi ma'i g.yabs ring sgor ma ka ba bdun cu don gnyis kyi sa'i byang brgyud star ma'i rtsig pa rtsa slong dang gzhan rnams kha gso byas pa'i thog gsar brjes/ khor sa bar pa'i rtsig pa dang thog sgor mar zhig gsos/ shing sbrul 'og khang gi sems dpa' gcig zhig pa gsar du bzhengs/ steng khang bar khang 'og gang gsum so sor mar me sdong rkang re dang zhal zasagasum re'i rgyun btsugs/ sa sprel bar khang sgo phibs ka ba bzhi 'phreng zhig gsos/ lte ba'i mda' yab gong 'og gnyis dang steng thog lcog bzhi bcas pa'i shing cha gso brjes dang g.yu thog gsar bzhengs rnams grub po/ rnam dkar 'di'i 'bras gling bzhin ma shong bar/ /lhun po'i rtse mor snyeg nus nga la nu'i/ /bsod nams rang nyid gcig pus mi spyod par/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba (2slob)kun la gtong bar shog /chu sbrul dge rgyas li ma gling gi khor sa steng shod khol gsos/ las mi stong brgal bas phyi'i bye ma bshub par zla ba phyed gnyis kyi bar ja thug sto sogs kyi mthun rkyen/ li ting bstobazhi/ shing sprul dkar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum re'i rgyun btsugs/ du g.yu thog legs par grub/'dir 'bad lus phra'i nu ma mngon mtho las/ /rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa 'o ma'i rgyun/ /dngar ba'i ro bcud mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyis/ /rtag tu myong ba'i skal pa bzang por shog /chu sbul bu tshal gser khang gling gi 'og khang du ting bcu bzhi dang steng khang du bdun tshar/ 'og khang rten gtso'i dbu thog tu mang lug dmar po'i bla bre che ba gcig /me bya steng khang du mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum re'i rgyun btsugs/ chu stag khor sa'i lto byang gnyis kyi steng dang shar gyi glo 'bur g.yas g.yon bcas ka ba bzhi bcu'i sa'i rtsig pa kha gsos dang thog gsar brjes/ nub brgyud ka ba dgu'i steng shod kyi rtsig pa kun dang / cong khang ka ba bzhi'i steng shod kyi thog dang rtsig pa rnams gsar brjes/ khyams nang ma'i sgo phibs ka ba drug tshar zhig gsos/ 'og khang mdo khyams shar gyi —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya 4'a gsung 'bum/ ()thog zo gcig gi sa'i rtsig pa dang ka ba brgyad kyi steng thog kyang gsar du bskrun/chu yos g.yu ban sgrig skyor/dkor khang byang phyogs kyi rtsig ba dang /'og khang bar khang gnyis kyi sgo phibs bcas pa rtsa slong lta bu'i zhig gsos/g.yu thog sgrig skyor/bar khang mdo khyams shar la 267na skokar chag nang bzhin gyi ldebs ris sngar mal ltar gsar bris dang /lto byang gnyis la tshon gsos/shing sprul 'og khang du mar me sdong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum re'i rgyun btsugs/sa bya shing cha rul ba dang g.yu thog rnams gsar brjes dngos gtsang ba grub bo//'di nang zhing sar chos dkar sa bon tshogs//btab pa'i myu gu grangs med skye ba sa/nam yang chud mi 'dza' bar yongs smin 'bras//yid can kun dang lhan cig spyod par smon//dpal skyon chen pos gung thang la thog tu bzhag pa'i zhabs rjes ngo mtshar can la me phag lo mar me sdong rkang gcig gi rgyun/bzhu mas khro/zangs dmar gyi mchod kong dang bcas pa/rgyab tu gshis gas yod 'dug par me spre lo mjal bar mi gnod pa'i dngul srang bzhi bcu'i thums phul/mi mthun nyes brgya'i smag rus dbyings su dengs//tshe dpal 'byor ba'i rgya mtsho ches cher 'phel thar pa'i sa mos bzhad pa'i sngon med zla//padma ka ras tshe rabs kun tu skyongs//sa sprel rka chu lha khang du mar me stong rkang gcig dang zhal zas gsum gyi rgyun btsugs/rten brten pa rnams la zhig gsosa'aphral 'phral du song /dbu rtses thog drangs pa'i lha khang gi 'bur sku rnams la de gnyis tsam ma gtogs gas chag phran bu ma byung ba med 'dug par lha bzo ba'i rigs kyis phyag mdzub sku rgyan sogs sbyar ba grul ma thub par/sde pa dpon g.yog nas phyag bdar gyis 267bsko sos pa shin tu 'byar zhing brtan pa byung bar/lcags byi gser btul ma zho brgya'i gser chab dang /lha khang so sor mchod cog rtsi ma pad rim can re phul/gling chen bzhi'i mdun du dar chen 'dom bcu re yod pa lo star brje ba'i rgyun btsugs so//'dzad med legs byas na ma mkha' mdzod kyi sgo//phye nas rtag tu yongs su nyer spyod pa//gser gyi lag pa'i khyim baXg rjes 'gro bar//phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs

sku gsung thug rten gsar ba tshe pas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)kun gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /gsung gi dben gnas mchims phu bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gsang phug tu chu stag gi lo slob dpon chen po'i sku gser zangs las grub pa'i mi tshad ma gsar bzhengs/ dar tshon tshogs drug gi snyan shal smon yig dang bcas pa/ gos chen gyi bla bre/ phye phur cha/ sgo la lcags khra btsugs so/ /spang rtogs yon tan rnam 'dren yongs mnyam yang / /bod 'bangs 'gro la thugs rje rgyal gzhan las/ /ches lhag padma thod 'phreng rtsal khyod gyis/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du rjes 'dzin shog /de ltar lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang le lag dang bcas par rten brten pa rnying pa la zhig gsos/ gsar du bzhengs pa/ bka' 'gyur rgyun sgrog /mchod pa dang 'phan rgyun 'dzugs kyi lo gcig gi dngos po 'gro tshod/ rab gnas la nged rang grwa tshang dang bcas drug brgya skor gyis zhag bcu gcig bsdad pa/ sa skya zhabs drung rin po che khri chen/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku/kong po rdzogs chen pa lha (268na btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal gsum gyis lan re/ sprul sku gsung sprul grwa bcas bdun cu skor gyis lan gsum byon par lha khang re re bzhin la cho ga tshar re btang ba'i yun ring ba/ dpal ri sprul skus lan gnyis/ rab byung pa rnams kyis lan kha yar dang bcas song ba'i bdog pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms par gser btul ma grang gser dbus zho drug brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe drug se ba phyed drug /gser thig hrug dbus zho stong phrag bdun dang bzhi brgya dgu bcu go bdun/ dngul btul ma dbus zho nyi shu rtsa gsum dang se ba bzhi/ dngul srang drug cu re dgu dang zho brgyad/ dngul mdong gcig /zangs khar rgya'i khal stong phrag gcig dang sum brgya bcu gsum nyag phyed/ dngul chu khar rgya'i khal bzhi bcu zhe gnyis dang nyag gang / ti tsha khar rgya'i khal drug dang lhag phyed do/ /bsha' dkar khar nyag gsum/ star bu khar rgya'i khal bdun dang nyag phyed dang bcu gnyis/ gser shog bre kha 'bum tsho gcig dang khri tsho gcig stong phrag bzhi brgya bdun cu tham pa/dngul shog bre kha che nges stong phrag gcig dang lnga brgya sum cu so drug /mtshal khar rgya'i khal bcu drug —317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang gyo mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 79)dang lhag bcu gcig /li khri khar brgya'i khal phyed drug /mthing chen khar rgya'i khal bzhi bcu zhe lnga lhag do/ /sngo skya khar rgya'i khal sum sto rdzob dun dang nyag bdun/ g.yu thog gi tshwa bcas spang wo mkhar rgya'i khal brgya dang bcu dgu nyag bco lnga spor gang / spang skya khar (268ba lo'i khal sum cu so lnga dang nyag lnga/ ba bla mkhar rgya'i khal bcu drug dang nyag lnga/ ram mkha' ru'i khal gnyis bre do phul lnga/ rgya tshos mkha' ru'i khal bcu gsum dang bre bcu drug /zhun mkhar ru'i khal bcu bzhi dang bre do/ /spyin mkha' ru'i khal brgya dang nyi shu rtsa drug /sra rtsi mkha' ru'i khal phyed dang bcu gcig /spos dkar ltang rtse drug /mtshal dkar gad ma mkhar rgya'i khal brgya dang lnga bcu nga bdun nyag phyed gsum/ snum snag bye ril ma mkha' ru'i khal gnyis dang bre bcu gnyis/ gzungs bzhugs la shog ngos nyi shu tham pa/gser zho sum cus nyos pa'i gur kum/ sman bzang drug ka ṭo ra lnga/ ar sdum gsum/ spos reng brgya khres lnga bcu tham pa/ lcags stod khar rgya'i khal brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe lnga nyag phyed dang nyi shu /gser thog gi shing sgrog gzer dang g.yu thog sna rten bcas lcags gzer phra sbom 'dres pa stong phrag dgu dang bas tham pa/ bla bre gnam rgyan 'dren pa bcu drug /'phan ring nyi shu rtsa lnga/ sbug sil cha gnyis/dung dkar gcig /mchod rnga khri bcas gnyis/ zangs tir gnyis/ me dam cha gsum/ li ting sgong bzo ma lnga brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig /khro kong mngags bcos bcu drug /khro shab gcig zangs dmar gyi mchod kong bcu gcig /dril bu rgyu legs bzhi bas zhe drug /'bru mkhar ru'i khal khri tsho lnga dang stong phrag gsum lnga brgya bdun cu don gcig bre bcu tham pa phul lnga brgya/ ja nag mo khor drug bcu bdun dang bar (269na khig gsum/ zi ling nag po sbag bzhi bcu zhe bzhi/ rtse hrug sbag gsum ba gyodang lnga bcu tham pa/ yag chu khor drug nyi shu phyed rtsa gcig sha shan kho re drug brgya dang bcu tham pa/ 'brasakhā ru'i khal sum cu so gnyis/ mar khar rgya'i khal stong phrag gsum dang bzhi brgya nyag brgyad/ snum khyar ru'i khal bzhi brgya dang bco lnga bre bcu bzhi phul lnga/ phyur ba mkha' ru'i khal bzhi brgya dang drug bre bco brgyad/ tshwa yon phran 'dres bcas kha' ru'i khal lnga brgya dang lnga bcu nga gnyis bre brgyad phul —318

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar mag / (ma)gang / tshag bubs bzhi brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe drug /lug khog stong phrag lnga dang brgya bzhi bas zhe bzhi/phag bubs bzhi bcu phyed zhe gcig /rab tu byung bar 'os pa'i rung mthun gyis gos cha tshang tha'i ji rang gi na bza' skor cha 'grig gcig dang / gos rtsag legs pa gcig /bkra shis kha btags dang 'dom 'khor 'dres pa stong phrag gcig dang nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa dgu /gos kha thi thon thi bcas rgyu legasayug tshang brgya dang bcu gcig /gos dkyus ma yug bdun cu phyed don gsum/ ling dang dar yug brgya dang phyed brgyad/ sman tse yug dgu bcu go gnyis/ spen bubs brgya dang drug /la ta yug gcig /zam so yug sum cu so gnyis/ dril yug brgya dang lnga bcu tham pa/ ras chen yug brgya dang bdun sto tham pa/ ras chen yug brgya dang bdun cu tham pa/ ka ras yug bdun cu don dgu /rta spus legs bdun cu don gcig /gser sga cha 'grig gnyis/ sga (269bskom ra dngul shan ma gcig dang / tha'i ji rang gi sga gcig /dwags sle lnga/ ar ti gnyis/ ral ku sngon po gcig /gzan sna lnga sum cu so drug dang rgya tshos gcig /snam dmar bubs sum brgya dang lnga bcu tham pa/ snam dkar bubs bdun stobyed don bzhi/ khrab rmog cha tshang gnyis/ me mda' legs pa cha 'grig gcig /phye shel ltang rtse bcu/bur ltang bzhi bcu tham pa/ rgun 'brum kha' ru'i khal bdun/ shi pha kha kha' ru'i khal bzhi/ kham bu dang star ga 'dres pa kha' ru'i khal brgya dang sum cu so dgu rnams/ /dbu rtse chen mo'i gser thog gsar bzhengs skabs/ zhal 'debs byung ba rnams logs su bkod par/ bkra shis ljongs nasasdepa chos rjes kha btags che ba/ dngul chu rgya thur gyi srang nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gser dbus zho lnga the ba'i hor rta kha gzhen gcig /bde chen nas sa skyong thog rgod rnam rgyal gyis gser dbus zho bcu drug /zangasakhar rgya'i khal bco lnga dang mchu phyed gsum/ gling ma chos mdzad mas gser zho do/ /sne'u gdong rtse bdag mos gser zho bcu tham pa/ byang chub gling skyes gser zho lnga dang se ba bcu bzhi/ rgyal srasasher 'phel bas gser zho bdun/ chad dkar dpon sa sa gser zho bco brgyad dang se ba do/ /sna mo shag grub chen pas gser zho bco brgyad dang se ba bco brgyad/ dge slong mchod dpon dang dbu mdzad —319—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāneganyis kyis gser zho phyed bstobadug bar khams sde pa gzhi rtsa bas dngul chu rgya thur gyi srang brgya tham ba/ che chen dbu chin gyis zangs(270na khir rgya bdun dang mchu phyed do/ yang kha lcog sbug pasagaser zho dgu /dngul chu srang sum cu so bzhi/ zangs khar rgya'i mchu gsum/ brag nyi dar rgan chosarjes kha btags gsum/ sman yug gcig gos dmar yug gcig /dngul srang bco lnga/ khams chosarje rgya ston pas gser zho lnga dang se ba bdun/ la mo dpon po sku rten pas gser srang gang dang zangasakhar rgya do/ stag don grub gyis gser zho phyed dang bcu gnyis dang zangs khar rgya do mchu do/ dga' ldan ha gdong dge slong rgyal mtshan gyis gser zho bdun dang se ba bcu bdun/ che chen dbon posagaser zho bdun dang se ba bcu gnyis/ bde chen chos 'khor sprul skus gser zho dgu /dpal ri sprul skus gser zho gsum dang se ba phyed dgu /rnam sras gling pas gser zho gang dang zangs lha nyag gi khal gsum/ gzims khang gong phyag mdzod pas dngul chu rgya thur gyi srang lnga bcu tham pa/ zangs lha nyag gi khal bcu gcig /phan po gnam gang gis zangs khar rgya'i khal gsum/ sdings po che sprul skus gser zho do dang se ba do/ drug brgya bas gser zho gsum dang seb gsum/ stag ru bas gser zho do/ no khong dge tshul gyis kha btags/ sman kha brgya bdun/ kha ti ser khra kha bsto'abrel/ sgrom pasagaser zho bcu dang se ba bdun/ sbas grong pas gser zho do dang se ba byed bcu bzhi/ zangs khar rgya'i mchu phyed gsum/ bsam yas sku rten mgon (270ba tshe thos gser zho gang dang seb phyed/ mkhan tshang gnyer pa kun dga' dar rgyas kyis gser zho gang dang se ba do/ mkha' rab nang so rnam sras kyisagaser zho gang dang se ba bcu drug /mnga' ris grwa tshang rab stims pa rtogs ring gis gser zho gang dang rtseb bcu drug /ka ras yug gcig /sle ri rab 'byams pas gser zho gang / chad dkar a dgos kyi gser zho gang dang se ba phyed do/ nyin sdings tshes bzhi bas gser zho gang / nyin sdingasasems dpa' sprul sku'i yab kyis gsar zho gang / phu lung 'tsho byed pas gser zho gang / lo phu 'tsho byed kyis gser zho gang / 'phyong rgyas ri bo bde chen nas grwa pa blo bzang dar rgyas kyis gser zho do/—320

sku gsung thugasartenagasar bakhosadang rin po tsho rmang rdza kha bzang gi dkar sa / (ma)'tsho byed nam mkhasagaser zho do se ba do/ rdzong dpon pas gser zho do/ dge slong ye shesaphun tshogs kyisagaser zho do dang se ba phyed bcu/ gser byung ba dang gdong pa gnyisakyisagaser zho gang dang se ba phyed do/ lha saskor skad pa smyon pasagaser zho gang dang se ba lnga/ sbusagrong pa'i tsha mosagaser zho gang dang seb do/ dwagasapo bla ma gling pasagaser zho gang / sle sbusapasagaser rtseb phyed bco brgyad/ 'tsho byed phun tshogasakyisagaser rtseb bcu tham pa/ ka ma bas zangasamakhar rgya'i mchu phyed dang / chu dbar bsazangasamachu phyed/ dge bsnyen gyisazangasamachu phyed do/ lha sa.a bug gisaka ṭo ra gcig /rasaphug chosamadzad kyisagaser se ba phyed nyi shu/ masagrong sgur 'tsho byed pasazangs khar rgya gang dang mchu phyed bzhi/ (271nalochimasaphu gsang phug dkon gnyer gyisagaser se ba do/srasamo nyor nyor gyisazangasakhar rgya'i mchu gang / bsam yas skor skad pas gser se ba bcu rnams phul ba yin no/ /gdul dka' 'dul la gar mkhan ji bzhin du/ /sa spyod gzugs kyi mig 'phrul cir snang yang / /sangasargyasasrasabacasango bo mi gtong bas/ /'gro blor rgyal ba'i 'phrin las 'jug sgo tsam/ /dam pa'i rnam thar lha lam mtha' snyed pa/ /dngosapo'i gshisalugasayin phyir ya mtshan ci/ /mkhan slob chosargyalamadzad pa mngon sum ding / /blta phyir nyi zla mkha' la rgyu 'di mtshar/ /'khrul ba'i ra bsayongasabaskor 'khor ba'i gzhir/ /chosabargyad mi gtsang dri la chagasamin pa'i/ /gto bde bung ba 'bab stegasadage ba'i chos/ /'dab stong snying po'i ge sar 'di na dgod/ /'gro ba'i snying la gzer ba'i sgrib gnyis mda'/ /lhag bsam dpyid kyis rtsa ba drungasa'abyin pa'i/ /tshe yi rig byed 'dzin pa mesapo'i bu/ /smon lam dag pa'i tshangasaskud mgul par 'chang / /gcig tu dkar ba'i rlabasachen spyod pa'i dri/ /tshe rabasamang po'i tsandan 'phreng ba la/ /rtag par sim pa'i ngad pa skye ba 'dir/ /ched du rtsol bar ma stos ngang gisa'athul/ /gnam gyi she mong nor 'dzin bdag po sa /dbang bskur lha gzigasaphag mo gru pa yis/ /rdzong dang dmag gi dpon du nyer mngags pa/ /skyid shod mi yi rje bo —321—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dga' ldan pa//chen po'i lung dang las271ba pos khungs dang 'brel//ya rabs rim par brgyud bas dpa' rtul mdzangs//lugs gnyis rnam dpyod do ger rang mnyam gyi//dregs ldan kun gyi gtsug tor rtse las mtho//bdag gas byang wo thob pa'i rgyu tsho gos dang //gangs ༅ phan bde'i rtsi sman ljon pa che//tshul 'di bstar ba'i phyag rjes grags pa'i rnga//srid mtha'i bar du phyogs kyi mdzesams brdungs//gang der lusang ga yid kyisang la bsten zhing //zang zing nor gyi phan pa bsgrubs so cog/rtag tu bde ba'i rna rgyan rab 'chang ba'i//gro bzhin skyes kyi ngang tshul mi gtong shog/thabasashes zung du 'jug pa'i gser lag las//tshogs gnyis dngul srang 'bum phrag nyin re bzhin//'bab pas skye rgu'i srid zhi dbul sel ba/khyim bdag lha rje'i bu yi rjes 'gror shog/longs spyod rmugs 'dzin mdzod dang gcig tu byas//srog gi 'tsho ba tshangs pa'i rig byed 'grub//mnga' thang brgya byin 'bangs la bgo bsha' mā/byed pa'i dbang phyug lhun gyis grub par shog/blo dman nyan rang rtul phod rgyal sras theg/dbang snon sngags kyi lam zhugs bgrod pa yis//bzod dka' 'khor bar phyi phyag yongs btsal nas//gtan du sgo gsum tshor ba sim par shog/'di dang lhan cig rang gzhan mtha' dag gis//dus gsum bsogs pa'i bsod nams phung po'i mthus//sgrib gnyis dgra tsho gos bcom snye rgyal rnga che//'og yī zhing gi rtse nas brdung bar shog/lung rtogs chosagyi bdud rtsi deng gi dus//272na〉zhul ba'i snod cig gangs ri'i sman ljongs 'dir//nad rims dbul dang 'thab rtsod rgol ga gyis//'tshe ba'i klan ka nam yang mi 'jug shog/rang dbang mnga' ris 'byor bar chog shes ldan//phan tshun phu nu bzhin du mnyes gshin byams//'byung bzhi cha snyoms tshe yang ring du 'tsho//mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor ngang gis 'byung bar shog/lo paṇa rgyal blon rnams kyi ba ched smon ltar//chos 'khor stod smad rten dang brten par bcas//yid ༅ yongs kyi bsod nams gsog zhing du//nyi zlas mun sel de srid brtan par shog/yon sbyor sa spyod mnga' thang dbyar gyi mtshor//lugs gnyis 'jug pa'i rlabs 'phreng dus mi yol/rang rigs thig

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnale ches dkar sras brgyud kyi/ /dbu ba'i do shal ring du dgod par shog /slu med dkon cog rin cen lha dang drang srong srung mar bcas rnams kyi/ /phul byung thugs rje'i bden pa'i chus bkrus phan bde'i rin cen dbang gi rgyal/ /bsam pa'i re ba yongs su skong ba'i ma smad 'dod dgu'i char chen pos/ /kun khyab bkra shis rgyud mangs glur drangs nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rnar 'jebs shog /ces bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang la sa skyong dga' ldan pa rdo rje rnam rgyal mched sras bcas kyis nyams gsos/ bkur sti gya nom pa mdzad pa rnamasadakar chag tu thebs na slad nas kyang bzang po'i mig ltos kyi rgyur 'gro ba 'dug pas rtsom par skul zhig ces snang srid dregs pa'i sdod pon rgyal po chen po li byin ha ra dang / bka' gnyan gnod sbyin chen (272ba)po tse'u dmar po gnyis kyi rdo rje'i gsung gis bskul ma mdzad pa'i lo rgyus/ /sa bon gyi shog dril dang bcas pa so so'i bar mtshams dang mjug tu smon lam gyis brgyan pa zhig dgos zhes sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal gyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i lo nag pa zla ba'i dmar cha'i bzang po dang po la lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /bskal mang tsho gis gnyis sa bon smin pa'i 'bras/ /chos gzugs sdong po yal 'dab dar drag pa'i/ /thub dbang dpag bsam yongs 'du'i zhabs pad rdul/ /byang chub bar du gtsug tor mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /gang gi ri mo g.yas 'khyil mgrin pa nas/ /nges don sher phyin dung gi dbyangasasnyan po/ /theg mchog rigs sad gdul byar legs bsgrags pa'i/ /phul byung stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam tshogs/ /blo bzang dngos grub blo dang brtson pa yis/ /e lung cho sodakar phyogs su 'di bskun nas/ /'ol kha'i rang khyim dga' ba'i tshal yangs por/ /ma smad bsod nams zhing du nye bar drangs/ /rnam 'dren sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi/ /mdzad pa gang la brten pa'i bsod nams—323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tshogs//gzugs su grub na stong gsum 'jig rten gyi/khams 'dis snod du byas kyang yangs min dog ga par mdzad pa'i rab dang phul gyur pa/khrang dang nges pa'i chos tso rgyan73na〉tsho che'i//glanas bla ra mtho 'khor lo bar pa zhes//zab las ches zab snying po'i pha rol jo sgo//brjod don gdod nas stonge pa'i gnas lugs la/khung zad the tshom zos kyang srid pa'i mtha'//brtul na yid tshes dad pas 'dri klog 'chang //sri zhu bskrun pa'i bsod nams tshad bzung min//de phyir bsags pa'i legs byas gaṅgā'i yab//rab dkar gtsug tor las babs bsod nams kyi//'dzad med nyal 'gros sgrib gnyis dri ma rnams//rab bkrus kun mkhyen chu gter klong 'bab shog/'di'i ched sgo gsum 'bad dang rgyu sbyor ba'i//yon gyi bdag bor bcas rnams deng nas bzung //nges par legs pa'i lam du bzhugs min par//'chi med bde bar mnyam du spyod par shog/mtho ris thar pa'i them skas la 'dzegs nas//ring min stug po bkod pa'i zhing gi gtsor//nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur//mngon gyur rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog/'jig rten spyi dang khyad par swā la yi//sman ljongs yangs pa gling dgu'i rgyal khams 'dir//rtsod pa'i ming yang mi grag rdzogs ldan gyi//bde skyid mngon sum nyams su myong bar shog/thog mtha' bar du slu med gtan gyi skyabs//sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'dus pa yis//ba po shis rgyud mangs glu las nyer drangs pa//rtag tu rna ba mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur cig zhes 'ol kha dga' tshal pa blo bzang dngos grub gnyen 'dun dang bcas pa ston pa mnyam med 273ba po kya'i dbang po'i gsung rab kun gyi rtse mor son pa sher phyin stong phrag brgya ba'i glegs bam bzhengs pa'i tshe smon lam tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no//spang dang rtogs pa'i sdong po yal 'dab tshogs//'og min zhing khams ma la yar rdzogos nas//ris bral 'gro ba'i gdung sel thugs rje'i dri//ches dngar 'dzi5mdzad rnam tshon zas gtsang sras//mgon po khyod kyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar//gdul bya/ snang ngor 'tsham pa nyan thos tshul//'dzin mdzad

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)gnas brtan byu po bcu drug ces//thub bstan ji srid mgo sum 'gro 'di'i garsā//dge bsnyen sto tar grags rim gro ba//tong khun pa yi tshangs pa'i mchod yul gyi//mgron du 'gugs byed hwa shang pho nya ba//dkar phyogs skyong bar zhal 'tshes rgyal chen bzhi//kun tshang ngo mtshar bkod pa'i rgya mtsho'i dpyid//mthong bas yid 'phrog sgyu ma'i rol rtsed ༅//bsod nams 'dzad med chu bo 'byung ba'i khungs//sku bas ti se'i gtsug tor gzengs su thon//gang gi khur chen dad brtson snying stobasakyi//khyogs las gyen du 'degs par ngal med pa//'phrul snang bya 'dab ka brgyad tshom pa ba//rta dpon rnam 'joms a mchog bcas pas bsgrubs//sngags 'chang dbang po so zur ga chubs gsum las/khur gyi gdung 'dzin gzhis/shar ba ba'i//'phrin las rnam rgyal sor mo'i zlos gar 'phrul//274na〉kha' la dbang po'i gzhu ris lta bur mtshar//de lta'i legs byas nya phyis khog pa nas/srid zhi'i phun tsho gis musti ka yi char//dus las yol ba med pa'i 'khri shing gi/rnam thar mngon sum nyams su myong bar shog/rang bder gzhol min 'gro kun la bsngos dge'i//'bras bu 'khor 'dasayongs bde'i wo mor byed//deng nas byang tso bar gyi mkhar shar nas//bdag gas gdung ba'i smag rum sangs par shog/ces rta dpon rnam 'joms kyis de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor 'phagasapa'i gnas brtan bcu drug dharma ta hā shang rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas pa'i bris sku bzhengs pa'i skabs rgyab yig smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no//'gro la byams dang brtse ba'i 'od stong gis//bdud bzhi'i smag rum mthar mdzad rgyal tshab mchog/gang gi sku bas mdo smad skye rgu yis//bsod nams zhing byon 'bum gling mi pham skur//bsam blo a zhad chos rjes gser zhun chu//yang skyor sri zhur bskrun pa'i dge tsho gis kyi//gaṅgā'i chu rgyun nam yang zad mi shes//kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor 'bab par shog/ces bsam blo a zhang chos rjes mdo smad 'bum gling gi khru brgyad cu'i sku tshad can gyi byams chen la gser gsol yang skyor

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()byed rtsis la tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi ma zhes sbyar ba'o//274babyams gling yem phyi sangs rgyas 'byung gnas kyi gra thang du gnas brtan bcu drug gi gos sku phul ba'i deb kyi 'go brjod snyan grags dpal 'bar sogs/ma rgan nyam thag snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro//'dren par snying stobs mchogo gi dam bca' la//bde gshegs kun gyi legs sos bsngags pa'i yul//bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i rgyal//bstan pa de srid gnas par nyan thos kyi//mngon sum sku yi bkod pa nyer bstan nas//mtha' klas gdul bya'i don mdzad gnas brtan che//drug gis lhag pa'i bcu phrag mtshan du snyan//stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur mdzad 'dzam gling lha//tha'i sun thang gi legs byas spel ba'i gzhin//mang bkur rgyal po'i khab tu spyan drangs pa'i//snang brnyan bkod pa rgya mtsho 'byams su klas//rnam 'dren slob mar bcas pa'i bris 'bur sku//sgyu ma'i gar du gang bsgyur rjo lar//rab gragasamachog dman kun gyi chos dkar rgyun//ho med byed por nyer bsgrubs gaṅgā'i rdul//gra nang phun tshogs dge ba'i yul gru nas//gso rig 'dzin pa sangs rgyas 'byung gnas zhes//zhwa ser cod paṇa 'chang ba'i bstan pa la//mos pa'i lhag bsam zla ltar dkar ba des//bslu med rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngang tshul la//yid ches dad pa'i shugs kyi nyer drangs nas//sna tsho gis gyon gos bza' bsgrigasa'aja' māṃ bzhin//rnam par bkra ba'i ngo mtshar rten 'di bskrun//tshe yi rig byed 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu//bshes gnyen grwa pa mngon shes gdan sa che//gra thang gtsug lag khang gi mdzes rgyan du//75na thags phul bdog pa'i deb ther 'di na spro//skyid shod chos rje'i sprul sku ngag dbang bska lon lon las kyis ser 'bras dge gsum ba po sha lhun po bcas par dnguX gyi chab ril rgyan drug phul ba'i kha byang tshul khrims 'dzil ba'i

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)rma bsto/tshangs par mtshungs par spyod la mkho ba'i rdzas/ /dngul dkar rin cen phras spud zhal bsil stod/ /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling chen por/ /phul gos skye bar rab tu 'byung bar shog /bsil byed sbreng snod brgya phrag srang ldan pa'i/ /dngul dkar zhun ma mdzes pa'i rgyan drug can/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos sder legs bstar mthus/ /rtag tu nyes brgya'i dri ma kun zhagi da shog /rin cen gnyis pa'i khams las legs grub pa'i/ /ril ba spyi blugs mdzes rgyan tshar dngar ba/ /theg chen gling du nyer sbyar bsod nams kyi/ /rlabs chen spyod pas 'gro ba 'dren par shog /bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i sde chen por/ /gtsang byed chu klung rab 'khyil mdzes pa'i snod//bstab pa'i 'bras bu gro bzhin bye ba rna'i/ /rnam par thar de mngon sum 'dzin par shog /su sti bra dzā ༷ ཿ mgon khyod mdzad pa ngo mtshar bkod pa'i gar/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i khams su re ba'i/ /zhing 'dir mchog gi sprul sku zas gtsang sras/ /slob mar bcas pa'i grags pa srid rtser snyan/ /mi zad yon tan chu zla pha mtha'i tshad/ /rtogs min sprul pa nam mkha'i (2'ab)mtha' klas pa/ /grags chen 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bcu drug ces/ /nyan thos tshulu 'dzin don du sangs rgyas dngos/ /thub dbang gnas brtan dge bsnyen rgyal chen bzhi/ /rtswa ṇa ra spyan 'dren byed po ha shang bcas/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i snang brnyan sku/ /gser zhun rnam bkrar ye shes semasadapa' 'khyil/ /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab lhag bsam gyis/ /dgos dgos skyid skyid gnyisakyis thog drangs pa'i/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun byang chub sar 'god ched/ /zang zing gtong ba'i lag pa ring du brkyangs/ /ri mo'i byed po kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /sngags yong rgyal po zur gyi gdung gsob pa/ /lha ldan gzhis ka shar pa'i sor mo'i 'phrul/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi khengs pa thung ngur byas/ /dge ba'i phung po ches dkar ti si yi/ /gtsug tor las babs tshe dpal bsod nams kyi/ /chu klung nam mkha'i ngo bo mi gtong bar/ /'dzad med srid zhi'i rgya mtshor rtag 'bab shog /'od snang pha masagatso byas 'gro ba kun/ /ring min bla med byang chub sa brnyes shing / /ma thob yang srid kun tu ngan song —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo9)gi /ming yang mi grag mtho ris rten thob shog /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par bod kyi yul/ /gling dgu'i rgyal khams kun tu rtsod ldan gyi/ /sdug bsngal btsal yang mi rnyed phan dang bde'i/ /dga' ston rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dpal rgod shog /rtag tu phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i dpal gyi sgo/ /'byed 'dzad dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum gyi/ /phul (27྅ bkra shis me tog manda ras/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyen kun khyab par shog /ces pa 'di 'ang rgyal dar gong pa mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis gnas brtan bcu drug gi gter thang bzhengs pa'i kha byang smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tre bo ngag dbang nam mkha' 'o/ /sa skyong blo bzang mas stobs kyi tham kod mar po'i tham phud lcags phag hor zla dang po'i tshes bcaganyi kyi nyin jo bo rin po che/dmag zor ma/ dung skyong ma gsum la phul gas bar 'dzam gling gtso/na gas thaba'i ri mo/rdzo bog po che/don kun grub pa'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ khrims gnyis 'dab brgya bshad pa'i lte ba sa /mi 'gyur bka' rtags ze'u 'bru g.yur za'i bcud/ /lus can bung pa'i dga' ston rgyas byin rlobs/ /dam gzor ma/thun mtshams mdangs
