'dzin phyag rgya ri mo'i rjes/ /yid can yongs kyi gtsug tor rtser gsal bas/ /bar med gnam sa kun la dbang phyug par/ /mdzod cig dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ /dpor lha/gangasacan lte ba'i rgyal khab chen po nas/ /chos srid gnyis ldan rnam par lci ba'i lung / /'dzam gling skye rgyas len pa'i dbang thang dpal/ /'bar bar mdzod cig dpal ldan dung skyong ma/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i sde dpon zhang blon che/ /nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'bar ba'i lugs 'dzin pa/ /mi'u thung srin po khrosapa'i drag shul gyis/ /yid grubs rtsa lag smag dras pha mthar sgrod/ /phyag na yid bzhin rin chen dbang gi rgyal/ /grangs med (276brko ngos grub 'byung ba'i sgo 'phar las/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi nad kyi gdung sel sman/ /phun tshogs gter gyi 'dod dgu char du snyil/ /rnam dag dad pa'i yid kyi man shel ngos/ /khyod sku'i zlos gar mtshon mdangs yongs ba pob/ /'di zhes ston phyir ras—328

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po tsho mgo rdzasakha bzang gi dkar sa/ (ma)dkar dri bral la//mgo sum ri lo bkod pa tsho du dngar//go du brtson pa'i sor lo stu gu yis//dge ba'i rgyud mngasabardungs ba'i sgra snyan po//lha khyod thos 'dzin dbang por legasa'abrol bas//med byung thugasarje chen po nyer bskul na//'tsho byed ngag dbang lhag pa'i bsam pa yis//nad gso sman gyi sbyor ba byas so cog/ring 'tsho'i srog gi bas len bdud rtsi sa/'gyur ba'i 'phrin lasalhun gyisagrub par mdzod//cesapa 'di'ang 'tsho byed ngag dbang lhag bsam gyisashad blon rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi brisasku bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bandes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkhas bgyisapa sakhyu dwa dza yantu//rnam gsum sdesnod 'brasabu nyer spungasapa//khrimasaldan 'dusapa'i gser sbyangasayolago sa/ne'u le'i kha nasaskyug pa'i nor bu'i dpya//'dzad med 'khyil bar mdzod cig ngal bsosapo//dza ta'i dri bsung 'thul ba'i sman ljongasanas//za 'og thagasasu 'thag pa'i yul tshun gyi//phun tshogasabadog pa'i rim pa byung zin dang //'byung 'gyur rim spel deb ther 'god pa la//legasaldan nag po 'chi bdag lasakyi gshin//277nakongasacan skyong ma dpal ldan yang gha bza'//gtsug lag srung ma li byin ha ra yis//mel tshe gtong grogasamadzad la shis pa stsol//zhesabakrashisapa'i tshigagasu bcad pa sngon du 'gro bsa'aphagasapa'i yul gyi shri dha n+ya ka ṭa ka gnyisapa gangasari'i ljongasa'adir chosasdechen po dpal ldan 'brasaspungasaphyogs thamasacad lasarnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i dge 'dun 'du ba'i spyi rdzas/gnyer khang gi 'dzin masagazhisakhag sosortsisa'akhri sogasasaphag phan gyi sprod rnying deb bsher thog nas/gsang mkhar dka' bcu dang char chosapa gnyisal rtsisasprad pa'i sdego so so'i gzham du dka' bcu ngag dbang smon lam dang dpon gshong brtson 'grusargyal mtshan gyigasar 'phar rnamasabrisapa'i lag yod kyi deb ther gsal bar bkod pa la//ji snyed shes bya'i sa'adzin yangs par brda sprod gser gyi 'khor lo la//brten nas rmongs pa'i rgol ༅ rab bcom bcu phrag rig gnasagling bzhi por//rnam dpyod dpung gisathogasamed 9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dbang sgyur byed po gtsug na zla ba'i sras//chos kyi 'khor lo'i pad mtshor dus kun bzhugs la rig byed dngos grub stsol//legs sbyar gser mngal thod kyi chu klung las//snying por dril ba'i yan lag brgyad ldan chab//ljongs 'dir yun du gnas pa chos skyong bzang //skal ldan shing rta'i drin yin slar yang skyongs//gang de'i legs bshad mdzod 'dzin skad gnyis pa//rim byon mkhas pa'i gsang tshig rta ljang gis//blo gros 'dab brgya cung zad bzhad pa la//277bsgom dbye'i 'jug tshul ge sar deng 'dir spro//pad dkar zla gzhen nya gang steng rnam dbyedang po don ṣṭha zhon pa'iXgar 'gying ba//phra ldem mdzes shing yid 'ong lang tsho ga7godag/gcig bsdus grangs med sgyu rtsal drug cu mang ṣkarnams//'dren byed bdud rtsir spro mdzad dbyangs can ma//rig gnas gtsug lag rgya mtshor blo grosag sdig po la su bya phegacig mig gzings//thogs med bgrod byed brtson pa'i rlung dag gnyis la//nyer 'bad 'dod don mang ga rnams la mthun rkyen kun//legs ster rdo rje dbyangs kyi dbang phyug ma//mtsho ldan mig stong rdo rje rtse brgya gsus po byed pa'i ga mi ka pas//mong rtul sa 'dzin bcom zhes sgra dag ga spyi sa min gis//blo gros lus can rnams mang gi kyis dus kun tu//'jigs bral dga' bde'i khyad par ci yang myong //ngag dbang dngos grub dga' 'gur spyod pa'i ga po gos go kyi ga rdzo phyir//tshangs sras sgeg mo dag gnyis la mchod bstod sogs//ring nas brtson shugs rnams mang rdzo kyi ched 'bad tshe//rab dga'i sa de rdzun snyam yin la grang //dbyangs can thugs rje dpag bsam ljon shing lnga po pas kyi gcig min las//legs 'ongs rig gnas dri bsung dag sto ga las kyang //rtogs dka' tsha gdung rnams mang min las ring tshang khung min kyang lnga pa ra cu khul brgal te//kun shesa'agrogs gzhe ne can dang rtag tu gnas//dbyangs can gzugs sku'i drugang we༅ga mi ka'achi med lam yangs ngos//rin cen phyang 'phrul 278na pog gi ga rdzis rdzo rgyu skar mchog/rab bkra shel dkar sa 'dzin rnams mang rdzo kyi mdangs//lan brgyar bsten yang rgya mtsho'i zla bar 'khu//zhal khrims mtsho la bdun pa gnas sha jigazhig rdzo 'dren byed 0ngang mo dkar//rnam ba po 'phur lding dag gnyis

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)gi la zur mig can//snyan 'gyur mgrin rnga 'dod ldan 'gro rnams mang li la//rtsed ga' rgod pa'i dga' ston ci yang gnas//'dud do brgyad pa 'bod pa'i snyan gi dbyangs can bsil sbyin mkhan po dgongs//blo gros utpal tshogs ga spyi rdzo dag rab tu rgyas//rigs gnas ze'u 'bru rnams4migakyang g.yur za ldem//dga' bde'i dpal la rol sogs thogs med stsol//rnam dbye brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i 'jug tshul das tshig rgyan gyi lam nas drangs pa 'di yang rig byed pa tshangs srasabazhad pa'i rdo rjes brda sprod kyi gtsug lag ka lwa par thos bsam cung zad bgyis skabs go tshod dang bstun te bris pa'o//sdeb sbyor me rta go phreng can/gro tam tre ga mānāñtsa sa ra rkyol go spo6gu:yukta kaḥno lki〈slo ta nu sturaX:mu ne rwa pustaka/sra dzaḥthos pa'i mod la 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi grib//srab mor byas nas nges legs la sbyor zhing //ring min kun mkhyen go 'phang bla na med//thob byed thub gsung pu sta ka yi 'phreng //rtsa rtse mtshe bzhin 278ba〉du paṇa tsho gis rnams kyi//'bad pas nyer bsgyur mdo 'dul sher phyogs dang //phyi 'gyur rgyud bcas bsod na mas mukta ga'i//'dzad med char du skyug pa'i 'khri shing bzhi//rab dkar 'jam mnyen shog bu'i ā darshar//brda sprod gzugs kyi rnam 'gyur lus phra'i bzhin//kun yid brtan pa 'phrog pa'i sgyu ma'i gar//gcig tu bsgyur ba'i tshul 'di ngo mtshar med//bya dga'i khur chen 'dzin pa bla nas blar//'degs pa'i snying stobs rus sbal sgyu thabs mkhan//phyag mdzod phun tshogasarab brtan blo brtson gyis/khyab 'jug dregs pa'i ri bo sal stol//lhag bsam ma dros mtsho chen las babs pa'i//bsod nams tshad med chu bo bzhi yi rgyun//byang chub mchog gi zla ba'i ma ma mā/nyer babs dbye ba med pa ro gcig shog/'dus byas mtshan ma med pa nam mkha'i khams//ngo bo gtong min de srid gser mdog gi/cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs 'dzam gling gzhir//yongs khyab mi 'gyur g.yung drung ltar brtan shog/blo bzang dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan rtser//ye shes gzi byin rnam par 'bar ba'i tog/snang bas nyes brgya'i smag rum da ga re//smra ba gzengs mtho'i dngos

rgyal dbang lnga par ga dang blo slong rgyam gsung tsom/ (9)po rtag brtan shog/phun tsho gos bang mdzod la dbang rim gro pa//rab brtson blo gros brtan sogasatshul 'di la//'bad par ga rta gos kun byams mgon dbus 'gyur 'chang //'byon pa'i khrus pa dang por skye bar shog/chos279na po kar bir gyis ma rgan 'gro kun la//pad rtsa lta bu'i lasabazang nyer bris pa'i/rnam smin sgo du dngar ba'i gzigs mo la//spyad de gto gyi bde skyid dpala'abar shog zhes la mdo sher phyogs gangs du stir ro cog dang rgyud sde rin bo che phyi 'gyur bcas pa'i glegs bam brgya phrag bla brang rgyal mas mthon po'i phyag mdzod phun tsho gos rab brtan gyis 'bad pa chen pos bsgrubs pa'i tshe bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o//ra snor sgo mar waṃ rgyu/skye rgu'i bsam pa'i pha mtha' nam mkha' bzhin//gzhal dka' rnam mkhyen gyis gzigs grangs med pa'i//rsā mongs garsā por gsungs pa'i chos kyi don//nyer rtogs de don gas la ston par shog/25lung sgo mar waṃ rgyu/brgal dka'i phra rgyas chu klung drag po'i rba//ldog byed sgo gsum bag yod bsdams pa'i rags//rang rgyud ched du 'dul ba'i bslab pa yi//tshul khrims phung po yongs su rdzogs par shogazhar phyog la lo rgyu/snang dang stong pa zung du wo 'jug mes//'khor ba'i bud shing phung po rab bsreg pa'i//slu med rten cing 'brel 'byung snang ba yis//mthar 'dzin smag rus ming gi lhag mar shog/sa lam sgo mar waṃ rgyu/ma nub dbang gi chu bos rang rgyud smin//grol byed zab lam mchog gi rnal 'byor gyis//tshe 'dir dpal ldan rdo rje sems pa che//sngon 'gyur 'gro rnams sgrol ba'i khur 'byer shog/279ba)sdeb sbyor mkho pa'i bri tta las rgyun ga gnyis pa chu rgyuna.a pa gagan kha badzra mā bskrus shā lha tsi ste khu snga0kā'i kṣa2shu rgya tā shrī la rka khro gi hi/ /bra hi tsam ha ta tsārsharā jigamārgyudma dod lnga tsā kta ya stog shā rir thro ter smin mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje ji bzhin gzugs dang mas ma dmigs su med pa chos sku stong nyid 'pho med ngang //'phags 'a nyag gcig yid ngo'i kun 'gror

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas rdzo bzang gi dkar ga/ (mnartag tu 'char yang 'dzad med longs spyod rdzogs sku'i nya gang bdud rtsi'i 'od//280nabra tir bi yi ti bkra se pañtsa sa sa chu tos re kā sha ni 4 8 mi ri bi/hi bi na yanas rā di she 9 losadzāyen so bra sto11kya siṅgā ya shi:rnamaḥbra phab lta bur rgyud lnga khams kyi rdzing bur gsal ba sprul pa'i snang brnan 'di zhes tshad gzung yongs bral yang //rnam 'dren gzhan las khyad zhugs tshulu la sras bcasargyal bas legs par rab sbyin shākya seng ger mgos phyag 'tshal//280ba tshe gcig tu lci ba'i phung por legs spungs lus can bsod nams tshong zong tsho gos kyis gzhal ba las//thog mtha' bar dge thub pa'i gsung rab mukta daḥ'aphreng yan lag drug cu'i srad bu la//brgyud nas skal bzang mgul pa'i rgyan mdzes lung rtogs bstan pa'i wo byed 'od kyi 'jig rten gsum//snang ba'i sgron me skye rgu kun gyi phan bde'i srog song chos kyis bdag byin rlobs//༅ mongs lang tsho dar la drag pa'i sems glang bag yod btsan po'i ra ba mā/nyer bcug shes bzhin lcags kyus rab btab bslab gsum mdzes pa'i gser sbyangs rgyan spras nas//'khor ba'i g.yul las mdzo par rgyal mdzad nyan rang byang sems dge 'dun tsho gos bcas kyi//rnam par thar pa'i rjes su bdag kyang slob na ngesalegs bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig/'phags bod paṇa grub 'jig rten mig gcig chos rgyal rim par byon rnams kyi//kha byung brtson pa'i shing rtas legs drangs tso pa'i bstan pa yid bawo nor//thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mas rtser mchod srid zhi'i legs tshogs 'dod rgu'i char//kun bzod lto ba yongs su bkang ba'i bka' drin pha mtha' gzhal nus su/khyod mkhyen me long ngos su mi 'char shes bya'i gzugs bas gang /khyun mtha' pa yis ma rtogs bar ho med lam la g.yur na//nges par rnam pa thams cad gzigs pa nyid las gas min pa'i//yid ches gto gyi skyabs gcig blo bzang grags pas rjes zungs shig/'chad rtsod rtsom pas bska 'dzin dge 'dun 28na gling bzhi la//mkhas dang grub pa'i gser gyi 'khor los yongs sgyur bas//lung rtogs rdzogs ldan dga' ston spel ba'i cho ga mkhan//rgya chen mtsho byung mgrin par zhugs khyod gtsug tu bsten//bsod nams

rgyal dbang lnga pa nga gdabang blo ba nga rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yis//hor 'bangs kun la dbang sgyur rigs bdag tu//son pa zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs kyis//rgya mtsho'i gos can mthar khyab mdzad la bsngags//'gro rnams ma rig stug po'i gnyid po cher//g.yur las sad byed chos kyi chu bo che//skad gsang phyogs bcur sgrog pa'i gsung rab kyi//pusta gaḥ'aphreng legs byas bye ba'i zhing //skye rgu'i rgyud kyi sgrib gnyis de snyed nad//sel nus mtha' klas chos phung rtsi sman ljon//rnam 'dren mgur dang byin rlabs rjes gnang ba//phung por spungs na srid pa'i rtse las brgal//ti mi'i grong las gzar bus bcus pa'i chus//skom pa'i gdung sel ji bzhin dbus 'gyur nas//lnga bcus lhag pa'i brgya phrag glegs bam tshogs//lo paṇa drin las kha ba'i ljongs 'dir 'gyur//yang mes chos rgyal dus byon rnam 'dren gsung //phal cher gsar bcad skad kyis gto phab pa'i//byed po mnga' bdag khri lde srong btsan gyi//rnam thar dran tshe dad pa'i spu long g.yo//dbus pa blo gsal blo ldan ral gri'i zhabs//tshal pa gi tu kun mkhyen bu ston sogs //bstan la gces 'dzin rnams kyi bod yul 'dir//'gyur ba phal cher dag ther dkar chag bsgrigs//sri zhu'i nang nas 'chad nyan nyer bsngags281ba lngas//gro lung 'phags pa bag ston sgrubatsun rje//gnas gsar khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mtshan//thub bstan srog gi zungs su grub pa bzhin//snga dar dus kyi ldan dkar 'phang thang mar//gsang sngags nang rgyud gnyen pas ma bkod ces//gsungs pa rnying ma'i rgyud kyi rin cen 'phreng //yin phyir deng gi dus kyang phal cher gab//'dul lung sher phyogs dkon brtsegs phal po che//theg pa gcig tu ma nges sna tshogasamado//phyi dar rgyud dang snga 'gyur gtso bsdus kyi//brgya phrag brgal ba'i bka' pod nor bu'i dpya//gang zhig mthong thos dran pas mngon mtho dang //nges par legs pa'i go 'phang la 'god pa//'bri ba'i bsod nams gzugs su nyer grub na//tshangs pas snod kyi 'jig rten sprul 'di chung //rnam smin dkar nag so sor 'byin pa'i zong //phra zhib las 'bras srang la brten pa na/khegs byasa'abras bus ci 'dod lhag pa'i sems//rdul bral 4ston zlas bsgrun min gcig tu dkar//de phyir

sku gsung thug rten gsar bldengs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (ma)gnam sngon 'khyil 'dra'i shog bu'i ngos//btso ma'i gser gyi khu bas nyer bris pa//ngang ring dal bur bkod pa'i gzugs mdzes ma//dpyad gsum dag pa'i brda dag lang tsho rgyas//ding phen gtsor gyur rgya dang hor gyi gos//lnga brtsegs stong skud lhas ma'i sku rags can//rgya rag glegs chab seng ldeng tsandan gyis//nyer g.yogs bzang rgu 'dus pa' bdog pas bsgrubs//dge 'dis kha lo sgyur ba'i 'gro mang zhig/thar pa'i ba gam nang du 'dzeg snyam nas//yid srubs chud mar bcas pa blong blong 282na sta'i//sems kyis mya ngan khang bur dran med brgyal//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i stobs ldan mthu chen rnams//legs so'i me tog mkha' la 'thor bzhin du//dgyes pa'i zlos gar dbyar rnga nyer thos pa'i//rma bya'i sgro gshog zlum por bsgyur ltar brel//dge 'di'i khyu mchog mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun//sangs rgyas 'thob rgyur snying nas bsngos pa'i zhan//lo legs phub ma dang mtshungasa'adi dang phyi'i//yang srid brgyud mar bde ba'i dpal 'bar shog/rang gzhan rnams kyi sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i gzhi//gces 'dzin rtsa ba sbom por bskyed bsrings pa//drung phyung kun 'byung 'khor ba'i ljon shing sdong /shes rab tsha dbal me lces bsreg par shog/sdig pa'i sa mkhan rjes su mi 'brang bar//sgo gsum dge ba'i lam la dal bgrod pas//'gro rnams srid las grol bar gyur min par//sum rtsen legs bris ji bzhin skyid par shog/dkar nag blang dor lag tu bstar ston pa//sangasargyas 'byung dang bstan pa ma nub par//rag las ra na thub pa'i ring lugs mchoge/byams mgon dbus 'gyur ma byon bar gnas shog/nyi ma'i gnyen gyis ji ltar bzhed pa'i chos//'khrul med tshul bzhin ston pa btsong kha pa'i//mdo sngags bshad grub rgya hor bod kyi mkhar//'char dang nub ba spangs te rtag brtan shog/gdul bya'i blo brid sdosnod rin cen gsum//tshul bzhin bgyid 'dun ri mo snying bris bdag/re ba 'grub phyir 'tsho ba'i srog gi zungs//rdo rje'i khams su dkon cog mthusabyin rlobs//282brko ga' ba brgya pa'i rjes 'gro'i dpal 'byor ldan//nyi 'og mngon par 'phags pa'i pho brang gi/lugs gnyis mnga' thang ches mtho khrims kyi shing //yid can yongs kyi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gnya' bar lci bar shog/glegs bam 'di bskrun ched du ngal dub pa'i//dka' thub bsten rnams lta zhog gom gsum tsam//spos pas mtha' rten bgyis kun 'khor bar yang //bde zhing myur du thar ba'i skas 'dzeg shog/dkon cog yul byas bsags pa'i bsod nams kyis//dus kyi bdag po'i las dbang ches btsan pas//'bangs su gtogos so cog la bde skyid kyi//dge ba'i mtshan masartag tu shis par shog/rgyal ba byang sems slob ma'i tsho gis kyi bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs dang //dkar phyogs la dga' lha klu gnod sbyin dri zar bcas pa'i bden pa'i tshig khyud mangs las drangasasnyan pa'i glur blangs bkra shis me tog manda ras//'chi med lam kun dog por bkod de nor 'dzin khyon la khyab gyur cig/ces gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud rnams bka' gnyan pas gtso bsdus tsam dang de phyin bod yul du 'gyur ro cog gi rgyal ba'i bka' rnams mthing shog la gser zhun gyis dris pa zhig bzheng 'dun yod pa'i steng /sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis brtson pa chen pos yar klungasasol nag thang po che'i gtsug lag khang du do dam gzims shag lho pa nang so dkon cog dar rgyas dang spel nag rin cen gnyis kyis bgyis pa'i 'phral du bsgrubs pa'i dge ba rnams byang chub kyi rgyur bsngos pas gnas skabs kyi bde skyid zhan la 'byung ba las 'os ma mchis rung sde pas nged rang ring du 'tsho bar dmigs pa yin pas tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung 283na tha'am khongs su 'thus pa byas/'dren pa mnyam med bu ram shing pa lcags sprel la sku bltams nas nyis stong drug brgya so gcig 'das pa 'phags yul ba bi ro dha spo ta ces ljongs 'dir 'gal byed du 'bod cing shar phyogs rgyal po'i 'dun sar zi sto brjod pa lcags mo phag 'byung ba sum ldan gyi lo chu shel gyi dbang po chu stod kyis nya ba'i tshes lnga nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor gyi dus za hor gyi bzhes ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar drag pa ngag dbang byams pas bgyis pa sarba kā li khu shri ya bha ( //sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i pri tta las ma po/ā ni tā ka ru༅bo stadma tsā pa tā ra go khu sna stag ṇa//dzñāXpu༅lta tsā kan di kā ya to du mo:rmi/gzod ma

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4kho dang rin po tsho ma rdzo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)nyid nas snying rje'i sa bon smon 'jug 'dzin mar legs bto tshogs//bsod nams ye shes drod gsher gyis smin sku gnyis sdong po g.yur za bas//mkhyen brtse nus pa ro bda'i g.yang chags 'phrin las sa bus 283ba〉ltangs dud ba//(ta dwa yashā gras su the lha ji ya karma phul pā riXmya/ /bzhi ka lnga tsam su noms bo(ga shra ma rtse ku me/ /thub dbang dpag bsam ljon pa'i grib mar lus can ma lusang la gsor mdzod//lha gcig mgrin pa bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung //rnam gsum 'khor lo bskor ba'i dbyangs snyan po//mchog dman gdul bya'i rna bar rab bsgrags pa//yid can kun gyi gsos sman bla na med//brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung po'i tshad//'gro ba'i blo dang 'tsham par legs stsal pa//mi brjed gzungs thob dgra bcom tsho gis rnams kyis//bka' bsdus bstan pa'i srog 'thud lus can gnyen//dbus 'gyur rgya gar shar dang lho phyogs nub//skyon gsang mdzod ka lā pa yi grong //mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gnasabazhugs gsung rab kyi//pha mtha' kun mkhyen las gzhan tshad gzung ci//gangs can skye rgu'i bsod nams lhun po'i 284na shing //rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i rgya mtshor bsgril ba las//ma smad bstan pa'i sa srungs phan dang bde'i//gom stabs lhod por da lta'i bar du rgyu//tho ri gnyan bas dus nas dbu brnyengs te//chos skyong bzang po'i bar du rim byon pa'i//lo paṇa drin lan rnyed pa'i rnam tshon bka'//'grel par bcas pas pur rgyal dog por byas/khyad par mdo 'dul sher phyogs gsar ma'i rgyud//bod 'dir tsor ro cog dang snga tsor nas//thor bur bcas pa padma dkar po yi//tso po skal bzang 'gro ba'i thod du bcings//legs byas drod kyis zhu ba'i te si'i chu//bsngo smon dag pa'i lam gsum la brgyud de//sems bskyed nyin mtshan chad pa med pa'i rgyun//kun mkhyen rgya mtshor 'bab 'di su yis bzlog/yang yang mthong bas don dang legs ldan cing //mang mang thosapas bzang po'i bag chags 'jog/gsal gsal bsams dang bsgoms pas rnam grol bas//dka' dka'i dal 'byor rnyed 'di stong log min//mi khom dang bral mi lus thob pa dbon//dkon

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo sang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (9)cog bla mar 'dzin pa'i shes ldan nyung /khung bsdus snying po bstan kyang gob dga'//dka ༷ spyad chos la byed pa wo skar tsam//'on te 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor min par//kun mkhyen ye shes ye nasasgrub 'dod blos//dge lis gang thob gang de byang tso rgyur//bsngo nus rnam dpyod rnam dkar yod pa med//dbang po'i rten dang 'gyod sdom sngon 'grobs//mthing shog rdzing bur gser dngul yig gzugs bya//brda dag rkang gdub 284bangs 'khrol kun tu spyod/skyobs bzhis 'dag par nusamin sdig de gang //mi dge'i ra ri gnyen bo'i chus bkrus nas//legs byas zla bzhin gsal ba'i sī ta ma//'phrog byed 'bod sgrogs gtsug tor sar lhung ba'i//dpal chen rā ma ṇa yi tshal 'di mtshar//zhes snyan pa'i tshig gi brjod pa rnam par dag pa sngon du btang nas//ji skad du/'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/kun dga' bo de lta bsan byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par 'dod pa dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyad par bya'o//shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mnyan par bya gzung bar bya bcang bar bya bklag par bya kun chub par bya rab tu gdon par bya bstan par bya lung 'bog par bya kha ton du bri bar bya de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugasadang rgyal mas dang dril bu dang ba dan dang kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i 'phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang pos/bkur stir bya bla mar bya brjed par bya mchod bar bya ri mor bya bsnyen bkur bya ste/kun dga' bo 'di ni ngas rjes su bstan pa'o//de ci'i phyir zhe na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di lasathams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro//zhes dang /sdud pa las/bde bar gshegs kyi yum 'di glegs bam la bris te/'chang zhing me rtag byug pas285na〉sti stang byed gyur na//mchod rten byas mchode bsod nams des ni char mi phod//ces dang /la las gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na//sems can ji snyed 'a/da kun dgra bcom nyid btul nas//gang gis

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (mnashes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes bka' stsal bas dngos su sher phyin la sbyar na'ang gsung rab gzhan rnams la yang de dang 'dra ba'i phan yon don gyis bstan la/ mdor na de bzhin gshegs pa yul du byas pa'i yon tan gang la dad pa bskyed pa'i phan yon kyang mtha' klas pa'i phyir na/ phal chen las/ su zhig sangs rgyasayul la dad sems pa/ /de ni chags med thub pa kun gyis dbang yang bskur/ /rdo rje lta bur sra zhing brtan la mi shigs pa/ /rkang gnyis gtso bos mdzad pa rtag tu dran shes shing / /'dren pa'i spyod yul snang ba shin tu rnyed pa rnams/ /g.yin gyi dring la mi rgyug byang chub sems kyang skye/ /zhes gsungs shing mdzad pa'i gtso bo ni gsung gi mdzad pa yin pas/ rje btsun btsong kha pas mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin de yang ni/ zhes gsungs pas shes nus shing / de bzhin gshegs pasazhal gyis 'tshes pa ni nam yang bslu ba med pa/ lung phran tshegs las/ zla ba skar ma'i tsho gos bcasasal lhung yang srid/ /sa 'dir ri dang nags bcas mkha' la 'gro yang srid/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni bskam par 'gyur srid kyi/ /drang srong chen po rdzun gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min/ /zhes 'byung ba yid ches(285ba〉kyi nges pas/ stod 'grel ba'i lugs la/ bi ro dha krita du 'bod pa 'gal byed ces pa lcags mo phag gi lor sol nag thang po cher bka' 'gyur rin po che gser chos dang skya bod tshar re 'bri ba'i sta gon gyi skabs sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khrims gnon du srog gcod pa sogs nan tur chad las bya ba'i kha na ma tho ba dang / rjes su chos skyong sogs gzhan rkyen la brten pa'i mchisabrang bdag gir bzung ba'i sdig pa sbyong thabs rnam grangs mang na'ang / gtso bo ni/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig tshe dpag tu med pa'i mdo 'di yi ger 'bri'am/ yi ger 'brir 'jug na/de'i sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam yang yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyal ba'i bka' nyid gtso bor bsngags shing / de yang rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs che ba'i khyad nas skya pod sngo chos su bsgyur la/dge ba bsgrubs pa de dag kyang smon lam gyis 'tshams sbyar ba nyid gtso che bas/ bu mo zla ba mchog —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 19)gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gal te rgyal ba de dag mchod 'dod na/ /sangs rgyas nyid phyir khyod kyisasmon lam thob/ /byang chub sems bskyed brtan gyur gang yin pa/ de las lhag mchod srid pa gsum na med/ /ces dang / ji skad du/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhungs/ /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ zhesa'abyung ba'i tshigs bcad phyi ma 'di blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo'i cho ga yin pas mkhas rlome phal cher la rlung ltar grags kyang der 'di 'dra'i phyogs tsam yang (286na〉da cing / blo gros mi zad pa'i mdor don 'di lhug par byas pa zhig yod pas de las sngon gyi bla ma zhig gis tshigs bcad du bsdebs par mngon/ gang ltar don la gnas pas mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa brtan pos yid drangs te bsngo smon gyi rim pa ni/ snying stobs thor tshugs gto me ba'i g.yang shun ldan/ /rnam dpyod tshangs skud 'chang ba'i gnyis skyes kyis/ /rgyal gsung ri mor bri ba'i bum pa'i chus/ /sdig lhung dri ma ma lus drung 'byin shog /las dpon yig mkhan bran du bkol ba sogs/ /'gul bskyod gtam smra rtog pa'i 'phro 'du yis/ /dngos po a ma 'dza' bar don ldan du/ /bsgrub kun rtag tu bde skyid myong bar shog /thub dbang rjes su tshul bzhin nyer slob pa/ /spyi dang khyad par rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa thosabasam sgom pas rab 'phel zhing / /de 'dzin sde bcas yun ring brtan par shog /gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor khyon la bar med du/ /dbang sgyur sa spyod srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /mi nyams mnga' thang rgyas pa'i btsan po'i bka'i/ /drang thig khrims kyis 'jig rten bde bar shog /kun bzod nya phyis khog pa yangs po sa /'byung ba'i bcud rnams sos pa'i mu thi la/ /rmugs 'dzin 'byor ba'i mdzod rgya grol ba dang / /lhan cig ru bzhi yongs gang phyur bur shog /ma byas las dang nam yang phrad min pa/ khyu 'bras dngos po'i gshis la mtshar du ci/ /dge sdig mnyam par dkar bas rtsod dus 'dir/ /rdzogs ldan dpal gyi rtse dga' rgod par shog /'di mtshon thog med yang srid ches mang bar/ /bsags pa'i 'dus byas dge rtsa ji snyed pa/ /nam mkha'i ska rags des kyang 'ching med pa'i/ /'gro kun bla med —340

grangasasnyed can//dga' rab dbang phyug sde dang bcas pa ming gi lhag mar rab btul ba//don kun grub khyod zhabasapad 287nabatsug na byang chub bar brten bdag byin rlobs//bstan pa rin cen gto rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()snying stobs gyad//rgyal bstan thugs la gces 'dzin ngang tshul zlas//bdag yid kunda khong nas cisami bzhad//sngon byung phang thang ma dang ldan dkar ma//rim bsgyur bsnan ba'i snar thang zha lu tshal//mkhas pa'i dpyad bsgrigs lus phra'i 'gram chang gis//mdo rgyud ba ku la bye gzigs mor mtshar//dbus ba blo gsal bcom ral bu ston rje//tshal pa si tu la sogs chos kyi spyan//rab gsal spyod tshul gcig tu dkar ba'i sgron//byed pos lhun po'i rtse nas spar ba bzhin//drang nges phra rags dka' ba'i gnad kyi rgya//mkhyen pa'i ral gyis gcod mdzad 287ba 'jam dpal dbyangs//mngon sum mi yi tshul 'dzin btsong kha pa/khyod min bla med gto gyi skyabs de su//chos blon thun mong nas gzung 'jig rten mig/chos skyong bzang po'i bar gyi thub pa'i bstan//dar ba'i lo rgyus thos ding rtagasatsam la//mtshar de 'dzin pa'i tshul 'dir mchi ma dku//sems gnas chig thub khung bur mal bcas nas//log rtog phud sgra sgrogs pa'i tshul 'chos lce//'jam po'i dug gis 'gro mang thar pa'i srog/gcod pa'i lto 'gros ljongs 'di gang ba bzhin//'on te dbyangs can dgyes pa'i rnam dpyod kyis//lang tsho gsar pas shes ldan ri dwags mig/bstan pa 'phrog pa'i sngon byon dam pa'i skrun//'ga' zhig srid snyam re bas rang sgro gsos//thub gsung 'dri dang nyan bklag kun chub pa/khre zhu ri mor byas pa grangs kyi tshad//zhing khams rgya mtsho'i lcags rdul gyis bgrangs kyang //ma ldangasang la bsatshangs pa gnyid la g.yur//dmyal sogs ngan du 'gro ba'i g.yang sa'i khung //cig car 'gegs pa'i sgo chen nyer bkab nas//mtho ris skas la khrid de thar pa yi/khang par 'jug pa'i dge tsho gos kun gyi rtse//de phyir 'bad pa yang dag don ldan du//dbang rnon chos kyi dad pas nges rnyed nas//rab dkar shog bu'i ngos su mig sman gyi//mdangs 'dzin yi ger spel ba'i cho ga brtsams//mkhasa'adod rang bzo'i gcan gzan dregs pa'i brda//ma yin chos skyong bzang po'i seng ge'i sgra//'jigasamed rgyud kyi dbyangs snyan za ma tog/dpang gtsugs zhus chen dpyad gsum dag pas bsgrubs//dge tshogs gser sbyangs bye ba khugs pa'i zong 4/2/'bras bu srid zhi'i lam du rtag bde ba'i//rna

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag / (ma)rgyan tshul 'di (288na〉sgrub par gtogs rnams kyis/ /mi 'bral gro bzhin skyes kyi rjes 'gror shog /byang chub sems kyi lag pa ring brkyangs te/ /bsod nams bsags kun 'gro la yongs btang yang / /'dzad med skye bar rang gis longs spyod pa/ /gser mdog rgyal po'i rnam thar 'dzin par shog /lnga phrag bcu yi rtsibs mas nyer bteg pa'i/ /thos bsam lha rdzas gos kyi sham bu can/ /mag rtogs nor bu'i rtag mdzes bstan pa'i gdugs/ /grib mar skye rgu ma lus bder 'khod shog /sna tsho gos skad dang cha lugs tha dad pa'i/ /yangs pa'i yul gru chen por mas klas par/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i ring lugs kyis/ /yongs khyab bla nas blar yang 'phel bar shog /kun dga'i sa bon legs ldan dbyid kyi mngal/ /sbrum pa'i sos kyi bde skyid pho brang che'i/ /lugs gnyis khrimasakyi ra bar yid can tshogs/ /bag phab phan tshun mnyes gshin mdza' bar shog /spyi dang khyad par rgya nag hor yul bod/ /kun tu dus kyi chad pa'i zug rngu yi/ /tshor ba dmigs med dpal 'byor phun tshogs shing / /tshe yang rig gnas mtshan ma mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs mgrin dang dbyangs gcig par/ /su sti na yi sgra las nyer drangs pa'i/ /rtag tu ba po shis rgya mtsho glur blangs ba//thos 'dzin snyan pa'i 'dod pa 'jo bar shog /ces snga 'gyur gyi rgyud rnams bka' gnyan pas gtso bsdus tsam dang de phyin bur rgyal gling dgu'i sa chen por 'gyur ro cog gi thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' rnams bzheng rtsis kyi shel dkar du bya lo shog bu'i sta gon gyi bkod pa song ba nye lam sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis brtson pa'i mthu la brten nas bsgrubs pa'i rdzong sdod gso rig smra ba bya ra ba dngos grub dang mtshal mig pa rgya (288bsgo tsho ched du mngags pa 'bri lung pa dbang rgyal dang smon grub pa rin cen bzhis do dam byas bzhengs pa'i tshe che brjod smon lam dang bcasapa 'di ni dbus tsor gyi yul du bi ro rdzo spo ta ces 'gal byed du grags pa 'byung ba sum ldan lcags mo phag gi lo nyin mor byed pa gan ṭa'i khyim du spyod pa'i dkar cha'i rdzogs pa dang po rta ljang can me bzhi'i dga' ma dang rtse ba'i dus za hor gyi bande 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa —343

brgyar dkrugs byas kyang //rjes chags zla ba nam yang mi gtong ba'i//thugs rje'i rlabs 'phreng dus las yol ba med//e ma slob lam dus na mgon khyod kyis//ma mdzad 'gro la phan pa rdul phran i/khrad min de phyir sngon byung rdzogs pa'i gto//sgos pa rgan pos glengs kyang mtha' rnyed min//'on kyang skyes rabasang dang sku tshe 'di'i//rtogs brjod mar mda'i grangs zur dpag bsnyo ljon//snya dngags mu tig 'khri shing g.yur za ba//'di 'dra mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed pa'i rgyan//sa spyod gtsug lag 'chang la spobs pa'i mthu//ches mtho dge ba'i dbang po yab sras kyi//rnam dpyod sor mos brdungs pa'i legs bshad rgyud//mang por 'khrol ba'i glu 'di gcig tu snyan//grong tshig bcad la dregs pa'i laṅka'i mgrin//don smyug sgra yi sgro ldan nyag phran gyis//gcod mdzad sngon byon lo paṇa lung rig 'phong //skyen pa'i stobs ldan rā ma ṇa de mang //gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i yang mesaphal mo che//skal ga dus kyi dmu thag lam bshegs bshul//pha bzang tswas las skyes rang rigasakyi//tshar ma'i yal ga 'byog pos sku gsung yis rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar tha kha bzang gi dkar ga/ (ma)lhag bsam gar mkhan 25ba thad//thub pa'i mdzad par chags pa'i dkyus ring mig/bsod nams phung po'i lus phrar gcig tu blta//rgyal la cung zad dad pa'i legs byas kyang //gzugs su grub tshe sa 'dir shong min na//rtogs brjod yongs bkod musti ka yi 4//'dzad med babs pasamakha' yang dog por 'god//rnam thar bris pa'i brgya rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (netshe dbang rigs 'dzin pa/mkhar rtse dpon bsam rnams rim 'byor gyis skya ris byas pa zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i zla snang la zin/lcags 'gyur/lcang srung khang ba rin cen rdo rje/lha sa dkon cog/'jam dbyangs don grub/rta mgrin/dngos bsam/ser ngag dbang dar rgyas/gzhis rtse rdo rje wo brtan/rdo rje tshe brtan/mkhar rtse kun dga' bstan 'phel/dge bsnyen rgyal po/bad nas rgyal po/gragasapa phun tshogs/rim pa brag logs pa/snye mo podze/tshon sbyor ba snyem bsod nams rdo rje rnams kyisatshon mdangs gib tshags gser dris sogs ru nga ba bstar/do dam glang ra 'og pa lha dbang tshe 'phel/lha sar ga pa tshe dbang rab brtan/gong gzham pa dbu mdzad ra phyi shag pa dbu rgyan/bstan pa/tshe brtan/dbu chung ra phyi shag pa bsod nams/bzad pa bco lnga/padma tshe ring /phun tshogs/byi pas grasargyal rtse bstan 'dzin/chos dbang /dpal 'byor/pa rnam rab brtan/nor bu/gra phyi nor skyong /bsod nams don grub/gra nang mkhas mchogo/290bskol pa bco lnga/gong dkar bsod namasadabang rgyal/do dam rtse chen pa rgan pa bkra shis rab rgyas/lha rtse lha khang pa kun dga' bsam 'phel/rgyab yig mkhan ye pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor/ngag dbang tshe ring /sri thar/rgyal rtse 'jam dbyangasadabang po/ngag dbang phun tsho gis phogs kyi dgos cha sprod mi byang gling bsam 'grub rgyal pos byas te hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga skor la gegs med du legs par sgrub bo//legs byas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang 'bum//smon lam gser ri'i rtse nas chad med du//shar bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i srid zhi'i mun//nyer sangs phan bde'i snang ba rtag 'bar shog/'di la chu thigs tsam gyis phan pa'i cha//bsgrubs pa'i pha mthar byas pa'i skye rgu kun//ma pham mgon de mchog gi sprul pa'i skur/gyur tshe 'dus pa dang por skye bar shog/nyi ma'i gnyen gyis spyad pa'i rlabs chen spyod//ji bzhin bsgrubs pa'i lhag ༷sam bdag snying stobs//zungs gyur yid dam

sku gsung thugs rten gsar nga zhedas dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (ma)brtan pa'i dga' dang spros/chu mtshor 4 pa bzhin du 'jug nus shog/bzod dka' mi khom gdung ba'i zhugs kyi lce//thar pa'i sa bon ljon par yongs 'bar ba//thugs rje'i char gyis gzhi la ba'i gshin pa'i sar//gtan bde'i tsandan nags klungs rgyas par shog/rgyal bstan 'dzam bu'i ljon pa dar drag las//zhwa ser mnabs pa'i ring lugs sa du tshogs//chos srid rgya mtshor ngo bo ro gcig pa//lus can bde ba'i gser du 'gyur bar shog/thub byin sa chen skyong kun yid zhugasanas//dkar nag las la nges rnyed dge ba bcu//rdzogs par spyad pa'i de gos don yod kyi//bskal pa ding shar rtsod dus mthar byed shog/pā ṇi ka tsan dbyangs can brda sprod pa//sgra don gab tshig sdeb sbyor mdzo brjod gzhung //zlos gar skar rtsis la sbyangs dpyod ldan gyis//kun bzod lus phra'i mngal khur lci bar shog/rgyal ba sras dang slob ma'i mdzad pa rnams//mngon sum mthong byed sor mo'i gar mkhan ma//mkhyen sman ring lugs 291na skod med 'dzin bzod mkhan//gaṅgā'i rdul gyi grangs su bsnyeg par shog/'dren mchog spyan sngar dkar phyogs nyer skyong bar//zhal 'tshes lha dang gnod sbyin stobs po che//kun gyis 'jig rten khams su bde legs pa'i//bkra shis manda ra yi char 'bebs shog/ces rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing gi zhing khams ngo mtshar bkod pa gsar du bskrun pa'i che brjod smon lam du za hor gyi btsun pa tshangs sras bshad pa'i rdo rjes 'gal ba zhes pa lcags mo phag gi lo hor gyi zla ba brgyad pa'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba dang po'i nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor gyi dus dge bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkhas bgyis pa sarba kā le khu bha skyi/sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bri tta las me tog 'phreng can5yab sna rma gas sa kālā ba dwa nod gro lha po dra thamarmā pa thaḥshā sa nā rje:te rje rnam zlum ye grarsha mo snga kṣa sarbadzha chum sha:rgyal gsung chos phung 'byam klas gdams pa sa/'char byed skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi gnad//ston mdzad 'phags bod paṇa grub bzhed gzhung mdud//'grol mkhas thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa/khyod bstan 'dzin rlom dregs pa'i /'dzin rkang //291bsgom dpyod rdo rje gdengs

rgyal dbang lnga pa sha dbang blo rsāng rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (9)nas phyer 'thag pa//dkon cog chos 'phel sngon med legs bris gtso//'jam mgon ngur smig zlos gar sgyur las ci//zab rgyas brgyud pa ma chad mu tig 'phreng //gzugs dbang grangs kyi brisathang rgyu sbyor ba//sa spyod blo bzang mthu stobs lhag bsam mdog/rdul bral ston zlas bsgrun min gcig tu dkar//kā shi'i mkha' la tshon mdangs 'ja' ris can//brgyud pa'i snang bas ye shesasems dpa'i gar//bsgyur bar chos bzang lha yi 'dun sa nas//bi shwa dmi sa 'dir 'ongs pa bzhin//zhes ched du bsngags nas lam rim brgyud pa'i zhal thang lnga bcu rtsa gcig lcags phag hor zla dang po'i zla stod nas dbu mdzad dpal mgon/srad pa bsod nams/pho brang phun tsho gis rong pa tshe dbang rigs 'dzin/mkhar rtse dpon bsam rnams kyis byas hor zla gnyis pa'i nyi shu skor nas//'phyong rgyas 'jam dbyangs/phun tshogs chos 'phel/rong lnga 'dzom pa/tshe bdag/lha khang dgos skyes/mkhar chu 'brug rgyas/dge bcu 'jam dbyangs/mtsho smad tshe brtan/bsod nams rgyal po/gnasarnying lhun grub rdo rje/mkhar lung bsod nams//gong dkar 'jam dbyangs rin cen/mtsho sman rdo rje/rtse gdong bstan 'dzin/lhun rtse rab brtan tshe ring /lho brag mchog grub/'phrang 'go da rka sgo mchog/mtshon sbyor snye mo tshe dbang nor bu rnams kyis tshon mdangs gser ris gib tshags do dam glang ra ba lha dbang tshe 'phel/lha sar ga pa tshe dbang rab brtan/gong gzham pa dbu rpā tshe brtan/dbu chung bzod pa bco lngas gtsos pa'i bzo bo bco brgyad/do dam yol gdong bkras rab/lha rtse lha khang pa/zhal byang yi ge'i 'du byed pa rgyal rtse 'jam dbyangs dbang po/dgos sprod mkhan byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos byas te lcags phag hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du lhun gyis grub bo//'di 'bras sku 292na thas bskrun par gtogos kun dang /mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams mtho ris thar pa'i skas//rim 'dzegs srid zhi'i bde bar spyod bzhin du//bla med sku gsum khang par myur 'jug shog/zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin pa dga' ldan pa'i//bstan pas 'dzam gling khyon yongs khyab pa'i zhar//yid can spyi dang khyad par rgya ho/ /da//bde skyid nor gyis phyur bur gtos par

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho 4sko rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha/ (mnashog/dkon cog gsum gyi thugs rje rgyud mangs po//dad pa'i sor mos bskul ba'i byin mas glu//thos pa'i bde ba chen po snying dbus su//'jug pa'i bkra shis dpal gyis gang bar shog/cesasaskyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis byang chub lam rim brgyud pa'i thang ka gra tshar lnga bcu nga gcig bzhengs pa'i che brjod smon khyadas gi re su da yaḥ maṇḍalā bi:mā yu ha tu pā rā ma kod to māni/byuḥdapal ldan rigs kun khyab bdag zla snang gzugs//grangs med gdul bya'i rdzing bur legs shar ba//dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i sgyu srol//'phreng ba kri ya nyi zla zung 'brel bzhin//tshul 'dir bsgyur 'chad mkhas grub mang byon mthar//'khrul med lugs 'dzin khyab bdag e waṃ pa//kun dga' bzang po brgyud par bcas ba yi//mdzad pas mtha' yas//sna tshogs tshon dang nye ba'i man shel bzhin//ngo mtshar mig gi gzigs mor tshar dngar bas//rang sems dag pa'i me long gtsang ma'i ngos//bskyed rim phyag rgya'i zlos gar sgyur la brel//zhes rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa'i 'dun ba yid ngor rim lus la nye char sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur blangs/ri mo'i 'du byed mkhyen brtse'i lugs la ring du sbyangs pa'i gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi 'bras skrungs slob dpon ngag dbang 'phrin las/dbu chung gsang sngags mkhar pa tshe 'phel/dol 293na sgom rgyal khang sngon pa byams pa rgyal mtshan/srin bu ri pa bsod nams mgon po/sdom brtson rin chen rgyal mtshan/rnam rab thar gling pa bkra shis dpal 'byor/dol rnam rgyal lte byang pa bsod nams 'jam dbyangs/dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling pa ngag dbang mdo sde/tsher shing sbus khyim pa bsod nams mgon po/gsang phu ra ba smad pa kun dga' rab 'phel/zhal byang gi kha yig 'dri mi nyang stod pa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/do dam thon bya sgo ba blo bzang dbang phyug/phogs sogs dgos cha sprod mi byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos byas nas lcags khyi hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la dbu btsugs/lcags phag hor zla dgu pa'i nang du legs par grub bo//dge tsho gis mtho ris yan lag brgyad ldan chus//'gro kun sgrib gnyis bag chags kun bkrus nas//sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs pa'i smin byed lam//nyer bgrod rnam grol rigs kun bdag gyur cig/skye bar yang dag rdo rje'i slob dpon gyis//rjes bzung dbang dang bskyed rdzogs rgyud man ngag/thos bsam sgom par byed pa'i snod ldan du//'gyur bar bla ma lha yis bdag byin rlobs//bsod nams 'di'i ched byed por gtogos so cog/gnas skabs 'chi med bdag po'i bde bar spyod//ring min kha spyor bdun ldan skur bzhengs nas//bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ces dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'phreng ba dang kṛ ya sa muñtsa zung du 'jug pa'i dkyil thang zhe lnga bzhengs pa'i dus/che brjod smon lam du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang gis bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu/ 293bsko ༷ mkho pa'i lhung ngal pritta la lag 'gro'i lhung ban tshwa shakwa lo tsa te ṭa shu tso/nye ta lha ma ro rmā khaX /hi gi lha bi lha pe ta burnya su su lhaXnta ma rtse ji:rdebadwa

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar sha/ (mnarbesgra slu rje/ka 'phreng so bzhir bcu drug dbyangs zhugs gzugs/kha ba ltar dkar shing gi ma mar 'khyil//ga che gsar du bzhengs pa'i che brjod smon lam zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dbyangasadapal bzang gis bgyis pa su sti si ji//sdeb sbyor mnya pa'i bri tta las dbang po rdo rje/rmi re kā dra ṇa mā ya pa dha kā ri ka bā lha lha mi nā ma3paḥ4bya shu ba smur puṭā rsha brdzu stoṅgā ga bhā lha dro4da nā rnyikashrīḥgar dbang thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul pa ni sdom brtson rig sngags 'chang ba 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sirnyi ri/ /sa spru dwa shri ya bha / /mtshan snyan thos pa tsam gyi srid zhi'i gdung / /sel mdzad dus gsum rgyal ba spyi yi gzugs/ /padma thod 'phreng rtsal la thun drug tu/ /gsol ba 'debs pa 'di phyi'i mdun ma'i rtse/ /sgra don rgyan gyis ched du bcos ma dang / /blun rgan grong gtam dum bur bcad min pa/ khugs khrung tshig 'jibs don bzang 'phags yul gyi/ /paṇa chen las gzhan mkhas rlomes su yis nus/ /grangs dang go rim dbye ba lhan thabs rnams/ /dbang rtul du mas nongs pa'i rnyog ma kun/ /nges par padma'i gdung 'tshob rim byon gyi/ /zhal lung ke ta ka yis drungs par byas/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga mi gtogesa'adren pa gzhan/ /gang de'i grangs su gsol 'debs 'khrul ba'i gtam/ /ma zhig zhig por brdzusapa'i brtsams chos kyis/ /blo dman mang dag log rtog drwa bar btsud/ /de phyir mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi/ /yang srid chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa'i/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga gter ston brgya rtsa yi/ /gsol 'debs 'di ko dpyad bzod legs pa'i lam/ /lhag bsam ma dros mtsho chen lasa'ongs pa'i/ /chos sbyin 'dzad pa med pa gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /gangs can skye rgu'i rgya mtshor rtag babs pas/ /phan bde'i rlabs 'phreng dus las yol ba med/ /tshogs gnyis spyi bo'i sha rmen las skyes pa'i/ /(296ba'i gnyis gser gyi 'khor los yongs sgyur bas/ /mtha' gnyis bcom ste lus can ma lusapa/ /don gnyis lhun grub byang chen sar 'khrid shog /ces skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob mar bcasapa'i gsol 'debs sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi bzhed pa ltar dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du brkos pa'i par byang du za hor gyi bzhes bris pa'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tsho gos dbang —354

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag/ (ma)pos bgyis pa dza — //gsol 'debs gong 'og gnyis kyi kha skong cung zad dgos pa gsar du bkod do//sdeng stor mnyam dbyangs//297na po dul bya'i dbang por 'tsham pa'i chos kyi tshad//'phags chen byang sems kyis 'dzin skal phra na//tshur mthong byis pa'i blo yis gzhal nus ci//'on te a mra'i tshi gu chu gter las//len ltar ljongs 'dir sa spyod lo paṇa gyis//snga phyir bsgyur ba'i thub gsung rin cen phreng //dpyod ldan mdzes ba'i do shal 'a du dngar//de tshul 'dri klog lung nod sri zhu sa/bgyis pa'i bsod nams mngon pa//gsal mdzad 'khon rigs 'jam mgon 'phags pa sogs//mkhas mang rnam thar yid sos bdud rtsi'i dbyid//thugs gsang dpal gyi be'ur rnam 'dren bstan//gces 'dzin dam pa du masabatsal ba'i lung //padma'i skud pa rdo rje'i khams kyi gzhir//sgyur mdzad kun dga' rnam rgyal 'gro ba'i mig/gal chung dam pa'i chos su byed dus ding //'bad rtsol rlung gi la ngo tha tsanda dri/'dren mdzad kho bo'i bshes gnyen gnas gsar ba//dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon las gzhan du ci/'dul mdo sher phyogs gsar rgyud pu sta gar//bod rgan blun po'i lhad kyi rnyog ma'i tshogs//dag byed chos kyi spyan ldan bu ston rje'i//ma smad rnam dpyod mtho ris chu bo 'dra//de phyir them spangasaglegs bam sor bzhag la//mdo sgyu sems phyogs sgrub sdo brgyad kyi bskor//snying por sdud mkhasatshal pa thams cad mkhyen//kun dga' rdo rje'i ba yongs 'dzin bgrang byar bzhengs//sdeb gzugs yi ge'i mig 'phrul sgyu ma mkhan//e dbyibs cho so lung dkar po'i 'dzin ma nas//gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa mes po'i bu//du mas sor mo'i zlos gar ci yang rje ngur sgrig 'dzin pa'i gzugs//blo bzang grags snyan rab 'bar btsong kha pa'i//bstan pa dzā ti'i me tog bkrab nas//rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas bar mtshams med khyab shog/ma smad dga' ba'i dpal ldan pho ba'i 'chi med tsho gis kyis manda raḥ/'thor dang lhan cig bden pa gsung ba'i tshig/ba po shis dbyangs kyis dusakun khyab par shog/ces rab byung bcu gcig pa'i yongs 'dzin du 'bod pa chu pho byi ba'i lo sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes mdzad do dam spun drug rdzong pa tshe dbang don grub dang smon grub pa rin cen bkra shis gnyis kyis byas 298na〉ske chos lung dkar po'i dpon yig mkhas bsgrugs bsdus te rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po'i khyab ngam ring pho brang du/'o skol kyi ston pa shākya seng ge'i gsung rab gangs ljongs 'dir 'gyur ba phal che ba rtsod med yongs grags kyi kun mkhyen
